name: Ms. Sunita
school: PM SHRI GGSSS, Sonepat Murthal Adda (3490)
citation: Ms. Sunita is a dedicated and highly effective teacher whose work is marked by a holistic approach to education and active involvement in both her school and community. Teaching since 2014, she has consistently achieved excellent student results, overseen increased enrollment, and reduced dropout rates, particularly in Geography Beyond the classroom, she implemented NEP 2020 through joyful, project-based learning and technology integration. Her initiatives have led her school to achieve State-level cultural champion status and a third-place national ranking. As an active member of organizations such as the Red Cross and Hindustan Scout and Guide, she instills values of selfless service and civic responsibility in her students. She collaborates actively with colleagues to foster a cohesive learning environment, empowering students to become responsible, patriotic citizens while improving environmental practices and social awareness within the community.
core: Innovative pedagogy and promotion of civic responsibility.
t_en: Project-based Geography with civic service clubs
t_hi: प्रोजेक्ट आधारित भूगोल और नागरिक सेवा क्लब
s_hi: भूगोल को आनंददायी प्रोजेक्ट और तकनीक से पढ़ाया; रेड क्रॉस व स्काउट-गाइड से बच्चों में सेवा भाव जगाया, नामांकन बढ़ा और ड्रॉपआउट घटा।
steps_en: Turn one Geography chapter into a 2-week group project (local map, weather log or survey) and end with a gallery walk
Start a weekly 'service hour' linked to Scouts/Red Cross: cleanliness, first aid, tree care
Track attendance and dropout monthly and celebrate improvement in assembly
steps_hi: एक भूगोल अध्याय को 2 हफ्ते के समूह प्रोजेक्ट (स्थानीय नक्शा, मौसम डायरी, सर्वे) में बदलें और गैलरी वॉक से समापन करें
स्काउट/रेड क्रॉस से जुड़ा साप्ताहिक 'सेवा घंटा' शुरू करें: सफाई, प्राथमिक उपचार, पौधों की देखभाल
हर महीने उपस्थिति व ड्रॉपआउट का रिकॉर्ड देखें और प्रार्थना सभा में सुधार का उत्सव मनाएँ
scene: Indian government-school girls in a courtyard drawing a large chalk map of their district, a teacher guiding, Scout scarves visible, students holding a hand-made weather chart

name: Mr. Shashi Paul
school: GOVT. MODEL CENTRE, PRIMARY SCHOOL, Shamror
citation: Mr. Shashi Paul is a dedicated teacher who consistently enhances educational opportunities in resource-limited settings. His pedagogy focuses on multi-grade, multi-level strategies, joyful learning with low-cost aids, and fostering a collaborative and inclusive classroom environment. He institutionalized structured sports training, leading students to state-level success in chess and badminton. Students from underprivileged backgrounds have secured admissions to prestigious institutions like Lawrence School. Beyond the classroom, Mr. Paul is a committed grassroots innovator. He developed English workbooks, established ICT and experiential learning labs, and mobilized community support from NGOs and local clubs to improve school infrastructure. His efforts resulted in increased student enrollment, improved attendance, and a more child-friendly school environment, exemplifying his profound impact on students and the community.
core: Institutionalized structured sports training and innovative pedagogy.
t_en: Multi-grade, multi-level teaching with low-cost aids
t_hi: बहुकक्षा-बहुस्तरीय शिक्षण और कम लागत TLM
s_hi: संसाधनों की कमी वाले स्कूल में बहुकक्षा शिक्षण, कम लागत TLM, अंग्रेज़ी वर्कबुक, ICT लैब और शतरंज-बैडमिंटन का नियमित प्रशिक्षण चलाया।
steps_en: Group children by learning level (not class) for 30 minutes daily and give each group a level-wise worksheet
Make a self-made English workbook with local pictures and simple tasks
Fix a weekly sports/chess period with a practice log and invite a local club as coach
steps_hi: रोज़ 30 मिनट बच्चों को कक्षा के बजाय सीखने के स्तर के अनुसार समूह में बाँटें और हर समूह को स्तरानुसार वर्कशीट दें
स्थानीय चित्रों वाली सरल अंग्रेज़ी वर्कबुक खुद बनाएँ
हर हफ्ते खेल/शतरंज का तय पीरियड रखें, अभ्यास रजिस्टर बनाएँ और स्थानीय क्लब को कोच के रूप में बुलाएँ
scene: A single hill-village primary classroom with three small groups of different ages working on different coloured worksheets, one group playing chess, teacher moving between groups

name: Mr. Narinder Singh
citation: Mr. Narinder Singh demonstrated exceptional dedication and initiative in school development, transforming a struggling institution into a well-equipped learning environment. Recognizing the poor condition of existing facilities, he actively engaged with the community, mobilizing parents, former students, and various stakeholders to secure support and funding. This collaborative approach was crucial in establishing 15 new classrooms, complete with modern amenities. His efforts extended beyond basic infrastructure to include specialized facilities like an IT Park, smart library, math park, and even an herbal garden, indicating a holistic vision for student growth. The emphasis on practical learning is evident with the establishment of a traffic training park and various sports courts. Furthermore, the inclusion of essential utilities such as a water harvesting system, generator, and Wi-Fi highlights his commitment to providing a conducive learning atmosphere. The personal investment of working "12 to 16 hours" daily underscores his profound dedication, which directly resulted in over 20 percent annual increase in school enrolment, showcasing the tangible impact of his leadership and tireless work.
core: Development of the School as a holistic educational ecosystem.
t_en: Community-funded holistic school campus (math park, herbal garden)
t_hi: समुदाय सहयोग से समग्र विद्यालय परिसर (गणित पार्क, हर्बल गार्डन)
s_hi: अभिभावकों, पूर्व छात्रों व समाज को जोड़कर 15 नए कमरे, IT पार्क, स्मार्ट लाइब्रेरी, गणित पार्क, हर्बल गार्डन व ट्रैफिक पार्क बनवाए; नामांकन हर साल 20% बढ़ा।
steps_en: List 3 small needs (e.g., math wall, garden bed) and present them at an SMC/alumni meeting with a cost sheet
Paint a 'math park' on the floor/wall: number line, hopscotch tables, shapes
Display a public 'thank-you board' for every donor to build trust
steps_hi: 3 छोटी ज़रूरतें (जैसे गणित दीवार, क्यारी) तय करें और SMC/पूर्व छात्र बैठक में खर्च सहित रखें
फर्श/दीवार पर 'गणित पार्क' पेंट करें: संख्या रेखा, पहाड़ा-स्टापू, आकृतियाँ
हर दानदाता के लिए सार्वजनिक 'धन्यवाद बोर्ड' लगाएँ ताकि विश्वास बढ़े
scene: A bright rural Punjab primary school courtyard with a painted number-line hopscotch, an herbal garden with labelled plants, children playing a maths game, parents watching

name: Mr. Awadhesh Kumar Jha
citation: Mr. Jha has launched an innovative initiative, “Dil ki baat”, to connect with students of Classes 5, 6, 9, and 12, offering them a safe environment to share their thoughts without being judged. He established the Zero Waste Citizen Bank, where students deposit dry waste to inculcate the philosophy of Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle. He created the ‘Shobhit Reading Room’, accommodating 70 students, accessible from 8 am to 8 pm on all 365 days, providing access to books, computers, and the internet. To foster joyful learning, he set up an Activity Room, a COVID-time Stress Buster Room, and a Junior Science Lab with NGO support, resulting in emotional well-being and hands-on learning. Mr. Jha also established a Heart-to-Heart Lounge to support personality development, time management, communication skills, and meditation.
core: Psychosocial support and socio-emotional learning.
t_en: "Dil ki Baat" safe-talk sessions and Zero-Waste Citizen Bank
t_hi: "दिल की बात" संवाद और ज़ीरो वेस्ट सिटीज़न बैंक
s_hi: बच्चों के लिए बिना-जजमेंट बात करने का "दिल की बात" मंच, सूखा कचरा जमा करने वाला ज़ीरो वेस्ट बैंक, 365 दिन खुला रीडिंग रूम और स्ट्रेस-बस्टर कमरा बनाया।
steps_en: Keep a weekly 20-minute 'Dil ki Baat' circle with ground rules: no judging, no sharing outside
Put a 'feelings box' for anonymous notes and reply in general advice talks
Start a dry-waste bank: students deposit sorted waste, earn points, points buy stationery
steps_hi: हर हफ्ते 20 मिनट का 'दिल की बात' घेरा रखें, नियम: कोई जज नहीं करेगा, बात बाहर नहीं जाएगी
गुमनाम पर्चियों के लिए 'भावना पेटी' रखें और सामान्य सलाह-वार्ता में जवाब दें
सूखा-कचरा बैंक शुरू करें: बच्चे छँटा कचरा जमा करें, अंक कमाएँ, अंकों से स्टेशनरी लें
scene: Children sitting in a calm circle on mats in a Delhi government school room, one speaking while others listen, a 'feelings box' and a waste-sorting 'bank' counter with labelled bins in the background

name: Ms. Manjubala
citation: Ms. Manjubala, the Principal of a Government Primary School in a remote area of Uttarakhand, has demonstrated a strong commitment to education. She has spearheaded innovative initiatives aligned with the National Education Policy 2020, promoting mother-tongue-based teaching, creating an inclusive learning environment, and utilizing activity-based methods to foster critical thinking. She strengthened Foundational Literacy and Numeracy through engaging TLM-based activities, developed a continuous assessment system for remedial support, ensuring all students achieve proficiency. She has leveraged technology, including smart classrooms and digital teaching materials, established a safe school environment through platforms like Bal Sabha, and organized awareness campaigns on menstrual hygiene and child marriage to empower girls. Her contributions have earned numerous accolades, including the Anmol Ratna Award, Teacher of the Year 2020 by the State HRD, Best Social Worker, and the title of Iron Lady from a national-level Human Rights Organization.
core: Democratization of school processes and Foundational Literacy and Numeracy
t_en: Mother-tongue FLN with continuous assessment and Bal Sabha
t_hi: मातृभाषा आधारित FLN, सतत आकलन और बाल सभा
s_hi: दूरस्थ स्कूल में मातृभाषा से शिक्षण, TLM आधारित FLN गतिविधियाँ, उपचारात्मक सहायता हेतु सतत आकलन, बाल सभा और बालिकाओं के लिए मासिक धर्म स्वच्छता व बाल विवाह जागरूकता।
steps_en: Start each FLN lesson with a local-language story or rhyme, then bridge to Hindi/English words
Keep a one-page tracker per child (letters, words, numbers) and update every 2 weeks
Run a weekly Bal Sabha where children chair, plan and speak
steps_hi: हर FLN पाठ स्थानीय बोली की कहानी/कविता से शुरू करें, फिर हिंदी/अंग्रेज़ी शब्दों से जोड़ें
हर बच्चे का एक-पेज ट्रैकर (अक्षर, शब्द, संख्या) रखें और हर 2 हफ्ते अपडेट करें
साप्ताहिक बाल सभा चलाएँ जिसमें बच्चे ही अध्यक्षता, योजना और भाषण करें
scene: Young children in a mountain-village primary school sitting in a circle with picture cards in their local language, a teacher holding a progress chart, a 'Bal Sabha' banner made by children

name: Ms. Parveen Kumari
school: Government Girls Model Senior Secondary School
citation: Ms. Parveen Kumari is instrumental in showcasing a teaching philosophy that is dynamic and student-centered, moving beyond traditional methods. She effectively uses hands-on projects, such as an herbal nursery and a kitchen garden, to connect theoretical knowledge with practical application and foster a sense of environmental responsibility. Her integration of technology is another key element, demonstrated by the two YouTube channels she has launched to provide accessible and engaging learning content. Ms. Kumari’s teaching approach prioritizes 21st-century skills, utilizing innovative tools like a "broken spherical structure" to make history lessons more engaging and interactive. She also organizes educational excursions to provide students with real-world learning experiences. Through these diverse strategies, Ms. Parveen Kumari demonstrates her dedication to nurturing well-rounded and inquisitive individuals.
core: Innovative pedagogic approach and use of ICT
t_en: Herbal nursery, kitchen garden and teacher YouTube channels
t_hi: हर्बल नर्सरी, किचन गार्डन और शिक्षक के यूट्यूब चैनल
s_hi: हर्बल नर्सरी व किचन गार्डन जैसे प्रोजेक्ट से सिद्धांत को व्यवहार से जोड़ा, दो यूट्यूब चैनल चलाए और इतिहास को रचनात्मक मॉडल से रोचक बनाया।
steps_en: Allot a small garden bed per class and link each task (seed, soil, growth) to a textbook concept
Record 3-minute phone videos of key concepts and share via a class WhatsApp/YouTube playlist
Use a simple 3D model or prop for one History lesson each month
steps_hi: हर कक्षा को एक छोटी क्यारी दें और हर काम (बीज, मिट्टी, बढ़त) को पाठ की अवधारणा से जोड़ें
मुख्य अवधारणाओं के 3 मिनट के मोबाइल वीडियो बनाकर कक्षा व्हाट्सऐप/यूट्यूब प्लेलिस्ट में साझा करें
हर महीने एक इतिहास पाठ में सरल 3D मॉडल या वस्तु का प्रयोग करें
scene: Teenage girls in a Chandigarh government school planting herbs in labelled pots, one student filming on a phone, a teacher explaining plant parts

name: Ms. Neelam Yadav
citation: Ms. Neelam Yadav is a committed educator and school leader who has driven remarkable transformation at her school. Her leadership has resulted in consistently excellent academic results, including 100% board class results for four consecutive years and multiple district toppers. To overcome resource limitations, she successfully secured CSR funding for a digital lab with 60 tablets and smart classrooms, bridging the digital divide and creating an engaging learning environment. She implemented "No Bag Day" with hands-on activities, organized career counselling, and established a STEM lab. Her efforts in co-curricular activities have led to students winning numerous awards, including the Gargi award for academic excellence and bronze in state-level wrestling.
core: Bridging the digital divide and inculcation of scientific temper
t_en: CSR tablet lab, No-Bag Day and STEM lab
t_hi: CSR टैबलेट लैब, नो-बैग डे और STEM लैब
s_hi: CSR से 60 टैबलेट की डिजिटल लैब व स्मार्ट क्लास बनवाई, "नो बैग डे" पर गतिविधियाँ, करियर काउंसलिंग और STEM लैब शुरू की; चार साल लगातार 100% बोर्ड परिणाम।
steps_en: Prepare a one-page CSR proposal (need, students served, budget) and send to nearby companies/banks
Declare one Saturday a month as No-Bag Day with hands-on stations (science, craft, quiz)
Hold a career talk each term with a local professional
steps_hi: एक-पेज CSR प्रस्ताव (ज़रूरत, लाभार्थी बच्चे, बजट) बनाकर नज़दीकी कंपनियों/बैंकों को भेजें
महीने का एक शनिवार नो-बैग डे घोषित करें, जिसमें हाथ से करने वाले स्टेशन हों (विज्ञान, शिल्प, क्विज़)
हर टर्म किसी स्थानीय पेशेवर की करियर वार्ता रखें
scene: Rajasthan village girls in a bright digital lab using tablets in pairs, another table with a simple STEM model, 'No Bag Day' poster on the wall

name: Ms. Bhaviniben Dineshbhai Desai
addr: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu - 396210
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
citation: Ms. Bhaviniben Dineshbhai Desai, a dedicated educator with over 26 years of service at GUPS Bhensroad, has demonstrated exceptional leadership and commitment. As an In-charge Head Teacher, she has actively contributed to various Government duties and held key roles like Complex Head and Sports Convener. Her innovative teaching methods include using smart TVs and creating low-cost teaching aids from waste materials. These efforts have not only enhanced learning but also led to her school winning the District Champion Shield in sports for four consecutive years. She has successfully reduced student dropouts through community engagement and parental awareness. During the COVID-19 pandemic, her dedication was reflected as she delivered rations and provided home-based learning. Smt. Desai's first-place win at the Daman Innovation Fair highlights her continuous pursuit of educational excellence.
core: Community engagement and parental awareness
t_en: Waste-material TLMs and parent awareness to stop dropouts
t_hi: कबाड़ से TLM और ड्रॉपआउट रोकने हेतु अभिभावक जागरूकता
s_hi: कबाड़ से कम लागत शिक्षण सामग्री, स्मार्ट टीवी का उपयोग, अभिभावक जागरूकता से ड्रॉपआउट में कमी; कोविड में राशन और घर-आधारित पढ़ाई पहुँचाई।
steps_en: Run a 'Best out of Waste' TLM day: bottle caps for counting, cartons for shapes
Visit homes of irregular students with a simple attendance card for parents
Hold quarterly parent meets showing children's work
steps_hi: 'कबाड़ से जुगाड़' TLM दिवस करें: गिनती के लिए ढक्कन, आकृतियों के लिए डिब्बे
अनियमित बच्चों के घर जाएँ और अभिभावकों को सरल उपस्थिति कार्ड दें
हर तिमाही अभिभावक बैठक में बच्चों का काम दिखाएँ
scene: Primary children sorting colourful bottle caps into number trays, teacher holding a cardboard shape model, mothers watching at the classroom door in a coastal Daman school

name: Mr. Vilas Ramnath Satarkar
school: Dr. K. B. Hedgewar High School, Cujira Bambolim
citation: Mr. Vilas Ramnath Satarkar, the Headmaster of Dr. K. B. Hedgewar High School, has dedicated over 29 years to education. He has taken a proactive approach, focusing on inclusive education, establishing an academic resource room for students with special needs, and implementing mentorship programs that extend through higher education. Mr. Vilas has also been a key figure in educational policy, serving on the State Level Steering Committee for NEP 2020 and as President of the Goa Headmasters Association. He actively promotes cultural literacy, community engagement, and civic responsibility by organizing blood donation drives and enhancing school infrastructure through CSR initiatives. His numerous recognitions, including the State Teachers Award 2021 and Lokmat Goan of the Year 2024, affirm his impactful contributions to education.
core: Leadership in education and community engagement
t_en: Resource room for special needs and mentorship to higher studies
t_hi: विशेष आवश्यकता वाले बच्चों के लिए रिसोर्स रूम और मेंटरशिप
s_hi: विशेष आवश्यकता वाले छात्रों के लिए अकादमिक रिसोर्स रूम, उच्च शिक्षा तक मेंटरशिप, CSR से अवसंरचना और सामुदायिक कार्यक्रम।
steps_en: Set up a corner/room with large-print books, tactile charts and quiet seating for CWSN
Pair each senior student with one alumni mentor who calls monthly
Keep an individual education plan (IEP) sheet for each CWSN child
steps_hi: CWSN के लिए बड़े अक्षरों की किताबें, स्पर्श चार्ट व शांत बैठक वाला कोना/कमरा बनाएँ
हर वरिष्ठ छात्र को एक पूर्व छात्र मेंटर से जोड़ें जो हर महीने बात करे
हर CWSN बच्चे की व्यक्तिगत शिक्षा योजना (IEP) शीट रखें
scene: A calm, colourful resource room in a Goa high school, a teacher helping a child with a tactile chart, another student using a magnifier, shelves of large-print books

name: Mr. Hitesh Kumar Pravinchandra Bhundiya
citation: Mr. Hitesh Kumar Pravinchandra Bhundiya is a highly accomplished science educator and Headmaster at Shri Swaminarayan Gurukul Vidyalaya, with a career marked by innovation, mentorship, and a deep commitment to student development. His journey began as a Junior Scientist, and he has become a key figure in promoting hands-on, experiential science education. He secured a ₹20 lakh grant to establish an Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL), enabling his students to compete and win awards in national and international events like the World's Biggest Robotic Olympiad. His mentorship has inspired students to excel, including a student receiving a research patent for a cotton spinning machine prototype, and others representing India at international science fairs. Beyond the classroom, Mr. Hitesh Kumar has contributed significantly to the community, including designing a patented alkaline water filter and organizing initiatives like "Vigyan Safar" and water recharge projects. During the COVID-19 pandemic, he created interactive educational videos to ensure continuous learning. His dedication has been recognized with numerous accolades, including the Gujarat State Best Teacher Award and the Skillprint Science Excellence Award, affirming his transformative impact on students and the broader community.
core: STEM promotion and patent intellectual property rights.
t_en: Atal Tinkering Lab, patents and "Vigyan Safar"
t_hi: अटल टिंकरिंग लैब, पेटेंट और "विज्ञान सफ़र"
s_hi: ₹20 लाख की अटल टिंकरिंग लैब, रोबोटिक्स ओलंपियाड में सफलता, छात्र को पेटेंट, "विज्ञान सफ़र" व जल-रिचार्ज प्रोजेक्ट; कोविड में इंटरैक्टिव वीडियो।
steps_en: Start a weekly tinkering club with a 'problem box' of local problems students choose from
Teach students to keep an idea logbook (problem, sketch, test, result)
Guide one project a year toward INSPIRE-MANAK or a patent/innovation fair
steps_hi: हर हफ्ते टिंकरिंग क्लब चलाएँ और स्थानीय समस्याओं का 'समस्या डिब्बा' रखें जिसमें से बच्चे चुनें
बच्चों को आइडिया लॉगबुक रखना सिखाएँ (समस्या, स्केच, परीक्षण, परिणाम)
हर साल कम से कम एक प्रोजेक्ट INSPIRE-MANAK या नवाचार मेले तक ले जाएँ
scene: Students in a tinkering lab building a small spinning-machine prototype and a robot, idea logbooks open, a science teacher observing, Gujarati school setting

name: Mr. Hirenkumar Hasmukhbhai Sharma
citation: Mr. Hirenkumar is an innovative teacher who has consistently focused on the holistic development of his students by integrating traditional values with modern teaching methods. His learner-centric approach is reflected in the development and implementation of activity-based learning modules, the creation of localized educational content in Gujarati, and the strategic use of digital tools like DIKSHA and YouTube to enhance classroom engagement. He has a strong commitment to fostering scientific thinking by encouraging students to participate in various science exhibitions, competitive programs like the Inspire Awards, and scholarship exams such as NMMS and Gyan Sadhana. These initiatives have led to admission of students in prestigious institutions and State-level recognition for him.
core: Innovative pedagogy and inculcation of scientific temper.
t_en: Gujarati activity modules with DIKSHA and scholarship prep
t_hi: गुजराती गतिविधि मॉड्यूल, दीक्षा और छात्रवृत्ति तैयारी
s_hi: गुजराती में स्थानीय गतिविधि मॉड्यूल, दीक्षा व यूट्यूब का उपयोग, विज्ञान प्रदर्शनी, INSPIRE व NMMS/ज्ञान साधना परीक्षाओं की तैयारी।
steps_en: Rewrite one textbook activity in the local language with local examples
Scan DIKSHA QR codes in class weekly and discuss the video
Run a 20-minute daily practice for NMMS-type reasoning questions from Class 7
steps_hi: एक पाठ्यपुस्तक गतिविधि को स्थानीय भाषा व उदाहरणों में दोबारा लिखें
हर हफ्ते कक्षा में दीक्षा QR कोड स्कैन करें और वीडियो पर चर्चा करें
कक्षा 7 से रोज़ 20 मिनट NMMS जैसे तर्क प्रश्नों का अभ्यास कराएँ
scene: Rural Gujarat primary students scanning a QR code in a textbook with a tablet, activity cards with Gujarati words on the desk, a small science exhibit nearby

name: Ms. Sheela Patel
citation: Ms. Sheela Patel is a primary teacher who has made significant contributions to her school and community by creating an enjoyable and child-friendly learning environment. She is especially dedicated to inclusive and community-based education. She has consistently achieved a 100% exam result by ensuring regular attendance, even using her own vehicle to bring students to school. She is a pioneer in implementing FLN (Foundational Literacy and Numeracy) activities, creating zero-cost TLMs, and engaging mothers in FLN workshops to extend learning into the home. Her innovative use of technology, such as showing educational videos on tablets and laptops and using QR codes to provide information about plants, has made learning more engaging. Beyond the classroom, she has initiated educational panels and "learning palaces" in local communities, organized summer and winter camps for students, and conducted women's literacy classes during holidays. Her efforts have not only improved the academic results of students but have also instilled social values and a sense of community responsibility.
core: Community-centric approach, blending innovative FLN methods.
t_en: Zero-cost FLN TLMs and mothers' FLN workshops
t_hi: शून्य लागत FLN TLM और माताओं की FLN कार्यशाला
s_hi: शून्य लागत TLM, माताओं के लिए FLN कार्यशाला, पौधों पर QR कोड, समुदाय में "लर्निंग पैलेस", शिविर और छुट्टियों में महिला साक्षरता कक्षाएँ; 100% परिणाम।
steps_en: Make 5 zero-cost TLMs (stone counters, leaf letters, bottle abacus) with children
Hold a monthly 'Mothers' FLN Workshop' showing 3 games they can play at home
Stick QR codes on school plants linking to a short info page/video
steps_hi: बच्चों के साथ 5 शून्य लागत TLM बनाएँ (पत्थर गिनती, पत्तों के अक्षर, बोतल अबेकस)
हर महीने 'माताओं की FLN कार्यशाला' में 3 ऐसे खेल दिखाएँ जो घर पर खेले जा सकें
विद्यालय के पौधों पर QR कोड लगाएँ जो छोटी जानकारी/वीडियो खोलें
scene: Mothers and small children sitting together on a mat outside a Madhya Pradesh village school playing number games with stones and leaves, a teacher demonstrating, QR tags on nearby plants

name: Mr. Bherulal Osara
citation: Mr. Bherulal Osara’s comprehensive and innovative approach to education extends beyond the classroom. His pedagogical methods, such as play-based, collaborative, and project-based learning, created an engaging environment for students. The flipped classroom model and daily activities like ‘exit tickets’ encouraged critical thinking and active participation. He focused on holistic student development, engaging parents and improving school management through initiatives like PTM-based monitoring and self-attendance tracking.
core: Innovative pedagogy and community engagement.
t_en: Flipped classroom and daily exit tickets
t_hi: फ्लिप्ड क्लासरूम और रोज़ाना एग्ज़िट टिकट
s_hi: खेल, सहयोगी व प्रोजेक्ट आधारित शिक्षण, फ्लिप्ड क्लासरूम, रोज़ाना "एग्ज़िट टिकट", PTM आधारित निगरानी और स्व-उपस्थिति ट्रैकिंग।
steps_en: At the end of every period give a 1-question 'exit ticket' slip; sort them to plan the next day
Send a short video/reading before class and use class time for doing and discussing
Let students mark their own attendance on a wall chart
steps_hi: हर पीरियड के अंत में 1 प्रश्न वाली 'एग्ज़िट टिकट' पर्ची दें; उन्हें छाँटकर अगले दिन की योजना बनाएँ
कक्षा से पहले छोटा वीडियो/पाठ भेजें और कक्षा का समय करने व चर्चा में लगाएँ
बच्चे दीवार चार्ट पर अपनी उपस्थिति स्वयं दर्ज करें
scene: Middle-school students in a village classroom dropping small paper 'exit tickets' into a box by the door, teacher sorting slips into three trays labelled Got it / Almost / Need help

name: Dr. Pragya Singh
citation: Dr. Pragya Singh has spent 17 years as a significant force in rural education, tackling issues like parental drug addiction and lack of educational awareness. Her efforts began by engaging parents, particularly mothers, leading to a remarkable 100% attendance rate for girls. She is an educational innovator, having created a self-funded "Adarsh Math Lab" and a "Maths Park" to make learning joyful. She also developed an "Ullas Kendra" using everyday household items to teach basic literacy and numeracy. This dedication has yielded exceptional academic results, with 23 students selected for NMMSE and others for prestigious institutions like Shrestha and Prayas. Beyond the classroom, Dr. Singh has led impactful social campaigns on drug eradication and girl education, securing corporate partnerships for initiatives like the free distribution of sanitary napkins.
core: Educational awareness and 100% attendance rate for girls.
t_en: Self-funded Math Lab, Maths Park and "Ullas Kendra"
t_hi: स्वयं वित्तपोषित गणित लैब, गणित पार्क और "उल्लास केंद्र"
s_hi: माताओं को जोड़कर बालिकाओं की 100% उपस्थिति, खुद के खर्च से आदर्श गणित लैब व गणित पार्क, घरेलू वस्तुओं से "उल्लास केंद्र"; नशा उन्मूलन व बालिका शिक्षा अभियान।
steps_en: Collect household items (bangles, matchboxes, spoons) for a maths kit: fractions, measurement, patterns
Meet mothers of girls with low attendance and agree on a simple attendance pledge
Paint outdoor maths games (number snake, shape hopscotch)
steps_hi: घरेलू वस्तुओं (चूड़ियाँ, माचिस की डिब्बियाँ, चम्मच) से गणित किट बनाएँ: भिन्न, माप, पैटर्न
कम उपस्थिति वाली बालिकाओं की माताओं से मिलें और सरल उपस्थिति संकल्प लें
बाहर ज़मीन पर गणित खेल पेंट करें (संख्या साँप, आकृति स्टापू)
scene: Girls in a Chhattisgarh middle school using bangles and matchboxes to show fractions, a painted maths park outside, mothers attending a meeting under a tree

name: Mr. Kuldeep Gupta
citation: Mr. Kuldeep Gupta, an educator since 1992, has a deep commitment to innovative, experiential learning. He is known for creating low-cost teaching aids and mentoring students for national competitions like the National Children Science Congress, successfully representing the Jammu Division. He serves as a resource person for DIET Jammu and JKSCERT. Mr. Gupta has significantly improved school enrolment and reduced dropout rates through proactive community engagement. His dedication to student counselling, drug de-addiction awareness, and focus on academic excellence has earned him district and state-level recognition.
core: Community engagement.
t_en: Low-cost science aids and Children's Science Congress mentoring
t_hi: कम लागत विज्ञान सामग्री और बाल विज्ञान कांग्रेस मेंटरिंग
s_hi: कम लागत शिक्षण सहायक सामग्री, राष्ट्रीय बाल विज्ञान कांग्रेस में मार्गदर्शन, समुदाय जुड़ाव से नामांकन बढ़ाना, नशा मुक्ति व छात्र परामर्श।
steps_en: Build one low-cost model per chapter (straw, balloon, bottle) and keep a model shelf
Help a student team pick a local problem for the Children's Science Congress and do a field survey
Hold a term-wise counselling talk on drug-abuse awareness
steps_hi: हर अध्याय का एक कम लागत मॉडल (स्ट्रॉ, गुब्बारा, बोतल) बनाएँ और मॉडल शेल्फ रखें
बाल विज्ञान कांग्रेस के लिए छात्र टीम को स्थानीय समस्या चुनने और फील्ड सर्वे करने में मदद करें
हर टर्म नशा जागरूकता पर परामर्श वार्ता रखें
scene: Jammu high-school students presenting a field-survey poster and a bottle-and-balloon model at a science congress table, teacher mentoring

name: Mr. Ram Lal Singh Yadav
citation: Mr. Ram Lal Singh Yadav is a dedicated educator who has transformed a rural school into a Center of Excellence through innovation and community engagement. By pioneering ICT-based smart classes and enrolling his own children in the school, he built a strong foundation of trust and modernized the learning environment. This commitment has led to remarkable student success, with over 153 students securing national scholarships—a clear testament to the school's high academic standards. His efforts also earned the school the prestigious Utkrishta Vidyalaya Award twice.
core: Created a high-performing academic environment.
t_en: ICT smart classes and scholarship success in a rural school
t_hi: ग्रामीण विद्यालय में ICT स्मार्ट क्लास और छात्रवृत्ति सफलता
s_hi: ICT स्मार्ट क्लास शुरू कीं, अपने बच्चों का दाखिला इसी विद्यालय में कराकर विश्वास बनाया; 153 से अधिक छात्रों को राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति मिली।
steps_en: Use one projector/TV period daily with curated short videos tied to the lesson
Publish a 'scholarship calendar' (NMMS, Navodaya, state exams) and run practice tests
Invite parents to see a smart-class lesson to build trust
steps_hi: रोज़ एक पीरियड प्रोजेक्टर/टीवी पर पाठ से जुड़े चुने हुए छोटे वीडियो दिखाएँ
'छात्रवृत्ति कैलेंडर' (NMMS, नवोदय, राज्य परीक्षाएँ) लगाएँ और अभ्यास परीक्षा कराएँ
विश्वास बनाने के लिए अभिभावकों को स्मार्ट क्लास का पाठ दिखाने बुलाएँ
scene: An Uttar Pradesh village upper-primary classroom with a smart TV lesson, parents sitting at the back watching, a scholarship-exam calendar on the wall

name: Ms. Madhurima Tiwari
school: P M Shri Composite Vidyalaya Rani Karnawati
citation: Ms. Madhurima Tiwari has made a significant contribution to education by transforming a dilapidated school into a modern, thriving institution. Her journey began in rural areas, where enrolment increased and infrastructure improved. After being transferred to Rani Karnawati Primary School, she revitalized a nearly ruined campus with low student enrolment. She also pioneered a "green school" initiative, which earned the school a Green School Award. Her dedication has led to a significant increase in enrolment.
core: Transforming a dilapidated school into a vibrant school.
t_en: Reviving a ruined campus as a Green School
t_hi: जर्जर परिसर को ग्रीन स्कूल में बदलना
s_hi: लगभग खंडहर हो चुके कम नामांकन वाले विद्यालय को आधुनिक बनाया, "ग्रीन स्कूल" पहल से ग्रीन स्कूल अवार्ड मिला और नामांकन बढ़ा।
steps_en: Do a 'campus walk' with children and list what to fix first; make it a class project
Start a green corner: plants per child, compost pit, water-saving rules
Share before/after photos with parents and the panchayat
steps_hi: बच्चों के साथ 'परिसर भ्रमण' करें और पहले क्या सुधारना है उसकी सूची बनाएँ; इसे कक्षा प्रोजेक्ट बनाएँ
हरित कोना शुरू करें: हर बच्चे का पौधा, कम्पोस्ट गड्ढा, पानी बचाने के नियम
पहले/बाद की तस्वीरें अभिभावकों और पंचायत से साझा करें
scene: Split scene of an old cracked school building turning into a freshly painted green campus with plants, children watering saplings, teacher with a 'Green School' plaque

name: Ms. Kumari Nidhi
citation: Ms. Kumari Nidhi is a grassroots enabler who uses teaching as a powerful tool for social upliftment in marginalized communities. She turned landless schools into thriving institutions through her resourceful approach. She created the "Nipun Balmanch," a child-centric learning model that inspired a state-level e-magazine and made education joyful and effective. Her social initiatives have prevented dozens of girls from child marriage and re-enrolled them in school by mobilizing the community through campaigns like "Our School Our Responsibility," which built and sustained school infrastructure. Her efforts have resulted in remarkable student retention and high FLN proficiency, earning her recognition in the India Book of Records.
core: Systemic change in education.
t_en: "Nipun Balmanch" child-led learning and anti-child-marriage campaign
t_hi: "निपुण बालमंच" बाल-केंद्रित शिक्षा और बाल विवाह रोको अभियान
s_hi: भूमिहीन विद्यालयों को सक्षम बनाया, "निपुण बालमंच" मॉडल (जिससे राज्य स्तरीय ई-पत्रिका बनी), "हमारा विद्यालय हमारी ज़िम्मेदारी" अभियान से बाल विवाह रोका व बालिकाओं का पुनः नामांकन कराया।
steps_en: Form a 'Balmanch' where children run reading, rhyme and number games for 30 minutes daily
Publish children's drawings and writing in a simple wall/e-magazine every month
Run a village campaign meeting with a public pledge against child marriage
steps_hi: 'बालमंच' बनाएँ जहाँ बच्चे रोज़ 30 मिनट पठन, कविता व संख्या खेल चलाएँ
हर महीने बच्चों के चित्र व लेखन को दीवार/ई-पत्रिका में प्रकाशित करें
गाँव में बाल विवाह के विरुद्ध सार्वजनिक संकल्प वाली अभियान बैठक करें
scene: Bihar primary children on a small stage leading a rhyme and number game for peers, a hand-made 'Balmanch' banner, villagers holding a pledge banner in background

name: Mr. Dilip Kumar
school: Lalit Narayan Laxmi Narayan Project Girls High School
citation: Mr. Dilip Kumar’s core contribution is his dedication to cultivating scientific thinking and a passion for STEM among students. He has guided students to achieve success at state and national levels, primarily through activity-based learning and the innovative use of technology. His efforts to bridge the digital divide have been particularly impactful, equipping students with skills to use digital tools and modern technology. By establishing an Atal Tinkering Lab, he provides students with a dynamic platform to work on projects, boosting their confidence and preparing them for future careers in science and technology.
core: Cultivating scientific thinking and a passion for STEM among students.
t_en: Atal Tinkering Lab for girls and digital skills
t_hi: बालिकाओं के लिए अटल टिंकरिंग लैब और डिजिटल कौशल
s_hi: गतिविधि आधारित व तकनीक युक्त शिक्षण से STEM में रुचि, डिजिटल डिवाइड कम करना और अटल टिंकरिंग लैब से प्रोजेक्ट कार्य।
steps_en: Give girls first access to lab/computer slots in a fixed weekly timetable
Run 6-week mini-projects (sensor alarm, solar lamp) in teams of 4
Show the finished projects to parents to build support for girls in STEM
steps_hi: साप्ताहिक समय-सारिणी में लैब/कंप्यूटर स्लॉट पहले बालिकाओं को दें
4-4 की टीम में 6 हफ्ते के मिनी प्रोजेक्ट (सेंसर अलार्म, सोलर लैंप) करवाएँ
STEM में बालिकाओं के प्रति समर्थन बढ़ाने हेतु तैयार प्रोजेक्ट अभिभावकों को दिखाएँ
scene: Teenage girls in a Bihar school tinkering lab wiring a small solar lamp and a sensor alarm, laptops open, a male teacher assisting

name: Ms. Sonia Vikas Kapoor
citation: Ms. Sonia Vikas Kapoor is a dedicated teacher who champions holistic development by blending innovative pedagogical approaches with life skills and values. Her teaching strategies, like cooperative learning and art-integrated learning, are commendable. Her dedication is also reflected in her book, Teach to Enrich , and articles on inclusive education and cooperative learning. Other initiatives include "Primary Pitara" and a repository of self-made TLMs to transform substitution periods into meaningful learning opportunities. She also established an "Open Library" to foster reading and multilingualism. Beyond academics, Ms. Kapoor is committed to nurturing students' character and well-being, inspired by the ‘Prerana Programme’.
core: Creation of an innovative Teaching Learning Environment.
t_en: Cooperative + art-integrated learning and "Primary Pitara" TLM bank
t_hi: सहकारी व कला-समेकित शिक्षण और "प्राइमरी पिटारा" TLM बैंक
s_hi: सहकारी व कला-समेकित शिक्षण, "प्राइमरी पिटारा" और स्वनिर्मित TLM भंडार से खाली (सब्स्टीट्यूशन) पीरियड को सार्थक बनाया, "ओपन लाइब्रेरी" से पठन व बहुभाषिकता बढ़ाई।
steps_en: Keep a 'Pitara' box of ready 15-minute activities any teacher can use in a free/substitution period
Use think-pair-share and jigsaw groups once a week
Set up an open shelf library with books in 2–3 languages and no issue register
steps_hi: 'पिटारा' डिब्बा रखें जिसमें 15 मिनट की तैयार गतिविधियाँ हों, जिन्हें कोई भी शिक्षक खाली/सब्स्टीट्यूशन पीरियड में करा सके
हफ्ते में एक बार थिंक-पेयर-शेयर और जिगसॉ समूह का प्रयोग करें
2–3 भाषाओं की किताबों वाली खुली शेल्फ लाइब्रेरी रखें, जिसमें इश्यू रजिस्टर न हो
scene: A teacher opening a colourful 'Pitara' activity box in front of eager primary children, an open bookshelf with books in several Indian languages, children painting in pairs

name: Mr. Kandhan Kumaresan
school: Govt. Model Senior Secondary School Aberdeen
citation: Mr. Kandhan Kumaresan is a primary school teacher whose work ethic is a testimony to his commitment to community-rooted pedagogy. He reinforces textbook learning with students' lived experiences by using local folklore, songs, and games. His innovative approach includes activities where students document local vegetation, encouraging observation and environmental awareness. Despite various challenges, he has effectively integrated technology into his teaching, shifting ICT labs to the primary section and creating WhatsApp-based learning modules. His belief in inclusivity is a hallmark of his work, designing differentiated learning plans for students with special needs. His support for Children with Special Needs (CwSN) has led to student successes in music. His leadership also extends to securing significant CSR partnerships to bring Atal Tinkering Labs, ICT Labs, and solar panels to schools.
core: Inclusive pedagogy.
t_en: Folklore, songs and games linking textbook to lived experience
t_hi: लोककथा, गीत और खेल से पाठ को जीवन से जोड़ना
s_hi: स्थानीय लोककथाओं, गीतों व खेलों से पाठ को जीवनानुभव से जोड़ा, स्थानीय वनस्पति का दस्तावेज़ीकरण, व्हाट्सऐप लर्निंग मॉड्यूल और CWSN के लिए विभेदित योजना।
steps_en: Begin a unit by asking children to bring a local song, story or game related to it
Run a 'plant diary' where each child documents one local plant with drawing and name
Write a 3-level version (easy/core/challenge) of each worksheet for differentiated learning
steps_hi: इकाई की शुरुआत में बच्चों से उससे जुड़ा स्थानीय गीत, कहानी या खेल लाने को कहें
'पौधा डायरी' चलाएँ: हर बच्चा एक स्थानीय पौधे का चित्र व नाम सहित दस्तावेज़ बनाए
विभेदित शिक्षण के लिए हर वर्कशीट के 3 स्तर (आसान/मुख्य/चुनौती) बनाएँ
scene: Island primary children under a coconut tree sketching local plants in diaries, one child singing a folk song, a teacher holding a tablet with a WhatsApp module

name: Mr. Santosh Kumar Chaurasia
school: PM SHRI School Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Salora
citation: Mr. Santosh Kumar Chaurasia has an illustrious career mentoring students, helping over 50 students gain admission to prestigious IITs and medical colleges. He serves as a Resource Person and Master Facilitator, training teachers in experiential and innovative pedagogies. Passionate about chemistry, he has developed over 50 interactive chemistry games on Word Wall, making learning engaging and ICT-driven. Beyond teaching, he is an accomplished writer, authoring books on the impact of mobile phones on children's concentration and exploring women's roles in modern India.
core: Use of innovative and ICT pedagogy.
t_en: 50+ Wordwall chemistry games and teacher training
t_hi: 50+ वर्डवॉल रसायन खेल और शिक्षक प्रशिक्षण
s_hi: रसायन विज्ञान पर 50 से अधिक इंटरैक्टिव Wordwall खेल बनाए, अनुभवात्मक शिक्षण पर शिक्षकों को प्रशिक्षण दिया; 50+ छात्र IIT व मेडिकल कॉलेजों में पहुँचे।
steps_en: Convert one chapter's key terms into a free online quiz/matching game (e.g., Wordwall)
Play it as a whole-class team game on the projector or as homework
Share your games with teachers in your cluster/complex
steps_hi: एक अध्याय के मुख्य शब्दों को मुफ्त ऑनलाइन क्विज़/मिलान खेल (जैसे Wordwall) में बदलें
इसे प्रोजेक्टर पर पूरी कक्षा का टीम खेल या गृहकार्य बनाएँ
अपने क्लस्टर/कॉम्प्लेक्स के शिक्षकों से अपने खेल साझा करें
scene: Navodaya students in two teams racing on a projected chemistry matching game, a periodic table on the wall, teacher keeping score

name: Dr. Pramod Kumar
citation: Dr. Pramod Kumar is a multi-faceted educator with over 28 years of experience, consistently achieving 100% board results in Biology. He serves as a CBSE Resource Person, CBSE Master Trainer, and NEP 2020 Ambassador, training over 250,000 teachers on pedagogy, gender sensitization, and NEP implementation. As a trained counsellor, he actively supports students’ psychosocial and career development. His distinguished work has earned him multiple awards, including the CBSE National Teachers Awards 2020, and he has represented India at the Global Inclusive Schools Forum in Paris.
core: Psychosocial support and academic achievement of students.
t_en: Counselling-led psychosocial and career support
t_hi: परामर्श आधारित मनोसामाजिक व करियर सहायता
s_hi: प्रशिक्षित परामर्शदाता के रूप में छात्रों के मनोसामाजिक व करियर विकास में सहायता; 2.5 लाख से अधिक शिक्षकों को प्रशिक्षण; जीवविज्ञान में 100% परिणाम।
steps_en: Keep a weekly 'open hour' for one-to-one student talks
Use a simple interest inventory to guide career conversations in Class 9–10
Train peer listeners in each class
steps_hi: हर हफ्ते छात्रों से व्यक्तिगत बातचीत के लिए 'ओपन आवर' रखें
कक्षा 9–10 में करियर चर्चा हेतु सरल रुचि-प्रश्नावली का प्रयोग करें
हर कक्षा में साथी-श्रोता (पीयर लिसनर) तैयार करें
scene: A teacher counselling a cadet one-on-one in a quiet corner of a Sainik School library, a career chart on the wall

name: Mr. Tarun Kumar Dash
citation: Mr. Tarun Kumar Dash is a trailblazer in education, fostering creativity and social awareness. Initiatives like the "Katha Chitra" project empower students as storytellers and filmmakers, while "My Reading Book and My Picture My Story" encourages children to author and illustrate their own books. The "News Nest" initiative develops vocabulary and summarization skills, and the "Mai Bhi Speaker" forum builds confidence and communication abilities. He also led the "Millet Kranti" campaign, raising awareness of millet nutrition through rallies and introducing weekly millet meals at his school, promoting healthy eating habits and local culture. These efforts reflect his vision of holistic student development—academic, creative, and socially conscious.
core: Innovative pedagogy and contribution to language teaching.
t_en: "Katha Chitra" student films and "Millet Kranti"
t_hi: "कथा चित्र" छात्र फ़िल्में और "मिलेट क्रांति"
s_hi: "कथा चित्र" में छात्र कहानीकार व फ़िल्मकार बने, बच्चे अपनी किताबें लिखकर चित्र बनाते हैं, "न्यूज़ नेस्ट" से शब्दावली, "मैं भी स्पीकर" मंच और "मिलेट क्रांति" अभियान।
steps_en: Let each child write and illustrate a 4-page 'My Picture My Story' booklet
Run a 10-minute 'News Nest': students read a news item and summarise in 3 lines
Make a 2-minute phone film of a class story with students as actors and editors
steps_hi: हर बच्चे से 4 पन्नों की 'मेरी तस्वीर मेरी कहानी' पुस्तिका लिखवाएँ और चित्र बनवाएँ
10 मिनट का 'न्यूज़ नेस्ट': बच्चे एक समाचार पढ़कर 3 पंक्तियों में सार लिखें
कक्षा की कहानी पर 2 मिनट की मोबाइल फ़िल्म बनाएँ जिसमें बच्चे ही अभिनेता और संपादक हों
scene: KV students filming a short story scene with a phone on a tripod, others holding hand-made picture books, a millet display table with ragi and bajra

name: Mr. Basanta Kumar Rana
citation: Mr. Basanta Kumar Rana’s contributions in the aspirational district of Malkangiri go beyond traditional teaching, creating significant improvements in student attendance and community engagement. He uses creative, low-cost methods to bridge the gap between the school and society. He organized awareness rallies, road shows, and puppet shows to communicate the importance of education. To foster a reading culture, he established a monthly community library, bringing books to different villages by bicycle, and successfully re-enrolled children who had dropped out. Mr. Rana transformed his school into a dynamic learning environment by implementing BaLA (Building as Learning Aid) initiatives like "talking walls" and a "stone alphabet and number garden," turning the entire campus into an interactive educational space. These walls, adorned with educational charts, creative artwork, and learning aids, actively engage students from Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) to more complex concepts, demonstrating innovation born from resource scarcity.
core: Innovative pedagogy and community engagement for students’ attendance.
t_en: BaLA talking walls, stone alphabet garden and bicycle library
t_hi: बाला (BaLA) बोलती दीवारें, पत्थर अक्षर उद्यान और साइकिल पुस्तकालय
s_hi: आकांक्षी ज़िले में रैली व कठपुतली से जागरूकता, साइकिल से गाँव-गाँव मासिक सामुदायिक पुस्तकालय, बोलती दीवारें और "पत्थर अक्षर-संख्या उद्यान" से पूरा परिसर सीखने का साधन बना।
steps_en: Paint letters, numbers and simple words at child eye-level on walls, steps and pillars (BaLA)
Arrange painted stones as an alphabet/number garden children can walk and play in
Carry a book bag to one village each month and run a reading mela
steps_hi: दीवारों, सीढ़ियों और खंभों पर बच्चों की आँख की ऊँचाई पर अक्षर, संख्याएँ व सरल शब्द पेंट करें (BaLA)
पेंट किए पत्थरों से अक्षर/संख्या उद्यान बनाएँ जिसमें बच्चे चलें और खेलें
हर महीने एक गाँव में किताबों का थैला ले जाकर पठन मेला लगाएँ
scene: Tribal Odisha school with colourful 'talking walls', children hopping on painted alphabet stones, a teacher on a bicycle with a bag of books

name: Ms. Tanusree Das
citation: Ms. Tanusree Das is an innovative and dedicated teacher whose work brings transformative change in the educational life cycle of children. She engages both students and mothers, instituting recognition for mothers through the “Mother of the Year Award.” When she joined Kuchlachati, the village faced low enrolment, high dropout rates, and early marriages for girls. Through her innovative teaching methods, she transformed the school into a hub of change for the community, achieving zero dropouts since 2016. Her initiatives, including the Nari Shakti Group and student support programs, not only improved academics but also addressed critical social issues like child marriage and domestic violence. She also started a school bank using piggy banks at the time of admission to prepare students for future financial responsibility. Ms. Tanusree’s mission is to use education as a tool for social reform, developing responsible and capable citizens who contribute positively to society.
core: Innovative teaching pedagogy and teaching for broader social reform.
t_en: "Mother of the Year" award and school piggy-bank
t_hi: "मदर ऑफ द ईयर" पुरस्कार और विद्यालय गुल्लक बैंक
s_hi: माताओं को "मदर ऑफ द ईयर" सम्मान, नारी शक्ति समूह, बाल विवाह व घरेलू हिंसा के विरुद्ध काम; 2016 से शून्य ड्रॉपआउट, प्रवेश के समय गुल्लक से स्कूल बैंक।
steps_en: Announce a yearly 'Mother of the Year' for mothers who support regular attendance and homework
Form a mothers' group that meets monthly on attendance and girls' safety
Give each new child a piggy bank and keep a simple savings register
steps_hi: नियमित उपस्थिति व गृहकार्य में सहयोग करने वाली माताओं के लिए वार्षिक 'मदर ऑफ द ईयर' घोषित करें
माताओं का समूह बनाएँ जो हर महीने उपस्थिति व बालिका सुरक्षा पर मिले
हर नए बच्चे को गुल्लक दें और सरल बचत रजिस्टर रखें
scene: A mother receiving a hand-made 'Mother of the Year' certificate from children in a Bengal village primary school, rows of clay piggy banks on a shelf

name: Ms. Nang Ekthani Mounglang
school: Govt. Sec. School Pachin, Papum Pare
citation: Ms. Nang Ekthani Mounglang is renowned for her leadership and dedication as Headmaster. Upon joining the institution, she faced a challenging environment, yet through consistent supervision, hard work, and well-planned mock tests, she raised the Class X CBSE result from 27% to 81.54% in 2024 and achieved an extraordinary 100% in 2025. This made her school the first government institution in the capital of Arunachal Pradesh to reach this milestone. She created a blended learning environment with ICT-integrated classrooms, making learning more practical and hands-on. Ms. Mounglang expanded the range of activities and responsibilities to promote holistic development in alignment with NEP 2020. She also led extensive community engagement programs, including regular PTMs, POCSO and drug abuse awareness campaigns, legal awareness initiatives, and Craft Melas, involving parents and the community significantly. Her professional engagement with SCERT Itanagar in textbook and module preparation, along with rigorous training for textbook development, exemplifies her relentless pursuit of professional excellence.
core: Exceptional leadership and innovative pedagogy.
t_en: Mock-test plan that lifted Class X result from 27% to 100%
t_hi: मॉक टेस्ट योजना जिससे कक्षा 10 परिणाम 27% से 100% हुआ
s_hi: नियमित निगरानी व सुनियोजित मॉक टेस्ट से कक्षा 10 परिणाम 27% से 81.54% (2024) और 100% (2025); ICT कक्षाएँ, PTM व जागरूकता अभियान।
steps_en: Plan monthly mock tests from August with analysis of every wrong answer
Group students by weak topics for 3 remedial periods a week
Share each child's mock-test graph with parents at PTM
steps_hi: अगस्त से हर महीने मॉक टेस्ट की योजना बनाएँ और हर गलत उत्तर का विश्लेषण करें
कमज़ोर टॉपिक के अनुसार बच्चों के समूह बनाकर हफ्ते में 3 उपचारात्मक पीरियड लें
PTM में हर बच्चे का मॉक टेस्ट ग्राफ अभिभावकों से साझा करें
scene: A headmistress in an Arunachal government school pointing at a rising result graph, Class 10 students in a test hall, parents at a PTM table

name: Ms. Peleno Petenilhu
school: John Govt. Higher Secondary School, Viswema, Kohima
citation: Ms. Peleno Petenilhu’s classroom transcends walls and rigid syllabi; it is a living space of joy, shared responsibility, empathy, and transformation. She has created a learning environment rooted in joy, empathy, and relevance, particularly for students facing adversity. A hallmark of her teaching is the “Each One Teach One” initiative, a peer learning model where Class 12 students mentor juniors or academically struggling students. She connects English lessons to local folktales and real-life issues to promote critical thinking, expression, and contextual understanding. Thematic poetry, peer reviews, mock interviews, and panel discussions further deepen comprehension and foster confidence among students, making learning both relevant and transformative.
core: Contextualization of English with folk tales.
t_en: "Each One Teach One" peer mentoring and folktale-based English
t_hi: "ईच वन टीच वन" साथी मेंटरिंग और लोककथा आधारित अंग्रेज़ी
s_hi: "ईच वन टीच वन" में कक्षा 12 के छात्र जूनियर व कमज़ोर छात्रों को पढ़ाते हैं; अंग्रेज़ी को स्थानीय लोककथाओं व वास्तविक मुद्दों से जोड़ा; कविता, पीयर रिव्यू, मॉक इंटरव्यू।
steps_en: Pair senior students with juniors for 2 peer-tutoring sessions a week with a simple log
Teach an English skill (summary, debate) using a local folktale
Run a monthly mock interview or panel discussion in English
steps_hi: वरिष्ठ छात्रों को जूनियर के साथ जोड़कर हफ्ते में 2 पीयर ट्यूशन सत्र कराएँ, सरल रजिस्टर रखें
स्थानीय लोककथा से कोई अंग्रेज़ी कौशल (सारांश, वाद-विवाद) सिखाएँ
हर महीने अंग्रेज़ी में मॉक इंटरव्यू या पैनल चर्चा करें
scene: Senior and junior students sitting in pairs on a hillside school verandah in Nagaland reading an English folktale, a small panel discussion in the background

name: Ms. Koijam Machasana
school: Ghari Upper Primary School, Imphal West
citation: Ms. Koijam Machasana is a visionary leader who identifies challenges and devises strategies to address them. Her revolutionary leadership as a school headmaster began with an honest assessment of issues like parental suspicion, weak community partnership, and skill-building learning deficits. Her most effective strategy was innovative community engagement, particularly focused on Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE). She directly engaged young mothers in the neighborhood, teaching them NEP and ECCE principles. This initiative not only established a thriving pre-primary wing but also fostered cooperation and trust, creating a dedicated, collaborative community. Her work demonstrates how people-centric planning can transform adversity into profound success.
core: People-focused planning and involving mothers in Early Childhood Care and Education.
t_en: Training young mothers in ECCE to build a pre-primary wing
t_hi: युवा माताओं को ECCE प्रशिक्षण देकर पूर्व-प्राथमिक कक्षा बनाना
s_hi: अभिभावकों के अविश्वास व कमज़ोर सामुदायिक साझेदारी को पहचाना; पड़ोस की युवा माताओं को NEP व ECCE सिद्धांत सिखाए, जिससे सफल पूर्व-प्राथमिक विंग बनी।
steps_en: Invite mothers of 3–6 year olds to a monthly play session showing 3 ECCE activities
Set up a play corner with blocks, picture books and clay
Ask mothers to volunteer one morning a month in the pre-primary room
steps_hi: 3–6 वर्ष के बच्चों की माताओं को मासिक खेल सत्र में बुलाकर 3 ECCE गतिविधियाँ दिखाएँ
ब्लॉक, चित्र-पुस्तकें और मिट्टी वाला खेल कोना बनाएँ
माताओं से महीने में एक सुबह पूर्व-प्राथमिक कक्ष में स्वयंसेवा करने को कहें
scene: Manipuri mothers in traditional phanek sitting with toddlers playing with blocks and clay in a bright pre-primary room, a headmistress guiding

name: Mr. Karma Tempo Ethenpa
citation: Mr. Karma Tempo Ethenpa is celebrated for his energetic leadership and contributions to holistic student development. A retired state football player and athlete, he channels his passion into coaching school football and volleyball teams to championship victories. Beyond sports, he addresses youth challenges like tobacco, cigarette, and technology addiction by providing healthy alternatives. An avid photographer, he encourages students to master mobile photography and visual storytelling, fostering appreciation for nature and generating school revenue through exhibitions. His curriculum design experience includes authoring English textbooks for SCERT Sikkim. Additionally, he spearheaded innovative green projects like rainwater harvesting and a vertical garden, and introduced a complete Pipers Band, reflecting his commitment to comprehensive education and vibrant school life.
core: Integration of Sports and Arts in education.
t_en: Sports coaching, mobile photography and a school pipers band
t_hi: खेल कोचिंग, मोबाइल फ़ोटोग्राफ़ी और विद्यालय पाइपर्स बैंड
s_hi: फुटबॉल/वॉलीबॉल कोचिंग से चैंपियनशिप, नशा व तकनीक की लत के स्वस्थ विकल्प, मोबाइल फ़ोटोग्राफ़ी व दृश्य कहानी, वर्षा जल संचयन, वर्टिकल गार्डन और पाइपर्स बैंड।
steps_en: Start an after-school sports practice with a fixed captain and attendance
Run a mobile photography club: weekly theme (nature, people), exhibition each term
Offer clubs as healthy alternatives during break to reduce phone addiction
steps_hi: स्कूल के बाद तय कप्तान व उपस्थिति के साथ खेल अभ्यास शुरू करें
मोबाइल फ़ोटोग्राफ़ी क्लब: हर हफ्ते एक विषय (प्रकृति, लोग), हर टर्म प्रदर्शनी
फ़ोन की लत कम करने हेतु अवकाश में स्वस्थ विकल्प के रूप में क्लब चलाएँ
scene: Sikkim mountain school ground with a football team practising, students photographing a vertical garden with phones, a pipers band rehearsing

name: Dr. Heipor Uni Bang
citation: Dr. Heipor Uni Bang is a distinguished teacher awarded the State Award 2024 by the Government of Meghalaya. He is a prolific author of three books—Guidebook Health Education Class X SSLC MBOSE, Ki Khlur Rit Khasi Book IV, and General Knowledge for classes 1–3—along with many publications. His classroom integrates technology and innovative pedagogy to cultivate independent learners with strong social interaction and critical life skills. His teaching employs flow charts, diagrams, maps, geometrical instruments, experimental projects, computers, and digital TVs to make learning engaging and interactive. His exceptional work with Children with Special Needs (CwSN) is especially commendable. Dr. Bang’s relentless dedication, innovative spirit, and unwavering commitment to his students and community make him a beacon of educational excellence in remote regions.
core: Inclusive and innovative pedagogy.
t_en: Visual organisers and support for CWSN in remote schools
t_hi: दूरस्थ विद्यालयों में दृश्य संयोजक और CWSN सहायता
s_hi: फ्लो चार्ट, आरेख, नक्शे, प्रयोग परियोजनाएँ, कंप्यूटर व डिजिटल टीवी से इंटरैक्टिव शिक्षण; CWSN के साथ उल्लेखनीय कार्य; तीन पुस्तकों के लेखक।
steps_en: Turn each lesson's key idea into a flow chart or concept map drawn with students
Give CWSN learners visual cue cards and extra time
Use one experimental project per term that every child can contribute to
steps_hi: हर पाठ के मुख्य विचार को बच्चों के साथ फ्लो चार्ट या कॉन्सेप्ट मैप में बदलें
CWSN बच्चों को दृश्य संकेत कार्ड और अतिरिक्त समय दें
हर टर्म एक ऐसा प्रयोग प्रोजेक्ट रखें जिसमें हर बच्चा योगदान दे सके
scene: Meghalaya village classroom where a teacher and students build a large flow chart on the board, a child with special needs using picture cue cards

name: Ms. Bidisha Majumder
citation: Ms. Bidisha Majumdar is a visionary teacher renowned for her pioneering efforts in promoting scientific temper and innovation. Under her guidance, students have excelled at INSPIRE Awards MANAK and the National Children's Science Congress (NCSC). She has also helped students participate in advanced programs such as ISRO YUVIKA and the Wipro Earthian Programme, fostering interest in science and sustainability. Beyond the classroom, Ms. Majumdar demonstrates exemplary social responsibility. She coaches orphanage children, conducts awareness campaigns against child marriage using innovative methods like street plays, and strongly advocates for inclusive education. Her work nurtures a generation of intellectually competent and morally strong citizens.
core: Inculcating a Scientific temperament, community awareness, and engagement.
t_en: INSPIRE-MANAK, ISRO YUVIKA mentoring and street plays on child marriage
t_hi: INSPIRE-MANAK, इसरो युविका मार्गदर्शन और बाल विवाह पर नुक्कड़ नाटक
s_hi: वैज्ञानिक सोच हेतु INSPIRE-MANAK, NCSC, ISRO YUVIKA व विप्रो अर्थियन में छात्रों का मार्गदर्शन; अनाथालय के बच्चों को कोचिंग; नुक्कड़ नाटक से बाल विवाह विरोधी अभियान।
steps_en: Keep a yearly calendar of science competitions and shortlist students by July
Hold a monthly 'idea pitch' where students present solutions to local problems
Use a 10-minute street play by students for awareness on social issues
steps_hi: विज्ञान प्रतियोगिताओं का वार्षिक कैलेंडर रखें और जुलाई तक छात्रों का चयन करें
हर महीने 'आइडिया पिच' रखें जिसमें छात्र स्थानीय समस्याओं के समाधान प्रस्तुत करें
सामाजिक मुद्दों पर जागरूकता के लिए छात्रों का 10 मिनट का नुक्कड़ नाटक करें
scene: Tripura students performing a street play in a market square, another group showing an INSPIRE science model, a woman teacher coordinating

name: Mr. Debajit Ghosh
citation: Mr. Debajit Ghosh is an exceptional and dedicated teacher whose tireless efforts have profoundly transformed Namsang TE Model School, a remote location without road connectivity or basic communication facilities. His leadership has yielded remarkable results. Through a unique science exhibition organized with VSSE SAC and ISRO, he fostered a love for learning, which significantly reduced student absenteeism. He addressed critical health issues after a camp revealed high undernutrition rates by improving the PM-POSHAN program—introducing green leafy vegetables and supplements, raising hemoglobin levels for 165 students. Under his guidance, HSLC results improved from 78% to 90%, and students now confidently participate in sports and music competitions. Mr. Ghosh’s unwavering commitment to students’ academic, physical, and emotional well-being exemplifies visionary leadership.
core: Lead the health initiatives in schools.
t_en: Science exhibition with ISRO and PM-POSHAN nutrition boost
t_hi: इसरो के साथ विज्ञान प्रदर्शनी और पीएम-पोषण सुधार
s_hi: सड़कविहीन दूरस्थ विद्यालय में इसरो के साथ विज्ञान प्रदर्शनी से अनुपस्थिति घटी; कुपोषण पाए जाने पर पीएम-पोषण में हरी सब्ज़ियाँ व पूरक जोड़कर 165 बच्चों का हीमोग्लोबिन बढ़ाया; HSLC परिणाम 78% से 90%।
steps_en: Hold a health check with the local PHC and record height, weight and haemoglobin
Add a school kitchen garden of green leafy vegetables to mid-day meals
Invite a science institution or college for an exhibition day to spark curiosity
steps_hi: स्थानीय PHC के साथ स्वास्थ्य जाँच कर लंबाई, वज़न व हीमोग्लोबिन दर्ज करें
मध्याह्न भोजन के लिए हरी पत्तेदार सब्ज़ियों का विद्यालय किचन गार्डन बनाएँ
जिज्ञासा जगाने हेतु किसी विज्ञान संस्थान/कॉलेज को प्रदर्शनी दिवस पर बुलाएँ
scene: Tea-garden school in Assam, children eating a mid-day meal with green vegetables, a health camp table with a haemoglobin meter, a rocket model at a science exhibition

name: Ms. Shweta Sharma
citation: Ms. Shweta Sharma is a dedicated government schoolteacher from Jharkhand with over two decades of experience, whose work embodies the vision of NEP 2020. Her journey is marked by a deep commitment to foundational learning, child-friendly pedagogy, and community engagement. Beginning her career at a rural school on the verge of closure, Shweta’s efforts to create a warm, joyful learning environment increased enrolment within two years. She applied play-way methods and activity-based learning, building strong foundational skills in reading, writing, and numeracy. A key innovator, she has contributed to state-level educational initiatives, including developing teaching materials and textbooks for Jharkhand. Her most cherished contribution is the "Abua Jadui Pitara," a localized, toy-based learning kit inspired by the state's tribal heritage, successfully adopted by other teachers. During the COVID-19 pandemic, she co-founded the "Copy Exchange Program," a peer-to-peer note-sharing network that earned a Pramerica International Award and led to her students' participation in a UN Youth Programme. Her dedication to professional development and collaboration, along with state and national awards, cements her reputation as a transformative educator committed to ensuring every child thrives.
core: Used innovative pedagogy for the retention of students.
t_en: "Abua Jadui Pitara" tribal toy kit and Copy Exchange Program
t_hi: "अबुआ जादुई पिटारा" आदिवासी खिलौना किट और कॉपी एक्सचेंज कार्यक्रम
s_hi: बंद होने के कगार के विद्यालय में आनंदमय माहौल से नामांकन बढ़ाया; झारखंड की आदिवासी विरासत से प्रेरित खिलौना-आधारित किट "अबुआ जादुई पिटारा" बनाई जिसे अन्य शिक्षकों ने अपनाया; कोविड में "कॉपी एक्सचेंज" नेटवर्क।
steps_en: Collect local toys, songs and objects from tribal/local culture into a 'Jadui Pitara' box
Plan one FLN activity per toy (counting, sound, story)
Let children exchange notebooks with a buddy to learn from each other's notes
steps_hi: आदिवासी/स्थानीय संस्कृति के खिलौने, गीत और वस्तुएँ एक 'जादुई पिटारा' डिब्बे में इकट्ठा करें
हर खिलौने के लिए एक FLN गतिविधि (गिनती, ध्वनि, कहानी) तय करें
बच्चे साथी से कॉपी बदलकर एक-दूसरे के नोट्स से सीखें
scene: Jharkhand primary children gathered around an open wooden treasure box of tribal toys, drums and seed counters, a teacher telling a story with a toy

name: Dr. Shaikh Mohammad Waquioddin Shaikh Hamidoddin
citation: Dr. Shaikh Mohammad Waquioddin Shaikh Hamidoddin is a dedicated educator with over 28 years of service who has profoundly impacted his school and community. As Headmaster and Science Teacher at Zilla Parishad High School, he transformed the institution into a hub of academic excellence and social reform. His core contributions include successfully tackling a girl student dropout crisis in a marginalized community by establishing a temporary school branch, providing safe education to over 2,000 girls. He is also a pioneer in health initiatives, launching a mission to distribute over 5 lakh sanitary napkins and installing a vending machine on school premises. Dr. Shaikh has actively mobilized the community to raise over ₹50 lakh for school infrastructure and resources, including digital tools and a Caring Classroom Policy. His exemplary work in promoting academic rigor, social awareness, and communal harmony earned him the prestigious State Teacher Award in 2018, the prize money of which he donated entirely back to his school.
core: Reduced girls' dropout rate and developed the academic excellence hub.
t_en: Temporary school branch for 2,000 girls and sanitary-pad mission
t_hi: 2,000 बालिकाओं के लिए अस्थायी विद्यालय शाखा और सैनिटरी पैड मिशन
s_hi: हाशिये के समुदाय में बालिका ड्रॉपआउट रोकने के लिए अस्थायी शाखा से 2,000+ बालिकाओं को सुरक्षित शिक्षा; 5 लाख सैनिटरी पैड वितरण व वेंडिंग मशीन; समुदाय से ₹50 लाख जुटाए; केयरिंग क्लासरूम नीति।
steps_en: Map where girls drop out and why (distance, safety, hygiene) through a short survey
Install a sanitary-pad box/vending machine and run a menstrual-hygiene talk each term
Write a one-page 'Caring Classroom' code with students
steps_hi: छोटे सर्वे से पता करें कि बालिकाएँ कहाँ और क्यों पढ़ाई छोड़ती हैं (दूरी, सुरक्षा, स्वच्छता)
सैनिटरी पैड बॉक्स/वेंडिंग मशीन लगाएँ और हर टर्म मासिक धर्म स्वच्छता वार्ता करें
बच्चों के साथ एक-पेज 'केयरिंग क्लासरूम' आचार संहिता बनाएँ
scene: Girls entering a safe neighbourhood school branch in Maharashtra, a sanitary-pad vending machine on a wall, a headmaster speaking with community elders

name: Dr. Sandipan Gurunath Jagdale
citation: Dr. Sandipan Gurunath Jagdale is a dedicated teacher at Dayanand College of Arts, Latur, with over two decades of service. He has acted as a social transformer through education, combining pedagogical innovation, digital technology, and inclusivity. He is particularly lauded for pioneering accessible learning materials, such as the first-ever Braille book for visually impaired students and an FLN book in a local dialect. He also leverages technology to reach lakhs of students for free. His mentorship ensures a 100% success rate and propels students from marginalized backgrounds to national and international recognition, including Guinness World Records and prestigious societal roles.
core: Education as a tool for social transformation
t_en: Braille book and local-dialect FLN book
t_hi: ब्रेल पुस्तक और स्थानीय बोली में FLN पुस्तक
s_hi: दृष्टिबाधित छात्रों के लिए पहली ब्रेल पुस्तक और स्थानीय बोली में FLN पुस्तक जैसी सुलभ सामग्री बनाई; तकनीक से लाखों छात्रों तक मुफ्त पहुँच।
steps_en: Record audio versions of key lessons for visually impaired learners
Make a small FLN reader in the children's home dialect with local words
Share materials free online so other schools can use them
steps_hi: दृष्टिबाधित बच्चों के लिए मुख्य पाठों के ऑडियो संस्करण रिकॉर्ड करें
बच्चों की घरेलू बोली व स्थानीय शब्दों में छोटी FLN पुस्तक बनाएँ
सामग्री मुफ्त ऑनलाइन साझा करें ताकि अन्य विद्यालय भी उपयोग करें
scene: A visually impaired student reading a Braille book with fingertips, beside a child reading a colourful dialect picture book, teacher recording audio on a phone

name: Mr. Ibrahim S.
citation: Mr. Ibrahim S. is a compassionate Headmaster, has dedicated his career to nurturing students' social, emotional, and academic well-being. Through personalized intervention, he has made remarkable efforts to transform student lives. His efforts to visit homes, build trust, and offer unwavering support have successfully brought students back to school, enabling them to complete their education and build meaningful lives. He uses different strategies to help children overcome behavioral and emotional difficulties. Beyond individual mentorship, he has created a nurturing school ecosystem. His initiatives, including a Green Library, play corners, a nail-cutting area, and a "One Plant for One Student" project, promote health, creativity, and environmental awareness. He has also strengthened community bonds through initiatives like "Tithi Bhojan" and a publicly displayed Statistical Board, demonstrating a deep commitment to holistic education and the collective spirit of his school community.
core: Community engagement and socio-emotional learning.
t_en: Home visits, SEL support and "One Plant for One Student"
t_hi: गृह भेंट, सामाजिक-भावनात्मक सहायता और "एक छात्र एक पौधा"
s_hi: घर-घर जाकर विश्वास बनाया और बच्चों को वापस विद्यालय लाया; व्यवहार व भावनात्मक कठिनाइयों हेतु रणनीतियाँ; ग्रीन लाइब्रेरी, प्ले कॉर्नर, नाखून काटने का कोना, "एक छात्र एक पौधा", तिथि भोजन व सार्वजनिक सांख्यिकी बोर्ड।
steps_en: Visit the home of every child absent 3+ days in a row within the same week
Give each child a sapling to name and care for; record growth monthly
Put up a public board with enrolment, attendance and results for the community
steps_hi: लगातार 3+ दिन अनुपस्थित हर बच्चे के घर उसी हफ्ते जाएँ
हर बच्चे को एक पौधा दें जिसका वह नाम रखे और देखभाल करे; हर महीने बढ़त दर्ज करें
समुदाय के लिए नामांकन, उपस्थिति व परिणाम का सार्वजनिक बोर्ड लगाएँ
scene: Lakshadweep island junior school, each child watering a named sapling, a headmaster walking to a home in a coconut grove, a public statistics board at the gate

name: Ms. Madhurima Acharya
citation: Ms. Madhurima Acharya is an active Computer Teacher who incorporates ICT tools, project-based learning, flipped classrooms, coding platforms, and real-life simulations to make learning engaging and meaningful. She has developed low-cost and no-cost teaching materials using open-source software to ensure inclusive learning. A key initiative of hers is linking theoretical concepts to real-world applications, especially in Computer Science, Robotics, and AI, to foster curiosity and innovation. Her students have developed projects such as an Automatic Plant Watering System, an Advanced Drive Assistance System, and Line Follower Robots, many of which received recognition at innovation festivals.
core: Innovative pedagogy using ICT and open-source software
t_en: Open-source coding and robotics projects
t_hi: ओपन-सोर्स कोडिंग और रोबोटिक्स प्रोजेक्ट
s_hi: ICT टूल, प्रोजेक्ट आधारित शिक्षण, फ्लिप्ड क्लासरूम, कोडिंग व सिमुलेशन; ओपन-सोर्स से कम/शून्य लागत सामग्री; ऑटोमैटिक पौधा सिंचाई, लाइन फॉलोअर रोबोट जैसे छात्र प्रोजेक्ट।
steps_en: Use free tools (Scratch, Tinkercad simulations) so no lab hardware is needed to start
Give a real-life problem (watering plants) and let teams code a solution
Hold an end-of-term innovation demo for parents
steps_hi: शुरुआत के लिए मुफ्त टूल (Scratch, Tinkercad सिमुलेशन) अपनाएँ ताकि लैब हार्डवेयर की ज़रूरत न हो
एक वास्तविक समस्या (पौधों को पानी) देकर टीमों से समाधान कोड करवाएँ
टर्म के अंत में अभिभावकों के लिए नवाचार प्रदर्शनी करें
scene: Students coding on laptops beside a small line-follower robot and an automatic plant-watering model in a Kolkata computer lab

name: Ms. Madabathula Thirumala Sridevi
citation: Ms. Madabathula Thirumala Sridevi has transformed classrooms that often stifle curiosity into student-centric learning environments, with technology as a powerful tool. She integrated Chromebooks, projectors, and interactive tablets to turn classrooms into dynamic launchpads for discovery. She implemented a paperless system for assessments and assignments, saving time and resources while teaching essential digital literacy skills. Her innovative initiatives, including the Talking Robot project, gained recognition from both national and international media, including BBC News. Ms. Sridevi also organized a Mega Parent Teacher Meeting 2.0 with activities like Rangoli for mothers and Tug of War for fathers, making parents active partners in their children’s education. She is the recipient of the State Best Teacher Savitribai Phule Award and the State Best Headmistress Award.
core: Innovative pedagogy in school science
t_en: Paperless assessment with Chromebooks and Mega PTM 2.0
t_hi: क्रोमबुक से पेपरलेस आकलन और मेगा PTM 2.0
s_hi: क्रोमबुक, प्रोजेक्टर व टैबलेट से छात्र-केंद्रित कक्षा, पेपरलेस आकलन व असाइनमेंट, "टॉकिंग रोबोट" प्रोजेक्ट, माताओं के लिए रंगोली व पिताओं के लिए रस्साकशी वाला मेगा PTM।
steps_en: Use a free form/quiz tool for one weekly test so results are instant
Let students build a simple 'talking' model with recorded voice for a science topic
Make PTM a festival: games for parents plus a short display of student work
steps_hi: हफ्ते की एक परीक्षा मुफ्त फ़ॉर्म/क्विज़ टूल से लें ताकि परिणाम तुरंत मिलें
किसी विज्ञान विषय पर रिकॉर्ड की गई आवाज़ वाला सरल 'बोलता' मॉडल बच्चों से बनवाएँ
PTM को उत्सव बनाएँ: अभिभावकों के खेल और बच्चों के काम की छोटी प्रदर्शनी
scene: Municipal high-school students in Visakhapatnam taking a quiz on Chromebooks, a cardboard talking robot on a desk, mothers drawing rangoli in the courtyard

name: Ms. Maram Pavithra
citation: Ms. Maram Pavithra has been actively participating in State-level projects since 2017, including mushroom cultivation, eco-innovation, water conservation, and sustainable farming. She spearheads the “Vidya Varadhi” programme, where her students interact with students from Pennsylvania, USA. She has contributed to developing textbooks and teacher support materials to enhance science education, authoring the Class 10 Science and Technology and Home Science textbooks for Telugu and English medium under the Telangana Open School Society (TOSS). Her dedication has been recognized with the State Best Teacher Award 2023 (Telangana Government), Microsoft Innovative Educator recognition, first prize in Agastya National Science, and featured TLMs in national newspapers. CSIR scientists appreciated her contributions during the IISF India International Science Festival workshop at IIT Guwahati in 2023. Ms. Pavithra also created learning outcome-based exemplars, capacity-building modules for biology teachers, and practice question banks aligned with National Achievement Survey (NAS) parameters.
core: Innovative pedagogy in Science
t_en: Mushroom cultivation, eco-projects and US school exchange
t_hi: मशरूम खेती, पर्यावरण प्रोजेक्ट और अमेरिकी विद्यालय से संवाद
s_hi: मशरूम खेती, इको-इनोवेशन, जल संरक्षण व टिकाऊ खेती प्रोजेक्ट; पेंसिल्वेनिया (USA) के छात्रों से "विद्या वारधि" संवाद; विज्ञान पाठ्यपुस्तक लेखन और NAS आधारित प्रश्न बैंक।
steps_en: Run a term-long hands-on project (mushroom bed, compost, water audit) with data recording
Connect online with a class in another state/country once a month
Write NAS-style competency questions for each chapter
steps_hi: एक टर्म का हाथ से करने वाला प्रोजेक्ट (मशरूम क्यारी, कम्पोस्ट, जल ऑडिट) डेटा रिकॉर्डिंग के साथ करें
हर महीने किसी दूसरे राज्य/देश की कक्षा से ऑनलाइन जुड़ें
हर अध्याय के लिए NAS जैसे दक्षता आधारित प्रश्न बनाएँ
scene: Telangana high-school students tending mushroom beds in a shed, a laptop video call with foreign students, a woman science teacher noting data

name: Ms. Revathy Parameswaran
school: P S Senior Secondary School, Chennai
citation: Ms. Revathy Parameswaran was appreciated by the United States Department of State for the Capstone Project on formative assessments and taught at a school in Maryland, USA. She also holds the Global Teacher Accreditation from the British Council (2013) and has been honored by the Governor of Tamil Nadu for her contribution to education. She has trained around 500 teachers on GeoGebra and developed 120 YouTube videos for students of classes 10 and 12, particularly to promote self-learning. As a member of the Core Advisory Group at the U.S. Consulate, she promotes STEM education among socially disadvantaged girl children. Ms. Revathy played a pivotal role in developing a state-of-the-art STEM lab equipped with IoT modules, 3D printing technology, and robotics kits, giving students practical exposure to cutting-edge innovations. Her students have won several prizes in annual Robotics League competitions, designing wireless robots from scratch. Through a partnership with IIT Madras, the School Connect Programme offers students exposure to Data Science, Design Thinking, and Electronics.
core: STEM education using ICT
t_en: GeoGebra maths, self-learning videos and STEM lab for girls
t_hi: जियोजेब्रा गणित, स्व-अध्ययन वीडियो और बालिकाओं के लिए STEM
s_hi: लगभग 500 शिक्षकों को GeoGebra प्रशिक्षण, कक्षा 10 व 12 के लिए 120 यूट्यूब वीडियो, IoT, 3D प्रिंटिंग व रोबोटिक्स वाली STEM लैब, वंचित बालिकाओं में STEM प्रोत्साहन, IIT मद्रास के साथ स्कूल कनेक्ट।
steps_en: Use free GeoGebra to let students drag shapes and discover a geometry rule themselves
Record short revision videos for tough topics and share as a playlist
Use formative 'check-for-understanding' questions every 10 minutes
steps_hi: मुफ्त GeoGebra से बच्चों को आकृतियाँ खिसकाकर ज्यामिति नियम स्वयं खोजने दें
कठिन टॉपिक के छोटे रिवीज़न वीडियो रिकॉर्ड कर प्लेलिस्ट साझा करें
हर 10 मिनट पर समझ जाँचने वाले फ़ॉर्मेटिव प्रश्न पूछें
scene: Chennai students exploring triangles on GeoGebra on a big screen, a 3D printer and robot kit in the background, a woman teacher asking a question

name: Ms. Vijayalakshmi V
school: Bharathiyar Centenary Government Girls Higher Secondary School, Tiruppur
citation: Ms. Vijayalakshmi V is pioneering in adopting experiential learning methods such as field visits to archaeological sites, practical demonstrations using everyday materials, and integration of digital tools to enhance understanding. She attended and conducted numerous training programs under the SCERT and DIET initiatives as a State-level resource person for Social Science and ICT training. Her efforts have focused on acquiring digital literacy and fostering collaborative learning environments among teachers. As a member of the Child Protection Committee and Women Protection Committee of Udumalpet Municipal Council, she has worked to safeguard the rights and well-being of children. She has organized health camps, menstrual hygiene awareness sessions, and nutritional guidance programs to support adolescent girls. Under her mentorship, alumni contributions have supported scholarships and awards. Her dedicated service has been recognized by the Dr. Radhakrishnan Best Teacher Award from the Government of Tamil Nadu.
core: Experiential Teaching, learning, and community engagement
t_en: Field visits to archaeological sites and everyday-material demos
t_hi: पुरातात्विक स्थलों की यात्रा और रोज़मर्रा की वस्तुओं से प्रदर्शन
s_hi: पुरातात्विक स्थलों की फील्ड यात्रा, रोज़मर्रा की वस्तुओं से व्यावहारिक प्रदर्शन, डिजिटल टूल; बाल संरक्षण समिति सदस्य; किशोरियों के लिए स्वास्थ्य शिविर व मासिक धर्म स्वच्छता जागरूकता।
steps_en: Plan one local heritage/field visit per term with a worksheet (observe, sketch, ask)
Demonstrate History/Geography ideas with everyday objects (clay pot = trade, rope = timeline)
Run a menstrual-hygiene and nutrition session for adolescent girls
steps_hi: हर टर्म एक स्थानीय विरासत/फील्ड यात्रा वर्कशीट (देखो, स्केच करो, पूछो) के साथ करें
इतिहास/भूगोल की बातें रोज़मर्रा की वस्तुओं से दिखाएँ (मिट्टी का घड़ा = व्यापार, रस्सी = समयरेखा)
किशोरियों के लिए मासिक धर्म स्वच्छता और पोषण सत्र रखें
scene: Tamil Nadu girls on a field trip at an ancient temple ruin sketching inscriptions, a teacher holding a clay pot to explain trade

name: Mr. Kishorkumar M S
