school: Government Vocational Higher Secondary School Kallara, Thiruvananthapuram
citation: Mr. Kishorkumar M.S. is a committed teacher working towards empowering girls through education in marginalized communities. He has made significant progress in lowering dropout rates among girls. He visits remote villages to engage with families and build trust. He creates awareness through different platforms, giving motivational talks on All India Radio and teaching lessons on Kalvi Tholaikatchi. He has worked as a State-level resource person, training teachers on innovative methods and how to use technology in the classroom. His commitment to student welfare is commendable. He has also organized health camps and takes prompt action to protect at-risk students. He has successfully gathered community support to improve school facilities and hygiene. For his steadfast dedication, Mr. Kishorkumar received the Dr. Radhakrishnan Best Teacher Award.
core: Gender sensitive approach to education
t_en: Village outreach to reduce girls' dropout
t_hi: बालिका ड्रॉपआउट कम करने हेतु गाँव-संपर्क
s_hi: हाशिये के समुदायों में बालिका शिक्षा; दूरस्थ गाँवों में परिवारों से मिलकर विश्वास बनाया; आकाशवाणी व कल्वी टीवी पर प्रेरक वार्ता; जोखिम वाले छात्रों की सुरक्षा।
steps_en: Keep a list of girls at risk of dropping out and visit their families every term
Invite women role models from the area to talk to girls
Set a quick referral plan for at-risk students (counsellor, helpline, CWC)
steps_hi: ड्रॉपआउट के जोखिम वाली बालिकाओं की सूची रखें और हर टर्म उनके परिवारों से मिलें
क्षेत्र की प्रेरक महिलाओं को बालिकाओं से बात करने बुलाएँ
जोखिम वाले छात्रों के लिए त्वरित रेफ़रल योजना रखें (काउंसलर, हेल्पलाइन, CWC)
scene: A teacher sitting on a verandah with parents and a teenage daughter in a Kerala village, the girl holding school books

name: Dr. V. Rex Alias Radhakrishnan
school: Thillaiyadi Valliammai Government High School, Pondicherry
citation: Dr. V. Radhakrishnan, a Trained Graduate Teacher at Thillaiyadi Valliammai Government High School, is a beacon of dedication and innovation in education. His commitment to student welfare and academic excellence is evident through his numerous practical initiatives. He developed e-content and handbooks for 10th-standard students, contributing to a 100% success rate in public exams for the past decade. Dr. Radhakrishnan fosters all-around development through joyful learning, field trips, and "bagless days." His efforts extend to the community, where he has successfully increased school enrolment, reduced dropouts, and organized vital programs like blood donation camps and environmental drives. He has authored two textbooks and received multiple accolades, including the State Best Teacher Award and the National Innovation Award. Dr. Radhakrishnan's inspirational work, such as guiding a student away from drug abuse and back to school, exemplifies his profound impact on the lives of his students and community.
core: Community engagement and Information and communication technology
t_en: Class 10 e-content handbooks and bagless days
t_hi: कक्षा 10 ई-कंटेंट हैंडबुक और बैगलेस दिवस
s_hi: कक्षा 10 के लिए ई-कंटेंट व हैंडबुक बनाकर दस साल से 100% परिणाम; आनंदमय शिक्षा, फील्ड ट्रिप व "बैगलेस डे"; नामांकन बढ़ाना, रक्तदान व पर्यावरण अभियान।
steps_en: Make a chapter-wise one-page handbook (key points, 5 likely questions)
Schedule a monthly bagless day with a field trip or activity stations
Track every Class 10 student weekly with a simple progress grid
steps_hi: अध्यायवार एक-पेज हैंडबुक (मुख्य बिंदु, 5 संभावित प्रश्न) बनाएँ
हर महीने फील्ड ट्रिप या गतिविधि स्टेशन वाला बैगलेस डे रखें
हर कक्षा 10 छात्र की साप्ताहिक प्रगति सरल ग्रिड में देखें
scene: Puducherry students on a bagless day studying plants in a botanical garden, others holding printed handbooks, teacher with a progress grid

name: Mr. Madhusudan K S
school: Government Higher Primary School Hinakal, Mysuru
citation: Mr. Madhusudan K. S. is a dedicated teacher whose teaching philosophy is founded on the belief that education must extend beyond the textbook, empowering students to become active participants and problem-solvers. In his classroom, he has successfully bridged the gap between theory and practice through a strong focus on experiential learning and hands-on projects. In 2023, Mr. Madhusudan established C Lounge (Camp, Create, Celebrate), a school makerspace equipped with robotics kits, a 3D printer, drone technology, and AI tools. This innovation has provided a platform for students to engage in real-world challenges, such as designing robots for problem-solving, exploring drone applications, and developing sustainable projects like grey water purification systems. Mr. Madhusudan’s dedication has resulted in significant student achievements, including award-winning projects at prestigious exhibitions. By securing support from stakeholders and collaborating with local organizations, he has made modern educational tools accessible to marginalized students, embodying a commitment to innovation, community involvement, and transformative impact in education.
core: Use of AI and Technology
t_en: "C Lounge" makerspace with robotics, drones and AI
t_hi: "सी लाउंज" मेकरस्पेस: रोबोटिक्स, ड्रोन और AI
s_hi: 2023 में "C Lounge (कैम्प, क्रिएट, सेलिब्रेट)" मेकरस्पेस बनाया जिसमें रोबोटिक्स किट, 3D प्रिंटर, ड्रोन व AI टूल हैं; बच्चे ग्रे-वॉटर शुद्धिकरण जैसे वास्तविक समस्याओं पर काम करते हैं।
steps_en: Start a 'maker corner' with waste material, simple tools and one robotics kit
Give a monthly real-world challenge (save water, help farmers) and celebrate solutions
Ask local organisations to sponsor one piece of equipment at a time
steps_hi: कबाड़, सरल औज़ार और एक रोबोटिक्स किट के साथ 'मेकर कॉर्नर' शुरू करें
हर महीने एक वास्तविक चुनौती (पानी बचाओ, किसानों की मदद) दें और समाधानों का उत्सव मनाएँ
स्थानीय संस्थाओं से एक-एक उपकरण प्रायोजित करने को कहें
scene: Karnataka government primary children assembling a small drone and a grey-water filter model in a colourful makerspace labelled 'C Lounge'

name: Dr. Avinasha Sharma
citation: Dr. Avinasha Sharma, an English Language teacher, has been instrumental in transforming the lives of students, especially those from underprivileged backgrounds, by making English learning engaging and enjoyable through the establishment of an English Language Lab. Recognizing the importance of practical exposure, she designed structured learning modules tailored for a technology-enabled language lab to strengthen students’ communication skills. She further enriched learning by organizing an international Skypeathon with Columbia University. Aligned with the National Education Policy 2020, she is currently leveraging Artificial Intelligence to identify individual student strengths and support their growth through targeted academic guidance and career mentorship.
core: Creative and formative assessment with emphasis on language learning processes
t_en: English Language Lab with structured modules and global Skypeathon
t_hi: संरचित मॉड्यूल वाली अंग्रेज़ी भाषा लैब और अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्काइपथॉन
s_hi: वंचित बच्चों के लिए अंग्रेज़ी भाषा लैब, संचार कौशल हेतु संरचित मॉड्यूल, कोलंबिया विश्वविद्यालय के साथ स्काइपथॉन; AI से व्यक्तिगत क्षमताएँ पहचानकर मार्गदर्शन।
steps_en: Make a weekly 'speaking lab' period: listen to a 2-minute audio, repeat, record yourself on a phone
Use a simple speaking rubric (fluency, words, confidence) for formative feedback
Arrange one video call a term with a class or expert from another country
steps_hi: हर हफ्ते 'स्पीकिंग लैब' पीरियड: 2 मिनट का ऑडियो सुनें, दोहराएँ, फ़ोन पर अपनी आवाज़ रिकॉर्ड करें
फ़ॉर्मेटिव फ़ीडबैक के लिए सरल बोलने की रूब्रिक (प्रवाह, शब्द, आत्मविश्वास) रखें
हर टर्म किसी दूसरे देश की कक्षा/विशेषज्ञ से एक वीडियो कॉल करें
scene: Haryana government school students wearing headphones in a language lab, one student speaking on a video call with foreign students on a projector

name: Mr. Sunil Kumar
citation: Mr. Sunil Kumar, a Chemistry Lecturer, is an inspiration known for his passion for teaching and commitment beyond the classroom. He has adopted innovative approaches such as observation-based learning and problem-solving techniques to make learning meaningful. He has mentored numerous students for competitions including the National Talent Hunt and INSPIRE, guiding them to success at district, state, and international levels. One of his students clinched the Bronze Award at the Indian Young Innovators and Inventors Challenge. His exceptional dedication to nurturing curiosity and encouraging inquiry among students earned him the prestigious Gyan Sarita Award .
core: Mentoring of students through encouragement and highlighting the utility of children’s questions
t_en: Question-driven Chemistry and INSPIRE mentoring
t_hi: प्रश्न-आधारित रसायन शिक्षण और INSPIRE मेंटरिंग
s_hi: अवलोकन आधारित शिक्षण व समस्या समाधान तकनीक, बच्चों के प्रश्नों को महत्व; NTSE व INSPIRE में मार्गदर्शन; एक छात्र को इंडियन यंग इनोवेटर्स चैलेंज में कांस्य।
steps_en: Start each topic with a 'question wall' where students post what they wonder
Turn the best question into a mini-investigation the class designs
Pick 2–3 student ideas each year for INSPIRE-MANAK
steps_hi: हर टॉपिक की शुरुआत 'प्रश्न दीवार' से करें जहाँ बच्चे अपनी जिज्ञासा लिखें
सबसे अच्छे प्रश्न को कक्षा द्वारा बनाई गई छोटी जाँच में बदलें
हर साल 2–3 छात्र विचार INSPIRE-MANAK के लिए चुनें
scene: Himachal hill-school students sticking question notes on a 'Why?' wall beside a simple chemistry experiment, teacher listening

name: Mr. Pankaj Kumar Goyal
citation: Mr. Pankaj Kumar Goyal has been honored with the State Teacher Award 2023 by the Chief Minister and Education Minister of Punjab for his exceptional commitment to empowering girls’ education. His mission is to provide maximum learning opportunities for girls and enable them to succeed academically and socially. During the pandemic, he developed video lectures and practice worksheets for Social Science, which were broadcast on national television, ensuring uninterrupted learning support for students. He employs joyful learning strategies, creative pedagogy, and low-cost teaching aids to cultivate reading and writing habits, making Social Science education engaging, inclusive, and effective.
core: Empowering Girls' Education and Innovative Pedagogy
t_en: TV video lessons and low-cost aids in Social Science for girls
t_hi: बालिकाओं के लिए सामाजिक विज्ञान में टीवी पाठ और कम लागत सामग्री
s_hi: बालिका शिक्षा को समर्पित; महामारी में सामाजिक विज्ञान के वीडियो व अभ्यास पत्र राष्ट्रीय टीवी पर प्रसारित; आनंदमय रणनीतियाँ व कम लागत सामग्री से पठन-लेखन की आदत।
steps_en: Record 5-minute topic videos with a phone and a chart, and share them before tests
Make low-cost aids (map puzzles, timeline strings) for each unit
Give a weekly reading-and-writing task from newspapers
steps_hi: फ़ोन और चार्ट से 5 मिनट के टॉपिक वीडियो रिकॉर्ड कर परीक्षा से पहले साझा करें
हर इकाई के लिए कम लागत सामग्री (नक्शा पहेली, समयरेखा धागा) बनाएँ
अखबार से साप्ताहिक पठन-लेखन कार्य दें
scene: Punjab girls' school classroom with students solving a cardboard map puzzle, a teacher recording a lesson on a phone tripod

name: Mr. Rajinder Singh
addr: Kothe Indra Singh Wale, Goniana Mandi, Punjab - 151201
citation: Mr. Rajinder Singh has transformed his school through remarkable personal commitment and visionary leadership. He invested his own resources to establish state-of-the-art facilities, including a library, park, kitchen garden, nursery room, computer lab, and art room. These facilities, combined with a strong emphasis on moral values, have attracted students even from remote areas. In 2017, he pioneered English as the medium of instruction in the Bathinda district and developed YouTube-based lessons to make quality education accessible to all. A dedicated Scouts and Guides trainer, he mentored 102 students to achieve the highest national award. His establishment of six smart libraries named after Kalpana Chawla has further enriched the learning environment. For significantly increasing school enrolment over the past three years, he was honored with the prestigious Ambassador of Enrolment Award .
core: Improving universal access to schooling
t_en: Kalpana Chawla smart libraries and YouTube lessons
t_hi: कल्पना चावला स्मार्ट लाइब्रेरी और यूट्यूब पाठ
s_hi: अपने संसाधनों से लाइब्रेरी, पार्क, किचन गार्डन, कंप्यूटर लैब और आर्ट रूम बनाए; 2017 में ज़िले में अंग्रेज़ी माध्यम शुरू किया; यूट्यूब पाठ; 102 स्काउट्स को राष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार; छह "कल्पना चावला" स्मार्ट लाइब्रेरी।
steps_en: Set up a reading corner named after a role model and add 5 new books a month
Upload short lessons to a school YouTube/WhatsApp channel for parents
Run Scouts & Guides weekly with badge targets
steps_hi: किसी प्रेरक व्यक्तित्व के नाम पर पठन कोना बनाएँ और हर महीने 5 नई किताबें जोड़ें
अभिभावकों के लिए स्कूल यूट्यूब/व्हाट्सऐप चैनल पर छोटे पाठ डालें
बैज लक्ष्य के साथ हर हफ्ते स्काउट्स-गाइड्स चलाएँ
scene: Punjab primary children reading in a bright library with a Kalpana Chawla portrait and rocket mural, Scouts in uniform at the door

name: Mr. Baljinder Singh Brar
citation: Mr. Baljinder Singh Brar is deeply committed to the holistic development of students through innovative curricular and co-curricular initiatives rooted in indigenous skills. His work extends beyond academics, encompassing school development, social welfare, and the emotional and intellectual well-being of learners. A notable initiative is the launch of “Paryavaran Pathshala” , which fosters environmental consciousness among students. Demonstrating creativity in pedagogy, he has developed engaging English teaching-learning materials using recycled waste, including cloth-based models to explain grammar concepts. His establishment of a free Stationery Bank , providing eco-friendly recycled notebooks, pens, and pencils to underprivileged students, exemplifies his strong commitment to sustainability, equity, and social responsibility.
core: Environment awareness and 3H (Head, Hand, and Heart) approach
t_en: "Paryavaran Pathshala", cloth grammar models and Stationery Bank
t_hi: "पर्यावरण पाठशाला", कपड़े के व्याकरण मॉडल और स्टेशनरी बैंक
s_hi: "पर्यावरण पाठशाला" से पर्यावरण चेतना, रीसायकल कचरे व कपड़े से अंग्रेज़ी व्याकरण मॉडल, वंचित बच्चों के लिए रीसायकल कॉपियों-पेनों का मुफ्त स्टेशनरी बैंक; 3H (हेड, हैंड, हार्ट) दृष्टिकोण।
steps_en: Make cloth/cardboard sentence strips to physically build and rearrange English sentences
Open a stationery bank where students donate and borrow notebooks and pens
Hold a weekly 'Paryavaran Pathshala' period on one local environment issue
steps_hi: अंग्रेज़ी वाक्य जोड़ने-बदलने के लिए कपड़े/गत्ते की वाक्य पट्टियाँ बनाएँ
स्टेशनरी बैंक खोलें जहाँ बच्चे कॉपी-पेन दान करें और उधार लें
हर हफ्ते किसी स्थानीय पर्यावरण मुद्दे पर 'पर्यावरण पाठशाला' पीरियड रखें
scene: Rajasthan desert-village students arranging colourful cloth word strips into an English sentence on a line, a stationery bank shelf of recycled notebooks

name: Mr. Hukam Chand Chaudhary
citation: Mr. Hukam Chand Chaudhary is a dedicated government school teacher who is deeply committed to nurturing academic excellence, personal growth, and essential life skills among his students. His innovative mindset is reflected in the development of low-cost, project-based learning models. Noteworthy initiatives include an automated school bell created from recycled materials and an AI-powered chatbot capable of answering student queries via WhatsApp. He is a strong advocate of mentoring and has conceptualized impactful platforms such as the Gyanotsav Quiz Portal , Prarthana Sabha , and Khabar Se Jugaad . Beyond academics, he actively promotes environmental responsibility and patriotism by planting hundreds of saplings on school premises and organizing events to honour national martyrs. His exemplary service has earned him prestigious recognitions, including the State Teacher Award and Best Teacher Award at the Block level .
core: Promoting academic excellence through project-based approach
t_en: Recycled automatic school bell and WhatsApp AI chatbot
t_hi: रीसायकल सामग्री से स्वचालित घंटी और व्हाट्सऐप AI चैटबॉट
s_hi: कम लागत प्रोजेक्ट मॉडल जैसे रीसायकल सामग्री से स्वचालित स्कूल घंटी और व्हाट्सऐप पर प्रश्नों का उत्तर देने वाला AI चैटबॉट; ज्ञानोत्सव क्विज़ पोर्टल व "खबर से जुगाड़"।
steps_en: Give students a 'school problem' (bell, lights, water) to solve with recycled parts
Set up a class Q&A group where common questions get a short answer daily
Run a monthly quiz from news ('Khabar se Jugaad')
steps_hi: बच्चों को 'स्कूल की समस्या' (घंटी, लाइट, पानी) रीसायकल पुर्ज़ों से हल करने को दें
कक्षा प्रश्नोत्तर समूह बनाएँ जहाँ आम प्रश्नों का रोज़ छोटा उत्तर मिले
समाचार पर आधारित मासिक क्विज़ ('खबर से जुगाड़') करें
scene: Students in a Bikaner school wiring an automatic bell from scrap, another student chatting with a school chatbot on a phone

name: Mrs. Kusum Lata Gariya
citation: Mrs. Kusum Lata Gariya, a dedicated primary school teacher, has played a pivotal role in increasing school enrolment through strong community engagement and participation. Her innovative teaching approaches include menstrual hygiene education , QR code–integrated learning materials , puppets as teaching models , and skill-based education , all of which have significantly enhanced student learning outcomes. A notable initiative led by her is the creation of home-based learning corners , transforming each child’s home into an active learning space. She is also a committed yoga practitioner and has successfully integrated yoga into the school curriculum. With consistent community support, she continues to improve school infrastructure and meaningfully celebrate events such as Mother’s Day , strengthening school–community bonds.
core: Community Mobilization and Innovative Teaching Models
t_en: Home learning corners, puppets and QR materials
t_hi: घर में सीखने के कोने, कठपुतली और QR सामग्री
s_hi: समुदाय भागीदारी से नामांकन बढ़ाया; मासिक धर्म स्वच्छता शिक्षा, QR कोड युक्त सामग्री, कठपुतली से पढ़ाना; हर बच्चे के घर में "होम लर्निंग कॉर्नर"; योग को पाठ्यक्रम में जोड़ा।
steps_en: Help each family set a small 'learning corner' at home: a shelf, a chart and a daily 15-minute routine
Make sock or paper-bag puppets to tell lessons as stories
Start the day with 10 minutes of yoga
steps_hi: हर परिवार को घर में छोटा 'लर्निंग कॉर्नर' बनाने में मदद करें: एक शेल्फ, एक चार्ट और रोज़ 15 मिनट की दिनचर्या
मोज़े या कागज़ के थैले से कठपुतलियाँ बनाकर पाठ को कहानी की तरह सुनाएँ
दिन की शुरुआत 10 मिनट योग से करें
scene: Uttarakhand mountain home with a child at a small learning corner with charts, mother watching; inset of a teacher using a hand puppet in class

name: Ms. Chandralekha Damodar Mestri
school: Satyawati Soiru Angle Higher Secondary School
addr: Mashem Loliem, Canacona, South Goa, Goa - 403728
citation: Ms. Chandralekha Damodar Mestri rose to the challenge of bridging the language gap while teaching in a remote South Goa school bordering Karnataka. To engage her primarily first-generation learner students, she developed innovative, low-cost teaching aids and initiated home visits with books and stationery to foster a love of learning. Beyond the classroom, she created engaging e-content and established an Atal Tinkering Lab to inspire local students. She has been recognized for innovation in teaching-learning practices and plays a key role in organizing the Annual Canacona Taluka Level National Science Day. Her commitment to social and environmental causes—including water conservation, biodiversity protection, plastic reduction, tiger conservation, tobacco prevention, malaria awareness, road safety, and cyber safety—is exemplary.
core: Innovative Pedagogy and Environmental Sustainability
t_en: Bridging the language gap with home visits and Atal Tinkering Lab
t_hi: गृह भेंट और अटल टिंकरिंग लैब से भाषा अंतर पाटना
s_hi: कर्नाटक सीमा पर दूरस्थ विद्यालय में भाषा अंतर पाटने हेतु कम लागत TLM, पहली पीढ़ी के बच्चों के घर किताबें-स्टेशनरी लेकर जाना, ई-कंटेंट, अटल टिंकरिंग लैब और अनेक पर्यावरण-सामाजिक अभियान।
steps_en: Prepare bilingual word lists (home language ↔ school language) for each chapter
Visit first-generation learners' homes with a book and simple stationery
Hold a National Science Day event in your block with student demos
steps_hi: हर अध्याय के लिए द्विभाषी शब्द सूची (घर की भाषा ↔ विद्यालय की भाषा) बनाएँ
पहली पीढ़ी के बच्चों के घर किताब और सरल स्टेशनरी लेकर जाएँ
अपने ब्लॉक में बच्चों के प्रदर्शनों के साथ राष्ट्रीय विज्ञान दिवस मनाएँ
scene: A Goa teacher visiting a forest-edge home with books, a child reading a bilingual word chart, tinkering lab models in the background

name: Mr. Chandreshkumar Bholashankar Borisagar
citation: Mr. Chandreshkumar Bholashankar Borisagar, a teacher at Navi Badhada (Badhadapara) Primary School, initiated an innovative educational awareness campaign by mounting an information board on his bike. Traveling through villages and rural areas, he played motivational songs using a mobile speaker to encourage the enrolment of eligible children. This unique outreach initiative resulted in 100% enrolment in the targeted schools. To further improve attendance, he introduced a self-attendance chart and a visual attendance tree in his classroom, empowering students to take ownership of their learning journey.
core: Self-attendance initiatives for regular attendance and song-based enrolment drives
t_en: Bike-mounted enrolment drive with songs and a self-attendance tree
t_hi: बाइक पर गीतों के साथ नामांकन अभियान और स्व-उपस्थिति वृक्ष
s_hi: बाइक पर सूचना बोर्ड लगाकर मोबाइल स्पीकर से प्रेरक गीत बजाते हुए गाँव-गाँव नामांकन अभियान, जिससे 100% नामांकन; कक्षा में स्व-उपस्थिति चार्ट व "उपस्थिति वृक्ष"।
steps_en: Before the session, ride/walk through the village with a banner and songs inviting parents to enrol children
Make an 'attendance tree' where each child adds a leaf with their name every day
Celebrate the class with the fullest tree each month
steps_hi: सत्र से पहले बैनर और गीतों के साथ गाँव में घूमकर अभिभावकों को नामांकन के लिए बुलाएँ
'उपस्थिति वृक्ष' बनाएँ जिस पर हर बच्चा रोज़ अपने नाम की पत्ती लगाए
हर महीने सबसे भरे पेड़ वाली कक्षा का उत्सव मनाएँ
scene: A Gujarat village teacher on a motorbike with a colourful enrolment board and loudspeaker, children waving; inset of a paper attendance tree full of leaves

name: Mr. Vinay Shashikant Patel
citation: Mr. Vinay Shashikant Patel, a teacher at R.F. Patel High School, Vadadla, has made significant contributions to both education and environmental sustainability. He provided invaluable support to Thakur Vaishali, a specially abled student, who was selected to compete in the 100-meter running event at the state level. Demonstrating his commitment to environmentalism, he planted approximately 100 herbal plants and regularly distributes free herbal saplings to promote awareness about Ayurveda. In addition, he modernized the school’s library, laboratory, computer lab, and audio-visual room using interactive multimedia technology. He also engages students and parents through science education broadcasts on the BISAG channel. His dedication has been recognized with several honours, including the Best Eco Officer Award .
core: Eco-friendly initiatives and environmental sustainability
t_en: Herbal garden, sapling distribution and support for a para-athlete
t_hi: हर्बल उद्यान, पौध वितरण और दिव्यांग धावक को सहयोग
s_hi: एक विशेष रूप से सक्षम छात्रा को राज्य स्तरीय 100 मीटर दौड़ तक पहुँचाया; लगभग 100 औषधीय पौधे लगाए और मुफ्त पौध वितरण; लाइब्रेरी-लैब का आधुनिकीकरण; BISAG चैनल पर विज्ञान प्रसारण।
steps_en: Plant 20 medicinal plants with name boards and assign student caretakers
Distribute saplings on Parents' Day with a care card
Identify and coach one CWSN student for a sports or arts event
steps_hi: नाम पट्टिकाओं के साथ 20 औषधीय पौधे लगाएँ और छात्र देखभालकर्ता तय करें
अभिभावक दिवस पर देखभाल कार्ड के साथ पौधे बाँटें
किसी एक CWSN छात्र को खेल या कला कार्यक्रम के लिए चुनें और प्रशिक्षित करें
scene: Gujarat high-school students labelling tulsi and aloe plants in a herbal garden, a girl athlete with a prosthetic training on a track

name: Mr. Madhav Prasad Patel
citation: Mr. Madhav Prasad Patel, a teacher at Government Middle School, Lidhora, has carried out praiseworthy initiatives to nurture curiosity and independent learning among students. He developed a science wall where students are encouraged to freely display their questions, ideas, and scientific explorations. To cultivate reading habits in rural communities, he introduced mobile libraries on motorcycles, delivering books directly to homes and inspiring families to read together. His innovative community learning boards and farm schools ( Khet Pathshaala ) extended education beyond classrooms into real-life environments. This holistic approach strengthened the school’s reputation and ensured equitable learning opportunities for all students.
core: Reading habit inculcation through mobile libraries and experiential learning through Farm School (Khet Pathshaala)
t_en: Science question wall, motorcycle library and Khet Pathshala
t_hi: विज्ञान प्रश्न दीवार, मोटरसाइकिल पुस्तकालय और खेत पाठशाला
s_hi: विज्ञान दीवार जहाँ बच्चे अपने प्रश्न व विचार लिखते हैं; मोटरसाइकिल से घर-घर पुस्तकें; सामुदायिक सीखने के बोर्ड और खेत पाठशाला से वास्तविक जीवन में सीखना।
steps_en: Paint a 'Science Wall' where children freely write questions and ideas
Take a box of books on a cycle/bike to homes once a week
Hold one lesson a month in a farmer's field (soil, seeds, water)
steps_hi: 'विज्ञान दीवार' पेंट करें जहाँ बच्चे खुलकर प्रश्न और विचार लिखें
हफ्ते में एक बार साइकिल/बाइक पर किताबों का डिब्बा लेकर घरों तक जाएँ
महीने में एक पाठ किसान के खेत में लें (मिट्टी, बीज, पानी)
scene: Madhya Pradesh children learning in a wheat field with a farmer, a teacher's motorbike loaded with a book box, a chalk science wall full of questions

name: Ms. Sunita Godha
citation: Ms. Sunita Godha, of Govt. High School, Khajuria Sarang, focuses on maintaining regular student attendance by creating a positive, engaging classroom environment with tailored assignments and activities. She uses question-answer sessions and blackboards to enhance learning. Regular parent-teacher meetings address absences, achievements, and discipline. Individual attention is provided to students, including those with special needs or from economically disadvantaged backgrounds. Academic activities and dropout rates are regularly reviewed to improve education and ensure retention.
core: Innovative pedagogy and regularity in school attendance
t_en: Regular attendance through engaging lessons and PTMs
t_hi: रोचक कक्षा और PTM से नियमित उपस्थिति
s_hi: सकारात्मक कक्षा वातावरण, अनुकूलित असाइनमेंट, प्रश्नोत्तर सत्र, नियमित PTM में अनुपस्थिति व उपलब्धि पर चर्चा; CWSN व वंचित बच्चों पर व्यक्तिगत ध्यान; ड्रॉपआउट की नियमित समीक्षा।
steps_en: Track absences weekly and call parents after two missed days
Give tailored tasks to 3 groups (support, core, extension)
Review dropout risk list in every staff meeting
steps_hi: हर हफ्ते अनुपस्थिति देखें और दो दिन चूकने पर अभिभावकों को फ़ोन करें
3 समूहों (सहायता, मुख्य, विस्तार) को अनुकूलित कार्य दें
हर स्टाफ बैठक में ड्रॉपआउट जोखिम सूची की समीक्षा करें
scene: A woman teacher at a rural MP high school checking an attendance chart with parents during a PTM, students answering questions at the blackboard

name: K. Sharda
citation: K. Sharda has authored 10 books on educational topics, including Mathematics, health & well-being, and moral stories. Her Mathematics booklet integrates QR codes for instructional videos and practice questions, fostering interactive learning through innovations like expression and normative skills. She translated a moral storybook into Halbi language for children in Bastar and has undertaken numerous initiatives to contribute to the community.
core: Creation of Mathematics books and translation of books into Halbi language
t_en: QR-linked maths booklet and Halbi-language storybooks
t_hi: QR युक्त गणित पुस्तिका और हल्बी भाषा में कहानियाँ
s_hi: गणित, स्वास्थ्य व नैतिक कहानियों पर 10 पुस्तकें; गणित पुस्तिका में वीडियो व अभ्यास हेतु QR कोड; बस्तर के बच्चों के लिए नैतिक कहानी पुस्तक का हल्बी भाषा में अनुवाद।
steps_en: Make a worksheet with QR codes linking to short explainer videos (free QR generator)
Translate one storybook into the children's tribal/home language
Use the home-language book first, then the school-language version
steps_hi: मुफ्त QR जनरेटर से ऐसी वर्कशीट बनाएँ जिसमें छोटे व्याख्या वीडियो के QR कोड हों
एक कहानी पुस्तक का बच्चों की आदिवासी/घरेलू भाषा में अनुवाद करें
पहले घरेलू भाषा की पुस्तक, फिर विद्यालय भाषा का संस्करण पढ़ाएँ
scene: Bastar tribal children in a Chhattisgarh school reading a Halbi storybook, one scanning a QR code in a maths booklet on a phone

name: Mr. Narasimha Murthy H K
citation: Mr. Narasimha Murthy H K, a teacher at Daffodils English School, Sanjaynagar, believes that every child can excel. He uses unplugged activities, such as blindfold tasks and paper folding, to teach clear instructions and step-by-step problem-solving. His teaching includes Sudoku, IT expos, and project-based learning. Innovations like gamified learning through treasure hunts and Minecraft Education enhance joyful and critical thinking experiences. Murthy also employs gamified assessments and invites global guest speakers for online student interactions.
core: Innovative pedagogy including gamification
t_en: Unplugged coding, Sudoku and Minecraft Education
t_hi: अनप्लग्ड कोडिंग, सुडोकू और माइनक्राफ्ट एजुकेशन
s_hi: आँख पर पट्टी बाँधने व कागज़ मोड़ने जैसी अनप्लग्ड गतिविधियों से स्पष्ट निर्देश व चरणबद्ध समस्या समाधान; सुडोकू, IT एक्सपो, ट्रेज़र हंट, माइनक्राफ्ट एजुकेशन और गेमीफ़ाइड आकलन।
steps_en: Play a 'robot game': one blindfolded student follows exact step instructions from a partner
Use paper folding to teach algorithms and sequencing
Turn a revision class into a treasure hunt with clue cards
steps_hi: 'रोबोट खेल' खेलें: पट्टी बँधा एक छात्र साथी के सटीक चरण निर्देश माने
कागज़ मोड़कर एल्गोरिद्म व क्रम सिखाएँ
रिवीज़न कक्षा को सुराग कार्डों वाले ट्रेज़र हंट में बदलें
scene: Bengaluru students playing a blindfold 'robot' coding game on a grid drawn on the floor, others folding paper step by step

name: Mr. Dwiti Chandra Sahu
citation: Mr. Dwiti Chandra Sahu, a teacher at Govt High School Billesu, works in a remote, hilly district with poor connectivity and frequent power cuts. He has innovatively integrated ICT into the classroom without relying on electricity or the internet, creating educational games, a YouTube channel, and soft-copy PDFs. To support bilingual education, he uses tribal language dictionaries and bilingual storybooks in Odia and Kovi. Sahu also employs practical tools like marbles for arithmetic and flashcards for creative learning. He introduced "Funday" Saturdays with Parimal Pathshala, focusing on hygiene and safety. Additionally, Sahu implemented Pitara Shikshan Pedi using recycled materials, and established a school cooperative store, tribal museum, MLE reading corner, and craft corner to enrich student development.
core: Innovative pedagogy and integration of information and communication technology
t_en: Offline ICT and Odia–Kui bilingual learning in a tribal district
t_hi: आदिवासी ज़िले में ऑफ़लाइन ICT और ओड़िया-कुई द्विभाषी शिक्षा
s_hi: बिजली-इंटरनेट रहित पहाड़ी क्षेत्र में ऑफ़लाइन ICT, शैक्षिक खेल, PDF; ओड़िया व कुई (कोवी) द्विभाषी कहानियाँ और जनजातीय शब्दकोश; कंचे से अंकगणित; "फ़नडे" शनिवार; सहकारी दुकान, जनजातीय संग्रहालय।
steps_en: Load lessons and games on a phone/tablet so they work without internet
Make a picture dictionary of 100 words in the tribal language and the school language
Set up a small tribal museum/corner with objects from children's homes
steps_hi: पाठ और खेल फ़ोन/टैबलेट में डाउनलोड कर रखें ताकि बिना इंटरनेट चलें
आदिवासी भाषा और विद्यालय भाषा में 100 शब्दों का चित्र-शब्दकोश बनाएँ
बच्चों के घरों की वस्तुओं से छोटा जनजातीय संग्रहालय/कोना बनाएँ
scene: Odisha hill-school children using an offline tablet game, a bilingual picture dictionary on the wall, a corner with tribal baskets and tools

name: Mr. Santosh Kumar Kar
school: Jaya Durga High School, Narla Road
citation: Mr. Santosh Kumar Kar, a teacher at Jaya Durga High School, Narla Road, has developed over 200 hands-on teaching-learning materials for classroom and laboratory use, making concepts comprehensible and engaging. With strong ICT skills, he assists fellow teachers in using Smart Boards, e-content, and computers. The School Science Club, under his guidance, promotes science education and scientific temper. He also established a mini science lab equipped with maximum resources with alumni support. Additionally, he manages a mini nursery in the school, germinating 1,000 saplings and distributing them free to institutions for plantation and science teaching purposes.
core: Innovative pedagogy and promoting a green ecosystem
t_en: 200+ hands-on TLMs, mini science lab and sapling nursery
t_hi: 200+ हस्तनिर्मित TLM, मिनी विज्ञान लैब और पौध नर्सरी
s_hi: कक्षा व प्रयोगशाला के लिए 200 से अधिक हस्तनिर्मित TLM; शिक्षकों को स्मार्ट बोर्ड में सहायता; विज्ञान क्लब; पूर्व छात्रों की मदद से मिनी लैब; 1,000 पौधे उगाकर मुफ्त वितरण।
steps_en: Aim for one hand-made TLM per week and store them in a labelled cupboard
Ask alumni to donate one lab item each
Grow saplings from seeds collected by students and gift them
steps_hi: हर हफ्ते एक हस्तनिर्मित TLM का लक्ष्य रखें और लेबल वाली अलमारी में रखें
पूर्व छात्रों से एक-एक प्रयोगशाला सामग्री दान करने को कहें
बच्चों द्वारा इकट्ठा बीजों से पौधे उगाकर उपहार दें
scene: Odisha science teacher showing a shelf of handmade models, students potting saplings in a school nursery

name: Mr. Ashis Kumar Roy
citation: Mr. Ashis Kumar Roy, a teacher at Sri Nara Singha Vidyapith, Atharakhai, has established an orchid park in the school. He secured funding from the West Bengal Biodiversity Board and transformed barren land into a butterfly conservation area to protect local species. He also created a medicinal garden with QR-coded plant information, initiated an Azolla project, and established a bird conservation area. With student participation, he implemented a composting project using kitchen waste and spearheaded groundwater recharge and wastewater management initiatives in collaboration with the Gram Panchayat. In addition, he employs innovative teaching methods focusing on environmental conservation and practical ecology.
core: Orchid conservation and wastewater management
t_en: Orchid park, butterfly zone and QR medicinal garden
t_hi: ऑर्किड पार्क, तितली क्षेत्र और QR युक्त औषधीय उद्यान
s_hi: जैव विविधता बोर्ड की मदद से ऑर्किड पार्क, बंजर भूमि पर तितली संरक्षण क्षेत्र, QR कोड वाला औषधीय उद्यान, एज़ोला प्रोजेक्ट, पक्षी क्षेत्र, किचन कचरे से कम्पोस्ट, ग्राम पंचायत के साथ भूजल रिचार्ज।
steps_en: Plant nectar plants to create a butterfly corner and keep a sighting log
Add QR codes to plants linking to student-written notes
Start a compost pit using mid-day meal kitchen waste
steps_hi: तितलियों के लिए मकरंद वाले पौधे लगाएँ और दर्शन रजिस्टर रखें
पौधों पर QR कोड लगाएँ जो बच्चों के लिखे नोट्स खोलें
मध्याह्न भोजन के किचन कचरे से कम्पोस्ट गड्ढा शुरू करें
scene: North Bengal school garden with orchids and butterflies, students logging butterfly sightings, a compost pit and QR tags on plants

name: Mr. Prasanta Kumar Marik
school: Shalbagan G S F P School, 1 No. Gurdaha
citation: Mr. Prasanta Kumar Marik, as an administrative head at Shalbagan G S F P School, leads educational initiatives collaboratively with teachers, staff, and the Child Cabinet. His focus spans teaching strategies, student enrolment, health, and hygiene, fostering an engaging and inclusive learning environment. Aligned with NEP 2020, he actively creates e-content, videos, and PPTs using blended or flipped teaching methods. He emphasizes holistic development through low-cost, play-based learning materials, encourages open-air classes, and implements innovative pedagogy to make education relatable and child-friendly. His mentorship nurtures curiosity, joy in learning, and a love for exploration among students.
core: Innovative pedagogy and activities in line with NEP 2020
t_en: Child Cabinet, open-air classes and play-based TLM
t_hi: बाल मंत्रिमंडल, खुले में कक्षाएँ और खेल आधारित TLM
s_hi: शिक्षकों, कर्मचारियों और बाल मंत्रिमंडल के साथ मिलकर नेतृत्व; NEP अनुरूप ई-कंटेंट, वीडियो, फ्लिप्ड शिक्षण; कम लागत खेल आधारित सामग्री; खुले में कक्षाएँ।
steps_en: Form a Child Cabinet (health, cleanliness, library ministers) that meets weekly
Hold one open-air class a week under a tree
Make 3 play-based TLMs per term with children
steps_hi: बाल मंत्रिमंडल (स्वास्थ्य, स्वच्छता, पुस्तकालय मंत्री) बनाएँ जो हर हफ्ते मिले
हफ्ते में एक कक्षा पेड़ के नीचे खुले में लें
हर टर्म बच्चों के साथ 3 खेल आधारित TLM बनाएँ
scene: West Bengal primary children holding a 'Child Cabinet' meeting with name badges, an open-air class under a large tree

name: Dr. Urfana Amin
citation: Dr. Urfana Amin is a multi-talented higher secondary teacher of English and Entrepreneurship, and a resource person for teacher training in Curriculum & Pedagogy, ECCE, and Inclusive Education. She has significantly contributed to education through teaching, mentorship, and material development. During the COVID-19 pandemic, she played a pivotal role in delivering classes via radio. She has fostered cultural activities within cluster schools of BHSS Soura and developed diverse educational resources including FLN modules, e-content for DIKSHA, e-Jadui Pitara, translated BARKHA series, Home-Based Activity Books, and Adult Literacy materials. Dr. Amin employs innovative teaching methodologies such as storytelling, treasure hunts, low-cost teaching aids, and effective integration of technology. With over three decades of teaching experience, she has mentored numerous students who now hold influential positions across various fields.
core: Experiential and exploratory teaching-learning pedagogy
t_en: Radio classes, e-Jadui Pitara and FLN modules
t_hi: रेडियो कक्षाएँ, ई-जादुई पिटारा और FLN मॉड्यूल
s_hi: कोविड में रेडियो से कक्षाएँ; FLN मॉड्यूल, दीक्षा ई-कंटेंट, ई-जादुई पिटारा, बरखा श्रृंखला अनुवाद, गृह-आधारित गतिविधि पुस्तकें, प्रौढ़ साक्षरता सामग्री; कहानी, ट्रेज़र हंट व कम लागत सामग्री।
steps_en: Translate a graded reader series (like Barkha) into the local language
Make a home-activity book with 20 simple tasks parents can do with children
Use storytelling and treasure hunts for revision
steps_hi: किसी स्तरीकृत पठन श्रृंखला (जैसे बरखा) का स्थानीय भाषा में अनुवाद करें
अभिभावकों के लिए 20 सरल गतिविधियों वाली घर-गतिविधि पुस्तक बनाएँ
रिवीज़न के लिए कहानी और ट्रेज़र हंट अपनाएँ
scene: Kashmir classroom with children listening to a story while a teacher holds a translated picture book; inset of a radio broadcasting a lesson

name: Mr. Ravi Kant Dwivedi
citation: Mr. Ravi Kant Dwivedi is dedicated to improving student enrolment and attendance with strong community support. He fosters a holistic learning environment emphasizing academics as well as co-curricular activities, introducing innovative initiatives like Samachar Vachan Kendra and Motivation for Mothers . Under his leadership, students have excelled in multiple district and state-level sports meets. He has enhanced school infrastructure through Smart Classrooms, a Mathematics Garden, and an Enrolment Help Desk, all supported by the community. The school’s exceptional performance earned Best School Awards in 2019 and 2022, and Mr. Dwivedi’s contributions were recognized with the prestigious Best Teacher Award at the state level in 2021.
core: Inspiring students to excel through innovative pedagogy
t_en: "Samachar Vachan Kendra", Maths Garden and Enrolment Help Desk
t_hi: "समाचार वाचन केंद्र", गणित उद्यान और नामांकन हेल्प डेस्क
s_hi: समुदाय सहयोग से नामांकन व उपस्थिति; "समाचार वाचन केंद्र" व "माताओं को प्रेरणा" पहल; स्मार्ट क्लास, गणित उद्यान व नामांकन हेल्प डेस्क; खेलों में सफलता।
steps_en: Let children read the day's headline aloud in assembly ('news reading centre')
Make a maths garden: number path, shape beds, measuring corner
Put up an enrolment help desk at the gate in April with a volunteer parent
steps_hi: प्रार्थना सभा में बच्चे दिन की मुख्य खबर पढ़ें ('समाचार वाचन केंद्र')
गणित उद्यान बनाएँ: संख्या पथ, आकृति क्यारियाँ, माप कोना
अप्रैल में एक स्वयंसेवी अभिभावक के साथ गेट पर नामांकन हेल्प डेस्क लगाएँ
scene: Mirzapur primary school assembly with a child reading a newspaper headline, a colourful maths garden path, parents at an enrolment desk

name: Mr. Shyam Prakash Maurya
citation: Mr. Shyam Prakash Maurya, a dedicated science teacher, has significantly boosted student enrolment through innovative initiatives like the annual enrolment fair, engaging both students and parents. Through community support, he enhanced schooling facilities with technologically integrated smart labs and well-equipped science labs. His students have excelled in competitions including the Inspire Award Manak Scheme, National Children's Science Congress, and District-level Science Olympiad. He fosters a holistic learning environment by emphasizing skill development, hands-on science experiments, and sports and physical training. His contributions have earned accolades such as the ICT and State Teacher Award (2018), A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial Award (2021), and Vidyarthi Vigyan Manthan Excellent Teacher Award (2022).
core: A firm believer in experiential learning, successfully implementing the "Learning by Doing" approach
t_en: Annual Enrolment Fair and "Learning by Doing" science
t_hi: वार्षिक नामांकन मेला और "करके सीखो" विज्ञान
s_hi: वार्षिक नामांकन मेले से नामांकन बढ़ाया; समुदाय सहयोग से स्मार्ट व विज्ञान लैब; INSPIRE, NCSC, विज्ञान ओलंपियाड में सफलता; कौशल, प्रयोग व खेल पर ज़ोर।
steps_en: Hold an Enrolment Fair with science demos, games and admission forms
Do at least one hands-on experiment per week with student-led recording
Prepare a 'science olympiad corner' with past questions
steps_hi: विज्ञान प्रदर्शन, खेल और प्रवेश फ़ॉर्म के साथ नामांकन मेला लगाएँ
हर हफ्ते कम से कम एक प्रयोग करवाएँ जिसे बच्चे ही दर्ज करें
पुराने प्रश्नों के साथ 'विज्ञान ओलंपियाड कोना' बनाएँ
scene: Uttar Pradesh school enrolment fair with stalls, children demonstrating simple experiments to visiting parents

name: Dr. Minakshi Kumari
school: Shiv Ganga Girls Plus 2 High School, Madhubani, Rahika
citation: Dr. Minakshi Kumari, a teacher at Shiv Ganga Girls Plus 2 High School, Madhubani, actively promotes community participation by engaging parents in school initiatives such as clean uniforms, sanitary pads, and basic drinking water facilities. She has published over 50 stories and poems and advocates against child marriage, successfully averting 20 potential cases. Her efforts encourage girls to participate in academic and extracurricular activities including games, athletics, Mithila painting, community service, and exploring self-employment opportunities.
core: Awareness creation against child marriage and fostering community participation
t_en: Averting child marriage and community-supported girls' school
t_hi: बाल विवाह रोकना और समुदाय-सहयोगी बालिका विद्यालय
s_hi: अभिभावकों को साफ यूनिफ़ॉर्म, सैनिटरी पैड, पेयजल जैसी पहलों से जोड़ा; 20 संभावित बाल विवाह रोके; 50+ कहानियाँ-कविताएँ प्रकाशित; खेल, मिथिला चित्रकला व स्वरोज़गार के अवसर।
steps_en: Set up a confidential channel for girls to report early-marriage pressure
Bring in a Mithila/local art session that can also become a livelihood skill
Hold a parents' pledge meeting on girls' education
steps_hi: बालिकाओं के लिए बाल विवाह दबाव बताने का गोपनीय माध्यम बनाएँ
मिथिला/स्थानीय कला सत्र रखें जो आजीविका कौशल भी बन सके
बालिका शिक्षा पर अभिभावकों की संकल्प बैठक करें
scene: Bihar girls in a classroom painting Madhubani art, a woman teacher talking with mothers about girls' education

name: Mr. Sikendra Kumar Suman
school: New Primary School Tarahani, Kaimur – Bhabua, Kudra
citation: Mr. Sikendra Kumar Suman, a teacher at New Primary School Tarahani, has made significant contributions across multiple educational domains, including ICT integration, school management, and the development of low-cost teaching aids. He created videos and e-content for the Chief Minister's Safe Saturday Programme (Mukhaya Mantri Vidyalaya Surakshit Shanivar Karyakarm) and enriched interaction for mentors, teachers, and students via YouTube. Additionally, he has revitalized students' reading and writing habits using libraries, e-content, storytelling, VR boxes, and Google tools.
core: Advancing ICT integration and development of effective Teaching-Learning Materials (TLM)
t_en: VR boxes, Safe Saturday videos and reading revival
t_hi: VR बॉक्स, सुरक्षित शनिवार वीडियो और पठन पुनर्जीवन
s_hi: मुख्यमंत्री विद्यालय सुरक्षित शनिवार कार्यक्रम के लिए वीडियो व ई-कंटेंट; यूट्यूब से संवाद; लाइब्रेरी, कहानी, VR बॉक्स और गूगल टूल से पढ़ने-लिखने की आदत।
steps_en: Use a low-cost cardboard VR viewer with a phone for virtual field trips
Make a weekly storytelling period followed by children writing 3 lines
Create short safety-awareness videos with children for Saturdays
steps_hi: फ़ोन के साथ कम लागत गत्ते के VR व्यूअर से वर्चुअल भ्रमण कराएँ
हर हफ्ते कहानी पीरियड रखें और फिर बच्चे 3 पंक्तियाँ लिखें
शनिवार के लिए बच्चों के साथ सुरक्षा जागरूकता के छोटे वीडियो बनाएँ
scene: Bihar primary children wearing cardboard VR viewers looking amazed, a teacher with a phone and a storybook

name: Ms. K. Suma
citation: Ms. K. Suma is committed to uplifting government schools and increasing enrolment. She promotes health and wellness through yoga camps for both students and the community and is dedicated to inclusive education. She conducts home-based education visits on every 4th Saturday and fosters experiential learning using innovative, low- and zero-cost Teaching-Learning Materials (TLMs). Her contributions have been recognized through certificates of appreciation for enhancing the quality of education and supporting initiatives like the Alternative Academic Calendar and Innovative Pathshaala.
core: Promoting community service and dedicated weekly home-based education
t_en: Fourth-Saturday home-based education visits and yoga camps
t_hi: हर चौथे शनिवार गृह-आधारित शिक्षा भेंट और योग शिविर
s_hi: सरकारी विद्यालयों को सशक्त करने व नामांकन बढ़ाने हेतु; छात्रों व समुदाय के लिए योग शिविर; समावेशी शिक्षा; हर चौथे शनिवार घर-आधारित शिक्षा भेंट; कम/शून्य लागत TLM।
steps_en: Fix every 4th Saturday for home visits to children who need extra support
Carry a small TLM kit to use with the child and parent
Hold a community yoga morning each term
steps_hi: हर चौथा शनिवार उन बच्चों के घर जाने के लिए तय करें जिन्हें अतिरिक्त सहायता चाहिए
बच्चे और अभिभावक के साथ उपयोग के लिए छोटा TLM किट साथ ले जाएँ
हर टर्म सामुदायिक योग सुबह रखें
scene: Andaman teacher sitting on a home's verandah teaching a child with a TLM kit, mother watching; community yoga on a beach-side school ground

name: Ms. Sunita Gupta
citation: Ms. Sunita Gupta, a dedicated Mathematics teacher, has transformed learning into a joyful experience. By leveraging technology through animated videos and creating low-cost teaching aids, she has made complex mathematical concepts accessible to all her students. Her effective use of digital platforms like DIKSHA and SWAYAM has enriched classroom instruction. She has developed e-content and video scripts on visualizing solid shapes and provided engaging educational content through her YouTube channel, particularly supporting students in remote areas during the COVID pandemic. She encourages students to create their own learning aids and has utilized alumni and community support to improve school facilities.
core: Making complex mathematical concepts accessible to all learners
t_en: Animated videos and student-made maths aids
t_hi: एनिमेटेड वीडियो और बच्चों द्वारा बनाए गणित साधन
s_hi: एनिमेटेड वीडियो व कम लागत साधनों से कठिन गणित सरल; दीक्षा व स्वयं प्लेटफ़ॉर्म; ठोस आकृतियों पर ई-कंटेंट; यूट्यूब चैनल; बच्चों से स्वयं अधिगम सामग्री बनवाना।
steps_en: Ask each student group to build a model for one concept (nets of solids, angle tool)
Show a 3-minute animation before the abstract explanation
Use DIKSHA resources for practice homework
steps_hi: हर छात्र समूह से एक अवधारणा का मॉडल बनवाएँ (ठोस आकृतियों के जाल, कोण साधन)
अमूर्त व्याख्या से पहले 3 मिनट का एनीमेशन दिखाएँ
अभ्यास गृहकार्य हेतु दीक्षा संसाधन दें
scene: Navodaya students in a tribal district building cardboard nets of cubes and cones, an animation of a solid shape on a screen

name: Ms. Charu Sharma
school: Dr. Rajendra Prasad Kendriya Vidyalaya, New Delhi
citation: Ms. Charu Sharma is a dedicated teacher committed to unlocking the full potential of every child. Her visionary leadership transformed a Sarvodaya Vidyalaya into a premier Kendriya Vidyalaya, setting a new standard for educational excellence. She has been instrumental in creating a modern learning environment by establishing an AI lab, a Digital language lab, and three Balvatikas. Beyond academics, she has promoted awareness about menstrual health, child marriage, and environmental sustainability. Her efforts in cleanliness, hygiene, and waste management have earned her recognitions including the KVS National Incentive Award, Cleanliness Environmental Awards, Green School Award, Green School Audit, and Energy Management Award.
core: Transforming school through teamwork, mental health initiatives, and mentorship
t_en: AI lab, digital language lab and Balvatikas
t_hi: AI लैब, डिजिटल भाषा लैब और बालवाटिकाएँ
s_hi: सर्वोदय विद्यालय को उत्कृष्ट केंद्रीय विद्यालय में बदला; AI लैब, डिजिटल भाषा लैब और तीन बालवाटिकाएँ; मासिक धर्म स्वास्थ्य, बाल विवाह, पर्यावरण पर जागरूकता; ग्रीन स्कूल अवार्ड।
steps_en: Do a green audit with students (water, energy, waste) and act on 3 findings
Start a Balvatika play-based corner for the youngest learners
Hold a monthly mental-health circle for staff and students
steps_hi: बच्चों के साथ ग्रीन ऑडिट (पानी, ऊर्जा, कचरा) करें और 3 निष्कर्षों पर काम करें
सबसे छोटे बच्चों के लिए खेल आधारित बालवाटिका कोना शुरू करें
स्टाफ और छात्रों के लिए मासिक मानसिक स्वास्थ्य घेरा रखें
scene: A Kendriya Vidyalaya in Delhi with students using an AI lab, little children playing in a colourful Balvatika, a green-audit chart on the wall

name: Mr. Ashok Sengupta
school: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. I, Jalahalli West, Bengaluru Rural
citation: Mr. Ashok Sengupta, a seasoned Computer Science educator with more than three decades of experience, has contributed significantly to education and environmental conservation. Beyond his core subject, he champions Value Education, ICT training, and nature-oriented initiatives. His innovative approach includes empowering teachers with technology, fostering a love for programming among students, and introducing biodiversity informatics. His dedication to environmental sustainability is reflected in extensive butterfly research and outreach programs. Recognitions include KVS Regional & National Incentive Awards and the Green Teacher Award.
core: Empowering students through butterfly research and outreach programmes.
t_en: Butterfly research and biodiversity informatics
t_hi: तितली शोध और जैव विविधता सूचना विज्ञान
s_hi: कंप्यूटर विज्ञान के साथ मूल्य शिक्षा, ICT प्रशिक्षण और प्रकृति पहल; बच्चों में प्रोग्रामिंग प्रेम; जैव विविधता सूचना विज्ञान और व्यापक तितली शोध व आउटरीच।
steps_en: Students photograph butterflies on campus and log species in a spreadsheet
Teach basic data analysis (charts) using the class's own nature data
Share findings with a citizen-science portal
steps_hi: बच्चे परिसर में तितलियों की फ़ोटो लें और प्रजातियाँ स्प्रेडशीट में दर्ज करें
कक्षा के अपने प्रकृति डेटा से सरल डेटा विश्लेषण (चार्ट) सिखाएँ
निष्कर्ष किसी सिटीज़न साइंस पोर्टल पर साझा करें
scene: KV students photographing butterflies in a campus garden, another student entering data into a laptop spreadsheet

name: Mr. H.N. Girish
school: Government PU College for Girls NN0045, Hunsur, Mysuru
citation: Mr. H.N. Girish, a dedicated lecturer with three decades of experience, has revolutionized learning through innovative techniques like games, rangoli competitions, and card-based methods, making complex biological concepts enjoyable. He empowers students with knowledge about government schemes and fosters social responsibility through Eco Clubs, Standards Clubs, and Red-Ribbon clubs. Recognitions include Karnataka Best Lecturer Award, Education Excellence Award, and Hemmeya Kannadiga Award.
core: Instrumental in empowering students with knowledge about government schemes.
t_en: Games, rangoli and card methods for Biology; scheme awareness
t_hi: जीवविज्ञान के लिए खेल, रंगोली व कार्ड विधि; योजना जागरूकता
s_hi: खेल, रंगोली प्रतियोगिता व कार्ड आधारित विधि से कठिन जीवविज्ञान रोचक; छात्राओं को सरकारी योजनाओं की जानकारी; इको क्लब, स्टैंडर्ड्स क्लब, रेड रिबन क्लब।
steps_en: Ask groups to draw a biological process (cell division, digestion) as a rangoli
Make flashcard sets for terms and play matching games
Put up a 'Schemes for You' board on scholarships and girl-child schemes
steps_hi: समूहों से किसी जैविक प्रक्रिया (कोशिका विभाजन, पाचन) की रंगोली बनवाएँ
शब्दों के फ़्लैशकार्ड सेट बनाकर मिलान खेल खेलें
छात्रवृत्ति और बालिका योजनाओं पर 'आपके लिए योजनाएँ' बोर्ड लगाएँ
scene: Karnataka girls drawing a rangoli of a cell on the college floor, others playing flashcard games, a scheme notice board

name: Ms. Jyoti Panka
school: PM SHRI Government Higher Secondary School, Longding
citation: Ms. Jyoti Panka, Political Science teacher, has created projects like “Ek Kadam Sundarta ki Aur” and “Chale Gaon Ki Aur”. As NSS Programme Officer (2014–17), she conducted social service activities and awareness campaigns in remote villages, promoting unity and brotherhood under “Not Me but You”.
core: Beautification of School campus and Community service.
t_en: "Chale Gaon Ki Aur" village service and campus beautification
t_hi: "चले गाँव की ओर" ग्राम सेवा और परिसर सौंदर्यीकरण
s_hi: "एक कदम सुंदरता की ओर" और "चले गाँव की ओर" प्रोजेक्ट; NSS कार्यक्रम अधिकारी के रूप में दूरस्थ गाँवों में सेवा व जागरूकता अभियान।
steps_en: Adopt a nearby village for one service day per term (cleanliness, awareness)
Make campus beautification a class-wise competition
Link the visit to a Political Science topic (local governance)
steps_hi: हर टर्म एक सेवा दिवस के लिए पास का गाँव गोद लें (स्वच्छता, जागरूकता)
परिसर सौंदर्यीकरण को कक्षावार प्रतियोगिता बनाएँ
भ्रमण को राजनीति विज्ञान के विषय (स्थानीय शासन) से जोड़ें
scene: Arunachal students walking to a hill village with brooms and posters, a beautified school campus with flowers

name: Mr. Lephizo Apon
citation: Mr. Lephizo Apon, teacher at GHSS Dimapur, created biodegradable bags with students and conducted discussions on climate change and global warming. He serves as Executive Member of the Nthenyi Literature Board, contributing to Nthenyi literature publications and phonetic principles for Nagaland Heritage Studies textbooks.
core: Use of eco-friendly material and use of local language for textbook development.
t_en: Biodegradable bags and local-language textbook work
t_hi: जैव-अपघटनीय थैले और स्थानीय भाषा पाठ्यपुस्तक कार्य
s_hi: छात्रों के साथ जैव-अपघटनीय थैले बनाए, जलवायु परिवर्तन पर चर्चा; न्थेन्यी साहित्य बोर्ड में योगदान और नागालैंड हेरिटेज स्टडीज़ पाठ्यपुस्तक हेतु ध्वन्यात्मक सिद्धांत।
steps_en: Run a bag-making workshop from old cloth/newspaper and stop plastic in the canteen
Hold a monthly climate talk where students present local changes they notice
Use local-language words and songs in lessons
steps_hi: पुराने कपड़े/अखबार से थैला बनाने की कार्यशाला करें और कैंटीन में प्लास्टिक बंद करें
मासिक जलवायु वार्ता रखें जिसमें बच्चे अपने आसपास के बदलाव बताएँ
पाठों में स्थानीय भाषा के शब्द और गीत अपनाएँ
scene: Nagaland students stitching cloth bags in a classroom, a poster on climate change, a teacher reading from a local-language book

name: Ms. Nandita Chongtham
school: Sagolband Rishikul Upper Primary School, Sagolband
citation: Ms. Nandita Chongtham introduced innovative pedagogy via TLM development, collaborating with 16 teachers to form a Teachers Volunteer Team. Initially, they developed 40 TLMs, which expanded to 4000 TLMs across respective schools.
core: Use of innovative pedagogic approaches through low-cost TLM.
t_en: Teachers' volunteer team that scaled 40 TLMs to 4,000
t_hi: शिक्षक स्वयंसेवी टीम जिसने 40 TLM से 4,000 TLM बनाए
s_hi: 16 शिक्षकों की स्वयंसेवी टीम बनाकर TLM विकसित किए; शुरुआत 40 TLM से हुई जो विद्यालयों में 4,000 तक पहुँचे।
steps_en: Form a cluster-level TLM group of 5–10 teachers that meets monthly
Each teacher makes 2 TLMs and teaches others how to copy them
Keep a shared photo catalogue so every school can reproduce them
steps_hi: 5–10 शिक्षकों का क्लस्टर स्तर TLM समूह बनाएँ जो हर महीने मिले
हर शिक्षक 2 TLM बनाए और दूसरों को उनकी नकल करना सिखाए
साझा फ़ोटो कैटलॉग रखें ताकि हर विद्यालय उन्हें बना सके
scene: A group of Manipuri teachers at a table crafting colourful teaching aids together, finished TLMs displayed on a wall

name: Ms. Yankila Lama
citation: Ms. Yankila Lama believes every classroom can be transformed into a joyful space fostering collaboration, interaction, and discussion. As NCC in-charge, she mobilizes young human resources for community benefit, making complex community initiatives achievable.
core: Creating joyful learning environment for open dialogue and community connect through NCC.
t_en: Joyful dialogue classrooms and NCC community action
t_hi: आनंदमय संवाद कक्षा और NCC सामुदायिक कार्य
s_hi: हर कक्षा को सहयोग, संवाद और चर्चा वाला आनंदमय स्थान बनाना; NCC प्रभारी के रूप में युवाओं को सामुदायिक लाभ के कार्यों में लगाना।
steps_en: Use a talking circle or debate format for one lesson a week
Plan one NCC/Scouts community project per term with students leading
Let students set classroom rules together
steps_hi: हफ्ते में एक पाठ टॉकिंग सर्कल या वाद-विवाद के रूप में करें
हर टर्म छात्रों के नेतृत्व में एक NCC/स्काउट सामुदायिक प्रोजेक्ट करें
कक्षा के नियम बच्चों के साथ मिलकर बनाएँ
scene: Sikkim students in a lively discussion circle, NCC cadets cleaning a mountain stream

name: Mr. Joseph Vanlalhruaia Sailo
school: Synod Higher Secondary School, Tuithiang Veng
citation: Mr. Joseph Vanlalhruaia Sailo has encouraged students to use virtual reality, fitness apps, and online platforms to make physical education engaging and accessible. He also introduced alternative sports such as rock climbing, trekking, adventure sports, and field trips to promote teamwork and physical activity in nature.
core: Use of ICT for learning and implementation of alternative sports in school education.
t_en: VR and fitness apps with adventure sports in PE
t_hi: शारीरिक शिक्षा में VR, फ़िटनेस ऐप और साहसिक खेल
s_hi: वर्चुअल रियलिटी, फ़िटनेस ऐप व ऑनलाइन प्लेटफ़ॉर्म से शारीरिक शिक्षा रोचक; रॉक क्लाइम्बिंग, ट्रेकिंग, साहसिक खेल और फील्ड ट्रिप जैसे वैकल्पिक खेल।
steps_en: Track class fitness (steps, sit-ups) with a free app or a chart each month
Add one alternative sport per term (trekking, climbing, frisbee)
Plan a nature trek with teamwork tasks
steps_hi: हर महीने मुफ्त ऐप या चार्ट से कक्षा की फ़िटनेस (कदम, सिट-अप) दर्ज करें
हर टर्म एक वैकल्पिक खेल जोड़ें (ट्रेकिंग, क्लाइम्बिंग, फ़्रिस्बी)
टीमवर्क कार्यों वाली प्रकृति ट्रेकिंग की योजना बनाएँ
scene: Mizoram students rock climbing on a hillside with a PE teacher, one checking a fitness app on a phone

name: Mr. Everlasting Pyngrope
school: Myngken Christian Higher Secondary School, Bhoirymbong
citation: Mr. Everlasting Pyngrope, Principal of Myngken Christian Higher Secondary School, has implemented a school improvement plan including CWSN children. The school utilizes ICT through computer labs and smart classrooms for effective interactive learning. He focuses on CWSN students' learning via specialized materials and mentorship in collaboration with the District Social Welfare Department, fostering eagerness to learn.
core: Use of technology for inclusive learning (CWSN) and implementing a whole school approach.
t_en: Whole-school inclusion plan with ICT for CWSN
t_hi: CWSN के लिए ICT के साथ संपूर्ण-विद्यालय समावेशन योजना
s_hi: CWSN सहित विद्यालय सुधार योजना; कंप्यूटर लैब और स्मार्ट क्लास; ज़िला समाज कल्याण विभाग के सहयोग से CWSN के लिए विशेष सामग्री और मेंटरशिप।
steps_en: Write a one-page school inclusion plan (ramps, seating, assessment changes)
Use text-to-speech and large-font settings for CWSN on school computers
Partner with the district social welfare office for aids and assessment
steps_hi: एक-पेज विद्यालय समावेशन योजना लिखें (रैंप, बैठक, आकलन बदलाव)
विद्यालय कंप्यूटरों पर CWSN के लिए टेक्स्ट-टू-स्पीच और बड़े फ़ॉन्ट का उपयोग करें
सहायक उपकरण व आकलन हेतु ज़िला समाज कल्याण कार्यालय से साझेदारी करें
scene: Meghalaya school computer lab where a child with hearing aids works with a peer on a large-font screen, a ramp at the classroom door

name: Dr. Nani Gopal Debnath
citation: Dr. Nani Gopal Debnath has worked extensively on climate resilience initiatives such as tree plantation, plastic decomposition methods, water conservation, and high compost techniques, fostering a scientific attitude among students. He also employs trilingual teaching approaches using Bengali, English, and Kokborak to enhance learning outcomes.
core: Inculcation of scientific attitude amongst students and use of multilingual approach in teaching.
t_en: Trilingual teaching (Bengali–English–Kokborok) and climate projects
t_hi: त्रिभाषी शिक्षण (बांग्ला-अंग्रेज़ी-कोकबोरोक) और जलवायु प्रोजेक्ट
s_hi: वृक्षारोपण, प्लास्टिक अपघटन विधियाँ, जल संरक्षण, कम्पोस्ट तकनीक जैसे जलवायु लचीलापन प्रोजेक्ट; बांग्ला, अंग्रेज़ी और कोकबोरोक में त्रिभाषी शिक्षण।
steps_en: Write key science terms in three languages on the board for every lesson
Let students explain a concept in their home language to a partner first
Run a plastic-decomposition experiment over a term
steps_hi: हर पाठ में मुख्य विज्ञान शब्द बोर्ड पर तीन भाषाओं में लिखें
बच्चे पहले साथी को अपनी घरेलू भाषा में अवधारणा समझाएँ
एक टर्म में प्लास्टिक अपघटन प्रयोग चलाएँ
scene: Tripura classroom board with science words in Bengali, English and Kokborok, students checking soil jars in a plastic-decomposition experiment

name: Mr. Dipen Khanikar
school: Chi Chia Bokuloni Girls High School, No3 Bokuloni
citation: Mr. Dipen Khanikar has used puppets to engage the affective domain of learners and enhance creativity by organizing puppet shows. He also developed word games from waste paper to build language-related competencies and promoted toy-based pedagogy in alignment with NEP 2020.
core: Toy-based pedagogy in line with National Education Policy.
t_en: Puppet shows and waste-paper word games
t_hi: कठपुतली शो और रद्दी कागज़ से शब्द खेल
s_hi: कठपुतली शो से भावनात्मक जुड़ाव व रचनात्मकता; रद्दी कागज़ से भाषा कौशल हेतु शब्द खेल; NEP अनुरूप खिलौना आधारित शिक्षण।
steps_en: Let students make paper puppets and perform a lesson as a puppet show
Make word cards from old notebooks for word-building games
Use toys/objects to introduce a new topic
steps_hi: बच्चों से कागज़ की कठपुतलियाँ बनवाकर पाठ को कठपुतली शो में प्रस्तुत कराएँ
पुरानी कॉपियों से शब्द कार्ड बनाकर शब्द निर्माण खेल खेलें
नए विषय की शुरुआत खिलौनों/वस्तुओं से करें
scene: Assam girls performing a puppet show behind a cloth screen, classmates laughing, word cards from waste paper on desks

name: Dr. Asha Rani
school: Plus 2 High School Chandankiari Bokaro, Chandankiari
citation: She has rendered immense service by inculcating value education among students through "Sanskrit Shloka" and song. She popularized Sanskrit among school students by applying information and communication technology, successfully integrating the mother tongue with Sanskrit teaching.
core: Inculcation of Value Education through Sanskrit Shloka.
t_en: Values through Sanskrit shlokas and songs with ICT
t_hi: ICT के साथ संस्कृत श्लोक और गीतों से मूल्य शिक्षा
s_hi: संस्कृत श्लोक व गीत से मूल्य शिक्षा; ICT के प्रयोग से संस्कृत लोकप्रिय बनाई; मातृभाषा को संस्कृत शिक्षण से जोड़ा।
steps_en: Teach one shloka a week with its meaning and a life example
Record students singing shlokas and share as audio
Explain Sanskrit words through similar words in the mother tongue
steps_hi: हर हफ्ते एक श्लोक अर्थ और जीवन उदाहरण के साथ सिखाएँ
बच्चों के श्लोक गायन रिकॉर्ड कर ऑडियो साझा करें
संस्कृत शब्दों को मातृभाषा के मिलते-जुलते शब्दों से समझाएँ
scene: Jharkhand students reciting Sanskrit shlokas with a woman teacher, a speaker and a laptop playing audio

name: Mr. Jinu George
citation: Mr. Jinu George has created a captivating student art gallery, offering a unique blend of indoor and outdoor learning spaces. Students can immerse themselves in nature-inspired painting or explore human anatomy through life-like models. This innovative approach fosters both mental and physical well-being. He is also a sought-after trainer in digital painting, sharing expertise with students and teachers from other schools.
core: An innovative art gallery provides immersive learning experiences and fosters student well-being.
t_en: Student art gallery with nature painting and anatomy models
t_hi: प्रकृति चित्रकला व शरीर रचना मॉडल वाली छात्र कला दीर्घा
s_hi: इनडोर-आउटडोर छात्र कला दीर्घा जहाँ प्रकृति-प्रेरित चित्रकला व सजीव शरीर रचना मॉडल; मानसिक व शारीरिक कल्याण; डिजिटल पेंटिंग प्रशिक्षक।
steps_en: Turn a corridor into a rotating student gallery with a new theme each month
Link art to science: draw/paint organs or plant parts from models
Hold an outdoor painting session in nature each term
steps_hi: गलियारे को छात्र दीर्घा बनाएँ, हर महीने नया विषय
कला को विज्ञान से जोड़ें: मॉडल देखकर अंग/पौधों के भाग बनाएँ
हर टर्म प्रकृति में बाहर चित्रकला सत्र करें
scene: Kerala school corridor gallery full of student paintings, students painting outdoors near backwaters, an anatomy model on an easel

name: Mr. K Sivaprasad
citation: Mr. K Sivaprasad developed an innovative writing model prioritizing word and sentence structure, implemented statewide to enhance communicative writing skills. To support visually impaired students, 916 audiobooks were created and released in the public domain. Innovative tactile learning materials were designed for visually impaired learners, and 100 science instruments were developed for a science park to foster scientific aptitude.
core: Development of audiobooks, innovative tactile teaching materials, and creation of a science park.
t_en: 916 audiobooks, tactile materials and a science park
t_hi: 916 ऑडियोबुक, स्पर्श सामग्री और विज्ञान पार्क
s_hi: शब्द व वाक्य संरचना पर आधारित लेखन मॉडल जो राज्य भर में लागू; दृष्टिबाधितों के लिए 916 ऑडियोबुक सार्वजनिक; स्पर्श शिक्षण सामग्री; विज्ञान पार्क के लिए 100 उपकरण।
steps_en: Record each textbook chapter as an audio file with student narrators
Make tactile diagrams using thread, sand and paper for key figures
Teach writing by building words, then sentences, then short paragraphs
steps_hi: हर पाठ को छात्र वाचकों के साथ ऑडियो फ़ाइल में रिकॉर्ड करें
धागे, रेत और कागज़ से मुख्य चित्रों के स्पर्श आरेख बनाएँ
लेखन को शब्द, फिर वाक्य, फिर छोटे अनुच्छेद के क्रम में सिखाएँ
scene: Kerala students recording an audiobook into a phone, a visually impaired child touching a raised-thread diagram, an outdoor science park

name: Mr. Midde Srinivasa Rao
school: S.P.S Municipal High School Plus, Gudivada
citation: Transformed traditional pedagogy using storytelling, arts, and digital tools to make complex subjects accessible and enjoyable. Conducted TV live classes and managed YouTube channels 'Vidyamrutam' and 'Vidyavaradhi', developed low-cost teaching aids, authored study materials, mentored students from disadvantaged backgrounds, and led environmental programs instilling responsibility among students.
core: Creating an inclusive, engaging, and supportive learning environment for students.
t_en: Storytelling, arts and YouTube channels "Vidyamrutam"
t_hi: कहानी, कला और यूट्यूब चैनल "विद्यामृतम"
s_hi: कहानी, कला व डिजिटल टूल से कठिन विषय सरल; टीवी लाइव कक्षाएँ; यूट्यूब चैनल "विद्यामृतम" और "विद्यावारधि"; कम लागत सामग्री; वंचित छात्रों की मेंटरिंग; पर्यावरण कार्यक्रम।
steps_en: Open a tough topic with a short story or drawing
Start a simple class YouTube channel with 5-minute explainers
Mentor 5 disadvantaged students with weekly check-ins
steps_hi: कठिन विषय की शुरुआत छोटी कहानी या चित्र से करें
5 मिनट की व्याख्याओं वाला सरल कक्षा यूट्यूब चैनल शुरू करें
5 वंचित छात्रों की साप्ताहिक मुलाक़ात के साथ मेंटरिंग करें
scene: Andhra municipal school teacher telling a story with a drawing on the board, a phone on a tripod recording for YouTube

name: Mr. Suresh Kunati
school: ZP High School, Urandur, Srikalahasti Mandal, Tirupati
citation: Pioneered computer-based teaching since 2007, developed digital content, established the first Techno school in Chittoor District, created a digital theatre and computer lab, co-founded Andhra Pradesh Social Forum supporting teacher development, and improved school enrolment and academic performance. Honoured with multiple awards including National ICT Award for Teachers 2018 and The Global Teacher award.
core: Enhancing Teaching Learning through ICT integration in Education.
t_en: First Techno School: digital theatre and computer lab
t_hi: पहला टेक्नो स्कूल: डिजिटल थिएटर और कंप्यूटर लैब
s_hi: 2007 से कंप्यूटर आधारित शिक्षण, डिजिटल कंटेंट, ज़िले का पहला टेक्नो स्कूल, डिजिटल थिएटर और कंप्यूटर लैब; शिक्षक विकास हेतु सामाजिक मंच; नामांकन व प्रदर्शन में सुधार।
steps_en: Start with one shared projector 'digital theatre' room and a timetable for all classes
Build a bank of e-content mapped to each chapter
Form a teachers' WhatsApp group to share digital resources
steps_hi: एक साझा प्रोजेक्टर 'डिजिटल थिएटर' कक्ष और सभी कक्षाओं की समय-सारिणी से शुरुआत करें
हर अध्याय से जुड़ा ई-कंटेंट बैंक बनाएँ
डिजिटल संसाधन साझा करने के लिए शिक्षकों का व्हाट्सऐप समूह बनाएँ
scene: Andhra rural school students watching a lesson in a dark 'digital theatre' room, a computer lab next door

name: Mr. Prabhakar Reddy Pesara
citation: Dedicated Biological Science teacher improving education in rural areas through innovative pedagogy, ICT integration, mentoring, e-content creation, career guidance, and school infrastructure development. Supported students and teachers with a wealth of educational materials and counseling.
core: Instrumental in empowering students belonging to rural areas.
t_en: Rural biology: e-content, mentoring and career guidance
t_hi: ग्रामीण जीवविज्ञान: ई-कंटेंट, मेंटरिंग और करियर मार्गदर्शन
s_hi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्र में नवाचारी शिक्षण, ICT, मेंटरिंग, ई-कंटेंट, करियर मार्गदर्शन व अवसंरचना विकास; छात्रों व शिक्षकों को शैक्षिक सामग्री और परामर्श।
steps_en: Make chapter-wise e-notes with labelled diagrams students can save
Hold a career-guidance session for Class 10 on science pathways
Offer counselling time before board exams
steps_hi: लेबल वाले चित्रों सहित अध्यायवार ई-नोट्स बनाएँ जिन्हें बच्चे सहेज सकें
कक्षा 10 के लिए विज्ञान मार्गों पर करियर मार्गदर्शन सत्र रखें
बोर्ड परीक्षा से पहले परामर्श समय दें
scene: Telangana rural classroom with a biology teacher explaining a heart diagram on a projector, a career chart for Class 10

name: Mr. Thaduri Sampath Kumar
citation: Dedicated Physical Science teacher empowering rural students through innovative initiatives like AVISHKAR TALKS and Innovative Yathri. Achieved multiple national and international awards for students, maintained 100% SSC pass rate, and received state and national recognition for teaching excellence.
core: Innovative pedagogy contributing significantly to the achievements of students.
t_en: "AVISHKAR TALKS" and "Innovative Yatri"
t_hi: "आविष्कार टॉक्स" और "इनोवेटिव यात्री"
s_hi: "आविष्कार टॉक्स" और "इनोवेटिव यात्री" जैसी पहलों से ग्रामीण छात्रों को सशक्त किया; छात्रों को राष्ट्रीय-अंतरराष्ट्रीय पुरस्कार; 100% SSC परिणाम।
steps_en: Host monthly 'Avishkar Talks' where a student presents an invention idea in 5 minutes
Take an 'innovation trip' to a local workshop, lab or farm
Keep a portfolio of each student's ideas
steps_hi: हर महीने 'आविष्कार टॉक्स' रखें जहाँ छात्र 5 मिनट में आविष्कार विचार प्रस्तुत करे

She has developed more than 150 video for quality improvement in foundational Literacy and Numeracy and the content is disseminated through DIKSHA Portal and app. She is instrumental in training girl students including visually challenged girl students in self-defense. She has contributed in collection of funds for school development through various stakeholders.
core: Learning material and mentorship
t_en: 150+ FLN videos and self-defence training for girls
t_hi: 150+ FLN वीडियो और बालिकाओं को आत्मरक्षा प्रशिक्षण
s_hi: SCERT राजस्थान के पाठ्यक्रम व ई-कंटेंट में योगदान; FLN के लिए 150 से अधिक वीडियो दीक्षा पर; दृष्टिबाधित बालिकाओं सहित छात्राओं को आत्मरक्षा प्रशिक्षण; विद्यालय विकास हेतु धन संग्रह।
steps_en: Record short FLN videos (letter sounds, number games) with children demonstrating
Arrange a weekly self-defence session for girls with a trained volunteer
Share videos on DIKSHA/WhatsApp for home practice
steps_hi: बच्चों के प्रदर्शन के साथ छोटे FLN वीडियो (अक्षर ध्वनि, संख्या खेल) रिकॉर्ड करें
प्रशिक्षित स्वयंसेवक के साथ बालिकाओं का साप्ताहिक आत्मरक्षा सत्र रखें
घर पर अभ्यास के लिए वीडियो दीक्षा/व्हाट्सऐप पर साझा करें
scene: Rajasthan village girls practising self-defence moves in a school ground; inset of a teacher filming an FLN number game

name: Mrs. Sheela Asopa
citation: Mrs. Sheela Asopa, Principal in a Govt. School has contributed significantly for over 17 years towards girls education, using various means including ICT Tools. She has been contributing to education in rural areas through effective teaching – learning approaches including various areas of health, safety, water conservation, Plantation and addressing concerns of Children With Special Needs. She has developed digital and QR coded books, and e-content for DIKSHA portal. She has been instrumental in advocating and encouraging Rainwater Harvesting in various schools. Her school received National water award 2022 in best school category from Ministry of Jal Shakti, Govt of India.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: QR-coded books, rainwater harvesting and National Water Award
t_hi: QR कोड पुस्तकें, वर्षा जल संचयन और राष्ट्रीय जल पुरस्कार
s_hi: 17 वर्षों से बालिका शिक्षा; स्वास्थ्य, सुरक्षा, जल संरक्षण, वृक्षारोपण व CWSN पर काम; डिजिटल व QR कोड पुस्तकें; वर्षा जल संचयन से विद्यालय को राष्ट्रीय जल पुरस्कार 2022।
steps_en: Do a school water audit with students and plan one rainwater harvesting step
Add QR codes to notes linking to explanations
Form a girls' water-warrior club for awareness in the community
steps_hi: बच्चों के साथ विद्यालय जल ऑडिट करें और वर्षा जल संचयन का एक कदम तय करें
नोट्स में व्याख्याओं से जुड़े QR कोड जोड़ें
समुदाय में जागरूकता के लिए बालिकाओं का 'जल योद्धा' क्लब बनाएँ
scene: Jodhpur girls' school with a rooftop rainwater pipe into a tank, students measuring rainfall, QR-coded books on a desk

name: Mr. Shyamsundar R. Khanchandani
school: Govt. Hr. Sec. School, Silvassa Daman & Diu – 396230
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
citation: A Post Graduate Teacher of Commerce, Shyamsundar Ramchand Khanchandani has been producing over 90% result in his subject through active classroom teaching and remedial classes. He has developed e-content based on the textbooks and uses ICT extensively in his classroom teaching and adopts Joyful learning techniques, creative methods, etc like storytelling and art integrated teaching. He organises Bank visit to make learning of Commerce and Secretarial practice experiential. He is an active participant in professional development programmes organised by NCERT and SCERT.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: Bank visits for experiential Commerce
t_hi: अनुभवात्मक वाणिज्य हेतु बैंक भ्रमण
s_hi: वाणिज्य में 90% से अधिक परिणाम; पाठ्यपुस्तक आधारित ई-कंटेंट; कहानी व कला समेकित शिक्षण; वाणिज्य व सचिवीय पद्धति को अनुभवात्मक बनाने हेतु बैंक भ्रमण।
steps_en: Visit a bank or post office and let students fill sample forms
Run a class 'mock bank' with deposit slips and passbooks
Use a short story to introduce each accounting concept
steps_hi: बैंक या डाकघर का भ्रमण कर बच्चों से नमूना फ़ॉर्म भरवाएँ
जमा पर्ची और पासबुक के साथ कक्षा में 'नकली बैंक' चलाएँ
हर लेखा अवधारणा की शुरुआत एक छोटी कहानी से करें
scene: Silvassa students at a bank counter filling deposit slips, a teacher explaining a passbook

name: Mr. Avinash M. Parkhe
school: Disha School for Special Children, Panaji Goa – 403110
citation: To perceive teaching as an enjoyable, meaningful, and fulfilling experience, Mr. Avinash Murlidhar Parkhe has indeed carved a niche not only for his students but also for society. As a certified special educator, he continues to work as a special educator at Disha School for Special Children in Panaji, Goa. In his 30 years tenure, he has worked for education, training, rehabilitation and employment of people with intellectual disabilities. The creative teaching and learning techniques he used provided practical life skills, independent living skills and foundational learning concepts. To boost enrolment in the school, he organized Screening and Detection Camps for children with special needs, established vocational training facility, started an early stimulation programme for children and initiated on-the-job training and job placement programme. To bring in the element of happiness and joy while learning, he created individualized curriculum for every student based on their needs and abilities. The functional and flexible curriculum improved student socialization, interaction with peer group and parents and enhanced positive attitude. His contribution has been widely appreciated.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: Individualised curriculum and job placement for intellectual disabilities
t_hi: बौद्धिक दिव्यांगता के लिए व्यक्तिगत पाठ्यक्रम और रोज़गार
s_hi: 30 वर्षों से बौद्धिक दिव्यांगों की शिक्षा, प्रशिक्षण, पुनर्वास व रोज़गार; स्क्रीनिंग शिविर, व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण, शीघ्र उद्दीपन कार्यक्रम, ऑन-जॉब प्रशिक्षण; हर छात्र के लिए व्यक्तिगत पाठ्यक्रम।
steps_en: Write a one-page individual plan for each CWSN child (strengths, 3 goals, supports)
Teach daily-living skills (money, time, cooking) through real tasks
Hold a screening camp with the local health centre to identify needs early
steps_hi: हर CWSN बच्चे की एक-पेज व्यक्तिगत योजना (ताक़त, 3 लक्ष्य, सहायता) लिखें
दैनिक जीवन कौशल (पैसा, समय, खाना बनाना) वास्तविक कामों से सिखाएँ
ज़रूरतें जल्दी पहचानने हेतु स्थानीय स्वास्थ्य केंद्र के साथ स्क्रीनिंग शिविर लगाएँ
scene: Goa special school where young adults practise counting money at a pretend shop with a special educator

name: Mr. Deepak Jethalal Mota
school: Shree Hundraibag Primary School, Kachchh Gujarat – 370465
citation: Mr. Deepak Jethalal Mota takes education to students, for example, he created an e-bicycle Digital mobile school during covid-19 to provide door-to-door education to children. He organizes Yoga Shivir for the versatile development of students every year. He also created an educational Kiosk – Any Time Education. These kiosks are placed like ATM in village markets, so that children can learn through them even during holidays. He has established educational theatre in 2023 for teaching students digitally, designed FLN Kit and prepared portfolio of each student. He trained other teachers in innovation sharing workshops. To ensure each student attends school, he takes students with him to school.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: E-bicycle mobile school and "Any Time Education" kiosks
t_hi: ई-साइकिल मोबाइल स्कूल और "एनी टाइम एजुकेशन" कियोस्क
s_hi: कोविड में ई-साइकिल डिजिटल मोबाइल स्कूल से घर-घर शिक्षा; गाँव के बाज़ार में ATM जैसे "एनी टाइम एजुकेशन" कियोस्क; शैक्षिक थिएटर, FLN किट, हर छात्र का पोर्टफ़ोलियो; योग शिविर।
steps_en: Put a 'learning box' (books, worksheets, a tablet if possible) in a village shop or temple for holidays
Make an FLN kit and a portfolio folder for every child
Visit the homes of children who don't come and walk them to school
