steps_hi: छुट्टियों के लिए गाँव की दुकान या मंदिर में 'लर्निंग बॉक्स' (किताबें, वर्कशीट, संभव हो तो टैबलेट) रखें
हर बच्चे के लिए FLN किट और पोर्टफ़ोलियो फ़ोल्डर बनाएँ
न आने वाले बच्चों के घर जाकर उन्हें साथ विद्यालय लाएँ
scene: Kutch desert village market with a teacher's e-bicycle mobile classroom and an ATM-like learning kiosk, children watching a lesson

name: Dr. RITABEN NIKESHCHANDRA FULWALA
school: SHETH SHREE P.H.BACHKANIWALA VIDHYAMANDIR, SURAT, SURAT CORPORATION GUJARAT - 395002
citation: Dr.Ritaben Nikeshchandra Fulwala, Principal of Sheth Shree P.H. Bachkaniwala Vidhyamandir is an immensely talented and active teacher. Under her leadership, the school got the Best School Award in 2015 and 2023 from the Government of Gujarat. Under her leadership school achieved 100% result in 12th Science. She has written reviews of books, published educational articles in newspapers, and organised programs for women empowerment. Her core area of appreciation aredeveloping methods for joyful learning, organizing quiz competitions and other co-curriculum activities.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning.
t_en: Joyful learning, quizzes and women-empowerment programmes
t_hi: आनंदमय शिक्षा, क्विज़ और महिला सशक्तीकरण कार्यक्रम
s_hi: प्रधानाचार्या के नेतृत्व में विद्यालय को 2015 व 2023 में सर्वश्रेष्ठ विद्यालय पुरस्कार; कक्षा 12 विज्ञान में 100% परिणाम; लेख-समीक्षाएँ; महिला सशक्तीकरण कार्यक्रम; क्विज़ व सह-पाठ्यक्रम।
steps_en: Hold a monthly inter-house quiz linked to the syllabus
Plan a calendar of co-curricular events across the year
Invite women achievers for an annual talk
steps_hi: पाठ्यक्रम से जुड़ा मासिक अंतर-सदन क्विज़ रखें
पूरे साल के सह-पाठ्यक्रम कार्यक्रमों का कैलेंडर बनाएँ
हर साल उपलब्धि प्राप्त महिलाओं की वार्ता रखें
scene: Surat school auditorium with an inter-house quiz on stage, a woman principal hosting

name: Ms. Sarika Gharu
school: Govt. H.S. School, Sandiya Madhya Pradesh – 461775
citation: Ms. Sarika Gharu has increased enrolment and learning of tribal students in the school by planning and implementing rather novel interesting activities such as organising puppet shows, science experiments, painting competitions and other participatory performing and visual arts. She has spread scientific knowledge among villagers by experiential means, e.g., by using a telescope. Four students from her school have received Ignite Award from National Innovation Foundation and Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. She has received a National Award in 2017 for science communication, Innovative Science Teacher Award in 2016 and State Level Excellence Teacher Award in 2022. She galvanised community to provide monitory help to distribute school bags, water bottles, etc. to the needy students which enhancedschool enrolment.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: Puppet shows, telescope nights and arts for tribal learners
t_hi: आदिवासी बच्चों के लिए कठपुतली, दूरबीन रात्रि और कलाएँ
s_hi: कठपुतली शो, विज्ञान प्रयोग, चित्रकला व प्रदर्शन कलाओं से आदिवासी बच्चों का नामांकन व अधिगम बढ़ाया; दूरबीन से गाँव में विज्ञान प्रसार; चार छात्रों को इग्नाइट अवार्ड।
steps_en: Organise a sky-watching evening for families with a telescope or binoculars
Explain a science concept through a puppet show made by students
Encourage students to send ideas to NIF's IGNITE competition
steps_hi: परिवारों के लिए दूरबीन/बायनोक्युलर के साथ आकाश दर्शन शाम रखें
छात्रों द्वारा बनाए कठपुतली शो से किसी विज्ञान अवधारणा को समझाएँ
बच्चों को NIF की इग्नाइट प्रतियोगिता में विचार भेजने हेतु प्रेरित करें
scene: Tribal MP village at dusk, children and parents taking turns at a telescope set up by a woman teacher

name: Ms. Seema Agnihotri
school: CM Rise Govt. Vinoba H.S. School, Ratlam Madhya Pradesh – 457001
citation: Ms. Seema Agnihotri is a dedicated teacher. She follows the methods of Joyful Learning while teaching in the classroom. She has prepared portfolio of her students to understand their likes and dislikes and their family conditions. She created environment of joyful learning by resorting to Teaching Learning Material with the help of ICT in the classroom. She involves community and organises a variety of competitions like Story reading competition, essay writing competition, newsletter writing, skit and dance competitions to increase interest in studies.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: Student portfolios to understand each child
t_hi: हर बच्चे को समझने के लिए छात्र पोर्टफ़ोलियो
s_hi: हर छात्र का पोर्टफ़ोलियो बनाकर रुचियाँ, अरुचियाँ व पारिवारिक स्थिति समझी; ICT के साथ TLM; समुदाय को जोड़कर कहानी पठन, निबंध, समाचार पत्र लेखन, नाटक व नृत्य प्रतियोगिताएँ।
steps_en: Make a portfolio for each child: interests, family context, best work, goals
Review portfolios twice a term to plan support
Run a class newsletter written by students
steps_hi: हर बच्चे का पोर्टफ़ोलियो बनाएँ: रुचियाँ, पारिवारिक संदर्भ, सर्वश्रेष्ठ काम, लक्ष्य
सहायता की योजना हेतु हर टर्म दो बार पोर्टफ़ोलियो देखें
बच्चों द्वारा लिखा कक्षा समाचार पत्र चलाएँ
scene: Ratlam classroom with a teacher flipping through colourful student portfolio folders with a student, a class newsletter on the wall

name: Dr. Brajesh Pandey
school: Swami Atmanand Govt. English School, Ambikapur Chhattisgarh – 497001
citation: With his unflinching efforts to make a difference in the lives of the young learners, Dr. Brajesh Pandey has left no stone unturned. As a science teacher, he adopted techniques that could help students to understand the concept of science in depth and its application in life. He has shouldered the responsibility of District Coordinator, National Children Science Congress, District Sarguja. In the year 2007, as the Head of Government H H S, Parsa, Ambikapur, his prime focus was on providing quality education which increased the enrolment to 100%. He participated in content generation on optics organized by D S T at SCERT, Raipur. His interest in integrating technology with education helped the school to start classes in PRAGYA room, during COVID. Dr. Brajesh created ways to nurture skills in students and make learning a joyful experience. He also got an opportunity to work as a mentor in Inspire Internship programme organized by DST, at New Delhi for two consecutive years.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: Deep-concept science and Children's Science Congress leadership
t_hi: गहन अवधारणा आधारित विज्ञान और बाल विज्ञान कांग्रेस
s_hi: विज्ञान अवधारणाओं को गहराई व जीवन उपयोग से पढ़ाया; ज़िला समन्वयक बाल विज्ञान कांग्रेस; प्रधान के रूप में 100% नामांकन; कोविड में "प्रज्ञा कक्ष" से कक्षाएँ; INSPIRE इंटर्नशिप में मेंटर।
steps_en: Ask 'Where do we see this in life?' for every concept and list examples
Guide one team each year for the Children's Science Congress on a local issue
Use a 'concept test' with why-questions, not just recall
steps_hi: हर अवधारणा पर पूछें 'यह जीवन में कहाँ दिखता है?' और उदाहरण लिखें
हर साल किसी स्थानीय मुद्दे पर बाल विज्ञान कांग्रेस हेतु एक टीम का मार्गदर्शन करें
केवल याद करने के बजाय 'क्यों' वाले प्रश्नों का अवधारणा परीक्षण लें
scene: Chhattisgarh English-medium school students presenting a project on local water quality at a science congress

name: Md. EJAZUL HAQUE
citation: Md. Ejazul Haque believes in involving students in learning teaching process by incorporating group discussion and role play methods in his pedagogical practices. He teaches by taking examples from daily life activities. He arranges painting, rangoli and quiz competition to make learning more experiential and fun. He has been part of a Committee for designing textbooks in SCERT. He had also worked to provide clean drinking water by setting up submersible in the school. As a acting head teacher he is working closely in raising awareness on issues like child marriage, good touch-bad touch, health & hygiene etc.
core: Engagement of community
t_en: Role play, rangoli and daily-life examples
t_hi: रोल प्ले, रंगोली और दैनिक जीवन के उदाहरण
s_hi: समूह चर्चा व रोल प्ले से छात्रों को शिक्षण में शामिल किया; दैनिक जीवन के उदाहरण; चित्रकला, रंगोली व क्विज़; पेयजल हेतु सबमर्सिबल; बाल विवाह, गुड-बैड टच, स्वास्थ्य जागरूकता।
steps_en: Turn one lesson a week into a role play by student groups
Start every lesson with a real-life example children give
Run a good-touch/bad-touch session with a female colleague and parents informed
steps_hi: हर हफ्ते एक पाठ को छात्र समूहों के रोल प्ले में बदलें
हर पाठ की शुरुआत बच्चों द्वारा दिए गए वास्तविक जीवन उदाहरण से करें
अभिभावकों को सूचित कर किसी महिला सहकर्मी के साथ गुड-टच/बैड-टच सत्र करें
scene: Jharkhand middle-school children performing a role play in class while others watch, rangoli on the floor

name: Ms. BHUPINDER GOGIA
school: SAT PAUL MITTAL SCHOOL, WARD NO. 44, PHASE 2 URBAN ESTATE LUDHIANA -I PUNJAB - 141002
citation: Ms. Bhupinder Gogia, introduced Computer Science as a subject in Senior Secondary level. She designed a new state of the art LAN equipped Computer lab. Implemented five pedagogical practices- experiential learning, multi-disciplinary learning, inquiry-based learning, competency-based learning and technology-based teaching. She ensured the infrastructure of the school to be inclusive in order to fully and effectively support children with special needs. The furniture was designed to work as a learning aid. She taught Mathematics using Geogebra, Minecraft and Kahoot. She published two research papers on action research. She had also set up two schools for underprivileged students.
core: Learning material and mentorship
t_en: Inclusive infrastructure where furniture is a learning aid
t_hi: समावेशी अवसंरचना जिसमें फ़र्नीचर ही अधिगम साधन
s_hi: वरिष्ठ माध्यमिक में कंप्यूटर विज्ञान शुरू किया; अनुभवात्मक, बहुविषयी, जिज्ञासा, दक्षता व तकनीक आधारित पाँच शिक्षण पद्धतियाँ; CWSN हेतु समावेशी अवसंरचना; जियोजेब्रा, माइनक्राफ्ट, काहूट से गणित; वंचितों के लिए दो विद्यालय।
steps_en: Paint number lines, grids or maps on desks/benches so furniture teaches
Do one action-research cycle a year on a classroom problem and share results
Use Minecraft/Scratch-style tasks for maths patterns
steps_hi: डेस्क/बेंच पर संख्या रेखा, ग्रिड या नक्शे पेंट करें ताकि फ़र्नीचर पढ़ाए
हर साल किसी कक्षा समस्या पर एक क्रियात्मक शोध चक्र करें और परिणाम साझा करें
गणितीय पैटर्न हेतु माइनक्राफ्ट/स्क्रैच जैसे कार्य दें
scene: Ludhiana classroom with desks painted with grids and number lines, a student in a wheelchair at an accessible computer

name: Mr. SHASHISEKHAR KAR SHARMA
school: KENDUAPADA NODAL HIGH SCHOOL, AMPORE, BONTH, BHADRAK ODISHA - 756112
citation: Mr. Shashisekhar Kar Sharma’s teaching skills are amply reflected in programmes on Door Darshan Edusat and YouTube. He raised around 4 lakh under MO School Aviyan programme. His research paper is selected for publishing in Universal Journal of Educational Research. He developed slides on entire science syllabus of class IX and X in Odia language which resulted in enthusiastic response from students’ community from all around the State. He has worked for FLN supplementary materials.
core: Delivery of FLN
t_en: Odia-language science slides for Classes IX–X
t_hi: कक्षा 9–10 के लिए ओड़िया भाषा में विज्ञान स्लाइड
s_hi: दूरदर्शन एडुसैट व यूट्यूब पर शिक्षण; "मो स्कूल अभियान" से लगभग 4 लाख जुटाए; पूरे कक्षा 9–10 विज्ञान पाठ्यक्रम की ओड़िया स्लाइड; FLN पूरक सामग्री।
steps_en: Make slides for each chapter in the students' mother tongue with English terms in brackets
Share them free on WhatsApp/YouTube for the whole district
Raise alumni funds through a state scheme (like Mo School) with a clear list
steps_hi: हर अध्याय की स्लाइड बच्चों की मातृभाषा में बनाएँ और अंग्रेज़ी शब्द कोष्ठक में लिखें
इन्हें पूरे ज़िले के लिए व्हाट्सऐप/यूट्यूब पर मुफ्त साझा करें
राज्य योजना (जैसे मो स्कूल) के माध्यम से स्पष्ट सूची के साथ पूर्व छात्रों से धन जुटाएँ
scene: Odisha high-school students watching Odia-language science slides on a projector, a teacher pointing to a diagram

name: Mr. SUBHASH CHANDRA ROUT
school: BRUNDABAN GOVT HIGH SCHOOL MARKANDAPUR, JAGATSINGHPUR ODISHA - 754103
citation: Mr. Subhash Chandra Rout is immensely dedicated Head teacher who has worked to achieve and maintain 100% pass result of his school for the last 3 years. He inspired his students to develop participatory approach. He has presented papers in National seminars regularly and has written several books. He has received the Prakruti Bandhu Award from the Department of Forest and Environment as well as the State level best teacher award. He was also honoured as a social worker for relief operations during Super Cyclone 1999. His innovative practices include Sabudina School Jiba to reduce attrition, Saturday Zero period activities, low cost TLM, My Book My Buddy etc.
core: Engagement of community
t_en: "My Book My Buddy" and Saturday zero-period activities
t_hi: "मेरी किताब मेरा दोस्त" और शनिवार शून्य पीरियड गतिविधियाँ
s_hi: तीन साल से 100% परिणाम; भागीदारी दृष्टिकोण; ड्रॉपआउट कम करने हेतु पहल, शनिवार शून्य पीरियड गतिविधियाँ, कम लागत TLM, "माई बुक माई बडी"; प्रकृति बंधु पुरस्कार।
steps_en: Give each child one library book as a 'buddy' to read and talk about every week
Use Saturday's first period for quizzes, crafts or talks
Track at-risk students and visit families
steps_hi: हर बच्चे को एक पुस्तक 'दोस्त' के रूप में दें जिसे वह हर हफ्ते पढ़े और उस पर बात करे
शनिवार के पहले पीरियड में क्विज़, शिल्प या वार्ता रखें
जोखिम वाले बच्चों पर नज़र रखें और परिवारों से मिलें
scene: Odisha coastal school students sitting under a tree each hugging a library book 'buddy', a head teacher reading with them

name: Dr. CHANDAN MISHRA
school: RAGHUNATHPUR NAFAR ACADEMY (HS), ABHAYNAGAR, BALLY JAGACHA, HOWRAH WEST BENGAL - 711205
citation: Dr. Chandan Mishra has integrated the modern aids of Augmented Reality and Virtual Reality in learning teaching processes. His endeavours increased enrolment from 625 in 2018 to nearly 800 students. His School participated in the United Nations Project Suchana to address United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. His students won INSPIRE awards, excelled in Kala Utsav and earned prizes in state level school games. The school received the Best School award for Information and Communication Technology usage in 2020. He was honoured with the Shiksha Ratna award by the State Government.
core: Learning material and mentorship
t_en: Augmented and Virtual Reality in class and UN SDG project
t_hi: कक्षा में AR-VR और संयुक्त राष्ट्र SDG प्रोजेक्ट
s_hi: शिक्षण में ऑगमेंटेड व वर्चुअल रियलिटी; नामांकन 625 से लगभग 800; संयुक्त राष्ट्र प्रोजेक्ट सूचना (SDG); INSPIRE, कला उत्सव, खेलों में सफलता; ICT हेतु सर्वश्रेष्ठ विद्यालय पुरस्कार।
steps_en: Use free AR apps (e.g., 3D anatomy, solar system) on a phone for one lesson a week
Map each club project to one UN Sustainable Development Goal
Let students present SDG projects at a community fair
steps_hi: हफ्ते में एक पाठ फ़ोन पर मुफ्त AR ऐप (जैसे 3D शरीर, सौरमंडल) से लें
हर क्लब प्रोजेक्ट को संयुक्त राष्ट्र के किसी सतत विकास लक्ष्य से जोड़ें
बच्चे सामुदायिक मेले में SDG प्रोजेक्ट प्रस्तुत करें
scene: Howrah students looking at a 3D heart floating over a phone screen through AR, SDG posters on the wall

name: Mr. REYAZ AHMAD SHEIKH
school: GOVT MIDDLE SCHOOL POSHNARI, CHITTERGUL, ANANTNAG JAMMU AND KASHMIR - 192201
citation: Mr. Reyaz Ahmed Sheikh is a teacher of Govt Middle School PoshnariChittergulAnantanag, Jammu and Kashmir with 13 years of experience. He has initiated an ICT based teaching- learning programme which benefited more than 150 students by making learning a great fun for different hamlets of Panchayat Poshhnari. His innovative approach in making more than 400 TLMs and different Science projects with his students enabled effective learning through observationsandimmersive experiences. One of his special initiatives during the pandemic was to undertake community classes to benefit the students. He created more than 20 e-contents for his school as well as other schools in the zone. He also took initiative to start an enrolment drive in which door to door visits were made resulting in bringing 30 students back to school. He motivated and counselled the parents through regular capacity building to allow girls to attend school regularly.
core: Learning material and mentorship
t_en: 400+ TLMs and community classes in hamlets
t_hi: 400+ TLM और बस्तियों में सामुदायिक कक्षाएँ
s_hi: ICT आधारित कार्यक्रम से पंचायत की बस्तियों के 150+ बच्चों को लाभ; छात्रों के साथ 400 से अधिक TLM व विज्ञान प्रोजेक्ट; महामारी में सामुदायिक कक्षाएँ; घर-घर नामांकन अभियान से 30 बच्चे वापस; बालिकाओं की नियमित उपस्थिति हेतु परामर्श।
steps_en: Make TLMs together with students so they own them
Hold weekend 'community classes' in hamlets far from school
Do a door-to-door survey in June to find out-of-school children
steps_hi: TLM बच्चों के साथ मिलकर बनाएँ ताकि वे उन्हें अपना समझें
विद्यालय से दूर बस्तियों में सप्ताहांत 'सामुदायिक कक्षाएँ' रखें
जून में घर-घर सर्वे कर विद्यालय से बाहर बच्चों को खोजें
scene: Kashmir mountain hamlet with a teacher holding an open-air class beside a stream, children with handmade science models

name: Ms. ASIYA FAROOQUI
school: PRIMARY SCHOOL ASTI, ASTI, NAGAR, FATEHPUR UTTAR PRADESH - 212601
citation: Ms. Asiya Farooqui is an immensely talented and committed teacher in Primary School, Asti Nagar, Fatehpur, Uttar Pradesh. She has designed innovative methods for kindling the curiosity of students suchthat appropriate knowledge is not only disseminated but created as well. She created an atmosphere of education in her school which is a learning hub and to be followed by others in the district with her continuous efforts of 7-8 years. She improved the infrastructure of her school. She has also motivated the girls and women of her district to raise their voice against domestic violence and substance abuse. She even helped them create their own small businesses and sponsor their own needs through various capacity building modes. Some of her selected educational content has also been uploaded on DIKSHA. She has prepared and uploaded about 700 videos on her Youtube channel. She has initiated a magazine in her school called Asti ki Udaan. She was awarded the U.P. State Govt. Teacher Award and Mission Shakti Award.
core: Engagement of community
t_en: 700 YouTube videos and "Asti ki Udaan" school magazine
t_hi: 700 यूट्यूब वीडियो और "अस्ती की उड़ान" विद्यालय पत्रिका
s_hi: जिज्ञासा जगाने वाली विधियाँ; 7–8 साल में विद्यालय को ज़िले का अधिगम केंद्र बनाया; महिलाओं को घरेलू हिंसा व नशे के विरुद्ध व स्वरोज़गार हेतु प्रेरित किया; 700 यूट्यूब वीडियो; "अस्ती की उड़ान" पत्रिका।
steps_en: Start a school magazine with children's stories, drawings and village news
Record short lesson videos and build a channel over time
Run a monthly mothers' meeting on livelihood and safety
steps_hi: बच्चों की कहानियों, चित्रों और गाँव के समाचारों वाली विद्यालय पत्रिका शुरू करें
छोटे पाठ वीडियो रिकॉर्ड कर धीरे-धीरे चैनल बनाएँ
आजीविका व सुरक्षा पर मासिक माताओं की बैठक रखें
scene: Fatehpur primary school children holding copies of their magazine 'Asti ki Udaan', a woman teacher filming a lesson

name: Mr. Chandra Prakash Agarwal
school: Shiv Kumar Agarwal Janta Inter College, Bulandshahr UTTAR PRADESH - 203394
citation: Shri Chndr Prakash Agrwal is a committed teacher in improving the infrastructure of his school which has created much better learning environment. He is a dedicated teacher who has done innovative work to reach out to students to support their education during the pandemic time as well outside of it. He has developed interesting online materials for the use of virtual classes including developing an app and website for his school for more effective learning. He collected a fund of Rs.15 lakhs through CSR and set up a library for his school to enhance the availability of knowledge. He was awarded with the State Award in 2018.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: School app, website and CSR-funded library
t_hi: विद्यालय ऐप, वेबसाइट और CSR पुस्तकालय
s_hi: अवसंरचना सुधार; महामारी में व बाद में छात्रों तक पहुँच; वर्चुअल कक्षाओं के लिए ऑनलाइन सामग्री, विद्यालय ऐप व वेबसाइट; CSR से ₹15 लाख जुटाकर पुस्तकालय।
steps_en: Create a free school website/Google Site with timetables, notes and notices
Write a CSR proposal for a library with a book list and reading plan
Track library issues to show impact to donors
steps_hi: समय-सारिणी, नोट्स और सूचनाओं वाली मुफ्त विद्यालय वेबसाइट/गूगल साइट बनाएँ
पुस्तक सूची व पठन योजना के साथ पुस्तकालय हेतु CSR प्रस्ताव लिखें
दानदाताओं को प्रभाव दिखाने के लिए पुस्तक इश्यू का रिकॉर्ड रखें
scene: Bulandshahr inter-college students in a new library, one browsing the school app on a phone

name: Mr. Anil Kumar Singh
school: Adarsh Girls Sr. Secondary School Bihar - 821110
citation: Shri Anil Kumar Singh, a highly self-motivated teacher in a girls school,made significant efforts to establish a hygiene club and a pad bank in his school for the successful retention of girl students. He also took initiatives and managed to set up a sanitary pad vending machine and an incinerator machine established. He also made concentrated efforts to educate girls in the use of computers and taught them basic computer skills. He established a guardian government in 2019 and collected funds from them used for employing additional teachers in his school. He took special initiatives for constructing additional rooms to house newly acquired computers. He worked hard and adopted various innovative initiatives to reduce dropout rate by involving students in various interesting educational and soft skills related activities.
core: Governance
t_en: Hygiene club, pad bank and "Guardian Government"
t_hi: स्वच्छता क्लब, पैड बैंक और "अभिभावक सरकार"
s_hi: बालिका विद्यालय में स्वच्छता क्लब व पैड बैंक, सैनिटरी पैड वेंडिंग व इंसीनरेटर मशीन; बालिकाओं को कंप्यूटर कौशल; 2019 में "अभिभावक सरकार" बनाकर उनके सहयोग से अतिरिक्त शिक्षक रखे।
steps_en: Start a hygiene club run by girls with a pad bank and a register
Form a 'guardian government' (parent council) with roles and monthly meetings
Teach basic computer skills to girls in a fixed weekly slot
steps_hi: बालिकाओं द्वारा संचालित स्वच्छता क्लब, पैड बैंक और रजिस्टर के साथ शुरू करें
भूमिकाओं व मासिक बैठकों के साथ 'अभिभावक सरकार' (अभिभावक परिषद) बनाएँ
तय साप्ताहिक समय में बालिकाओं को बुनियादी कंप्यूटर कौशल सिखाएँ
scene: Bihar girls' school with a sanitary-pad vending machine, girls learning on computers, a parents' council meeting

name: Mr. Dwijendra Kumar
citation: Shri Dwijendra Kumar is a model for what can be achieved with hard work and commitment. He put his small school on the map by initiatives that contributed in making his school a divyang model school. He actively involved the community in spreading awareness about various social issues like health and hygiene, child marriage, dowry system etc. He was awarded the State Award in 2017.
core: Engagement of community
t_en: Building a Divyang-friendly model school
t_hi: दिव्यांग-अनुकूल मॉडल विद्यालय
s_hi: मेहनत से छोटे विद्यालय को दिव्यांग मॉडल विद्यालय बनाया; स्वास्थ्य, स्वच्छता, बाल विवाह, दहेज जैसे मुद्दों पर समुदाय जागरूकता।
steps_en: Do an accessibility check: ramps, rails, toilet, seating, signage
Seat CWSN children with a buddy and adapt one task per lesson
Hold community meetings on social issues each term
steps_hi: सुलभता जाँच करें: रैंप, रेलिंग, शौचालय, बैठक, संकेत
CWSN बच्चों को साथी के साथ बैठाएँ और हर पाठ में एक कार्य अनुकूलित करें
हर टर्म सामाजिक मुद्दों पर सामुदायिक बैठक करें
scene: Bihar middle school with a ramp and handrails, a child using crutches entering class with a buddy

name: Ms. Kumari Guddi
citation: Ms. Kumari Guddi has been a passionate teacher working closely towards promoting girl child education in-spite of several socio-economic challenges in the region. She achieved it through wide range of activities including activity-based learning, counselling to girls students and their parents. Her innovative idea of sanitary pad bank contributed towards increased enrolment and enhanced attendance of girl students. She regularly organises Kishori Munch to develop leadership skills among students. She has developed videos for class 10 in the E-talim project of Kishanganj District Administration. She also played a pro-active role in involving parents and community in general in school related activities.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: Sanitary pad bank and "Kishori Manch" leadership
t_hi: सैनिटरी पैड बैंक और "किशोरी मंच" नेतृत्व
s_hi: सामाजिक-आर्थिक चुनौतियों के बीच बालिका शिक्षा; गतिविधि आधारित शिक्षण व परामर्श; पैड बैंक से नामांकन व उपस्थिति बढ़ी; "किशोरी मंच" से नेतृत्व; ई-तालीम हेतु कक्षा 10 वीडियो।
steps_en: Start a monthly 'Kishori Manch' where girls plan and lead an activity
Keep a confidential pad bank with a girl monitor
Counsel parents of irregular girls with a home visit
steps_hi: मासिक 'किशोरी मंच' शुरू करें जहाँ बालिकाएँ गतिविधि की योजना बनाएँ और नेतृत्व करें
एक बालिका निगरानीकर्ता के साथ गोपनीय पैड बैंक रखें
अनियमित बालिकाओं के अभिभावकों से घर जाकर परामर्श करें
scene: Kishanganj high-school girls leading a Kishori Manch meeting, a woman teacher in the background

name: Mr. Ravi Kant Mishra
school: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Datia MADHYA PRADESH - 475661
citation: Shri Ravi Kant Mishra works in JNV Beekar Datia. He was immensely active in spreading awareness among students on various important issues like good health, balanced diet at home etc. He is a member of the selection committee of e-content on Vidya Daan Portal of DIKSHA and has taken live classes on PMeVIDYA 12 National television channel. He teaches chemistry to thousands of students of class 9 to 12 through his youtube channel. He is the master trainer of PISA by Navodaya VidyalaSamiti.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: National TV chemistry classes and PISA master training
t_hi: राष्ट्रीय टीवी पर रसायन कक्षाएँ और PISA मास्टर प्रशिक्षण
s_hi: स्वास्थ्य व संतुलित आहार पर जागरूकता; दीक्षा विद्यादान ई-कंटेंट चयन समिति सदस्य; पीएम ई-विद्या टीवी पर लाइव कक्षाएँ; यूट्यूब से हज़ारों छात्रों को रसायन; NVS के PISA मास्टर ट्रेनर।
steps_en: Use PISA-style questions (real-life context, data reading) once a week
Record a lesson series and share on YouTube for revision
Run a 'balanced diet' project with students tracking meals
steps_hi: हफ्ते में एक बार PISA जैसे प्रश्न (वास्तविक संदर्भ, डेटा पढ़ना) दें
रिवीज़न के लिए पाठ श्रृंखला रिकॉर्ड कर यूट्यूब पर साझा करें
'संतुलित आहार' प्रोजेक्ट चलाएँ जिसमें बच्चे अपने भोजन का रिकॉर्ड रखें
scene: Navodaya chemistry teacher in a studio recording a TV lesson, students in a lab solving a real-life chemistry problem

name: Mr. Manoranjan Pathak
school: Sainik School Tilaiya, KANTI, CHANDWARA, KODARMA Jharkhand - 825413
citation: Shri Manoranjan Pathak is a dedicated and motivated teacher who has worked very hard for the improvement of his school and performance of its students. The school caters to the under privileged sections of the society. His abilities and effectiveness as a NCC officer in training his cadets to become future army officers deserves special recognition. He has assisted in the development of library automation in his school which is now a part of e-granthalaya, a digital library of e-books, articles etc.
core: Joyful learning and digital classroom
t_en: NCC training and e-Granthalaya library automation
t_hi: NCC प्रशिक्षण और ई-ग्रंथालय पुस्तकालय स्वचालन
s_hi: वंचित वर्गों के लिए विद्यालय सुधार; NCC अधिकारी के रूप में कैडेटों को सैन्य अधिकारी बनने हेतु तैयार किया; पुस्तकालय स्वचालन को ई-ग्रंथालय से जोड़ा।
steps_en: Register the school library on e-Granthalaya (free) and catalogue books
Run an NCC/Scouts career talk with alumni officers
Let students manage the digital library as a club
steps_hi: विद्यालय पुस्तकालय को ई-ग्रंथालय (मुफ्त) पर पंजीकृत कर पुस्तकों की सूची बनाएँ
पूर्व छात्र अधिकारियों के साथ NCC/स्काउट करियर वार्ता रखें
डिजिटल पुस्तकालय का प्रबंधन क्लब के रूप में छात्रों को दें
scene: Sainik School cadets scanning book barcodes into a computer in a library, NCC flag in the background

name: Dr. Yashpal Singh
citation: Dr. Yashpal Singh of Eklavya Model Residential school has done much of what is expected of a complete teacher and also demonstrated committed efforts towards the environment by motivating the children to plant trees and has educated them about the importance of saving the environment. He has taken the initiative of organizing smart classes in his school for which tab on wheels was also used. He has extensively contributed in raising awareness on various social issues like child marriage, dowry system, substance abuse, illiteracy etc.
core: Engagement of community
t_en: Tab-on-wheels smart class and tree-planting drives
t_hi: टैब-ऑन-व्हील्स स्मार्ट क्लास और वृक्षारोपण अभियान
s_hi: बच्चों को वृक्षारोपण व पर्यावरण संरक्षण हेतु प्रेरित किया; "टैब ऑन व्हील्स" से स्मार्ट कक्षाएँ; बाल विवाह, दहेज, नशा, निरक्षरता पर जागरूकता।
steps_en: Put tablets on a trolley that moves class to class on a timetable
Give each student a tree to plant and adopt
Run awareness rallies with student-made posters
steps_hi: टैबलेट को ट्रॉली पर रखें जो समय-सारिणी से कक्षा-दर-कक्षा जाए
हर छात्र को एक पेड़ लगाने व गोद लेने को दें
छात्रों के बनाए पोस्टरों के साथ जागरूकता रैली करें
scene: EMRS tribal students using tablets from a rolling cart, a tree-plantation drive on campus

name: Mr. Mujib Rahiman K U
school: Kendriya Vidyalaya, KANJIKODE, PUDUSSERY, MALAMPUZHA, PALAKKAD KERALA - 678623
citation: Mr. Mujib Rahiman K U has exemplified himself to be a dedicated and motivated library science teacher who has contributed to the promotion of good reading habits through various innovative activities. He is an iconic innovator, tech savvy teacher and a determined human being all rolled into one. He developed a library software in 2007 which provides free access to many school libraries in India. He has designed library websites and a mobile application for easy access to online services. As an IT expert, he has successfully trained 600 librarians through 11 Inservice Training courses. He worked as teacher coordinator for Skill Hub Initiative under Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojna and has trained 16 students to complete the Domestic Data Entry Operator course in 2022.He has won several awards and certificates of appreciation for various contributions. He is also a Fulbright scholar.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: Free library software and digital reading culture
t_hi: मुफ्त पुस्तकालय सॉफ़्टवेयर और डिजिटल पठन संस्कृति
s_hi: पुस्तकालय विज्ञान शिक्षक के रूप में पठन आदत; 2007 में मुफ्त पुस्तकालय सॉफ़्टवेयर जो अनेक विद्यालयों में उपयोग; पुस्तकालय वेबसाइट व ऐप; 600 पुस्तकालयाध्यक्षों को प्रशिक्षण; स्किल हब समन्वयक।
steps_en: Run a reading challenge with a class leaderboard (pages/books read)
Put the library catalogue online so students can search from home
Hold monthly author/book talks by students
steps_hi: कक्षा लीडरबोर्ड (पढ़े गए पन्ने/किताबें) के साथ पठन चुनौती चलाएँ
पुस्तकालय सूची ऑनलाइन रखें ताकि बच्चे घर से खोज सकें
बच्चों द्वारा मासिक लेखक/पुस्तक वार्ता रखें
scene: KV library with students searching an online catalogue on a computer, a reading leaderboard on the wall

name: Ms. Chetna Khambete
school: Kendriya Vidyalaya No.2 BSF, Indore MADHYA PRADESH - 452005
citation: Ms. Chetna Khambete is a PGT teacher in Kendriya Vidyalaya, Indore. Through her indefatigable enthusiasm, she has demonstrated what academic acumen and hard work can do to a teacher and to the students through her. Her committed efforts for last 18 years have been a story of hard work, experimentation and inevitable success. She has received various awards as a recognition of her contribution. Her biology laboratory is a hub of learning equipped with 3D models, teaching aids, charts and interactive information. She is a continuous teacher – learner.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: Interactive biology lab with 3D models
t_hi: 3D मॉडलों वाली इंटरैक्टिव जीवविज्ञान प्रयोगशाला
s_hi: 18 वर्षों का परिश्रम व प्रयोग; जीवविज्ञान प्रयोगशाला 3D मॉडल, शिक्षण साधन, चार्ट व इंटरैक्टिव जानकारी से सीखने का केंद्र; निरंतर शिक्षक-अधिगमकर्ता।
steps_en: Make 3D models of cells/organs with clay and thermocol with students
Add 'touch and learn' labels with questions next to each model
Keep the lab open in breaks for self-exploration
steps_hi: बच्चों के साथ मिट्टी व थर्मोकोल से कोशिका/अंगों के 3D मॉडल बनाएँ
हर मॉडल के पास प्रश्नों वाले 'छूकर सीखो' लेबल लगाएँ
स्व-अन्वेषण हेतु अवकाश में प्रयोगशाला खुली रखें
scene: KV biology lab filled with colourful 3D models of a heart and cell, students exploring with question cards

name: Shri Narayan Parmeshwar Bhagwat
school: SHRI MARIKAMBA GOVERNMENT PUC HIGH SCHOOL SECTION SIRSI, UTTARA KANNADA SIRSI KARNATAKA - 581402
citation: Shri Narayan Parmeshwar Bhagwat, is a teacher for the last 33 years. He started with the determination of making his school touch the highest standards in education. He did everything possible to get the infrastructure to an acceptable level by raising funds through CSR. He has also shown keen interest and practice in creating a joyful environment. He successfully deployed theatre for improving verbal and non-verbal communication skills among students. He has worked to distribute books, arrange safe drinking water units and other infrastructure and learning materials through CSR and alumni. He is actively involved in formation of Students Care Committee for the wider welfare of students. He has contributed significantly towards reducing dropouts and increasing enrolment through active involvement of community. He also contributed as a resource person in DD Chandana and conducted various online classes during the pandemic.
core: Engagement of community
t_en: Theatre for communication skills and Students Care Committee
t_hi: संचार कौशल हेतु रंगमंच और छात्र देखभाल समिति
s_hi: CSR व पूर्व छात्रों से अवसंरचना; आनंदमय वातावरण; मौखिक व अमौखिक संचार हेतु रंगमंच; पुस्तकें, पेयजल; छात्र कल्याण हेतु "स्टूडेंट्स केयर कमेटी"; डीडी चंदना पर कक्षाएँ।
steps_en: Run a drama club that performs one textbook lesson each term
Use theatre games (mirror, freeze-frame) for 10 minutes to build confidence
Form a Students Care Committee to look after welfare cases
steps_hi: नाटक क्लब चलाएँ जो हर टर्म एक पाठ का मंचन करे
आत्मविश्वास हेतु 10 मिनट के रंगमंच खेल (मिरर, फ़्रीज़-फ़्रेम) कराएँ
कल्याण मामलों की देखभाल हेतु छात्र देखभाल समिति बनाएँ
scene: Karnataka high-school students performing a play on a simple stage, classmates watching in the courtyard

name: Ms. Sapna Shrishail Anigol
school: K.L.E.SOCIETYS S.C.P. JR COLLEGE HIGH SCHOOL SECTION MAHALINGPUR, MUDHOL, BAGALKOT KARNATAKA - 587312
citation: Ms Sapna Shrishail Anigol has prepared e-content for video lessons which were broadcasted on DD Chandan channel. These are also available on Diksha Portal. She uses ICT, along with joyful learning for engaging, empowering and playful learning of meaningful content in a loving and supportive way. She played an active role to minimise dropout and to enhance enrolment in the school. She has propagated adoption of reusable cloth bags towards environment protection. She adopted micro scale biology experiments to improve learning outcomes.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: Micro-scale biology experiments and DD Chandana lessons
t_hi: सूक्ष्म-स्तरीय जीवविज्ञान प्रयोग और डीडी चंदना पाठ
s_hi: डीडी चंदना पर प्रसारित वीडियो पाठ, दीक्षा पर उपलब्ध; ICT व आनंदमय शिक्षण; ड्रॉपआउट कम करना; कपड़े के थैले अपनाना; सूक्ष्म-स्तरीय जीवविज्ञान प्रयोग।
steps_en: Use micro-scale experiments (drops, small vials) so every student can do it with little material
Share recorded lessons for absentees
Run a cloth-bag campaign through the eco-club
steps_hi: सूक्ष्म-स्तरीय प्रयोग (बूँदें, छोटी शीशियाँ) अपनाएँ ताकि हर बच्चा कम सामग्री में कर सके
अनुपस्थित बच्चों के लिए रिकॉर्ड किए पाठ साझा करें
इको क्लब के माध्यम से कपड़े के थैले का अभियान चलाएँ
scene: Karnataka girls doing micro-scale biology experiments with droppers on small tiles, cloth bags hanging behind

name: Shri Netai Chandra Dey
school: RAMAKRISHNA MISSION SCHOOL, NAROTTAM NAGAR, DEOMALI, TIRAP ARUNACHAL PRADESH - 792129
citation: Shri Netai Chandra Dey has put tremendous efforts to set up a science museum and a science laboratory in the school. He has attended school on all working days for the past 11 years. He is working hard towards character building of students in addition to imparting formal education. During the pandemic, he continued teaching the students effectively through various digital resources like Delta step, Google classrooms, Think Merit, Teachmint etc. He has been taking classes on Skill education and has conducted a science exhibition in the school as a part of Art Education where the students made different types of 3D models. He is instrumental in training and enabling students to participate in National Children’sScience Congress and science exhibitions.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: School science museum and perfect attendance
t_hi: विद्यालय विज्ञान संग्रहालय और पूर्ण उपस्थिति
s_hi: विद्यालय में विज्ञान संग्रहालय व प्रयोगशाला; 11 साल से हर कार्यदिवस उपस्थित; चरित्र निर्माण; महामारी में डिजिटल संसाधन; कौशल शिक्षा; 3D मॉडल प्रदर्शनी; बाल विज्ञान कांग्रेस।
steps_en: Collect local rocks, seeds, tools and student models into a small science museum
Let students be museum guides for visitors
Hold an annual 3D model exhibition
steps_hi: स्थानीय पत्थर, बीज, औज़ार और छात्र मॉडल से छोटा विज्ञान संग्रहालय बनाएँ
बच्चे आगंतुकों के लिए संग्रहालय गाइड बनें
वार्षिक 3D मॉडल प्रदर्शनी लगाएँ
scene: Arunachal school science museum with shelves of rocks, seeds and models, a student guide explaining to younger children

name: Shri Ningthoujam Binoy Singh
school: CHINGMEI UPPER PRIMARY SCHOOL, KEIBUL LAMJAO, MOIRANG, BISHNUPUR MANIPUR - 795133
citation: Shri. Ningthoujam Binoy Singh revived his school which was in an inhospitable condition when he joined. He was instrumental in transforming the infrastructure, some of it even by spending his own money,which brought students back to school. He motivated the parents of the dropouts to send them back to school by visiting their homes. He himself cleans the school campus and toilets regularly. He increased the strength of his school from 5 to 232. He even distributes stationary items and free books to the children. Due to his efforts, Chingmei Primary School has been upgraded to Chingmei Upper primary School.
core: Governance
t_en: Reviving a school from 5 to 232 students
t_hi: 5 से 232 छात्रों तक विद्यालय का पुनर्जीवन
s_hi: जर्जर विद्यालय को अपने पैसे से भी सुधारा; ड्रॉपआउट बच्चों के घर जाकर अभिभावकों को मनाया; खुद परिसर व शौचालय साफ़ करते हैं; संख्या 5 से 232; मुफ्त स्टेशनरी व पुस्तकें; विद्यालय उच्च प्राथमिक में उन्नत।
steps_en: Make the school clean and welcoming first: toilets, water, a painted room
Visit each dropout's home with a simple message and a free notebook
Display monthly enrolment growth at the gate
steps_hi: पहले विद्यालय को साफ़ और स्वागतयोग्य बनाएँ: शौचालय, पानी, पेंट किया कमरा
हर ड्रॉपआउट के घर सरल संदेश और मुफ्त कॉपी के साथ जाएँ
गेट पर मासिक नामांकन वृद्धि दिखाएँ
scene: Manipur lakeside upper-primary school freshly painted, a teacher welcoming children with notebooks, Loktak lake in the background

name: Dr. Purna Bahadur Chhetri
school: GOVERNMENT SENIOR SECONDARY SCHOOL SORENG SIKKIM - 737121
citation: Dr. Purna Bahadur Chhetri has worked as a programme officer of NSS for 5 years. He has also been a trainer for school accreditation and trained many school heads. He has successfully deployed organic farming as an experiential learning tool for enhanced comprehension of sustainability and nutrition. He supported girls in the field of football and as a result became the North- East Champion in 2022. Several of his students are playing professional football at National level. His school stood 2nd in the National Pipe Band competition 2023.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: Organic farming as experiential learning and girls' football
t_hi: अनुभवात्मक शिक्षा के रूप में जैविक खेती और बालिका फ़ुटबॉल
s_hi: NSS कार्यक्रम अधिकारी; विद्यालय मान्यता प्रशिक्षक; सततता व पोषण समझाने हेतु जैविक खेती; बालिका फ़ुटबॉल टीम पूर्वोत्तर चैंपियन 2022; राष्ट्रीय पाइप बैंड प्रतियोगिता में द्वितीय।
steps_en: Run an organic vegetable bed per class and link it to nutrition lessons
Start a girls' football practice with a fixed coach and schedule
Record crop data and sell surplus to the canteen
steps_hi: हर कक्षा की एक जैविक सब्ज़ी क्यारी रखें और उसे पोषण पाठ से जोड़ें
तय कोच व समय के साथ बालिका फ़ुटबॉल अभ्यास शुरू करें
फ़सल का डेटा दर्ज करें और अतिरिक्त उपज कैंटीन को बेचें
scene: Sikkim terrace with students tending organic vegetable beds, a girls' football team practising on the school ground below

name: Mr. Lalthianghlima
school: GOVT. DIAKKAWN HIGH SCHOOL, BILKHAWTHLIR, KOLASIB MIZORAM - 796081
citation: Mr. Lalthianghlima, a sincere and dedicated teacher, has made a great contribution in District and State Level Children’s Science Congress for Kolasib District. He has made immense effort to improve the pedagogical inputs to inculcate scientific temper among students. He was selected as the Best Booth Level officer of Mizoram State in 2018 and Local ambassador for Project Veng Kolasib under Swatch Bharat Mission. He was the Guide Teacher for students in Children’s Science Congress, Inspire Award MANAK and Science Seminar for students at District, State and National Level. His constructive approach towards teaching enhanced active participation in improving the teaching practices in classroom. He worked on encouraging participation of local communities such as members from NGO, Village Council and Parent Teacher Association to promote better education.
core: Learning material and mentorship
t_en: Guide teacher for Children's Science Congress and INSPIRE
t_hi: बाल विज्ञान कांग्रेस और INSPIRE के मार्गदर्शक शिक्षक
s_hi: ज़िला व राज्य बाल विज्ञान कांग्रेस में योगदान; वैज्ञानिक सोच हेतु शिक्षण सुधार; INSPIRE-MANAK व विज्ञान सेमिनार के मार्गदर्शक; NGO, ग्राम परिषद व PTA को जोड़ा।
steps_en: Form a science team that meets weekly from July for NCSC
Invite the village council and PTA to the project presentation
Teach the scientific method with a simple local investigation
steps_hi: जुलाई से हर हफ्ते मिलने वाली विज्ञान टीम NCSC के लिए बनाएँ
प्रोजेक्ट प्रस्तुति में ग्राम परिषद व PTA को बुलाएँ
सरल स्थानीय जाँच से वैज्ञानिक पद्धति सिखाएँ
scene: Mizoram students presenting a science congress poster to village council elders in a community hall

name: Shri Madhav Singh
school: ALPHA ENGLISH HIGHER SECONDARY SCHOOL, LUMSOHDANEI, UMLING, RI BHOI MEGHALAYA - 793102
citation: Shri. Madhav Singh is a resource person in National Children’s Science Congress and is actively involved in popularizing science among young children. As a coordinator of Green club, he is instrumental in organizing environmental protection activities. He has also authored a book on health education. He received State best teacher award in 2021. He uses simple and innovative techniques to enable students to understand science better.
core: Learning material and mentorship
t_en: Green club and simple science techniques
t_hi: ग्रीन क्लब और सरल विज्ञान तकनीकें
s_hi: बाल विज्ञान कांग्रेस रिसोर्स पर्सन; बच्चों में विज्ञान लोकप्रिय; ग्रीन क्लब समन्वयक के रूप में पर्यावरण गतिविधियाँ; स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा पुस्तक; सरल तकनीकों से विज्ञान।
steps_en: Run a monthly green-club action (cleanup, plantation, waste audit)
Explain each science idea with one simple demo before theory
Let students keep a nature notebook
steps_hi: हर महीने ग्रीन क्लब कार्य (सफ़ाई, वृक्षारोपण, कचरा ऑडिट) करें
हर विज्ञान विचार को सिद्धांत से पहले एक सरल प्रदर्शन से समझाएँ
बच्चे प्रकृति नोटबुक रखें
scene: Meghalaya green-club students planting saplings on a misty hillside, a teacher with a simple science demo

name: Mr. Kumud Kalita
school: PATHSALA SENIOR SECONDARY SCHOOL, MUGURIA PATHSALAL, BAJALI ASSAM - 781325
citation: A dedicated teacher for 35 years, Shri. Kumud Kalita played a vital role in establishing a residential school for the especially abled children. He has organized book fairs and awareness drives in his district. He received the Assam Chief Minister Best Community Action Award. He has authored several books including books for children. He has been a teacher, mentor and social service worker representing the qualities of compassion and dedication. He plays a crucial role in social welfare as a member of Juvenile Justice Board and Sishu Kalyan Samiti in preventing child marriage, child labour, women and child trafficking, etc. He employs innovative methods like music and joy in offering therapy to differently abled children.
core: Governance
t_en: Music therapy and residential school for specially abled children
t_hi: संगीत चिकित्सा और विशेष रूप से सक्षम बच्चों हेतु आवासीय विद्यालय
s_hi: 35 वर्षों से शिक्षण; विशेष रूप से सक्षम बच्चों के लिए आवासीय विद्यालय स्थापित करने में भूमिका; पुस्तक मेले; किशोर न्याय बोर्ड व शिशु कल्याण समिति सदस्य; संगीत से दिव्यांग बच्चों को थेरेपी।
steps_en: Use songs and rhythm to teach routines and words to CWSN children
Organise a book fair with local publishers once a year
Know your local Child Welfare Committee contact for child-protection cases
steps_hi: CWSN बच्चों को दिनचर्या और शब्द सिखाने के लिए गीत व लय का प्रयोग करें
साल में एक बार स्थानीय प्रकाशकों के साथ पुस्तक मेला लगाएँ
बाल संरक्षण मामलों हेतु स्थानीय बाल कल्याण समिति का संपर्क रखें
scene: Assam special school where a teacher plays a drum and children with disabilities clap and sing joyfully

name: Mr. Jose D Sujeev
school: GOVERNMENT MODEL GIRLS HIGHER SECONDARY SCHOOL PATTOM, THIRUVANANTHAPURAM KERALA - 695004
citation: As an educator, Shri .Jose D Sujeev introduced interactive and creative activities in his classroom, for example, Let’s Build Vocabulary, On This Day and an activity book for second language learners. He organized workshops and training sessions for teachers from different schools. He created a strong bond between the school and the community by initiating educational visits and environmental programs. He offered free online video classes to SSLC examination aspirants and even made DVDs and resource CDs to various grade levels, including hearing impaired students, thus ensuring inclusivity in language education. He developed an activity package of 28 modules for the learners to familiarize themselves with basic language skills. He is also a member of various teams of Government of Kerala furthering cause of education.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: "Let's Build Vocabulary", "On This Day" and 28 language modules
t_hi: "लेट्स बिल्ड वोकैबुलरी", "ऑन दिस डे" और 28 भाषा मॉड्यूल
s_hi: "लेट्स बिल्ड वोकैबुलरी", "ऑन दिस डे" जैसी रचनात्मक गतिविधियाँ; द्वितीय भाषा हेतु गतिविधि पुस्तक; SSLC के लिए मुफ्त वीडियो; श्रवण बाधित छात्रों सहित DVD/CD; 28 मॉड्यूल का भाषा पैकेज।
steps_en: Begin class with 'On This Day': one event, 3 new words
Keep a word wall where students add 2 words daily
Add captions/sign cues to videos for hearing-impaired learners
steps_hi: कक्षा की शुरुआत 'आज के दिन' से करें: एक घटना, 3 नए शब्द
शब्द दीवार रखें जिसमें बच्चे रोज़ 2 शब्द जोड़ें
श्रवण बाधित बच्चों के लिए वीडियो में कैप्शन/संकेत जोड़ें
scene: Thiruvananthapuram girls adding words to a colourful word wall, an 'On This Day' board with a date and picture

name: Mr. Mekala Bhaskar Rao
school: MCPS KONDAYAPALEM SW, SC COLONY KONDAYAPALEM, 20 TH DIVISON, SPSR NELLORE ANDHRA PRADESH - 524004
citation: Due to the efforts of Shri.M Bhaskar Rao and with the help from Government and donors, his school got infrastructure worth Rs. 20 lakhs. It consisted of toilets, additional classrooms, compound wall, grill, drinking water facility etc. He tackled the problem of dropouts in his district along with other teachers by visiting the houses of the students and understanding their problems. His school is one of the few schools to introduce digital technology in teaching. The useof computer education made the children to think more creatively and more intelligently. He conducts awareness programs in his school through rallies and participatory activities on different issues like child labour, child marriage, clean and green environment, etc.
core: Engagement of community
t_en: Door-to-door dropout tracking and computer education
t_hi: घर-घर ड्रॉपआउट ट्रैकिंग और कंप्यूटर शिक्षा
s_hi: सरकार व दानदाताओं से ₹20 लाख की अवसंरचना; ड्रॉपआउट समस्या हेतु घर जाकर कारण समझे; डिजिटल तकनीक व कंप्यूटर शिक्षा; बाल श्रम, बाल विवाह, स्वच्छता पर रैलियाँ।
steps_en: Prepare a list of every dropout with reason and visit with another teacher
Introduce basic computer time for primary children weekly
Hold awareness rallies on child labour with posters
steps_hi: हर ड्रॉपआउट की कारण सहित सूची बनाएँ और एक अन्य शिक्षक के साथ घर जाएँ
प्राथमिक बच्चों के लिए साप्ताहिक बुनियादी कंप्यूटर समय रखें
पोस्टरों के साथ बाल श्रम पर जागरूकता रैली करें
scene: Nellore teachers walking through a colony visiting homes, children in the background at school computers

name: Ms. MURAHARA RAO UMA GANDHI
school: GVMCP SCHOOL, SIVAJIPALEM, 21, VISAKHAPATNAM ANDHRA PRADESH - 530017
citation: Apart from being a teacher, Smt. MURAHARA RAO UMA GANDHI is a yoga practitioner too. She teaches yoga and meditationfree of cost with focus on under-privileged people. TEACHING AT THE RIGHT LEVEL was one of the programs that her school launchedwhere they visited the homes of students and taught various important things inlife. With the help of an online website FROOTS she hasorganised online sessions during the summer vacation to narrate stories, rhymes andto conduct various other activities. She has also translated three English books into Telugu which were published by NBT. She has served as a member for the development ofbalasahithyam and integrating joyful learning with TLM. She has curated teaching modules and written severalpoems for students.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: Teaching at the Right Level home visits and online summer sessions
t_hi: टीचिंग एट द राइट लेवल गृह भेंट और ऑनलाइन ग्रीष्म सत्र
s_hi: गरीबों को मुफ्त योग-ध्यान; "टीचिंग एट द राइट लेवल" के तहत घर-घर जाकर पढ़ाना; ग्रीष्मावकाश में ऑनलाइन कहानी-कविता सत्र; तीन अंग्रेज़ी पुस्तकों का तेलुगु अनुवाद (NBT); बालसाहित्य।
steps_en: Test each child with a simple reading/number tool and group by level, not class
Teach each level group daily with level-specific activities for 45 minutes
Run online story sessions during vacations
steps_hi: सरल पठन/संख्या उपकरण से हर बच्चे का स्तर जाँचें और कक्षा के बजाय स्तर से समूह बनाएँ
हर स्तर समूह को रोज़ 45 मिनट स्तर-विशेष गतिविधियाँ कराएँ
छुट्टियों में ऑनलाइन कहानी सत्र चलाएँ
scene: Visakhapatnam teacher sitting with a small group of children at a home doorstep doing level-based reading cards

name: Mr. Settem Anjaneyulu
school: S.R.R Z.P HIGH SCHOOL, MASAPETA, RAYACHOTI, ANNAMAYYA ANDHRA PRADESH - 516270
citation: Shri Settem Anjaneyulu has employed interactive teaching methods such as group discussions, role play and made learning enjoyable for students by these and other means. For better understanding of concepts, he has used visual aids like charts, diagrams and models. By regular assessments of students, he identifies areas where students need additional support, tracks students’ progress over time with the help of parents and local community. He has given guidanceto students preparing for Navodaya Vidyalaya,Sainik School and Residential School entrance exams. For this he got an appreciation from the District Administration also.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: Regular assessment with parent tracking and entrance-exam guidance
t_hi: अभिभावक सहयोग से नियमित आकलन और प्रवेश परीक्षा मार्गदर्शन
s_hi: समूह चर्चा, रोल प्ले, चार्ट व मॉडल; नियमित आकलन से कमज़ोर क्षेत्र पहचान, अभिभावकों व समुदाय के साथ प्रगति ट्रैक; नवोदय, सैनिक व आवासीय विद्यालय प्रवेश परीक्षा मार्गदर्शन।
steps_en: Give a short weekly test and mark weak areas in a class grid
Send a simple progress card home every month
Hold free evening coaching for Navodaya/Sainik entrance
steps_hi: हर हफ्ते छोटी परीक्षा लें और कक्षा ग्रिड में कमज़ोर क्षेत्र चिह्नित करें
हर महीने सरल प्रगति कार्ड घर भेजें
नवोदय/सैनिक प्रवेश हेतु शाम को मुफ्त कोचिंग दें
scene: Andhra high-school teacher marking a progress grid with students, parents reading progress cards

name: Ms. Archana Nooguri
school: MPPS REBBANAPALLY, REBBANPALLY, LUXETTIPET, MANCHERIAL TELANGANA - 504215
citation: Throughout her career, Smt. Archana Nooguri’s primary focus has been to improve enrolment rates and reduce dropouts in the schools by raising awareness about facilities provided by government among parents and villagers. With valuable communityinvolvement, she has managed to procure a bore well, a purified water plant, furniture and a library.To make use of ICT, she has arranged computers, LED projectors, and additional classrooms. She provided digital learningexperiences to children to ensure joyful learning. The development and use of low-cost Teaching LearningMaterial have been central to her approach as aneducator. Two of her papers have been published in international journals. She authored a book on Transforming India by means of National Education Policy 2020.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: Community-sourced bore well, RO plant and library
t_hi: समुदाय सहयोग से बोरवेल, RO प्लांट और पुस्तकालय
s_hi: सरकारी सुविधाओं के बारे में अभिभावकों में जागरूकता से नामांकन बढ़ाया; समुदाय से बोरवेल, शुद्ध जल प्लांट, फ़र्नीचर व पुस्तकालय; कंप्यूटर, प्रोजेक्टर; कम लागत TLM; NEP पर पुस्तक।
steps_en: Hold a village meeting explaining government entitlements (books, uniforms, meals)
Ask the community for one need at a time and thank them publicly
Use low-cost TLMs in every lesson
steps_hi: गाँव में बैठक कर सरकारी सुविधाएँ (पुस्तकें, यूनिफ़ॉर्म, भोजन) समझाएँ
समुदाय से एक बार में एक ज़रूरत माँगें और सार्वजनिक धन्यवाद दें
हर पाठ में कम लागत TLM का प्रयोग करें
scene: Telangana village primary school with a new water purifier and library shelf, villagers at a meeting with a woman teacher

name: Mr. Santhosh Kumar Bhedodkar
school: MANDAL PARISHAD UPPER PRIMARY SCHOOL NIPANI, BHEEMPUR, ADILABAD TELANGANA - 504312
citation: Throughout 18 years of his journey as a teacher and Head Teacher Shri Santhosh Kumar Bhedodkar Mandal has been dedicated to creating innovative and effective teaching methodologies by integratingarts like singing, music along with ICT in teaching learning process, which resulted in improved learning outcomes and enthusiastic participation of students. Enrolment in his school increased every year and dropout rates reduced due to his efforts. He has served as a State ResourcePerson and imparted training to teachers on different ICT tools, Pedagogy of SocialSciences etc. He has also actively participated in the development of textbooks, worksheets by SCERT, Telangana Open School Society. He initiated programmes like Namaste Nipani where students gather online after school hours and read online newspaper, magazines, story books and share their knowledge.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: Songs and music with ICT and "Namaste Nipani" online reading
t_hi: ICT के साथ गीत-संगीत और "नमस्ते निपानी" ऑनलाइन पठन
s_hi: गायन व संगीत को ICT से जोड़कर अधिगम सुधार; नामांकन बढ़ा; राज्य रिसोर्स पर्सन; पाठ्यपुस्तक विकास; "नमस्ते निपानी" में बच्चे स्कूल के बाद ऑनलाइन समाचार, पत्रिकाएँ व कहानियाँ पढ़कर साझा करते हैं।
steps_en: Turn key facts of a chapter into a song with students
Run an after-school reading circle (online or in the village) to read and share news
Use a projector for map and video-based Social Science
steps_hi: अध्याय के मुख्य तथ्यों को बच्चों के साथ गीत में बदलें
स्कूल के बाद पठन घेरा (ऑनलाइन या गाँव में) चलाएँ जिसमें समाचार पढ़कर साझा करें
नक्शे व वीडियो आधारित सामाजिक विज्ञान हेतु प्रोजेक्टर का उपयोग करें
scene: Adilabad tribal students singing a Social Science song with a harmonium, an online reading circle on a laptop

name: Ms. Ritika Anand
school: ST. MARKS SEC SEC PUBLIC SCHOOL, PASCHIM VIHAR, A-BLOCK MEERA BAGH, WEST DELHI DELHI - 110087
citation: With 22 years of experience in teaching administration, and management of school activities at St Marks SchoolNew Delhi, Ms. Ritika Anand has strived to build a creative, innovative safe and healthy environmentat school. She collaborates with specialeducation teachers and guidance counsellors to help in implementing special education, mental health and counselling programs.She has contributed to Kishore Manch, NCERT PM e-vidya, DIKSHA portal,SWAYAMPRABHA, NIOS Mukt Vidya Vani as a subject expert in Physics.She has created infographics, scripts, toys games, story boards etc for children. She has used Story Telling and Toy based Pedagogy and Art Integration in teaching ofPhysics. She was awarded the CBSE award for excellence in school teaching and leadership in 2021 and Delhi State Teachers Award 2022.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: Toy-based, story and art-integrated Physics
t_hi: खिलौना, कहानी व कला समेकित भौतिकी
s_hi: सुरक्षित व स्वस्थ विद्यालय वातावरण; विशेष शिक्षा व परामर्श कार्यक्रम; पीएम ई-विद्या, दीक्षा, स्वयंप्रभा में भौतिकी विशेषज्ञ; इन्फ़ोग्राफ़िक, खिलौने, स्टोरीबोर्ड; कहानी, खिलौना व कला से भौतिकी।
steps_en: Use a toy (spinning top, balloon car) to open each Physics chapter
Let students make a 6-box storyboard explaining a concept
Create one infographic per chapter with students
steps_hi: हर भौतिकी अध्याय की शुरुआत किसी खिलौने (लट्टू, गुब्बारा कार) से करें
बच्चों से 6 खानों का स्टोरीबोर्ड बनवाएँ जो अवधारणा समझाए
बच्चों के साथ हर अध्याय का एक इन्फ़ोग्राफ़िक बनाएँ
scene: Delhi students racing balloon cars across a classroom floor, a storyboard about motion pinned on the board

name: Sudhanshu Shekhar Panda
school: K.L. INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL, MEERUT UTTAR PRADESH - 250005
citation: A dedicated teacher for 29 years, Shri. Sudhanshu Shekhar Panda has received many awards including like the CBSE award. He has been working for the syllabus review committee and has prepared creative activities in Economics. He has contributed in Graphic Novels for Diksha Portal. He was instrumental in preparing a theme based magazine for the students of the school. At present he is the Lead City Coordinator CBSE of 4 districts of UP and also looking after the smooth functioning of Board Examination as City Coordinator CBSE Meerut District.
core: Governance
t_en: Creative Economics activities and graphic novels
t_hi: रचनात्मक अर्थशास्त्र गतिविधियाँ और ग्राफ़िक उपन्यास
s_hi: 29 वर्षों का शिक्षण; पाठ्यक्रम समीक्षा समिति; अर्थशास्त्र में रचनात्मक गतिविधियाँ; दीक्षा के लिए ग्राफ़िक उपन्यास; थीम आधारित पत्रिका; CBSE सिटी कोऑर्डिनेटर।
steps_en: Explain an Economics concept as a 6-panel comic drawn by students
Run a market simulation (demand-supply with tokens)
Publish a theme-based class magazine each year
steps_hi: किसी अर्थशास्त्र अवधारणा को बच्चों द्वारा बनाए 6 पैनल कॉमिक में समझाएँ
बाज़ार सिमुलेशन (टोकन से माँग-आपूर्ति) चलाएँ
हर साल थीम आधारित कक्षा पत्रिका प्रकाशित करें
scene: Meerut students running a mini market simulation with tokens, a hand-drawn economics comic on the wall

name: Dr. T Godwin Vedanayagam Rajkumar
school: GOVERNMENT BOYS HR SEC SCHOOL, ALANGANALLUR, MADURAI TAMIL NADU - 625501
citation: Dr. T Godwin Vedanayagam Rajkumar is an inspiring Physical Education teacher who believes in equipping students with essential life skills such as team work, discipline, resilience and goal setting. As a physical education teacher, he has not only taught the fundamentals of various sports, but has also imparted valuable lessons that would resonate with students as they navigate their personal and professional journeys. Furthermore,he is shaping the habits and attitudes of young learners. He has understood the transformative power of physical education in nurturing holistic development and is conveying the same to students.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: Life skills through Physical Education
t_hi: शारीरिक शिक्षा से जीवन कौशल
s_hi: शारीरिक शिक्षा से टीमवर्क, अनुशासन, लचीलापन व लक्ष्य निर्धारण; खेलों की मूल बातों के साथ जीवन के मूल्यवान सबक; समग्र विकास में शारीरिक शिक्षा की शक्ति।
steps_en: End each PE period with a 3-minute reflection: what did teamwork/discipline look like today?
Let students set a personal fitness goal and track it monthly
Rotate captaincy so every student leads once
steps_hi: हर PE पीरियड के अंत में 3 मिनट चिंतन: आज टीमवर्क/अनुशासन कैसा दिखा?
बच्चे निजी फ़िटनेस लक्ष्य तय करें और हर महीने ट्रैक करें
कप्तानी बदलते रहें ताकि हर बच्चा एक बार नेतृत्व करे
scene: Madurai boys' school ground, a PE teacher in a huddle with a kabaddi team discussing teamwork

name: Ms. Malathi S
school: GOVERNMENT HIGHER SECONDARY SCHOOL, VEERAKERALAMPUDUR, KEELAPPAVOOR, TENKASI TAMIL NADU - 627861
citation: Smt. Malathi S. S. Malathi uses ICT tools and science apps in the classroom such as Quizizz, Wordwall and Twin science games, solar system scope, science practical simulator etc for teaching and evaluation. She also teaches through puppets and storytelling. She also utilizes low cost TLMs like empty biscuit wrappers, beads, old newspapers, shoes, laces etc. She received Dr. Radhakrishnan Best Teacher Award in 2021. She also received certificate from Tamil Nadu Education Department for teaching students online.
core: Innovative pedagogy and joyful learning
t_en: Science apps plus puppets and biscuit-wrapper TLMs
t_hi: विज्ञान ऐप के साथ कठपुतली और बिस्कुट-रैपर TLM
s_hi: क्विज़िज़, वर्डवॉल, सोलर सिस्टम स्कोप, साइंस प्रैक्टिकल सिम्युलेटर से शिक्षण व मूल्यांकन; कठपुतली व कहानी; बिस्कुट रैपर, मोती, अखबार, जूते-फीते जैसे कम लागत TLM।
steps_en: Use a free simulator for practicals you cannot do in a lab
Make models from wrappers, beads and laces (e.g., DNA, atom)
Tell one science story with a puppet each month
steps_hi: जो प्रयोग लैब में संभव नहीं, उनके लिए मुफ्त सिम्युलेटर का प्रयोग करें
रैपर, मोती और फीतों से मॉडल बनाएँ (जैसे DNA, परमाणु)
हर महीने कठपुतली से एक विज्ञान कहानी सुनाएँ
scene: Tenkasi students building a bead-and-lace DNA model, a solar-system app on a phone, a puppet on the teacher's hand

name: Ms. Mrinal Nandkishor Ganjale
school: Z P SCHOOL PIMPALGAON TARFE MAHALUNGE, AMBEGAON, PUNE MAHARASHTRA - 410503
citation: Ms. Mrinal Nandkishor Ganjale uses modern technology in teaching and tries to impart life-oriented education to students. She has introduced an element of joy in students learning and believes in their empowerment. She received National ICT Award in 2019 for effective use of technology in teaching learning process. She also received Maharashtra Ideal Teacher Award in 2020.
core: Use of technology for learning
t_en: Technology for life-oriented learning
t_hi: जीवनोपयोगी शिक्षा हेतु तकनीक
s_hi: आधुनिक तकनीक से जीवनोपयोगी शिक्षा; आनंदमय व सशक्त अधिगम; राष्ट्रीय ICT पुरस्कार 2019 और महाराष्ट्र आदर्श शिक्षक पुरस्कार 2020।
steps_en: Link every digital activity to a real-life task (shopping list, weather report)
Let children make a short video or slideshow about their village
Use a tablet as a station in group rotation
steps_hi: हर डिजिटल गतिविधि को वास्तविक कार्य (खरीदारी सूची, मौसम रिपोर्ट) से जोड़ें
बच्चे अपने गाँव पर छोटा वीडियो या स्लाइड शो बनाएँ
समूह रोटेशन में टैबलेट को एक स्टेशन बनाएँ
scene: Pune rural ZP school children recording a weather report on a tablet outside, others in activity stations

name: Mr. Amit Kumar
citation: Mr. Amit Kumar, a computer teacher at Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya at Theog, Shimla, of Himachal Pradesh has made science and math learning a great fun to students. Adopting a blended learning approach to put his computers education to the best use, Mr. Amit has used Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) based MOOCs to reach out to students in the same class but with different abilities to learn. By introducing Collaborative Flipped learning in the classroom to implement Communication, Critical Thinking, Creativity, Curation and Collaboration to empower students and teachers with 21st Century skills he made the science leaning an all-round experience to students. For students with rural backdrop, Mr. Amit’s innovative approaches such as Creation of Mind Maps by students, Skype Interactions of students with classrooms across various countries, collaborative learning using Wakelet and student voice empowerment for better engagement using Flipgrid are plane changing experiences. It helped his students to participate in various National and International level competitions like NSF, ENF, Inspire Manak Award, e-Raksha Competition and Adobe Creativity Challenge with accolades. In an effort to extend his efforts to others, Mr. Amit has published Books and more than 75 research papers. By giving the experience of a fully loaded corporate school at a Navodaya school, Mr. Amit proves to be a ‘super teacher’ for his students.
t_en: Collaborative flipped learning with FOSS MOOCs, mind maps and Flipgrid
t_hi: FOSS MOOC, माइंड मैप और फ़्लिपग्रिड के साथ सहयोगी फ्लिप्ड शिक्षा
s_hi: ब्लेंडेड शिक्षा, विभिन्न क्षमताओं वाले बच्चों हेतु ओपन-सोर्स MOOC, सहयोगी फ्लिप्ड कक्षा (5C कौशल), छात्रों द्वारा माइंड मैप, विदेशी कक्षाओं से स्काइप संवाद, वेकलेट व फ़्लिपग्रिड।
steps_en: Let students create a mind map at the end of every chapter
Give a pre-class video and use class for group problem solving
Ask students to record 1-minute video reflections (Flipgrid-style) on a phone
steps_hi: हर अध्याय के अंत में बच्चों से माइंड मैप बनवाएँ
कक्षा से पहले वीडियो दें और कक्षा का समय समूह समस्या समाधान में लगाएँ
बच्चे फ़ोन पर 1 मिनट का वीडियो चिंतन रिकॉर्ड करें (फ़्लिपग्रिड शैली)
scene: Navodaya students in a Himachal hill school drawing colourful mind maps, others on a video call with a classroom abroad

name: Ms. Anju Dahiya
school: Government Sr. Sec. School, Barwasni, Sonipat
citation: Ms. Anju Dahiya is an immensely talented Science (Chemistry) teacher. She has designed innovative methods for kindling the curiosity of students so that knowledge is not only disseminated but created as well. The science congresses, conclaves, quizzes have been effectively employed. In order to develop personalities of the students in a holistic manner, she has initiated many activities such as mountaineering, planting of trees and the use of QR codes for getting detailed information needed. Ms. Anju took the help of NGOs and philanthropists for updating the infrastructure of the school.
t_en: Science conclaves, mountaineering and QR information trails
t_hi: विज्ञान सम्मेलन, पर्वतारोहण और QR सूचना मार्ग
s_hi: जिज्ञासा जगाने हेतु विज्ञान कांग्रेस, सम्मेलन व क्विज़; पर्वतारोहण, वृक्षारोपण व QR कोड से विस्तृत जानकारी; NGO व दानदाताओं से अवसंरचना सुधार।
steps_en: Hold a student-run 'science conclave' each term with short talks
Put QR codes on lab equipment linking to how-to videos
Plan an adventure/nature trip with a science task
steps_hi: हर टर्म छात्रों द्वारा संचालित 'विज्ञान सम्मेलन' छोटी वार्ताओं के साथ करें
प्रयोगशाला उपकरणों पर QR कोड लगाएँ जो उपयोग के वीडियो खोलें
विज्ञान कार्य के साथ साहसिक/प्रकृति यात्रा की योजना बनाएँ
scene: Haryana girls presenting at a school science conclave, QR codes on lab equipment, mountain trekking photos on a board

name: Mr. Aravindaraja D
citation: Mr. Aravindaraja D. is model for what can be achieved with hard work and commitment. He has put his small school on the international map by the innovative programmes. The bubble show, creation of the science corner to stimulate curiosity, the eco club, use of Foldscope project microscopy, establishing photography centre are all noteworthy. Special mention must be made about the students who won International Astronomical Union award from among 128 countries, Honorary Mention award in Worldwide Crystal growing competition, winning prizes in Make Science International competition at Paris, receiving recognition certificate from Vigyan Prasar, Government of India. His mastery over rangoli art and drawing have made his classrooms and teaching exciting. His love of science has excited and involved the entire community.
t_en: Bubble show, Foldscope microscopy and international science wins
t_hi: बबल शो, फ़ोल्डस्कोप माइक्रोस्कोपी और अंतरराष्ट्रीय विज्ञान सफलताएँ
s_hi: बबल शो, जिज्ञासा हेतु विज्ञान कोना, इको क्लब, फ़ोल्डस्कोप (कागज़ का माइक्रोस्कोप), फ़ोटोग्राफ़ी केंद्र; छात्रों को अंतरराष्ट्रीय खगोल संघ व क्रिस्टल ग्रोइंग प्रतियोगिता में पुरस्कार; रंगोली व चित्रकला से रोचक कक्षा।
steps_en: Use a paper microscope (Foldscope) to let every student see cells and pond water
Run a 'bubble show' to teach surface tension and colours
Enter students in international citizen-science contests (astronomy, crystal growing)
steps_hi: कागज़ के माइक्रोस्कोप (फ़ोल्डस्कोप) से हर बच्चे को कोशिकाएँ व तालाब का पानी दिखाएँ
पृष्ठ तनाव व रंग सिखाने हेतु 'बबल शो' करें
बच्चों को अंतरराष्ट्रीय सिटीज़न साइंस प्रतियोगिताओं (खगोल, क्रिस्टल) में भेजें
scene: Puducherry students looking through paper Foldscope microscopes, a teacher making giant soap bubbles, rangoli of a cell on the floor

name: Mr. Arun Kumar Garg
citation: Mr. Arun Kumar Garg heads the school. His contributions in making the school more learners friendly made headlines. The concepts that he introduced such as kitchen gardening, subject labs and education village have made the students practice sustainable lifestyles. Being a mathematics teacher he innovated with pedagogy to make mathematics learning more joyful. He went on to do online teaching and organized doubts clearing sessions that spreads across school boundaries. Innovative practices such as making the students write review of books that they study in a well-developed school library helps the students in overall development and improves their creative thinking. He has been maintaining a good balance of school development and teaching and that has earned him laurels.
t_en: Education village, subject labs and student book reviews
t_hi: शिक्षा ग्राम, विषय प्रयोगशालाएँ और छात्र पुस्तक समीक्षा
s_hi: किचन गार्डन, विषय लैब और "एजुकेशन विलेज" से टिकाऊ जीवनशैली; गणित को आनंदमय बनाने हेतु नवाचार; ऑनलाइन डाउट सत्र; पुस्तकालय से पढ़ी पुस्तकों की छात्र समीक्षा।
steps_en: Ask every student to write a 5-line review of each library book and display the best
Set up subject corners/labs for maths, science and language
Hold an evening online doubt session once a week
steps_hi: हर बच्चे से पढ़ी हर पुस्तक की 5 पंक्तियों की समीक्षा लिखवाएँ और श्रेष्ठ को प्रदर्शित करें
गणित, विज्ञान व भाषा के लिए विषय कोने/प्रयोगशालाएँ बनाएँ
हफ्ते में एक बार शाम को ऑनलाइन डाउट सत्र रखें
scene: Punjab middle-school library wall covered with student book reviews, a kitchen garden outside the window

name: Mr. Buddhadev Dutta
addr: Joypur Primary School, Bankura, West Bengal - 722138
citation: Mr.Buddhadev Datta, a primary school teacher at Joypur Primary School in West Bengal is an exemplary innovator in school education. Notwithstanding the rural setting of his school he went on to innovate pedagogical methods that gets the students interested and involved. Breaking the monotony, he made the students ask questions and he as a teacher answered them and this has helped immensely in inculcating critical thinking in students. Peer to peer learning process which is an advanced pedagogical method implemented in foreign countries is followed by this ‘dedicated and innovative guru’ in West Bengal. Creating a reading club he also tried to get the students a habit of reading. Coming from vulnerable conditions geographically, he ensured that his students are equipped with lifesaving skills. His efforts during COVID pandemic where he created e-content and innovative online material to help students continue their learning and attending to the learning gaps as they return to physical school demonstrates his love to students and sincerity as a teacher. He promises to make big roads to his students and for their bright future.
t_en: Student questions first, peer learning and reading club
t_hi: पहले बच्चों के प्रश्न, साथी शिक्षण और पठन क्लब
s_hi: ग्रामीण विद्यालय में बच्चे प्रश्न पूछें और शिक्षक उत्तर दें, इससे आलोचनात्मक सोच; साथी शिक्षण; पठन क्लब; आपदा-प्रवण क्षेत्र में जीवन रक्षक कौशल; कोविड में ई-कंटेंट व अधिगम अंतर पूर्ति।
steps_en: Begin each class with 3 questions from children before you teach
Pair stronger and weaker readers for 15 minutes daily
Teach basic safety and life-saving skills relevant to your area (flood, snakebite)
steps_hi: पढ़ाने से पहले हर कक्षा की शुरुआत बच्चों के 3 प्रश्नों से करें
रोज़ 15 मिनट मज़बूत व कमज़ोर पाठकों की जोड़ी बनाएँ
अपने क्षेत्र के अनुरूप बुनियादी सुरक्षा व जीवन रक्षा कौशल (बाढ़, सर्पदंश) सिखाएँ
scene: West Bengal village primary children raising hands to ask questions, pairs reading together on a verandah

name: Mr. Durga Ram Muwal
citation: Mr. Durga Ram Muwal has shown himself to be dedicated and motivated teacher who has worked very hard for the improvement and performance of his school. The school caters to the most deprived sections of the society. He has worked hard to make the school attractive and effective. His abilities and effectiveness in yoga training, self-defence training have given him a popular face among the community. He has been successfully curtailing dropouts by activating the interest of students through the use of joyful TLMs and experiential pedagogical practices and co-scholastic activities. He has given a voice to the girl child through education.
t_en: Joyful TLM, yoga and self-defence to curb dropouts
t_hi: ड्रॉपआउट रोकने हेतु आनंदमय TLM, योग और आत्मरक्षा
s_hi: सबसे वंचित वर्गों के विद्यालय को आकर्षक बनाया; योग व आत्मरक्षा प्रशिक्षण से समुदाय में लोकप्रिय; आनंदमय TLM व अनुभवात्मक शिक्षण से ड्रॉपआउट रोका; बालिकाओं को शिक्षा से आवाज़ दी।
steps_en: Start the school day with 10 minutes of yoga
Run weekly self-defence practice for girls
Make every lesson start with a TLM or activity
steps_hi: विद्यालय दिवस की शुरुआत 10 मिनट योग से करें
बालिकाओं के लिए साप्ताहिक आत्मरक्षा अभ्यास कराएँ
हर पाठ की शुरुआत किसी TLM या गतिविधि से करें
scene: Udaipur tribal-area school children doing yoga in the morning, girls practising self-defence

name: Ms. G. Ponsankari
citation: Ms. G. Ponsankari has done most of what is expected of a complete teacher. Joining hands with NGOs to build eco-friendly components for the school, developing local health traditions, plastic free campus, effective Alumni meets, project-based learning, optimising the use of Atal Tinkering Lab and ensuring peer learning in the school have all been her fingerprints on the school canvas. Niti Ayog’s award is a reward for her good work. Her out of classroom activities are a revelation of her acumen.
t_en: Plastic-free campus, Atal Tinkering Lab and peer learning
t_hi: प्लास्टिक मुक्त परिसर, अटल टिंकरिंग लैब और साथी शिक्षण
s_hi: NGO के साथ पर्यावरण अनुकूल घटक; स्थानीय स्वास्थ्य परंपराएँ; प्लास्टिक मुक्त परिसर; पूर्व छात्र मिलन; प्रोजेक्ट आधारित शिक्षा; अटल टिंकरिंग लैब का बेहतर उपयोग; साथी शिक्षण; नीति आयोग पुरस्कार।
steps_en: Declare the campus plastic-free with student monitors and a weekly check
Give ATL time to every class, not just a few students
Run peer-teaching where students teach a topic they mastered
steps_hi: छात्र निगरानीकर्ताओं व साप्ताहिक जाँच के साथ परिसर को प्लास्टिक मुक्त घोषित करें
ATL का समय कुछ नहीं, हर कक्षा को दें
साथी शिक्षण करें जिसमें बच्चे अपना अच्छा आया विषय पढ़ाएँ
scene: KV Tumakuru students in a tinkering lab, a 'plastic-free campus' banner, a student teaching peers at the board

name: Ms. Gamchi Timre R. Marak
citation: Ms. Gamchi Timre R Marak is a courageous lady determined to do her best for the rural, inaccessible areas and help children to discover their potentials. Having worked as an administrator in a school, she noticed the challenges faced by the children in the mining areas and decided to start a school of her own with the local support and a few similar minded teachers. She took to counselling, introducing innovative teaching programmes so that these children could be drawn out of the rampant alcoholism, domestic violence and early marriages. She introduced Music and Taekwondo and agriculture to hold back these children. Her visits to the homes of parents have ironed out a few challenges and the NLP sessions have offered succour to the troubled minds.
t_en: Starting a school in mining areas with music, taekwondo and counselling
t_hi: खनन क्षेत्र में संगीत, ताइक्वांडो और परामर्श के साथ विद्यालय
s_hi: खनन क्षेत्र के बच्चों की चुनौतियाँ देखकर स्थानीय सहयोग से अपना विद्यालय शुरू किया; शराबखोरी, घरेलू हिंसा व बाल विवाह से बचाने हेतु परामर्श; संगीत, ताइक्वांडो व कृषि; गृह भेंट।
steps_en: Offer music, martial arts or farming clubs to keep at-risk students engaged
Visit homes of children facing violence or addiction and connect with help
Keep a weekly counselling slot
steps_hi: जोखिम वाले बच्चों को जोड़े रखने हेतु संगीत, मार्शल आर्ट या खेती क्लब चलाएँ
हिंसा या नशे का सामना कर रहे बच्चों के घर जाएँ और सहायता से जोड़ें
हर हफ्ते परामर्श का समय रखें
scene: Meghalaya hill school with students practising taekwondo in a yard, others playing guitars, a head teacher counselling a child

name: Mr. Harpreet Singh
citation: Mr. Harpreet Singh, as a head teacher of Government Primary Smart School, has demonstrated committed efforts in transforming his school infrastructure by mobilizing support from NRIs and the community apart from his own personal contributions. He not only made the school clean, hygienic and modern, but also ensured that the learning is joyful for students by establishing Special Education Activity Park, various labs for languages as well as science and social science subject areas. Not limiting to his own school, he mentored 5 other schools in Punjab to become clean and smart in providing education. Making his school as ISO certified school, he has been inspiring many other schools in Punjab to modernize their school infrastructure and student learning.
t_en: NRI-supported smart school and mentoring 5 other schools
t_hi: NRI सहयोग से स्मार्ट स्कूल और 5 अन्य विद्यालयों की मेंटरिंग
s_hi: NRI व समुदाय सहयोग से विद्यालय को स्वच्छ, आधुनिक बनाया; विशेष शिक्षा गतिविधि पार्क; भाषा, विज्ञान व सामाजिक विज्ञान लैब; 5 अन्य विद्यालयों को स्मार्ट बनाने में मेंटरिंग; ISO प्रमाणित विद्यालय।
steps_en: Connect with village NRIs/diaspora through a WhatsApp group with photos of needs
Build an activity park with special-education equipment
Adopt a nearby school and share what worked
steps_hi: गाँव के NRI/प्रवासियों से ज़रूरतों की तस्वीरों के साथ व्हाट्सऐप समूह से जुड़ें
विशेष शिक्षा उपकरणों वाला गतिविधि पार्क बनाएँ
पास का एक विद्यालय गोद लें और जो सफल रहा वह साझा करें
scene: Punjab primary 'smart school' with a colourful activity park, children with special needs on sensory equipment

name: Mr. Iswar Chandra Nayak
citation: Mr. Iswar Chandra Nayak is an Assistant Teacher at Government Upper Primary School Kanapur in Odisha. He is an extensive writer and a popular columnist in the field of school education. He has implemented innovation in teaching methods such as ‘devise the education material and means of delivery by observing the students’. He not only published these innovative practices in the form of books, columns and magazines but also made the students part of such writings. With his writings and interaction on various platforms he has reached out to larger audience making the impact manifolds and that has given him wide recognition and many accolades at state and national level. With the combination of dedicated teaching, innovation in pedagogy and extensive writing and outreach Mr. Nayak can motivate and be role model for many young teachers in the country.
t_en: Writing columns and books with students on classroom innovation
t_hi: बच्चों के साथ कक्षा नवाचार पर स्तंभ व पुस्तक लेखन
s_hi: "बच्चों को देखकर शिक्षण सामग्री और प्रस्तुति गढ़ना" जैसे नवाचार; पुस्तकों, स्तंभों व पत्रिकाओं में प्रकाशन और बच्चों को भी लेखन में शामिल करना; अनेक मंचों से व्यापक पहुँच।
steps_en: Observe how children learn for a week and change one material based on what you saw
