Help children write and publish one piece a month (local paper, school wall)
Write a short note on your innovation for a teachers' magazine
steps_hi: एक हफ्ते देखें कि बच्चे कैसे सीखते हैं और उस आधार पर एक सामग्री बदलें
बच्चों को हर महीने एक रचना लिखने और प्रकाशित करने में मदद करें (स्थानीय अखबार, विद्यालय दीवार)
अपने नवाचार पर शिक्षकों की पत्रिका के लिए छोटा लेख लिखें
scene: Odisha village children holding a local newspaper page with their own article, a teacher writing in a notebook

name: Ms. Jainus Jacob
citation: Ms. Jainus Jacob has demonstrated what academic acumen and hard work can do to a teacher and to the students through her. Her committed efforts for the last 26 years have been a story of struggle, experimentation and inevitable success. The recognition has come in the form of KVS National innovation and experimentation award, Fulbright Distinguished award for teachers and publication of the coffee table book by Intel. Her videos and projects have attracted the attention of scholars in education.
t_en: Award-winning innovation projects and teacher videos
t_hi: पुरस्कृत नवाचार प्रोजेक्ट और शिक्षक वीडियो
s_hi: 26 वर्षों का संघर्ष, प्रयोग और सफलता; KVS राष्ट्रीय नवाचार पुरस्कार, फुलब्राइट पुरस्कार, इंटेल की कॉफ़ी टेबल बुक; वीडियो व प्रोजेक्ट शोधकर्ताओं में चर्चित।
steps_en: Pick one class problem each year and try an experiment to solve it
Document the experiment with photos/video and results
Share it at a KVS/state innovation forum
steps_hi: हर साल कक्षा की एक समस्या चुनें और उसे हल करने हेतु प्रयोग करें
प्रयोग को फ़ोटो/वीडियो व परिणाम के साथ दर्ज करें
इसे KVS/राज्य नवाचार मंच पर साझा करें
scene: Kerala KV teacher filming students doing a project, an innovation-award certificate on the wall

name: Mr. Kandala Ramaiah
citation: Mr. Kandala Ramaiah is a teacher at Zilla Parishad High School at Abbapur in Telangana State. He used the local conditions to innovate in teaching mathematics. Math Rangoli to teach shapes and Algebraic tiling on the floor and wall painting with math concepts goes well with the local and limiting conditions of a government school with very good outcomes. Use of simple graph paper to teach the basic math concepts testimonies his ‘presence of mind’ in innovating to the local conditions. The ‘connected learning’ adopted by Mr. Kandala during COVID is a praise worthy initiative to ensure learning during the pandemic. This enthusiastic teacher has used social media based crowd funding approach to improve his school infrastructure. He rephrased the government’s slogan ‘mana vuru, mana badi’ as ‘mana vuru, mana badi, mana gudi’ (translates to ‘our village, our school, our temple’) and that demonstrates his sincerity as a teacher. Mr. Kandala’s innovation and application would go a long way in serving the students.
t_en: Math Rangoli, algebra floor tiles and "Mana Vuru Mana Badi Mana Gudi"
t_hi: गणित रंगोली, बीजगणित टाइल्स और "मन ऊरु मन बडी मन गुडी"
s_hi: स्थानीय परिस्थितियों से गणित नवाचार: आकृतियों हेतु गणित रंगोली, फ़र्श पर बीजगणितीय टाइलिंग, गणित दीवार चित्र, ग्राफ़ पेपर से मूल अवधारणाएँ; कोविड में कनेक्टेड लर्निंग; सोशल मीडिया क्राउडफ़ंडिंग।
steps_en: Teach symmetry and shapes through rangoli patterns drawn by students
Paint (a+b)² and other identities as floor tiles students can walk on
Use graph paper for fractions, area and coordinates
steps_hi: बच्चों द्वारा बनाई रंगोली से समरूपता व आकृतियाँ सिखाएँ
(a+b)² जैसी सर्वसमिकाएँ फ़र्श पर टाइल्स की तरह पेंट करें जिन पर बच्चे चल सकें
भिन्न, क्षेत्रफल व निर्देशांक हेतु ग्राफ़ पेपर का प्रयोग करें
scene: Telangana girls drawing a symmetric rangoli in a school courtyard, a floor painted with algebra-tile squares

name: Mr. Kaustubh Chandra Joshi
citation: Mr. Kaustubh Chandra Joshi, exemplifies school leadership skills as a Principal of a higher secondary school. As a result of his ability and a range of diverse learning experiences, he has contributed a lot for the holistic development of the students. He has contributed in creation of virtual lab as well as a website to promote ICT based learning. He has developed innovative digital library and computer club in his school and is extensively using the same for students learning. His efforts have led students to succeed and achieve positions in many prestigious fields. His dedication and leadership skill in school and building a well-rounded perspective for his students make him an exemplary teacher.
t_en: Virtual lab, school website and digital library
t_hi: वर्चुअल लैब, विद्यालय वेबसाइट और डिजिटल पुस्तकालय
s_hi: प्रधानाचार्य के रूप में समग्र विकास; ICT आधारित शिक्षा हेतु वर्चुअल लैब व वेबसाइट; नवाचारी डिजिटल पुस्तकालय व कंप्यूटर क्लब; छात्रों की प्रतिष्ठित क्षेत्रों में सफलता।
steps_en: Use free virtual labs (e.g., OLabs) for experiments missing in your lab
Start a computer club run by students
Put e-books on school computers as a digital library
steps_hi: अपनी लैब में न होने वाले प्रयोगों हेतु मुफ्त वर्चुअल लैब (जैसे OLabs) का प्रयोग करें
छात्रों द्वारा संचालित कंप्यूटर क्लब शुरू करें
विद्यालय कंप्यूटरों पर ई-पुस्तकें रखकर डिजिटल पुस्तकालय बनाएँ
scene: Nainital hill-college students doing a virtual chemistry lab on computers, a digital library screen

name: Ms. Kavita Sanghvi
citation: Believing in holistic and society sensitive growth of children, Ms. Kavita Sanghvi, the Principal of the school, has made efforts in devising the curriculum that gives the students a chance to explore many domains of learning. ‘Bag less day’ initiative that she had implemented helped the students to try and experiment with different fields including arts and culture and this is the closest to the philosophy adopted in the New Education Policy (NEP 2020). The blend of science excellence which allowed the students to participate in ISRO activities and the focused activity on life skills where they are taught soap and shoe making etc. is an example of a balance in curriculum that many schools may like to follow. Ms. Kavita has been a STEM educator, resource person to all major education bodies in the country and as an educator and school administrator her outreach has been phenomenal wherein she trained teachers in countries like Maldives and Nepal. Ms. Kavita sets an example of a perfect school administrator for ‘urban setting’.
t_en: Bagless days with arts, ISRO science and life skills
t_hi: कला, इसरो विज्ञान और जीवन कौशल वाले बैगलेस दिवस
s_hi: समग्र व समाज-संवेदी विकास हेतु पाठ्यक्रम; "बैग लेस डे" में कला व संस्कृति; इसरो गतिविधियों में भागीदारी; साबुन व जूते बनाने जैसे जीवन कौशल; मालदीव-नेपाल के शिक्षकों को प्रशिक्षण।
steps_en: Plan a bagless day each month with rotation stations (art, science, life skill)
Teach one practical life skill per term (soap making, basic repairs)
Link to ISRO/space activities through free online programmes
steps_hi: हर महीने रोटेशन स्टेशनों (कला, विज्ञान, जीवन कौशल) वाला बैगलेस डे रखें
हर टर्म एक व्यावहारिक जीवन कौशल सिखाएँ (साबुन बनाना, बुनियादी मरम्मत)
मुफ्त ऑनलाइन कार्यक्रमों से इसरो/अंतरिक्ष गतिविधियों से जुड़ें
scene: Mumbai school on a bagless day: students making soap at one table, building a rocket model at another, painting at a third

name: Mr. Khursheed Ahmad
citation: Mr. Khursheed Ahmad is a science teacher at Composite School, Sahawa in Uttar Pradesh. Popularizing science by impactful teaching is the heart of Mr. Ahmad’s teaching philosophy. Simple innovations in pedagogy such as using the elements of periodic table as role numbers of students to make it easy for them to remember is simple but proved to be effective. With the limited resources he made science models such as heart, human circulatory system etc. with recycled material and made students do experiments such as chromatography. Enthused by this learning the students got various national scholarships such as INSPIRE and prizes in science competitions. His efforts and ability to handhold the students towards scientific temperament goes a long way with the national ambitions of Atmanirbhar Bharat.
t_en: Periodic-table roll numbers and recycled body models
t_hi: आवर्त सारणी रोल नंबर और रीसायकल शरीर मॉडल
s_hi: सरल नवाचार: छात्रों के रोल नंबर आवर्त सारणी के तत्वों से ताकि याद रहें; सीमित संसाधनों में रीसायकल सामग्री से हृदय, परिसंचरण तंत्र मॉडल; क्रोमैटोग्राफ़ी जैसे प्रयोग; INSPIRE छात्रवृत्तियाँ।
steps_en: Give each student an element as their 'roll number' and call attendance by element names
Build a circulatory-system model with pipes, bottles and red water
Do chalk-and-ink chromatography with every student
steps_hi: हर बच्चे को एक तत्व 'रोल नंबर' के रूप में दें और उपस्थिति तत्वों के नाम से लें
पाइप, बोतलों और लाल पानी से परिसंचरण तंत्र का मॉडल बनाएँ
हर बच्चे से चॉक-स्याही क्रोमैटोग्राफ़ी करवाएँ
scene: UP composite school students each wearing a badge with an element symbol, a recycled heart model on the table

name: Ms. Mala Jigdal Dorjee
citation: Ms. Mala Jigdal Dorjee started with the determination of making the Government school touch the highest standards in education. She did everything possible to get the infrastructure to an acceptable level, by seeking donations, conducting charity shows, reaching out to CSR funds. She got training for her teachers in creative teaching strategies, took the issue of tackling the substance abuse seriously, established Artificial Intelligence laboratory, launched the Entrepreneurship club, celebrated the Annual Day in a grand manner and instituted cash prizes for grade X and XII toppers. All these measures have changed the mindset of parents towards the Government School.
t_en: AI lab, entrepreneurship club and drug-abuse prevention
t_hi: AI लैब, उद्यमिता क्लब और नशा रोकथाम
s_hi: सरकारी विद्यालय को उच्च स्तर पर लाने हेतु दान, चैरिटी शो, CSR; शिक्षकों का रचनात्मक शिक्षण प्रशिक्षण; नशा रोकथाम; AI लैब; उद्यमिता क्लब; टॉपर्स के लिए नकद पुरस्कार; अभिभावकों की सोच बदली।
steps_en: Run an entrepreneurship club where teams plan and sell a small product
Organise a charity show to raise funds for one school need
Run a term-wise awareness programme on substance abuse
steps_hi: उद्यमिता क्लब चलाएँ जिसमें टीमें छोटा उत्पाद बनाकर बेचें
विद्यालय की एक ज़रूरत हेतु धन जुटाने के लिए चैरिटी शो करें
हर टर्म नशा जागरूकता कार्यक्रम चलाएँ
scene: Sikkim students at a school entrepreneurship fair stall, an AI lab in the background

name: Ms. Mamta Ahar
citation: Ms. Mamta Ahar, an assistant teacher of a government primary school has shown keen interest and practice in creating a joyful environment. She has been able to mobilize community support for enhancing enrolment among girls in a rural location. She has taken special care to encourage children in different national integration activities. She believes in including the spirit of lifelong learning with use of innovative teaching learning practices through dedicated reading corners, use of technology, music in education and encouraging participation in sports. She has also implemented home counselling and her deeper involvement and encouragement in the school helped students’ holistic development.
t_en: Reading corners, music and home counselling
t_hi: पठन कोने, संगीत और घरेलू परामर्श
s_hi: आनंदमय वातावरण; ग्रामीण क्षेत्र में बालिकाओं का नामांकन बढ़ाने हेतु समुदाय सहयोग; राष्ट्रीय एकता गतिविधियाँ; समर्पित पठन कोने, तकनीक, संगीत व खेल; घरेलू परामर्श।
steps_en: Set up a reading corner in every classroom with a mat and 20 books
Use songs to teach rhymes, tables and spellings
Visit homes of girls not enrolled and counsel parents
steps_hi: हर कक्षा में चटाई व 20 किताबों वाला पठन कोना बनाएँ
कविताएँ, पहाड़े और वर्तनी गीतों से सिखाएँ
नामांकित न हुई बालिकाओं के घर जाकर अभिभावकों को परामर्श दें
scene: Chhattisgarh rural primary girls reading on a mat in a cosy reading corner, a teacher with a dholak teaching a song

name: Ms. Maria Murena Miranda
citation: With her unflinching efforts, Ms. Maria Murena Miranda as Principal has successfully renovated, upgraded and made her rural tribal school infrastructure child friendly with the help of the community. Due to her efforts, dropout rate has declined in her school. She has worked hard to support tribal students by undertaking home visits, remedial classes, encouraging girls by providing free note books and uniforms. She inspires her students with good values and helps them in building a strong foundation for their lives ahead.
t_en: Tribal school renovation, home visits and remedial classes
t_hi: आदिवासी विद्यालय का नवीनीकरण, गृह भेंट और उपचारात्मक कक्षाएँ
s_hi: समुदाय सहयोग से ग्रामीण आदिवासी विद्यालय को बाल-अनुकूल बनाया; ड्रॉपआउट घटा; गृह भेंट, उपचारात्मक कक्षाएँ; बालिकाओं को मुफ्त कॉपियाँ व यूनिफ़ॉर्म; मूल्य शिक्षा।
steps_en: Run remedial classes after school for students below grade level
Visit homes of tribal students every term
Provide free notebooks to girls through donors
steps_hi: स्तर से पीछे बच्चों के लिए स्कूल के बाद उपचारात्मक कक्षाएँ चलाएँ
हर टर्म आदिवासी बच्चों के घर जाएँ
दानदाताओं के माध्यम से बालिकाओं को मुफ्त कॉपियाँ दें
scene: Goa tribal-area high school with a woman principal handing notebooks to girls, a remedial class in progress

name: Ms. Meenakshi Goswami
citation: As a Principal, Ms. Meenakshi Goswami is able to establish a positive school culture by treating the people the way they would like to be treated. She has helped guiding the curriculum development with the teachers providing insight and leadership to meet both students and teachers needs. She lays emphasis on the usages of language and removes fear for learning the language. She shares warm personal interactions for their academic progress. She has concentrated on social skill development and overall personality development along with acquisition of knowledge of the child.
t_en: Fear-free language learning and positive school culture
t_hi: भय-मुक्त भाषा शिक्षण और सकारात्मक विद्यालय संस्कृति
s_hi: लोगों से वैसा व्यवहार जैसा वे चाहें, इससे सकारात्मक संस्कृति; शिक्षकों के साथ पाठ्यक्रम विकास; भाषा के प्रयोग पर ज़ोर और भाषा सीखने का डर दूर; सामाजिक कौशल व व्यक्तित्व विकास।
steps_en: Allow mistakes in speaking—praise attempts before correcting
Run a daily 5-minute 'speak about anything' round
Hold teacher meetings where staff co-plan the curriculum
steps_hi: बोलने में गलतियों की अनुमति दें—सुधारने से पहले प्रयास की प्रशंसा करें
रोज़ 5 मिनट 'किसी भी विषय पर बोलो' दौर चलाएँ
शिक्षक बैठकें करें जिनमें स्टाफ मिलकर पाठ्यक्रम की योजना बनाए
scene: Assam school where a smiling principal listens to a nervous student speaking in English, classmates encouraging

name: Ms. Mimi Yhoshii
citation: Ms. Mimi Yhoshii is a graduate teacher and also the head teacher, who has motivation built in her. Her incorrigible enthusiasm, rubbed off on the community and that resulted in building extra classrooms, beautifying the campus, school meal programme, develop a kitchen garden and that lead to the inevitable increase in the enrolment. 80% of her students are domestic helpers and hence, she conducts classes for them after school hours to reduce drop-out rate. Particularly fascinating are her innovative teaching learning methods and helping children to learn vocations. Turning bio non -degradable plastic waste into baskets, floor mats, old clothes into potholders, door mats and selling them to generate some income for the school are wonderful ideas of Ms. Mimi.
t_en: Evening classes for child domestic helpers and waste-to-craft income
t_hi: बाल घरेलू सहायकों के लिए शाम की कक्षाएँ और कबाड़ से शिल्प आय
s_hi: समुदाय सहयोग से अतिरिक्त कक्षाएँ, परिसर सौंदर्यीकरण, भोजन कार्यक्रम, किचन गार्डन; 80% छात्र घरेलू सहायक, इसलिए स्कूल के बाद कक्षाएँ; व्यावसायिक कौशल; प्लास्टिक से टोकरियाँ-चटाइयाँ बनाकर विद्यालय की आय।
steps_en: Offer flexible after-hours classes for working children
Teach a craft from waste (plastic baskets, cloth mats) and sell at a school fair
Use the income for school needs chosen by students
steps_hi: काम करने वाले बच्चों के लिए समय से बाहर लचीली कक्षाएँ दें
कबाड़ से शिल्प (प्लास्टिक टोकरियाँ, कपड़े की चटाइयाँ) सिखाएँ और विद्यालय मेले में बेचें
आय का उपयोग बच्चों द्वारा चुनी विद्यालय ज़रूरतों में करें
scene: Kohima school evening class with children weaving baskets from plastic waste, a kitchen garden nearby

name: Mr. Mohd. Jabir
citation: Mr. Mohd Jabir is a senior educator in English and Environmental Studies at Government Middle School Karith, Ladakh. Mr. Jabir finds innovative ways to teach which are based on the principle of ‘no punishment to students’. Acting smartly as per children’s psychology, he used the technique of ‘clapping while learning’ for teaching English Phonetics, Grammar, Vocabulary and many others. Taking ‘joyful learning’ as his philosophy he tried innovative ways of teaching such as Prose Singing Strategy, Learning with Body Language, Teaching via Slogan Technique, Language Games, Teaching in Open Air, Story Role Playing etc. He has been training teachers of the other schools on these innovations and also published the same in research journals. His efforts during COVID pandemic by innovating with the concepts of WhatsApp Classroom, Offline Notes and Online Assessments etc. to avoid ‘student disconnect’ are the testimony of his sincerity as a teacher.
t_en: Clap-while-learning phonetics and prose singing
t_hi: ताली बजाते हुए ध्वनि शिक्षण और गद्य गायन
s_hi: "बच्चों को कोई सज़ा नहीं" सिद्धांत; अंग्रेज़ी ध्वनि, व्याकरण व शब्दावली के लिए "क्लैपिंग व्हाइल लर्निंग"; प्रोज़ सिंगिंग, बॉडी लैंग्वेज, स्लोगन तकनीक, भाषा खेल, खुले में कक्षा, कहानी रोल प्ले; कोविड में व्हाट्सऐप कक्षा।
steps_en: Clap syllables and sounds while reading new English words
Turn a prose passage into a simple chant or song
Make a 'no punishment' class charter with children
steps_hi: नए अंग्रेज़ी शब्द पढ़ते समय अक्षरों और ध्वनियों पर ताली बजाएँ
किसी गद्यांश को सरल लय या गीत में बदलें
बच्चों के साथ 'कोई सज़ा नहीं' कक्षा चार्टर बनाएँ
scene: Ladakh mountain school children clapping in rhythm while reading English words outdoors, snowy peaks behind

name: Mr. Neeraj Saxena
citation: Mr. Neeraj Saxena is an iconic teacher, social reformer, determined soldier, all rolled in one. His school is situated in the forest area and he is the only teacher in the school. He contacted everyone willing to listen, to uplift the facilities for the school. From getting the road to the school, borewell and garden, Mr. Neeraj has motivated and mobilised the women in the villages around, to be perfect volunteers for schoolwork. The whole village is charged up with his motivation. He has convinced the parents to send girls to school and there are 54 of them already.
t_en: Single-teacher forest school mobilising village women
t_hi: ग्रामीण महिलाओं को जोड़ने वाला एकल-शिक्षक वन विद्यालय
s_hi: वन क्षेत्र में एकमात्र शिक्षक; सड़क, बोरवेल व बगीचे के लिए सबसे संपर्क; आसपास की महिलाओं को विद्यालय कार्य हेतु स्वयंसेवक बनाया; अभिभावकों को मनाकर 54 बालिकाओं को विद्यालय लाया।
steps_en: Form a women volunteers' group who help with reading, meals or cleanliness
Write to block officials/panchayat for one infrastructure need at a time
Keep a girls' enrolment drive every June
steps_hi: महिला स्वयंसेवकों का समूह बनाएँ जो पठन, भोजन या स्वच्छता में मदद करें
ब्लॉक अधिकारियों/पंचायत को एक बार में एक अवसंरचना ज़रूरत के लिए लिखें
हर जून बालिका नामांकन अभियान चलाएँ
scene: Forest-village primary school in MP with village women helping children read under a tree, a single male teacher

name: Ms. Nishi Kumari
citation: Ms. Nishi Kumari as a teacher of the Mahadev Higher Secondary School has shown herself to be an extremely holistic and versatile teacher. A state level active career counsellor, she has been involved in programs such as awareness about child rights, child marriage, dowry, menstrual hygiene, creating pollution free environment, waste management etc. in collaboration with other organizations. She has motivated students to think rationally, implemented learner centered pedagogy in classrooms, and created a culture of creativity and innovation. She has also contributed in preparing e-content, models, and learning resources for which she was selected from the state for National Teacher Resource Repository (NTRR). She has been engaged consistently with the community to increase enrolment and to reduce dropout rate particularly for girls.
t_en: Career counselling and child-rights awareness
t_hi: करियर परामर्श और बाल अधिकार जागरूकता
s_hi: राज्य स्तरीय करियर परामर्शदाता; बाल अधिकार, बाल विवाह, दहेज, मासिक धर्म स्वच्छता, प्रदूषण, कचरा प्रबंधन पर कार्यक्रम; छात्र-केंद्रित पद्धति; ई-कंटेंट व मॉडल (NTRR); बालिकाओं का नामांकन बढ़ाना।
steps_en: Run a career-guidance week with stream and job information for Class 9–10
Hold a child-rights quiz and poster-making activity
Upload your best teaching resources to DIKSHA/NTRR
steps_hi: कक्षा 9–10 के लिए स्ट्रीम व रोज़गार जानकारी के साथ करियर मार्गदर्शन सप्ताह चलाएँ
बाल अधिकार क्विज़ और पोस्टर गतिविधि करें
अपने श्रेष्ठ शिक्षण संसाधन दीक्षा/NTRR पर अपलोड करें
scene: Patna classroom with a woman teacher showing a career pathway chart to girls, child-rights posters on the wall

name: Mr. Pradeep Negi
citation: Mr. Pradeep Negi is a Lecturer and passionate about providing equal educational opportunities to the underprivileged children. He has made enormous effort for mobilization of society through different awareness programmes, educational visits of students and organized environmental programmes. He has promoted innovative experiments for joyful learning like use of ICT, Blogs and Websites, YouTube channels, TLM, Project based learning, activity orientation and role play method. His creative thinking inspires many and creates a climate for innovation in his school.
t_en: Blogs, YouTube and role play for underprivileged learners
t_hi: वंचित बच्चों के लिए ब्लॉग, यूट्यूब और रोल प्ले
s_hi: वंचित बच्चों के लिए समान अवसर; जागरूकता कार्यक्रम, शैक्षिक भ्रमण, पर्यावरण कार्यक्रम; ICT, ब्लॉग, वेबसाइट, यूट्यूब, TLM, प्रोजेक्ट आधारित शिक्षा, रोल प्ले।
steps_en: Start a free class blog where students post project work
Plan one educational visit per term
Use role play for one lesson a month
steps_hi: मुफ्त कक्षा ब्लॉग शुरू करें जहाँ बच्चे प्रोजेक्ट कार्य डालें
हर टर्म एक शैक्षिक भ्रमण करें
महीने में एक पाठ रोल प्ले से करें
scene: Haridwar students on an educational visit by the Ganga, a student typing a blog post on a laptop

name: Mr. Nongmaithem Gautam Singh
citation: Mr. Nongmaithem Gautam Singh, a primary teacher at the Eastern Ideal High School in Manipur has been striving to provide better instruction to his students within the limited pool of resources. His attempt to protect students from the falling chalk powder by converting the blackboards to white boards using the local material is praise worthy. Mr. Singh has put the local resources such as bamboo to their best use with his innovative thinking in making protractors, bulletin boards out of bamboo. He donated and also trained other school teachers in doing so. All his innovations did not limit to curriculum and instruction but extended to augment the school infrastructure. Ideas such as ‘volunteer painting’, ‘crowd funding’ and ‘renovation with old clothes’ were not only put to use in his school but also propagated to the other schools. Use of waste material in making teaching aids and his zeal to provide students with a better instruction not only is praise worthy but also inspiring to others.
t_en: Bamboo protractors and DIY whiteboards from local material
t_hi: बाँस के चाँदे और स्थानीय सामग्री से बने व्हाइटबोर्ड
s_hi: चॉक के धूल से बचाने हेतु स्थानीय सामग्री से ब्लैकबोर्ड को व्हाइटबोर्ड बनाया; बाँस से चाँदे व बुलेटिन बोर्ड; अन्य शिक्षकों को प्रशिक्षण; "वॉलंटियर पेंटिंग", क्राउडफ़ंडिंग व पुराने कपड़ों से नवीनीकरण।
steps_en: Make geometry tools (protractor, ruler, compass) from bamboo or cardboard
Organise a volunteer painting day with parents and alumni
Reuse old cloth for curtains, mats and display boards
steps_hi: बाँस या गत्ते से ज्यामिति उपकरण (चाँदा, पैमाना, परकार) बनाएँ
अभिभावकों व पूर्व छात्रों के साथ स्वयंसेवी पेंटिंग दिवस रखें
पर्दे, चटाई व प्रदर्शन बोर्ड हेतु पुराने कपड़े का उपयोग करें
scene: Manipur classroom with a teacher showing a bamboo protractor, a bamboo bulletin board, volunteers painting walls

name: Mr. Om Prakash Patidar
citation: Mr. Om Prakash Patidar has shown himself to be a dedicated and motivated teacher of senior secondary school who has worked very hard for the improvement and performance of his school. He has implemented many innovative practices for making the learning joyful through development of e-content and ICT tools for encouraging creativity in science teaching and learning. He has worked on online laboratory students for laboratory experiences. He has untiringly built a strong rapport with the community and has thus helped the school to attain high enrolment. His creative thinking inspires many and creates a climate of innovation in his school.
t_en: Online laboratory and science e-content
t_hi: ऑनलाइन प्रयोगशाला और विज्ञान ई-कंटेंट
s_hi: ई-कंटेंट व ICT टूल से विज्ञान में रचनात्मकता व आनंदमय शिक्षा; छात्रों के लिए ऑनलाइन प्रयोगशाला अनुभव; समुदाय से मज़बूत संबंध से उच्च नामांकन।
steps_en: Use a free online lab simulation before the real experiment
Make short e-content for each practical
Invite parents to a science open day
steps_hi: वास्तविक प्रयोग से पहले मुफ्त ऑनलाइन लैब सिमुलेशन का प्रयोग करें
हर प्रयोग का छोटा ई-कंटेंट बनाएँ
अभिभावकों को विज्ञान खुले दिवस पर बुलाएँ
scene: Shajapur students running an online physics simulation on a projector, then doing the real experiment

name: Ms. Rajni Sharma
citation: Ms Rajni Sharma is a dedicated teacher in a primary school who has done innovative work to reach out to students to support their education during the pandemic time as well as the normal time. She has developed interesting online materials for use in virtual classes, of which most are self-developed materials including balgeet. She has been playing the role of a mentor too for teachers. She has also contributed her efforts for environmental awareness. Her innovative way for integrated learning across subjects has been widely disseminated and appreciated.
t_en: Self-made balgeet and integrated learning across subjects
t_hi: स्वनिर्मित बालगीत और विषयों में समेकित शिक्षा
s_hi: महामारी व सामान्य समय में बच्चों तक पहुँच; वर्चुअल कक्षाओं के लिए स्वनिर्मित सामग्री व बालगीत; शिक्षकों की मेंटर; पर्यावरण जागरूकता; विषयों को जोड़कर समेकित शिक्षा।
steps_en: Write simple songs (balgeet) for key concepts in maths, EVS and language
Plan one theme (water, festivals) across all subjects for a week
Share recordings with parents
steps_hi: गणित, पर्यावरण व भाषा की मुख्य अवधारणाओं पर सरल गीत (बालगीत) लिखें
एक हफ्ते सभी विषयों में एक ही विषय-वस्तु (पानी, त्योहार) की योजना बनाएँ
रिकॉर्डिंग अभिभावकों से साझा करें
scene: Delhi primary children singing an action song about water with a teacher, a theme web chart on the wall

name: Mr. Ramachandran K
citation: Mr. Ramachandran K. is primary teacher who is committed to make a difference to the lives of not only his students but also to the community he serves. It is gratifying to see the entire community involved in building and developing a government school and Mr. Ramachandran is the focal point. Beginning from clearing the land from the noxious Karuvelam trees to planting flower and fruit plants, installing drip irrigation, painting the building, getting books and stationery all with public support has been a great saga of tenacity and perseverance. Motivating all the teachers for creative teaching with worksheets and activities, introducing Thirukkural for all the students and conducting competitions is a new dimension of spirituality in education.
t_en: Community-built school garden with drip irrigation and Thirukkural
t_hi: ड्रिप सिंचाई और तिरुक्कुरल के साथ समुदाय निर्मित विद्यालय उद्यान
s_hi: पूरे समुदाय को विद्यालय निर्माण में जोड़ा; ज़हरीले करुवेलम पेड़ हटाकर फूल-फल पौधे, ड्रिप सिंचाई, भवन पेंटिंग, पुस्तकें—सब जन सहयोग से; वर्कशीट व गतिविधियाँ; सभी छात्रों को तिरुक्कुरल।
steps_en: Hold a community shramdaan day to clear and plant the school land
Install simple drip irrigation with bottles and pipes
Teach one value couplet (Thirukkural/doha) a week with meaning
steps_hi: विद्यालय भूमि की सफ़ाई और रोपण हेतु सामुदायिक श्रमदान दिवस रखें
बोतलों और पाइपों से सरल ड्रिप सिंचाई लगाएँ
हर हफ्ते अर्थ सहित एक मूल्य दोहा (तिरुक्कुरल/दोहा) सिखाएँ
scene: Tamil Nadu villagers and children planting fruit trees with drip pipes around a freshly painted primary school

name: Dr. Ravi Aruna
citation: Dr. Ravi Aruna is a Physical Science teacher at ASNRA Zilla Prishad High School in Kanuru of Andhra Pradesh. Her attempt to make science learning more effective by employing the ‘Immerse learning’ technique proved to imbibe science temperament in students who went on to win many prizes in science exhibitions. She employed low cost TLM such as clay moldings to explain science concepts and resorted to drama and play to make science learning joyful. Raising funds with the community involvement she has also helped in improving the school infrastructure. Putting to use her PhD research experience, Dr. Aruna has developed an innovative teaching model named ‘Group Clinical Supervision Model’ for the evaluation of the professional development of the in-service teachers. She has participated actively in outreach and as resource person at a number of prestigious programmes such as NISHTHA and published handbooks on physical science teachers for SCERT.
t_en: Immersive science with clay models and drama
t_hi: मिट्टी मॉडल और नाटक से तल्लीन विज्ञान
s_hi: "इमर्सिव लर्निंग" से वैज्ञानिक सोच; मिट्टी के मॉडल जैसे कम लागत TLM; नाटक व खेल से आनंदमय विज्ञान; समुदाय से अवसंरचना; सेवारत शिक्षकों के लिए "ग्रुप क्लिनिकल सुपरविज़न मॉडल"; NISHTHA रिसोर्स पर्सन।
steps_en: Shape atoms, molecules or the solar system in clay with students
Let students act out a science process (electric circuit, digestion) as a drama
Observe a colleague's class and give feedback in a small teacher group
steps_hi: बच्चों के साथ मिट्टी से परमाणु, अणु या सौरमंडल बनाएँ
बच्चे किसी विज्ञान प्रक्रिया (विद्युत परिपथ, पाचन) को नाटक में प्रस्तुत करें
छोटे शिक्षक समूह में सहकर्मी की कक्षा देखकर फ़ीडबैक दें
scene: Andhra girls moulding clay molecule models, a group acting out an electric circuit holding hands

name: Mr. Santosh Nath
citation: Mr. Santosh Nath is a man on a mission to popularise science and fight superstitions. His work is exemplary in the sense that his ICT classroom was converted into the COVID war room and entire South Tripura was monitored through it. His working models and exhibits have made his school a place of visit. Experiments to calculate the rate of photosynthesis in different coloured lights, demonstration of Newton’s laws, mobile globe, structure of DNA, models to interpret geometrical shapes, colours of light have attracted the children and public and the reason for increased admissions to the school. His dramas, role plays are the tools to warn people against superstitions. With public support, he has built clean hygienic toilets with incinerators. His effective teaching methods coupled with social interactions have made him a Man Friday for the community.
t_en: Science exhibits and drama against superstition
t_hi: अंधविश्वास के विरुद्ध विज्ञान प्रदर्शन और नाटक
s_hi: विज्ञान लोकप्रिय बनाना और अंधविश्वास से लड़ना; कोविड में ICT कक्ष को वॉर रूम बनाया; प्रकाश रंगों में प्रकाश संश्लेषण दर, न्यूटन के नियम, DNA जैसे मॉडल; नाटक-रोल प्ले से अंधविश्वास पर चेतावनी; शौचालय व इंसीनरेटर।
steps_en: Explain the science behind a local 'miracle' trick in a public demo
Build working exhibits and open the school as a science centre once a month
Let students write and perform a skit against a superstition
steps_hi: किसी स्थानीय 'चमत्कार' के पीछे का विज्ञान सार्वजनिक प्रदर्शन में समझाएँ
कार्यशील मॉडल बनाएँ और महीने में एक बार विद्यालय को विज्ञान केंद्र के रूप में खोलें
बच्चे किसी अंधविश्वास के विरुद्ध लघु नाटक लिखें और करें
scene: Tripura villagers watching students demonstrate a 'miracle' trick explained by science, working models on tables

name: Mr. Saurabh Suman
school: Lalit Narayan Laxmi Narayan Project Girls High School
citation: Mr. Saurabh Suman, teacher of Lalit Narayan Laxmi Narayan Project Girls High School has put immense effort to improve the pedagogic and academic aspects of his School. He has developed e-content for Science and Mathematics and these are very useful for students and teachers. For introducing modern techniques in his school, he has done many innovations such as smart card for social distancing, smart blind stick, RADAR, automatic security road system, SMS alert flood control system, voice controlled electronic appliance and smart dustbin. He has also given importance to coding and robotics to enable students for creating different models as a support to their other activities. For bringing social awareness he has done so many things through his paintings and creativity. Programmes such as stop the alcohol, voters’ awareness, stop dowry, use of dustbin, yoga, planting sapling have helped to bring awareness among students and community.
t_en: Student inventions: smart blind stick, flood SMS alert, smart dustbin
t_hi: छात्र आविष्कार: स्मार्ट छड़ी, बाढ़ SMS अलर्ट, स्मार्ट डस्टबिन
s_hi: विज्ञान व गणित ई-कंटेंट; सोशल डिस्टेंसिंग स्मार्ट कार्ड, स्मार्ट ब्लाइंड स्टिक, रडार, SMS बाढ़ अलर्ट, आवाज़ नियंत्रित उपकरण, स्मार्ट डस्टबिन जैसे नवाचार; कोडिंग व रोबोटिक्स; चित्रकला से सामाजिक जागरूकता।
steps_en: List local problems (floods, blindness aids, waste) and let teams pick one to solve
Teach basic Arduino/sensor projects step by step
Use posters and paintings for social awareness campaigns
steps_hi: स्थानीय समस्याओं (बाढ़, दृष्टिहीन सहायता, कचरा) की सूची बनाएँ और टीमें एक चुनकर हल करें
बुनियादी आर्डुइनो/सेंसर प्रोजेक्ट चरणबद्ध सिखाएँ
सामाजिक जागरूकता अभियानों हेतु पोस्टर व चित्र बनाएँ
scene: Bihar girls' school students testing a smart blind stick with a sensor and a flood-alert model with a phone

name: Ms. Seema Rani
citation: As a Principal, Ms. Seema Rani has been involved in providing holistic education for making global citizens out of her students. She is a dynamic administrator known for her community and social outreach programs. She has taken lead for both character building and nation building via establishing honesty shop, Bachpan ki Galiband and many more such innovations in her school. She has promoted awareness about reducing the use of polythene bags, conversion of dry leaves into organic compost, dual mode of teaching, liquid soap and hand sanitizer preparation in her school. She has empowered teacher educators for inclusive education too. Her motto is not only to impart knowledge to the students but also to inculcate in them wisdom, compassion and humanitarian spirit.
t_en: Honesty shop, "Bachpan ki Gali" and compost from leaves
t_hi: ईमानदारी दुकान, "बचपन की गली" और पत्तियों से कम्पोस्ट
s_hi: वैश्विक नागरिक बनाने हेतु समग्र शिक्षा; चरित्र व राष्ट्र निर्माण हेतु ईमानदारी दुकान, "बचपन की गली"; पॉलीथिन कम करना, सूखी पत्तियों से जैविक खाद, लिक्विड सोप व सैनिटाइज़र बनाना; समावेशी शिक्षा।
steps_en: Open an unmanned 'honesty shop' for stationery with a cash box
Convert dry leaves into compost in a pit managed by students
Make liquid soap in a chemistry/life-skills class
steps_hi: स्टेशनरी की बिना-दुकानदार 'ईमानदारी दुकान' नकदी डिब्बे के साथ खोलें
छात्रों द्वारा प्रबंधित गड्ढे में सूखी पत्तियों से कम्पोस्ट बनाएँ
रसायन/जीवन कौशल कक्षा में लिक्विड सोप बनाएँ
scene: Chandigarh school corridor with an unmanned honesty shop and cash box, students making compost from leaves

name: Mr. Shashikant Sambhajirao Kulthe
citation: Mr. Shashikant Sambhajirao Kulthe has been a pioneer in educating children of migrants. His school is located in a remote area, mostly inhabited by Banjaras whose main vocation is to cut sugar cane crop. They would go away to different places for work along with their children, who would miss schooling. Mr. Kulthe has ensured that the children stay in the village and get educated. He has an interesting academic profile with degrees in English, Hindi, Urdu and Music, which he uses to the maximum to help his students to learn. The community support he has received in building infrastructure, stay facilities for children is creditable. Employing audio visual aids, conducting various activities and competitions and writing articles and books make Mr. Kulthe a model teacher.
t_en: Keeping migrant sugarcane workers' children in school
t_hi: गन्ना कटाई प्रवासी मज़दूरों के बच्चों को विद्यालय में रखना
s_hi: दूरस्थ बंजारा बस्ती में गन्ना कटाई हेतु प्रवास करने वाले परिवारों के बच्चों को गाँव में रोककर पढ़ाया; समुदाय से अवसंरचना व रहने की सुविधा; अंग्रेज़ी, हिंदी, उर्दू व संगीत का उपयोग; दृश्य-श्रव्य साधन।
steps_en: Make a list of families who migrate seasonally and meet them before they leave
Arrange stay with relatives or a community hostel for children
Use music and multiple languages to teach mixed-language groups
steps_hi: मौसमी प्रवास करने वाले परिवारों की सूची बनाएँ और जाने से पहले उनसे मिलें
बच्चों के लिए रिश्तेदारों या सामुदायिक छात्रावास में रहने की व्यवस्था करें
मिश्रित भाषा समूहों को संगीत व कई भाषाओं से पढ़ाएँ
scene: Maharashtra Banjara hamlet school with children singing with a harmonium while families' bullock carts leave for sugarcane fields in the background

name: Ms. Shipra
school: Tata Workers Union High School Kadma
citation: Ms. Shipra is an extremely creative teacher of science in a high school. She has introduced many innovative practices in teaching of science that have helped students to learn better. She has guided the metamorphosis of school from a deprived school to better accomplished school. She works with 360 degree approach for holistic development of students in her school. She is committed to inspire students to learn through participation, collaboration and experimentation utilizing new techniques and natural resources for improving our society and environment as well as to build cost effective solutions.
t_en: 360-degree science with natural resources and low-cost solutions
t_hi: प्राकृतिक संसाधनों और कम लागत समाधानों से 360-डिग्री विज्ञान
s_hi: रचनात्मक विज्ञान शिक्षक; विद्यालय को वंचित से बेहतर बनाया; 360 डिग्री दृष्टिकोण; भागीदारी, सहयोग व प्रयोग से सीखना; प्राकृतिक संसाधनों से समाज व पर्यावरण हेतु किफ़ायती समाधान।
steps_en: Give a 'cost-effective solution' challenge each term (water filter, cooler)
Use leaves, soil and seeds from the campus for experiments
Let groups present their solution to the community
steps_hi: हर टर्म 'किफ़ायती समाधान' चुनौती दें (पानी फ़िल्टर, कूलर)
प्रयोगों हेतु परिसर की पत्तियाँ, मिट्टी व बीज लें
समूह अपना समाधान समुदाय के सामने प्रस्तुत करें
scene: Jamshedpur girls building a low-cost sand-and-charcoal water filter in a school yard

name: Mr. Sidharth Yonzone
citation: Mr. Sidharth Yonzone is an example of a creative teacher, who can materialise something very useful from almost nothing. When he became the founder Principal of the Ekalavya Model Residential School at Gangyap, Sikkim, there was no infrastructure. From building the infrastructure, bringing children out of their natural shyness to building confidence and Values in them using the unique way of basketball and music have been success stories recognised internationally. His journey on the road less travelled is actually a guiding light for a creative teacher.
t_en: Basketball and music to build confidence in an EMRS
t_hi: EMRS में आत्मविश्वास बढ़ाने हेतु बास्केटबॉल और संगीत
s_hi: संस्थापक प्रधानाचार्य के रूप में शून्य से अवसंरचना; बास्केटबॉल और संगीत के अनूठे तरीके से बच्चों की झिझक तोड़कर आत्मविश्वास व मूल्य; अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर मान्यता।
steps_en: Start a daily team-sport slot (e.g., basketball) with rotating captains
Form a school band or choir open to every student
Use performances to build stage confidence in shy students
steps_hi: रोज़ टीम खेल का समय (जैसे बास्केटबॉल) बदलते कप्तानों के साथ रखें
हर बच्चे के लिए खुला विद्यालय बैंड या गायक दल बनाएँ
झिझकने वाले बच्चों का मंच आत्मविश्वास बढ़ाने हेतु प्रस्तुतियाँ करें
scene: Sikkim EMRS students playing basketball on a mountain court, a school band with guitars beside

name: Mr. Somnath Waman Walke
citation: Mr. Somnath Waman Walke is an amazing talent dedicated to build a school of excellence, where novelty is a rule. Convincing the migratory parents to stay back for their children’s education, arranging School meals, getting community support to make the school tech savvy with tablets for children, creating an audio visual studio, making children sing the poems in the text book and converting the lessons in to recorded role plays, planning on line classes when the only road that connects the village to the school gets inundated during rainy days, painting the school building with his own resources have made this school a Happy school. Creative activities like Saturday – my war, backpack free day, let’s enjoy, my mirror have been attractions and have resulted in better enrolment. Introducing Robotics is an addition to long list of achievements.
t_en: Happy school: tablets, AV studio and recorded role-play lessons
t_hi: हैप्पी स्कूल: टैबलेट, AV स्टूडियो और रिकॉर्डेड रोल-प्ले पाठ
s_hi: प्रवासी अभिभावकों को बच्चों के लिए रुकने को मनाया; भोजन व्यवस्था; टैबलेट व दृश्य-श्रव्य स्टूडियो; पाठ्यपुस्तक कविताओं का गायन और पाठों के रिकॉर्डेड रोल प्ले; बरसात में ऑनलाइन कक्षाएँ; "शनिवार-मेरा वार", बैकपैक फ़्री डे; रोबोटिक्स।
steps_en: Convert textbook lessons into role plays and record them on a phone
Sing textbook poems in a tune children choose
Plan an online backup class for days when the road is cut off
steps_hi: पाठ्यपुस्तक के पाठों को रोल प्ले में बदलकर फ़ोन पर रिकॉर्ड करें
पाठ्यपुस्तक की कविताएँ बच्चों की चुनी धुन में गाएँ
जिन दिनों सड़क कट जाए उनके लिए ऑनलाइन बैकअप कक्षा की योजना बनाएँ
scene: Maharashtra ZP school children acting a lesson in front of a phone camera in a small AV studio, tablets on a table

name: Ms. Sunita
citation: Ms. Sunita is a science teacher of special education for the deaf students and works passionately to inculcate scientific and innovative spirit amongst her deaf students. She has demonstrated that she is a creative and innovative teacher who has kept her students engaged in learning activities in challenging circumstances. She has set up a science lab for children with special needs. She has extended support to her students through the creation of online teacher module, innovative e-videos, and workbooks for class. Her skills have contributed to a larger audience as she was a resource person for the training of teachers.
t_en: Science lab and e-content for deaf students
t_hi: श्रवण बाधित छात्रों के लिए विज्ञान प्रयोगशाला और ई-कंटेंट
s_hi: श्रवण बाधित छात्रों की विशेष शिक्षा विज्ञान शिक्षिका; CWSN हेतु विज्ञान लैब; ऑनलाइन शिक्षक मॉड्यूल, नवाचारी ई-वीडियो, वर्कबुक; शिक्षक प्रशिक्षण रिसोर्स पर्सन।
steps_en: Use visual demos, sign-supported vocabulary cards and captions in every science lesson
Let deaf students record experiment steps as photo sequences
Train colleagues in basic sign for science terms
steps_hi: हर विज्ञान पाठ में दृश्य प्रदर्शन, संकेत-सहित शब्द कार्ड और कैप्शन का प्रयोग करें
श्रवण बाधित बच्चे प्रयोग के चरण फ़ोटो क्रम में दर्ज करें
सहकर्मियों को विज्ञान शब्दों के बुनियादी संकेत सिखाएँ
scene: Bikaner classroom with deaf students signing during a science experiment, picture-word cards on the board

name: Ms. Sunitha Rao
citation: Ms. Sunita Rao is the Principal at Delhi Public School (DPS) in Nacharam of Telangana State. Over her long and illustrious career as an educator she has served different schools in various capacities. At DPS she was instrumental in establishing ‘Toy Lab’ as part of joyful and art based learning for the young learners. Her efforts in getting the e-content developed for the pre-school children are a great value addition. Ms. Sunita has focused more on developing lab such as Artificial Intelligence lab which provided the dynamic urban students a chance to express themselves. As a social responsibility Ms. Sunita’s initiative to share her resources with the local government schools is noteworthy and sets an example for others. ‘Each one – Teach one’ initiative that aims to help the staff within her school is an excellent ‘extension’ service that is worth for every school to attempt.
t_en: Toy Lab for young learners and sharing with government schools
t_hi: छोटे बच्चों के लिए टॉय लैब और सरकारी विद्यालयों से साझेदारी
s_hi: आनंदमय व कला आधारित शिक्षा हेतु "टॉय लैब"; पूर्व-प्राथमिक ई-कंटेंट; AI लैब; स्थानीय सरकारी विद्यालयों से संसाधन साझा करना; स्टाफ के लिए "ईच वन टीच वन"।
steps_en: Set up a toy lab with blocks, puzzles and local toys organised by concept
Share your school's labs or resources with a nearby government school weekly
Have each staff member teach one skill to another
steps_hi: अवधारणा के अनुसार व्यवस्थित ब्लॉक, पहेलियाँ और स्थानीय खिलौनों वाली टॉय लैब बनाएँ
हर हफ्ते अपनी प्रयोगशाला/संसाधन पास के सरकारी विद्यालय से साझा करें
हर स्टाफ सदस्य दूसरे को एक कौशल सिखाए
scene: Hyderabad pre-primary children playing in a toy lab with blocks and puzzles, visiting government-school children joining

name: Mr. T N Sridhar
citation: Mr. T N Sridhar from ZillaParishad School in Telangana State is an educator who believed strongly in experiential and thought provocative learning both for students and teachers. Some of the innovative programmes that he adopted such as Vidhyabarthi, kutuhal, vacation value and establishment of ‘Kalam Dream Force’ by donating his salary demonstrate his vision and drive for such approach to learning. Use of low cost material to develop concept labs with a large number of demonstrative material and self-learning kits showcases his attempt to beat the ‘funds limitation’ in achieving his objective in teaching. Joyful learning with ‘self-collected material’ by students is the closest to the new ways of teaching under the new NEP. Mr. Sridhar’s efforts have resulted in his students winning scholarships such as NCSC, INSPIRE, India International Science Festivals and recognition in international programmes such as SAKURA Japan science exchange program. His statement that village students are high on ‘innovation’ quotient compared to ‘criticality’ quotient portrays his deep understanding of the students with rural backdrop.
t_en: Low-cost concept labs and self-learning kits
t_hi: कम लागत अवधारणा प्रयोगशालाएँ और स्व-अधिगम किट
s_hi: अनुभवात्मक व विचारोत्तेजक शिक्षा; विद्याबार्थी, कुतूहल, वेकेशन वैल्यू; वेतन दान कर "कलाम ड्रीम फ़ोर्स"; कम लागत अवधारणा लैब व स्व-अधिगम किट; बच्चों द्वारा स्वयं इकट्ठी सामग्री; NCSC, INSPIRE, सकुरा जापान कार्यक्रम।
steps_en: Ask students to collect materials from home for each experiment
Make self-learning kits (box + instruction card) for 10 concepts
Form a science club named after a role model with monthly challenges
steps_hi: हर प्रयोग हेतु बच्चों से घर से सामग्री लाने को कहें
10 अवधारणाओं के स्व-अधिगम किट (डिब्बा + निर्देश कार्ड) बनाएँ
किसी प्रेरक व्यक्ति के नाम पर विज्ञान क्लब बनाएँ जिसमें मासिक चुनौतियाँ हों
scene: Telangana village students opening labelled self-learning science kit boxes, a 'Kalam Dream Force' banner

name: Mr. Umesh Bharatbhai Vala
citation: Mr. Umesh Bharatbhai Vala is a remarkable teacher and is a combination of many things that makes an ideal teacher – punctuality, hard work, care and a huge commitment for social work. He is a panelist for SCERT and NCERT in the Social Science and Gujarati subjects. In Gujarati, that he teaches, the results in the Board examinations, for the last three years are cent percent. He conducts regular camps for rural children. His outstanding social commitment is seen in the way he helps slum & street children get education at their own place. To top it all, he has not taken a single day leave for the last seven years.
t_en: Street-side classes for slum children and perfect attendance
t_hi: झुग्गी बच्चों के लिए गली कक्षाएँ और पूर्ण उपस्थिति
s_hi: समयनिष्ठा, परिश्रम, देखभाल व सामाजिक कार्य; SCERT-NCERT पैनलिस्ट; तीन साल से गुजराती में 100% बोर्ड परिणाम; ग्रामीण बच्चों हेतु शिविर; झुग्गी व सड़क के बच्चों को उनकी जगह पर शिक्षा; सात साल से एक भी छुट्टी नहीं।
steps_en: Hold a weekly 'pavement class' near a slum with slates and story books
Run a holiday camp for rural children
Track your own punctuality and share the habit with students
steps_hi: झुग्गी के पास साप्ताहिक 'फुटपाथ कक्षा' स्लेट व कहानी पुस्तकों के साथ लगाएँ
ग्रामीण बच्चों के लिए अवकाश शिविर चलाएँ
अपनी समयनिष्ठा रिकॉर्ड करें और यह आदत बच्चों से साझा करें
scene: Gujarat street with a teacher teaching slum children on slates on a pavement, a city backdrop

name: Mr Umesh T P
citation: Mr. Umesh T P has innovatively deployed effective teaching strategies to improve his school which is in the interior village, deprived of basic facilities. Keeping aside all the challenges while performing the duty, he has contributed to reduce high dropout rates. He has taken proactive measures not only to create an attractive school but also to introduce many pedagogical practices to maximize learning levels of his students. He has successfully mobilized the community for improving student-enrolment, school infrastructure and setting up of smart classrooms. He has contributed to the development of e-content and use of ICT for improving teaching learning of students.
t_en: Interior-village school with smart classrooms via community
t_hi: समुदाय सहयोग से स्मार्ट कक्षा वाला अंदरूनी गाँव विद्यालय
s_hi: बुनियादी सुविधाओं से वंचित दूरस्थ गाँव में प्रभावी शिक्षण; उच्च ड्रॉपआउट घटाया; आकर्षक विद्यालय; समुदाय से नामांकन, अवसंरचना व स्मार्ट कक्षा; ई-कंटेंट व ICT।
steps_en: Present a 'smart classroom' plan with cost to the gram sabha
Make the school attractive with child art on walls
Keep a dropout watch list and visit families
steps_hi: ग्राम सभा के सामने लागत सहित 'स्मार्ट क्लासरूम' योजना रखें
दीवारों पर बच्चों की कला से विद्यालय को आकर्षक बनाएँ
ड्रॉपआउट निगरानी सूची रखें और परिवारों से मिलें
scene: Karnataka interior-village primary school with a new smart TV, villagers at a gram sabha meeting

name: Ms. Vandna Shahi
citation: Ms. Vandana Shahi, the Principal of BCM School, Ludhiana in Punjab believes strongly in giving freedom to her students to explore their inherent strengths. She provides them with all kinds of labs wherein they can explore their interest. Ideas factory, innovation lab and LAKSHAY initiative are such efforts which are deeply admired by students and closely aligned to the aspirations of NEP 2020. Her efforts to develop leadership qualities in students by establishing entrepreneurs’ lab fit perfectly with the present trend and needs of urban students. All such efforts have resulted in students excelling in all domains of art and science and this can be an example of providing exploratory curriculum in school education. She has demonstrated great social responsibility and imbibing the same in students by some initiatives such as WE CARE under which women empowerment activities were conducted. Ms. Vandana sets an example of a model urban school that allows the aspirations of the students to flourish.
t_en: Ideas Factory, innovation lab and entrepreneurs' lab
t_hi: आइडियाज़ फ़ैक्टरी, इनोवेशन लैब और उद्यमी लैब
s_hi: बच्चों को अपनी शक्तियाँ खोजने की स्वतंत्रता; हर रुचि के लिए लैब; आइडियाज़ फ़ैक्टरी, इनोवेशन लैब व लक्ष्य पहल; नेतृत्व हेतु उद्यमी लैब; "वी केयर" के तहत महिला सशक्तीकरण।
steps_en: Hold an 'ideas factory' period where students pitch ideas and vote
Give students a small budget to prototype the winning idea
Invite a local entrepreneur to mentor a student team
steps_hi: 'आइडियाज़ फ़ैक्टरी' पीरियड रखें जिसमें बच्चे विचार प्रस्तुत करें और मत दें
विजेता विचार का प्रोटोटाइप बनाने हेतु बच्चों को छोटा बजट दें
किसी स्थानीय उद्यमी को छात्र टीम का मेंटर बनाएँ
scene: Ludhiana students pitching ideas to classmates in an 'Ideas Factory' room with sticky notes

name: Mr. Virender Kumar
citation: Mr. Virender Kumar is a trained graduate teacher who is passionate in employing art as an instrument of social change. He has authored three books and has trained over 20,000 teachers on the aspect of art integration in curriculum. He has taken up the mission of improving the handwriting of students by teaching them calligraphy. He also teaches English and Social Science subjects. He has served as the resource person for SCERT, NCERT and NIEPA.
t_en: Art integration and calligraphy for handwriting
t_hi: कला समेकन और सुलेख से हस्तलेख सुधार
s_hi: कला को सामाजिक परिवर्तन का साधन बनाया; तीन पुस्तकें; 20,000 से अधिक शिक्षकों को कला समेकन प्रशिक्षण; सुलेख से बच्चों का हस्तलेख सुधार; अंग्रेज़ी व सामाजिक विज्ञान शिक्षक; SCERT-NCERT-NIEPA रिसोर्स पर्सन।
steps_en: Practise 10 minutes of calligraphy/handwriting daily with a model sheet
Integrate one art form (folk painting, collage) into each Social Science unit
Display improved handwriting samples monthly
steps_hi: मॉडल शीट के साथ रोज़ 10 मिनट सुलेख/हस्तलेख अभ्यास कराएँ
हर सामाजिक विज्ञान इकाई में एक कला रूप (लोक चित्रकला, कोलाज) जोड़ें
हर महीने सुधरे हस्तलेख के नमूने प्रदर्शित करें
scene: Himachal students practising calligraphy with nib pens, a Social Science collage map on the wall

name: Mr. Yudhveer
citation: Mr. Yudhveer has played multiple roles depending on the need of the school as a teacher in Hindi, English, Mathematics, Computer Science, EVS, Yoga and General Knowledge. That speaks of his versatility. Mr. Yudhveer has functioned as State Nodal Resource Person for online content development for Har Ghar Pathashala official web portal, Computer and ICT Coordinator of school, Member of Focus Groups of the state on NEP 2020.
t_en: Versatile single-teacher school and Har Ghar Pathshala content
t_hi: बहुमुखी एकल-शिक्षक विद्यालय और हर घर पाठशाला सामग्री
s_hi: विद्यालय की ज़रूरत अनुसार हिंदी, अंग्रेज़ी, गणित, कंप्यूटर, EVS, योग व GK पढ़ाना; "हर घर पाठशाला" पोर्टल हेतु राज्य नोडल रिसोर्स पर्सन; ICT समन्वयक; NEP फ़ोकस समूह सदस्य।
steps_en: Plan a multi-grade timetable where one activity serves two classes at different levels
Use recorded state-portal content for one group while teaching another
Share content with parents for home learning
steps_hi: ऐसी बहुकक्षा समय-सारिणी बनाएँ जिसमें एक गतिविधि दो कक्षाओं को अलग स्तर पर चले
एक समूह को पढ़ाते समय दूसरे के लिए राज्य पोर्टल की रिकॉर्डेड सामग्री चलाएँ
घर पर सीखने हेतु अभिभावकों से सामग्री साझा करें
scene: Chamba mountain primary school with one teacher handling two groups, one group watching a tablet lesson

name: Mr. Ranjan Kumar Biswas
citation: Mr. Ranjan Kumar Biswas, as a teacher has done commendable work in making the learning easier for children with visual challenge. He has taught them through Braille script, Abacus for Mathematics and imparted vocational training for life skills development. He has developed videos on how to use Abacus, Braille script, signature guide, tactile sketch maker, sign language for children with cerebral palsy, paddle wheeler and rollator. His innovations such as tactile sketch maker and signature guide has given him a unique identification. His innovative work for inclusive education to help differently abled learners has helped them to learn better and improved enrolment in the school.
t_en: Braille, abacus and tactile sketch maker for visually impaired learners
t_hi: दृष्टिबाधित बच्चों के लिए ब्रेल, अबेकस और स्पर्श स्केच मेकर
s_hi: दृष्टिबाधित बच्चों को ब्रेल, गणित हेतु अबेकस और जीवन कौशल हेतु व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण; अबेकस, ब्रेल, सिग्नेचर गाइड, टैक्टाइल स्केच मेकर, सेरेब्रल पाल्सी हेतु सांकेतिक भाषा के वीडियो; समावेशी शिक्षा से नामांकन बढ़ा।
steps_en: Teach number sense to visually impaired children with an abacus
Make a tactile drawing board using a rubber mat and ball-pen
Create a signature guide from a cardboard window
steps_hi: दृष्टिबाधित बच्चों को अबेकस से संख्या बोध सिखाएँ
रबर मैट और बॉल-पेन से स्पर्श ड्रॉइंग बोर्ड बनाएँ
गत्ते की खिड़की से हस्ताक्षर गाइड बनाएँ
scene: Andaman classroom with a visually impaired child using an abacus, a teacher guiding hands on a tactile drawing board

name: Ms. Mamta Paliwal
citation: Ms. Mamta Paliwal is a very dedicated maths teacher who has made learning maths joyful and interesting for girls at her school. She teaches maths with games, quizzes, online apps and 3D models with innovative materials along with work at the Atal Tinkering Lab, all of which has contributed towards higher student motivation and improved learning outcomes. During the pandemic, she created her own maths tutorials on a YouTube channel that was also telecast on Edusat and other media. She is also actively engaged in extra-curricular cultural and social activities, campus improvement and collection drives of materials for students.
t_en: Maths for girls with games, 3D models and Atal Tinkering Lab
t_hi: बालिकाओं के लिए खेल, 3D मॉडल और ATL से गणित
s_hi: बालिका विद्यालय में खेल, क्विज़, ऑनलाइन ऐप, 3D मॉडल व अटल टिंकरिंग लैब से आनंदमय गणित; महामारी में यूट्यूब ट्यूटोरियल जो एडुसैट पर प्रसारित; सांस्कृतिक व सामाजिक गतिविधियाँ।
steps_en: Make a 3D model (cube, cone, cylinder) for each solid-shapes lesson from card sheets
Play a 10-minute maths quiz game each Friday
Record your own short tutorials for revision
steps_hi: हर ठोस आकृति पाठ के लिए कार्ड शीट से 3D मॉडल (घन, शंकु, बेलन) बनाएँ
हर शुक्रवार 10 मिनट का गणित क्विज़ खेल खेलें
रिवीज़न के लिए अपने छोटे ट्यूटोरियल रिकॉर्ड करें
scene: Bhiwani girls building 3D geometric shapes from card, a maths quiz on the board, an ATL corner

name: Shri Kamal Kishore Sharma
school: Government Senior Secondary School Kalhog, Kandaghat
citation: Shri Kamal Kishore Sharma, exemplifies school leadership skills as a Principal of a Govt. Senior Secondary School. As a result of his ability to work with various stakeholders he could get much needed land donated for the school in order to create good school infrastructure. His dedication and positive attitude resulted in the mobilization of adequate funds for the development of the land and construction of better and safer infrastructure for the school including a refurbished Mid Day Meal Room and improved classrooms. He also mobilized the local community to offer its services in many forms including Shramdaan so as to optimally use all available resources for setting up a school with good standards.
t_en: Land donation and shramdaan to build a safe school
t_hi: भूमि दान और श्रमदान से सुरक्षित विद्यालय निर्माण
s_hi: हितधारकों के साथ काम करके विद्यालय हेतु भूमि दान करवाई; बेहतर व सुरक्षित भवन, मध्याह्न भोजन कक्ष व कक्षाओं हेतु धन जुटाया; समुदाय से श्रमदान।
steps_en: Map who in the village can give land, labour, material or money
Organise a monthly shramdaan day with clear small tasks
Publish a simple report of every rupee and hour received
steps_hi: सूची बनाएँ कि गाँव में कौन भूमि, श्रम, सामग्री या धन दे सकता है
स्पष्ट छोटे कार्यों के साथ मासिक श्रमदान दिवस रखें
मिले हर रुपये और घंटे की सरल रिपोर्ट प्रकाशित करें
scene: Himachal hill villagers doing shramdaan carrying stones to build a new school wall, a principal directing

name: Shri Jagtar Singh
citation: Mr. Jagtar Singh as a primary school teacher mobilised the community to set up very good infrastructure for his school. He mobilised funds to improve the school in terms of well-maintained and colourful classrooms, optimum use of walls and outdoor spaces as teaching learning aids, enhancing digital infrastructure of his own school by providing projectors, e-content, e-libraries, and language labs. He introduced innovative ideas for reading and learning during the pandemic by extensive use of e-materials as also providing smart phones to students and teachers.
t_en: Walls and outdoor spaces as learning aids with e-libraries
t_hi: दीवारें व बाहरी स्थान अधिगम साधन, ई-पुस्तकालय के साथ
s_hi: समुदाय से रंगीन कक्षाएँ; दीवारों व बाहरी स्थानों का शिक्षण सामग्री के रूप में उपयोग; प्रोजेक्टर, ई-कंटेंट, ई-लाइब्रेरी व भाषा लैब; महामारी में बच्चों-शिक्षकों को स्मार्टफ़ोन।
steps_en: Paint the verandah with alphabets, number line, map and body parts
Load e-books on a tablet/projector for a weekly e-library period
Ask donors for second-hand phones for students without devices
steps_hi: बरामदे पर वर्णमाला, संख्या रेखा, नक्शा और शरीर के अंग पेंट करें
साप्ताहिक ई-लाइब्रेरी पीरियड हेतु टैबलेट/प्रोजेक्टर पर ई-पुस्तकें डालें
उपकरण-विहीन बच्चों के लिए दानदाताओं से पुराने फ़ोन माँगें
scene: Punjab primary school verandah painted with alphabets and a world map, children reading e-books on a projector

name: Shri Vipin Kumar
school: Rajkiya Pratibha Vikas Vidyalaya, Sector-11 Rohini
citation: Shri Vipin Kumar as Vice Principal of Rajkiya Pratibha Vikas Vidyalaya, Sector-11, Rohini in North West Delhi District has worked consistently and spearheaded the school towards excellence which has shown steady outcomes in the number of students from his school successfully completing and qualifying in national competitions like the NEET exam, JEE exam, NMMS exam etc. He has also encouraged and guided students to participate and win positions in other competitions for excellence in Science, the Olympiads of different subjects and in the field of sports. He has strived towards making his school a centre for excellence and high achievement, with his leadership skills and dedication to his students.
t_en: Pathways to NEET, JEE and NMMS from a government school
t_hi: सरकारी विद्यालय से NEET, JEE और NMMS तक
s_hi: उप-प्रधानाचार्य के रूप में विद्यालय को उत्कृष्टता की ओर ले गए; NEET, JEE, NMMS जैसी परीक्षाओं में सफलता; विज्ञान, ओलंपियाड व खेलों में मार्गदर्शन।
steps_en: Create a competitive-exam calendar and a weekly practice test schedule
Pair alumni who cleared exams with current students as mentors
Analyse test results topic-wise and plan remedial sessions
steps_hi: प्रतियोगी परीक्षा कैलेंडर और साप्ताहिक अभ्यास परीक्षा कार्यक्रम बनाएँ
परीक्षा पास कर चुके पूर्व छात्रों को वर्तमान छात्रों के मेंटर बनाएँ
परीक्षा परिणाम का टॉपिकवार विश्लेषण कर उपचारात्मक सत्र की योजना बनाएँ
scene: Delhi government school students in a quiet study hall solving practice papers, an alumnus mentoring

name: Shri Deepak Joshi
school: Govt. Sr. Sec. School, Dandusar, Bikaner
citation: Shri Deepak Joshi is a Science Teacher and works passionately to inculcate scientific and innovative spirit amongst his students. He has developed an innovative science lab in his school, which is used by his students to work on new ideas. As a result, about 10 students under his charge, have won the prestigious ‘Inspire Award’ at the national level. He has also worked tirelessly to connect science to address local issues of nutrition with plants rich in vitamins, a harness to carry cement bags etc. so as to help children and the community appreciate and develop a scientific temper.
t_en: Innovation lab solving local problems (nutrition, cement-bag harness)
t_hi: स्थानीय समस्याएँ हल करती नवाचार प्रयोगशाला
s_hi: विद्यालय में नवाचारी विज्ञान लैब जहाँ बच्चे नए विचारों पर काम करते हैं; लगभग 10 छात्रों को राष्ट्रीय INSPIRE पुरस्कार; विटामिन युक्त पौधों से पोषण, सीमेंट बोरी उठाने का हार्नेस जैसे स्थानीय समाधान।
steps_en: Ask students to interview parents about a daily hardship and design a fix
Keep an 'innovation shelf' of prototypes with the problem written below
Submit the best ideas to INSPIRE-MANAK
steps_hi: बच्चों से अभिभावकों की किसी रोज़मर्रा की परेशानी पर बात करवाएँ और समाधान डिज़ाइन करवाएँ
'नवाचार शेल्फ' रखें जिस पर प्रोटोटाइप और नीचे समस्या लिखी हो
श्रेष्ठ विचार INSPIRE-MANAK में भेजें
scene: Bikaner desert-village students testing a harness for carrying heavy bags, a teacher noting improvements

name: Shri Jai Singh
school: Govt. Ser. Sec. School, Devroad, Surajgarh, Jhunjhunu
citation: Shri Jai Singh is a Sports Teacher and has been instrumental in constructing a big sport’s stadium for games like volleyball, football, basketball, an athlete track etc. in his school. He accomplished this goal by raising funds from various government schemes and by extensive community mobilisation. He is very passionate about Yoga and sports and has been working tirelessly for promoting physical fitness amongst youngsters, for several decades. He has trained and inspired multiple players amongst which there are several girls, to compete nationally and beyond, in a variety of games.
t_en: Community-built stadium and sports for girls
t_hi: समुदाय निर्मित स्टेडियम और बालिकाओं के लिए खेल
s_hi: सरकारी योजनाओं व समुदाय सहयोग से वॉलीबॉल, फ़ुटबॉल, बास्केटबॉल व एथलेटिक ट्रैक वाला स्टेडियम; दशकों से योग व खेल से फ़िटनेस; अनेक बालिकाओं सहित खिलाड़ी राष्ट्रीय स्तर तक।
steps_en: Mark a running track and one court on available land with lime and local help
Hold daily morning practice with separate slots for girls
Apply for Khelo India / state sports schemes for equipment
steps_hi: उपलब्ध भूमि पर चूने और स्थानीय मदद से दौड़ ट्रैक व एक कोर्ट बनाएँ
रोज़ सुबह अभ्यास रखें जिसमें बालिकाओं का अलग समय हो
उपकरण हेतु खेलो इंडिया/राज्य खेल योजनाओं में आवेदन करें
scene: Rajasthan village school stadium with girls sprinting on a track and a volleyball game, a PE teacher with a whistle

name: Ms Vanita Dayabhai Rathod
school: Shri Vinoba Bhave School No 93, Nana Mava, West Zone Rajkot
citation: Ms. Vanita Rathod is a committed and proud Principal of an upper primary school. She has systematically built up an attractive and sound school infrastructure which has attracted and enhanced enrolments over the years. She has tirelessly built a theme for protection of the environment in her school by enthusing students towards systematic plantation drives, planting and maintenance of a medicinal garden etc. Her aim has been to educate students on sustainability by reuse of waste materials in aesthetic ways so as to beautify the school campus.
t_en: Medicinal garden and waste-to-art campus beautification
t_hi: औषधीय उद्यान और कबाड़ से कला द्वारा परिसर सौंदर्यीकरण
s_hi: आकर्षक अवसंरचना से नामांकन बढ़ा; पर्यावरण संरक्षण थीम; वृक्षारोपण व औषधीय उद्यान; कबाड़ के सुंदर पुन:उपयोग से परिसर सजाकर सततता की शिक्षा।
steps_en: Give each class a section of the campus to beautify with waste materials
Grow 10 medicinal plants with name boards made by students
Hold a 'reuse art' exhibition each term
steps_hi: हर कक्षा को परिसर का एक हिस्सा कबाड़ से सजाने को दें
बच्चों द्वारा बनाए नाम पट्ट के साथ 10 औषधीय पौधे लगाएँ
हर टर्म 'पुनःउपयोग कला' प्रदर्शनी लगाएँ
scene: Rajkot school campus decorated with tyre planters and bottle art, students watering a medicinal garden

name: Shri Ashok Kumar Mohanlal Parmar
citation: Mr. Ashok kumar Mohanlal Parmar is very creative educator with several innovative toys, games and puzzles to his credit. He has been actively involved in creating e-content on Science concepts on social media. He reaches out to students through his YouTube channel and WhatsApp groups where he shares logical puzzles and promotes STEM learning. His innovative models and practices for integrated learning across subjects, have been widely disseminated and appreciated.
t_en: Science toys, puzzles and WhatsApp STEM groups
t_hi: विज्ञान खिलौने, पहेलियाँ और व्हाट्सऐप STEM समूह
s_hi: अनेक नवाचारी खिलौने, खेल और पहेलियाँ; सोशल मीडिया पर विज्ञान ई-कंटेंट; यूट्यूब व व्हाट्सऐप समूहों में तार्किक पहेलियाँ और STEM; विषयों में समेकित अधिगम के मॉडल।
steps_en: Make one science toy per month (balloon rocket, paper helicopter) with students
Post a logic puzzle on the class group every evening
Explain the science behind each toy in 3 lines
steps_hi: हर महीने बच्चों के साथ एक विज्ञान खिलौना (गुब्बारा रॉकेट, कागज़ हेलीकॉप्टर) बनाएँ
हर शाम कक्षा समूह पर एक तर्क पहेली डालें
हर खिलौने के पीछे का विज्ञान 3 पंक्तियों में समझाएँ
scene: Kutch students launching balloon rockets on strings and spinning paper helicopters, a teacher filming

name: Shri Shakti Patel
school: Govt. High School, Mand, Bichhiya, Mandla
citation: Shri Shakti Patel is a dedicated teacher of Hindi in a government High School who has done innovative work to reach out to his students to support their education during the pandemic times. He developed interesting online materials for use in virtual classes, of which over one hundred were self-study materials for students and also several training videos for teachers. His skills have contributed to a larger audience as he was a resource person for the training of teachers with many online teacher training programmes being conducted in the State. He continued to assist his students with follow up studies online and where necessary, with physical materials being made available to them.
t_en: 100+ self-study Hindi materials and teacher training videos
t_hi: 100+ हिंदी स्व-अध्ययन सामग्री और शिक्षक प्रशिक्षण वीडियो
s_hi: महामारी में आभासी कक्षाओं हेतु रोचक ऑनलाइन सामग्री; 100 से अधिक स्व-अध्ययन सामग्री; शिक्षकों के प्रशिक्षण वीडियो; राज्य में ऑनलाइन प्रशिक्षण रिसोर्स पर्सन; ज़रूरत पर भौतिक सामग्री।
steps_en: Make one-page self-study sheets for each Hindi chapter (summary, words, 5 questions)
Send them on WhatsApp and also print for students without phones
Follow up weekly with a 5-minute call or visit
steps_hi: हर हिंदी अध्याय की एक-पेज स्व-अध्ययन शीट (सार, शब्द, 5 प्रश्न) बनाएँ
इन्हें व्हाट्सऐप पर भेजें और फ़ोन-विहीन बच्चों के लिए छापें
हर हफ्ते 5 मिनट के फ़ोन या भेंट से फ़ॉलो-अप करें
scene: Mandla tribal-area high school teacher handing printed self-study sheets to students in a village, a phone with a video lesson

name: Shri Haridas Sharma
citation: As a Head Teacher of Upper Primary School, Shri Hari Das Sharma’s devotion to the profession and his school leadership abilities have been visible in his tireless efforts to change the face of his school. He mobilized the students, fellow teachers, and the larger community to work together, donate time and resources to provide a clean safe and hygienic learning environment. Infrastructural improvements like creation of the boundary, several smart classrooms, use of walls as learning aids and a medicinal garden were accomplished, despite scarcity of resources. His desire to make the school as a place for all around development led to enhanced academic and co-curricular achievements amongst the children.
t_en: Clean, safe school with walls as learning aids
t_hi: दीवारें अधिगम साधन, स्वच्छ व सुरक्षित विद्यालय
s_hi: छात्रों, शिक्षकों व समुदाय से समय-संसाधन दान; चारदीवारी, स्मार्ट कक्षाएँ, अधिगम साधन के रूप में दीवारें और औषधीय उद्यान; अकादमिक व सह-पाठ्यक्रम उपलब्धियाँ।
steps_en: Make a cleanliness roster where every class owns one area
Turn each wall into a subject chart painted with students
Set up a medicinal garden with labelled plants
steps_hi: स्वच्छता रोस्टर बनाएँ जिसमें हर कक्षा एक क्षेत्र की ज़िम्मेदार हो
हर दीवार को बच्चों के साथ विषय चार्ट में बदलें
लेबल वाले पौधों के साथ औषधीय उद्यान बनाएँ
scene: Bihar upper-primary school with freshly painted learning walls and a boundary wall, children cleaning their area

name: Ms Chandana Dutta
school: M.S. Ranti Government School, Rajnagar, Madhubani
citation: Ms. Chandana Dutta has displayed strong resolve and community mobilization skills to create an inspired and equitable learning environment in her school, despite working within a socially challenging environment and large resource constraints. Her focus on building trust with the community, led to large enrolment of girls from the minority community. She worked with the parents and students to provide basic infrastructural improvements in the school buildings, overcame constraints to girls education and as a language teacher successfully integrated local arts and skills in her teaching methodology.
t_en: Building trust for minority girls and local arts in language class
t_hi: अल्पसंख्यक बालिकाओं का विश्वास और भाषा कक्षा में स्थानीय कला
s_hi: सामाजिक रूप से चुनौतीपूर्ण माहौल में समुदाय का विश्वास जीतकर अल्पसंख्यक समुदाय की बालिकाओं का बड़ा नामांकन; बुनियादी सुधार; भाषा शिक्षिका के रूप में स्थानीय कला व कौशल (मधुबनी) को शिक्षण में जोड़ा।
steps_en: Meet community and religious leaders to explain your plan for girls' safety and learning
Use Madhubani or local art to illustrate stories and poems
Invite mothers to see girls' work regularly
steps_hi: बालिकाओं की सुरक्षा व पढ़ाई की योजना समझाने के लिए समुदाय और धार्मिक नेताओं से मिलें
कहानियों व कविताओं के चित्रण हेतु मधुबनी या स्थानीय कला अपनाएँ
माताओं को नियमित रूप से बालिकाओं का काम देखने बुलाएँ
scene: Madhubani village girls painting Mithila-style illustrations of a poem, mothers in the doorway

name: Shri Ashok Kumar Satpathy
citation: Shri Ashok Kumar Satpathy is a Science Teacher and passionate about providing equal educational opportunities to the underprivileged children. As his school suffered from scarcity of resources, he made enormous efforts to connect with school alumni nationally & internationally and systematically motivated them to donate generously for the development of the school. Through these alumni donations, he built up the school infrastructure including a new conference hall, computer labs and procured other ICT equipment for the school. He also instituted several scholarships for meritorious students.
t_en: Global alumni network funding labs and scholarships
t_hi: प्रयोगशाला व छात्रवृत्ति हेतु वैश्विक पूर्व छात्र नेटवर्क
s_hi: संसाधनों की कमी वाले विद्यालय के लिए देश-विदेश के पूर्व छात्रों से संपर्क; दान से सम्मेलन हॉल, कंप्यूटर लैब, ICT उपकरण; मेधावी छात्रों के लिए अनेक छात्रवृत्तियाँ।
steps_en: Build an alumni list from old registers and start an online group
Share one specific need with a photo and cost each quarter
Name scholarships after donors and award them publicly
steps_hi: पुराने रजिस्टरों से पूर्व छात्र सूची बनाकर ऑनलाइन समूह शुरू करें
हर तिमाही एक विशिष्ट ज़रूरत फ़ोटो और लागत सहित साझा करें
दानदाताओं के नाम पर छात्रवृत्तियाँ रखें और सार्वजनिक रूप से दें
scene: Odisha school alumni meet with old students donating to a new computer lab, a scholarship ceremony

name: Shri Ajit Kumar Sethy
citation: Shri Ajit Kumar Sethy is an arts and music teacher and acting Head Teacher of his school. He has innovated with inter disciplinary learning styles by using his musical instruments as “props” to help children understand abstract concepts in science, mathematics, geography, etc. He also uses this approach to develop problem solving & critical thinking mindset amongst his students. He mobilized the school alumni and the local community to raise funds for the development of his school.
t_en: Musical instruments as props for science and maths
t_hi: विज्ञान व गणित के लिए संगीत वाद्यों का उपयोग
s_hi: कला व संगीत शिक्षक ने अपने वाद्यों को "प्रॉप" बनाकर विज्ञान, गणित, भूगोल की अमूर्त अवधारणाएँ समझाईं; समस्या समाधान व आलोचनात्मक सोच; पूर्व छात्रों व समुदाय से धन।
steps_en: Use a string instrument to show vibration, pitch and length
Teach fractions and patterns through rhythm and beats
Let children make simple instruments and explain the science
steps_hi: कंपन, तारत्व और लंबाई दिखाने के लिए तार वाद्य का प्रयोग करें
लय और ताल से भिन्न और पैटर्न सिखाएँ
बच्चे सरल वाद्य बनाएँ और उनका विज्ञान समझाएँ
scene: Odisha school teacher plucking a stringed instrument while children observe vibration, others clapping rhythm patterns

name: Shri Hariswami Das
school: Sovanagar High School, Sovanagar, English Bazar
citation: With his unstinting efforts, Dr. Hariswami Das successfully renovated, upgraded and made his school infrastructure child friendly with the help of the community. Largely due to his efforts, enrolment in his school has gone up manifold and the dropout rate has plummeted. He has designed and implemented several environmental projects with his students so as to create awareness about environmental conservation and sustainable development.
t_en: Child-friendly renovation and student environmental projects
t_hi: बाल-अनुकूल नवीनीकरण और छात्र पर्यावरण प्रोजेक्ट
s_hi: समुदाय सहयोग से विद्यालय अवसंरचना का नवीनीकरण व बाल-अनुकूल बनाया; नामांकन कई गुना बढ़ा, ड्रॉपआउट घटा; छात्रों के साथ अनेक पर्यावरण प्रोजेक्ट।
steps_en: Run one environmental project per class per year (water, trees, waste)
Ask students to present projects to the gram panchayat
Track enrolment and dropout every year
steps_hi: हर कक्षा का हर साल एक पर्यावरण प्रोजेक्ट (पानी, पेड़, कचरा) चलाएँ
बच्चे प्रोजेक्ट ग्राम पंचायत के सामने प्रस्तुत करें
हर साल नामांकन और ड्रॉपआउट का रिकॉर्ड रखें
scene: Malda high school students presenting a tree-census project to village elders

name: Shri Sanjeev Kumar Sharma
school: Government Primary School, Ikhani, Sungal, Pouni, Reasi
citation: Shri Sanjeev Kumar Sharma works as a Teacher in a primary school in a remote and hilly region of J & K where he has made extraordinary efforts to rebuild and improve the poor and dilapidated condition of his school. He has transformed it into a beautiful and attractive school building with the help of the community that he helped mobilize and who have contributed in cash and kind. From very meager enrolments, the school now has very high participation from the village children and this has brought pride and ownership to the local community. Shri Sharma also uses joyful learning and art integrated pedagogy for facilitating learning along with his teacher colleagues.
t_en: Rebuilding a hill school with community cash and kind
t_hi: समुदाय के नकद व वस्तु सहयोग से पहाड़ी विद्यालय का पुनर्निर्माण
s_hi: दूरस्थ पहाड़ी क्षेत्र के जर्जर विद्यालय को समुदाय के नकद व वस्तु सहयोग से सुंदर भवन में बदला; नामांकन बढ़ा; गाँव में गर्व व अपनापन; आनंदमय व कला समेकित शिक्षण।
steps_en: Hold a village meeting with before-photos and a clear rebuild plan
Accept in-kind help (cement, labour, paint) and record it on a board
Use art in every subject to make the school attractive
steps_hi: पहले की तस्वीरों और स्पष्ट पुनर्निर्माण योजना के साथ गाँव बैठक करें
वस्तु सहयोग (सीमेंट, श्रम, पेंट) स्वीकार करें और बोर्ड पर दर्ज करें
विद्यालय को आकर्षक बनाने के लिए हर विषय में कला अपनाएँ
scene: Reasi hill-village primary school being repainted by villagers, children drawing on a new wall

name: Shri Muhammad Ali
school: Govt Middle School Karith, Shargole, Kargil
citation: Shri Mohammad Ali is an acting Head Teacher in his upper primary school. He is an extremely passionate educator who subscribes to the belief of “learning by doing” which is central to the academic process seen in his classrooms and adopted by his students. Shri Ali has innovated many strategies to improve learning levels, amongst which a notable one is the setting up of ‘subject-wise classrooms’ instead of conventional grade-wise classrooms, thus enabling better focus and facilitating experiential learning.
t_en: Subject-wise classrooms instead of grade-wise rooms
t_hi: कक्षावार के बजाय विषयवार कक्षाएँ
s_hi: "करके सीखना" में विश्वास; अधिगम स्तर सुधारने हेतु पारंपरिक कक्षावार कमरों के बजाय "विषयवार कक्षाएँ" जिससे बेहतर ध्यान और अनुभवात्मक शिक्षा।
steps_en: Convert rooms into a Maths room, Science room and Language room with materials on the walls
Let students move between rooms instead of teachers
Keep subject-specific kits in each room
steps_hi: कमरों को गणित कक्ष, विज्ञान कक्ष और भाषा कक्ष में बदलें जिनकी दीवारों पर सामग्री हो
शिक्षकों के बजाय बच्चे कक्षों के बीच जाएँ
हर कक्ष में विषय-विशेष किट रखें
scene: Kargil middle school with a 'Maths Room' sign, shelves of geometry kits, students entering from another room

name: Ms Tripti Mahaur
school: Government Girls Inter College Quila, Sadar, Rampur
citation: Ms.Tripti Mahaur is an inspirational Social Science Educator and has demonstrated that she is a creative and innovative teacher who has kept her students engaged in learning activities, even in challenging circumstances of the pandemic. She has set up a social science lab in her school and engages with the local community to build connections between social science as a subject and social values of humanity, citizenship and social consciousness amongst her students. She believes in education as an empowering tool for girls and guides them to make appropriate choices of subjects with future job prospects and encourages them to continue school beyond class 10.
t_en: Social Science lab and career choices for girls
t_hi: सामाजिक विज्ञान प्रयोगशाला और बालिकाओं के करियर विकल्प
