Her innovative teaching philosophy emphasizes experiential and student-centered learning to address diverse learner needs.She has pioneered structured pedagogical frameworks such as Do–Observe–Record– Arrange (DORA) and Joyful Integrative Learning & Update (JILU). To further enrich learning outcomes, she implemented the Multiple Integrative Learning Algorithm (MILA), complemented by game-based and digital assessment tools including CHIKKU, Micro-Innova, Social Media Integrated Learning in Education (SMILE), and Open-Read-Orient (OREO).Her classroom practices integrate Process Oriented Guided Inquiry Learning (POGIL), peer-led discussions, and critical pedagogy. She also bridges theory and clinical practice by embedding Evidence-Based Dentistry (EBD), case-based clinical examinations, and advanced molecular methodologies into the curriculum, transforming traditional lecture-based education.
core: Innovative medical microbiology pedagogy, experiential learning models, integration of digital and game-based assessments, and clinical-academic curriculum bridging.
t_en: DORA, JILU and game-based microbiology frameworks
t_hi: DORA, JILU और खेल आधारित सूक्ष्मजीव विज्ञान ढाँचे
s_hi: अनुभवात्मक व छात्र-केंद्रित ढाँचे: डू-ऑब्ज़र्व-रिकॉर्ड-अरेंज (DORA), JILU, MILA; खेल व डिजिटल आकलन उपकरण; POGIL, साथी चर्चा; सिद्धांत को क्लिनिकल अभ्यास से जोड़ा।
steps_en: School use: follow Do–Observe–Record–Arrange for every experiment
Use a quick game-based quiz at the end of practicals
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: हर प्रयोग में करो–देखो–लिखो–व्यवस्थित करो (DORA) अपनाएँ
प्रयोग के अंत में त्वरित खेल आधारित क्विज़ लें
scene: Dental college microbiology lab with students recording observations in a DORA chart

name: Prof. Birinchi Kumar Sarma
school: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh
citation: Prof. Birinchi Kumar Sarma, a distinguished faculty member in Mycology and Plant Pathology at the Institute of Agricultural Sciences, Banaras Hindu University (BHU), is widely admired for his enthusiastic and transformative teaching approaches. With over 22 years of experience at BHU, he has played a significant role in building student capacity through innovative, real-world oriented learning. He fosters creative inquiry by engaging students with stakeholders, identifying practical challenges, and encouraging innovative thinking. He has developed two Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) and supported Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) to promote entrepreneurship and applied learning. As Chairman of the Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Cell, he has guided innovators in protecting their work through patents. He leads the experiential learning program on “Biofertilizer and Biopesticide Production”, enabling final-year undergraduate students to become industry-ready and pursue start-ups. Through initiatives such as the flagship program “Finding the Leader in You (FLY)”, he actively nurtures leadership qualities among students.
core: Experiential and entrepreneurial learning, intellectual property mentoring, capacity building, and leadership development in agricultural education.
t_en: Stakeholder-based learning and biofertilizer entrepreneurship
t_hi: हितधारक आधारित शिक्षा और जैव-उर्वरक उद्यमिता
s_hi: छात्रों को हितधारकों से जोड़कर व्यावहारिक चुनौतियाँ पहचानना; दो MOOC; उद्यमिता हेतु LLP; IPR सेल अध्यक्ष; "जैव-उर्वरक व जैव-कीटनाशक" अनुभवात्मक कार्यक्रम।
steps_en: School use: invite a farmer to class and let students list problems they face
Make compost or a simple bio-pesticide (neem) as a project
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: किसान को कक्षा में बुलाएँ और बच्चे उनकी समस्याएँ सूचीबद्ध करें
प्रोजेक्ट के रूप में कम्पोस्ट या सरल जैव-कीटनाशक (नीम) बनाएँ
scene: Agriculture students with a farmer in a field examining crops, biofertilizer packets in hand

name: Prof. Srinivas Hotha
school: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER), Pune Maharashtra
citation: Prof. Srinivas Hotha has over 21 years of teaching experience and is a highly passionate chemistry educator at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER), Pune. He has inspired and mentored numerous undergraduate and postgraduate students by developing innovative pedagogical tools for effective classroom teaching. He discovered the first gold-catalyzed glycosidation reaction and developed a suite of experimental protocols. His research group has synthesized complex and branched glycan probes that contribute to vaccine development for Mycobacterium tuberculosis . Under his leadership, the TLC–MS Interface, named SWADESI (Software Assisted Direct Extraction and Sampling Interface), was invented to enable rapid confirmation of molecular weights of drugs and pharmaceuticals. He has also authored over 100 research publications, reflecting his significant impact on chemical education and research.
core: Innovative chemistry pedagogy, pioneering glycoscience research, translational scientific tools, and excellence in academic mentorship.
t_en: Innovative chemistry teaching tools and SWADESI TLC–MS interface
t_hi: नवाचारी रसायन शिक्षण उपकरण और स्वदेशी TLC–MS इंटरफ़ेस
s_hi: कक्षा हेतु नवाचारी शिक्षण उपकरण; पहली स्वर्ण-उत्प्रेरित ग्लाइकोसिडेशन अभिक्रिया; TB वैक्सीन हेतु ग्लाइकन प्रोब; स्वदेशी TLC–MS इंटरफ़ेस "SWADESI"; 100+ प्रकाशन।
steps_en: School use: do paper/chalk chromatography to introduce separation techniques
Tell the story of an Indian invention to inspire students
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: पृथक्करण तकनीकों के परिचय हेतु कागज़/चॉक क्रोमैटोग्राफ़ी करें
बच्चों को प्रेरित करने हेतु किसी भारतीय आविष्कार की कहानी सुनाएँ
scene: IISER chemistry lab with students running thin-layer chromatography plates

name: Prof. S.R. Keshava
citation: Prof. S.R. Keshava has 26 years of experience as a passionate professor of Economics at Bangalore University, Karnataka. He strongly believes in experiential learning and actively organizes outreach activities, including visits to industries, start-ups, and farmlands, to provide students with first-hand exposure to real-world economic environments. To enrich classroom instruction, he curates comprehensive reading lists and integrates ICT-enabled teaching methodologies such as online academic resources, YouTube-based learning content, and Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs). These blended learning strategies have significantly enhanced student engagement and conceptual understanding. His most cited research works include studies on foreign direct investment, socio-economic exclusion of Indian farmers, and urbanization and solid waste management in Bangalore, reflecting his commitment to addressing pressing economic and policy challenges through teaching and research.
core: Experiential economics education, ICT-enabled teaching, impactful policy research, and student-centered outreach initiatives.
t_en: Field visits to industries, startups and farmlands in Economics
t_hi: अर्थशास्त्र में उद्योग, स्टार्टअप और खेतों का भ्रमण
s_hi: अनुभवात्मक शिक्षा; उद्योगों, स्टार्टअप व खेतों का भ्रमण; विस्तृत पठन सूचियाँ; ICT, यूट्यूब व MOOC के साथ ब्लेंडेड शिक्षा; FDI, किसानों के बहिष्करण, शहरीकरण पर शोध।
steps_en: School use: visit a local market and record prices to learn demand and supply
Give a short reading list with one video per topic
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: माँग-आपूर्ति सीखने हेतु स्थानीय बाज़ार जाकर मूल्य दर्ज करें
हर टॉपिक के लिए एक वीडियो सहित छोटी पठन सूची दें
scene: Economics students interviewing a vegetable vendor in a Bengaluru market, notebooks in hand

name: Prof. Shilpagauri Prasad Ganpule
school: Pune District Education Association’s Prof. Ramkrishna More Arts, Commerce and Science College Pune, Maharashtra
citation: Prof. Shilpagauri Prasad Ganpule has 30 years of distinguished teaching experience and has played a significant leadership role in higher education. She served as the lead of the 84th Poets, Essayists, Novelists (PEN) Congress, demonstrating her commitment to literary scholarship and global academic engagement. Her teaching methodology emphasizes experiential learning and strong ICT integration. She effectively uses digital platforms such as Google Classroom and Zoom to enhance student engagement and interactive learning outcomes. She was the Principal Investigator for the Hedra Research Associates’ “Covid Metaphor Project” and was appointed as a Peace Ambassador by the Institute of Economics and Peace, Sydney, Australia. Additionally, she has been recognized as the Director of the International Fellowship of Rotarian Educators, reflecting her global academic and humanitarian contributions.
core: Experiential and ICT-enabled English pedagogy, international academic leadership, peace education advocacy, and research-driven literary scholarship.
t_en: ICT-integrated experiential English and global literary engagement
t_hi: ICT समेकित अनुभवात्मक अंग्रेज़ी और वैश्विक साहित्यिक जुड़ाव
s_hi: 30 वर्षों का शिक्षण; PEN कांग्रेस का नेतृत्व; अनुभवात्मक शिक्षा व ICT (गूगल क्लासरूम, ज़ूम); कोविड रूपक प्रोजेक्ट; शांति दूत।
steps_en: School use: set one writing task a week on Google Classroom with peer comments
Connect with a writer online for a class Q&A
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: गूगल क्लासरूम पर हर हफ्ते एक लेखन कार्य दें जिस पर साथी टिप्पणी करें
कक्षा प्रश्नोत्तर हेतु किसी लेखक से ऑनलाइन जुड़ें
scene: College English class on a video call with a writer, students posting comments in Google Classroom

name: Dr. C. Jaya Sankar Babu
role: Associate Professor & Head Department of Hindi
citation: Dr. C. Jaya Sankar Babu has 16 years of academic experience as an Associate Professor and Head of the Department of Hindi at Pondicherry University. A committed teacher and researcher, he has made significant contributions toward student skill development and employability. As the Founder Editor of “Yug Manas” and Chief Editor of “Antar Bharati” , he has actively engaged with mainstream media and conducted scholarly research in journalism. He has played a vital role in promoting e-literacy, particularly in computing in Indian languages. He initiated a Digital Literacy Mission in 1999 and has since organized more than 1,700 workshops over the past two and a half decades. He has developed MOOCs for the SWAYAM platform, implemented research projects, and has been honored with multiple awards, including the Best Teacher Award from Pondicherry University on three occasions.
core: Promotion of Indian language computing, digital and e-literacy initiatives, journalism research, and student skill development in higher education.
t_en: Digital Literacy Mission: computing in Indian languages
t_hi: डिजिटल साक्षरता मिशन: भारतीय भाषाओं में कंप्यूटिंग
s_hi: छात्र कौशल व रोज़गार पर काम; "युग मानस" व "अंतर भारती" के संपादक; भारतीय भाषाओं में कंप्यूटिंग हेतु ई-साक्षरता; 1999 से डिजिटल साक्षरता मिशन—1,700+ कार्यशालाएँ; स्वयं MOOC।
steps_en: School use: teach students to type in Hindi/regional language using free keyboards
Make a class blog in the mother tongue
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: बच्चों को मुफ्त कीबोर्ड से हिंदी/क्षेत्रीय भाषा में टाइप करना सिखाएँ
मातृभाषा में कक्षा ब्लॉग बनाएँ
scene: Students typing in Devanagari on computers in a workshop led by a professor

name: Prof. Nilabh Tiwari
school: Central Sanskrit University, Bhopal Campus, Madhya Pradesh
citation: Prof. Nilabh Tiwari has 18 years of teaching experience and is a distinguished educator and academic leader in the field of education and Sanskrit studies. As a prolific author and editor, he has made substantial contributions to academic literature, authoring and editing 34 books and journals and publishing 37 research papers in reputed journals. His scholarly work addresses diverse areas including Indian knowledge-based educational psychology, information and communication technology (ICT), and curriculum development. He has played a pivotal role in advancing research and innovation in education through evidence-based academic practices. Prof. Tiwari has demonstrated exceptional leadership in spearheading the orientation programs for the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. His professional experience spans curriculum design, educational surveys, research and development initiatives, and the creation of comprehensive teacher orientation and capacity-building programs.
core: Academic leadership in education, Indian knowledge systems, NEP 2020 implementation, curriculum development, and teacher capacity building.
t_en: Indian-knowledge-based educational psychology and NEP orientation
t_hi: भारतीय ज्ञान आधारित शैक्षिक मनोविज्ञान और NEP अभिमुखीकरण
s_hi: 34 पुस्तकें/पत्रिकाएँ और 37 शोध पत्र; भारतीय ज्ञान आधारित शैक्षिक मनोविज्ञान, ICT व पाठ्यक्रम विकास; NEP 2020 अभिमुखीकरण कार्यक्रमों का नेतृत्व।
steps_en: School use: use a short story from Indian tradition to discuss focus and self-discipline
Run an NEP-awareness session for parents
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: एकाग्रता व आत्म-अनुशासन पर चर्चा हेतु भारतीय परंपरा की छोटी कहानी का प्रयोग करें
अभिभावकों के लिए NEP जागरूकता सत्र करें
scene: Teacher-education class at a Sanskrit university with a professor leading an NEP orientation

name: Prof. Vinay Sharma
school: Joint Professor, Dept. of Design, IIT Roorkee, Uttarakhand
citation: Prof. Vinay Sharma, with around 30 years of experience, is a Professor in the Department of Management Studies and also a Joint Professor in the Department of Design at IIT Roorkee. He has contributed significantly to marketing innovation literature, with one of his theories acknowledged by the Academy of Marketing Science. He has been part of the working group for the Ganga River Basin Environment Management Plan and executed projects in low-cost energy generation and livelihood development in the North-Western Himalayas, which have been patented, tested, and commercialized. In his book, ‘Affordability for the Poor and Profitability for the Provider’, he proposed a specialized model recognized on various platforms. Prof. Sharma has trained around 5000 senior executives, including Managing Directors, CEOs, and Senior Managers of large corporations and multinationals.
t_en: Affordable design and Himalayan livelihood innovations
t_hi: किफ़ायती डिज़ाइन और हिमालयी आजीविका नवाचार
s_hi: मार्केटिंग नवाचार साहित्य में योगदान; गंगा बेसिन पर्यावरण योजना कार्य समूह; उत्तर-पश्चिम हिमालय में कम लागत ऊर्जा व आजीविका प्रोजेक्ट (पेटेंट व व्यावसायीकरण); "गरीबों के लिए किफ़ायत" मॉडल।
steps_en: School use: give a design challenge: make something useful for a village under ₹50
Discuss who benefits and who pays
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: डिज़ाइन चुनौती दें: ₹50 से कम में गाँव के लिए कुछ उपयोगी बनाओ
चर्चा करें कि लाभ किसे और भुगतान कौन करता है
scene: Design students testing a low-cost water mill model in a Himalayan stream

name: Dr. Nandavaram Mrudula
school: Department of Telugu Govt. Degree College for Women, Begumpet, Hyderabad, Telangana
citation: Dr. Nandavaram Mrudula is an Associate Professor and Head of the Department of Telugu at the Government Degree College for Women, Begumpet, Hyderabad, with an illustrious teaching career spanning 34 years. Her teaching methodology is deeply student-centric, emphasizing critical thinking and contextual understanding. A significant portion of her career has been dedicated to serving rural areas, where she actively engaged in outreach initiatives to support students struggling with academic fees and extended humanitarian support to homeless individuals. Dr. Mrudula’s pedagogical approach inspires thought-provoking inquiry by presenting even classical lessons through contemporary perspectives, seamlessly integrating current affairs and future societal demands. Her commitment to inclusive education and social responsibility has had a lasting impact on both her students and the wider community.
core: Student-centric pedagogy, Telugu language education, rural outreach, social service, and inclusive higher education.
t_en: Classical Telugu through contemporary issues
t_hi: समकालीन मुद्दों के माध्यम से शास्त्रीय तेलुगु
s_hi: 34 वर्षों का शिक्षण; आलोचनात्मक सोच व संदर्भ आधारित समझ; ग्रामीण छात्रों की फ़ीस सहायता; शास्त्रीय पाठों को समकालीन दृष्टिकोण व वर्तमान घटनाओं से जोड़ना।
steps_en: School use: link a classical poem to a news story of the week
Ask students to rewrite a classic scene in today's setting
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: किसी शास्त्रीय कविता को सप्ताह की किसी खबर से जोड़ें
बच्चे किसी शास्त्रीय दृश्य को आज के परिवेश में दोबारा लिखें
scene: Women's degree college Telugu class discussing a newspaper next to a classical text

name: Dr. Shimi S.L.
school: Electrical Engineering Department Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh
citation: Dr. Shimi S.L. is an Associate Professor in the Electrical Engineering Department at Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh, with 21 years of extensive academic and research experience. Her areas of specialization include Power Electronics and Drives, Electro-mobility, Power Quality, Advanced Control Theory, Soft Computing Techniques, and hardware implementation. She completed her postdoctoral research in Electromobility at Luleå Technical University, Sweden (2019–2021). She was awarded an Indian Patent for a “Multilevel Inverter” in February 2024 and has co-investigated the DST Chandigarh-funded project “Emergency Vehicle Preemption.” She is currently investigating a project on measurement-based impact studies of solar PV and electric vehicle integration into the grid. Dr. Shimi played a key role in establishing the Centre of Excellence in Hardware-in-Loop (HIL) Simulation in collaboration with Typhoon HIL, Switzerland. She has also contributed to several real-time projects, including solar-powered smart classrooms, IoT-based smart laboratories, and EV charging stations. During 2018–19, she developed MOOCs under the SWAYAM platform on Real-Time Power System Analysis and Smart Grid, significantly contributing to technology-enabled learning.
core: Power electronics, electromobility, smart grids, renewable energy integration, applied research, innovation, and technology-enabled education.
t_en: Hardware-in-loop lab and patent-oriented power electronics
t_hi: हार्डवेयर-इन-लूप लैब और पेटेंट उन्मुख पावर इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स
s_hi: पावर इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, इलेक्ट्रो-मोबिलिटी व सॉफ़्ट कंप्यूटिंग; मल्टीलेवल इन्वर्टर पेटेंट; आपातकालीन वाहन प्राथमिकता प्रोजेक्ट; सौर PV व EV ग्रिड अध्ययन; HIL सिमुलेशन उत्कृष्टता केंद्र।
steps_en: School use: build a simple solar-panel and battery circuit to show energy flow
Discuss electric vehicles and the grid in Science class
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: ऊर्जा प्रवाह दिखाने हेतु सरल सोलर पैनल व बैटरी परिपथ बनाएँ
विज्ञान कक्षा में इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन व ग्रिड पर चर्चा करें
scene: Engineering lab with women students testing an inverter connected to solar panels

name: Prof. Kapil Ahuja
school: Department of Computer Science and Engineering IIT Indore, Madhya Pradesh
citation: Prof. Kapil Ahuja is a Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Indore with 14 years of teaching and research experience in India and the United States. A four-time recipient of the Best Teacher Award at IIT Indore, his teaching methodology emphasizes open-ended, project-based learning that fosters critical thinking and innovation. He also initiated the first Master of Science by Research (MSR) program at IIT Indore. Prof. Ahuja has successfully executed fifteen sponsored research projects and has published forty-four research papers. His notable work includes modeling social cloud systems as strategic network formation games and proposing the novel concept of Bilateral Stability, enabling organizations to create more efficient collaborative networks. Beyond academics, he served as the founding Dean of International Affairs at IIT Indore, playing a pivotal role in establishing and strengthening the institute’s global collaborations.
core: Innovative pedagogy, computer science research, project-based learning, strategic network modeling, and academic leadership.
t_en: Open-ended project-based learning in computer science
t_hi: कंप्यूटर विज्ञान में खुली प्रोजेक्ट आधारित शिक्षा
s_hi: चार बार सर्वश्रेष्ठ शिक्षक; खुली प्रोजेक्ट आधारित शिक्षा से आलोचनात्मक सोच व नवाचार; IIT इंदौर में MSR कार्यक्रम; 15 प्रायोजित शोध प्रोजेक्ट; अंतरराष्ट्रीय मामलों के संस्थापक डीन।
steps_en: School use: give an open problem with many possible answers (design a school app) instead of one right answer
Grade the process, not just the result
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: एक सही उत्तर के बजाय कई संभावित उत्तरों वाली खुली समस्या दें (विद्यालय ऐप डिज़ाइन करो)
केवल परिणाम नहीं, प्रक्रिया का भी मूल्यांकन करें
scene: IIT students presenting different solutions to the same open-ended project on whiteboards

name: Dr. Anitha Suseelan
school: School of Architecture CHRIST University, Bangalore, Karnataka
citation: Dr. Anitha Suseelan is Professor and Head of the School of Architecture at CHRIST University, Bangalore, with over 30 years of experience in Architecture, Urban Design, and Rural Design studies. She pioneered the Rural Studio Program Mission in academia, extending architectural education into rural India through experiential learning and impactful research. Her pedagogy emphasizes student skill development, utilization of local resources and labour, and environmentally low-impact, innovative modular design suited for ecologically and socially sensitive contexts. Dr. Suseelan is a recipient of several prestigious national and international recognitions, including ICSSR funding, Times Higher Education Asia Award 2024 (Top 8), Lafarge Holcim Participation Award 2021, London Design Biennale 2021, Sir Patrick Geddes Award, Vastu Shilpa Foundation Award, Prof. J.C. Alexander Memorial Endowment, and the Sthapathi Samman.
core: Experiential architectural pedagogy, rural and sustainable design, community-oriented architecture, and innovation in higher education.
t_en: Rural Studio: architecture with local resources and labour
t_hi: रूरल स्टूडियो: स्थानीय संसाधन व श्रम से वास्तुकला
s_hi: "रूरल स्टूडियो प्रोग्राम मिशन" से वास्तुकला शिक्षा को ग्रामीण भारत तक; स्थानीय संसाधन व श्रम; पर्यावरण पर कम प्रभाव वाला मॉड्यूलर डिज़ाइन।
steps_en: School use: let students map their village/neighbourhood and suggest one improvement
Build a model using local materials (mud, bamboo)
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: बच्चे अपने गाँव/मोहल्ले का नक्शा बनाकर एक सुधार सुझाएँ
स्थानीय सामग्री (मिट्टी, बाँस) से मॉडल बनाएँ
scene: Architecture students building a bamboo-and-mud shelter with villagers

name: Prof. Shahanaz Ayub
school: Bundelkhand Institute of Engineering & Technology Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh
citation: Prof. Shahanaz Ayub has 25 years of experience with the Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering at the Bundelkhand Institute of Engineering & Technology, Jhansi. She has extensive expertise in both industrial research and teaching and has been recognized for her outstanding contributions to engineering education. She was conferred with the prestigious AICTE Visvesvaraya Best Teacher Award (2021) . Prof. Ayub serves as a Mentor of Change under NITI Aayog’s ATAL Tinkering Labs initiative. To promote innovation, start-ups, and entrepreneurship among students, faculty, and staff, she introduced a credit course on Idea to Business Model and played a pivotal role in establishing an Incubation Centre at her institute.
core: Engineering education, innovation and entrepreneurship development, industrial research integration, and start-up ecosystem building.
t_en: Idea-to-Business-Model course and ATL Mentor of Change
t_hi: आइडिया-टू-बिज़नेस-मॉडल पाठ्यक्रम और ATL मेंटर ऑफ़ चेंज
s_hi: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स व संचार में 25 वर्ष; AICTE विश्वेश्वरैया सर्वश्रेष्ठ शिक्षक; नीति आयोग अटल टिंकरिंग लैब की "मेंटर ऑफ़ चेंज"; "आइडिया टू बिज़नेस मॉडल" क्रेडिट कोर्स; इनक्यूबेशन केंद्र।
steps_en: School use: invite a nearby engineering teacher as an ATL mentor (Mentor of Change)
Teach a one-page business model canvas for student ideas
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: पास के इंजीनियरिंग शिक्षक को ATL मेंटर (मेंटर ऑफ़ चेंज) बनाएँ
छात्र विचारों हेतु एक-पेज बिज़नेस मॉडल कैनवास सिखाएँ
scene: Woman professor mentoring school students in an Atal Tinkering Lab

name: Dr. Subbiah Brindha
school: PSG Polytechnic College, Coimbatore Tamil Nadu
citation: Dr. Subbiah Brindha is a passionate teacher and Head of the Computer Networking department at PSG Polytechnic College, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. She has over 20 years of experience teaching diploma students, many of whom consider her a role model. She actively encourages young girls to pursue careers in computer networking, a traditionally male-dominated sector. Despite multiple offers from degree institutions, Dr. Brindha chose to continue at the polytechnic, recognizing the critical impact on students from socio-economically backward backgrounds. She has developed strong industry connections, enabling students to secure internships and employment, and helped establish an industry-sponsored IoT laboratory. Under her leadership, a new Diploma Programme in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning was launched. Dr. Brindha also played a key role in obtaining NBA Accreditation for the Computer Engineering department in 2011 and 2021 — a commendable achievement for a diploma institution.
core: Diploma education leadership, industry collaboration, female student empowerment, and program accreditation.
t_en: Encouraging girls in computer networking and industry IoT lab
t_hi: कंप्यूटर नेटवर्किंग में बालिकाओं को प्रोत्साहन और उद्योग IoT लैब
s_hi: डिप्लोमा छात्रों की प्रेरणा; पुरुष-प्रधान क्षेत्र में बालिकाओं को कंप्यूटर नेटवर्किंग हेतु प्रोत्साहन; उद्योग संपर्क से इंटर्नशिप व रोज़गार; उद्योग प्रायोजित IoT लैब; AI-ML डिप्लोमा।
steps_en: School use: invite women engineers to talk to girls in Classes 8–10
Give girls equal (or first) lab time
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: कक्षा 8–10 की बालिकाओं से बात करने महिला इंजीनियरों को बुलाएँ
बालिकाओं को प्रयोगशाला में बराबर (या पहले) समय दें
scene: Polytechnic women students configuring network routers in an IoT lab

name: Smt Mehta Zankhana Dilipbhai
citation: Smt. Mehta Zankhana Dilipbhai is a Lecturer in the Department of Instrumentation and Control Engineering at Government Polytechnic, Ahmedabad, Gujarat. She teaches Instrumentation and Control Engineering and Automation & Robotics Engineering and is extremely popular among her students. Beyond academics, she motivates students to pursue entrepreneurial ventures by developing innovative products and technologies. She established the Project and Innovation Lab and has overseen multiple projects. The Government of Gujarat recognized her efforts in mentoring innovation and start-up activities for diploma students by awarding her the “SSIP Prashansa Award-2020”. Smt. Mehta also serves as a Psychological Counsellor, available to students even after office hours. She contributes to curriculum development as a member of the board of studies for new courses like Automation and Robotics Engineering and mentors degree engineering students during internships.
core: Mentoring, innovation, entrepreneurship, student counselling, and curriculum development.
t_en: Innovation lab for diploma students and counselling after hours
t_hi: डिप्लोमा छात्रों हेतु इनोवेशन लैब और समय के बाद परामर्श
s_hi: इंस्ट्रुमेंटेशन, ऑटोमेशन व रोबोटिक्स; उद्यमिता हेतु प्रेरणा; प्रोजेक्ट व इनोवेशन लैब; SSIP प्रशंसा पुरस्कार; मनोवैज्ञानिक परामर्शदाता—कार्यालय समय के बाद भी उपलब्ध।
steps_en: School use: keep one 'open door' time per week for students to talk
Give student teams a small robotics or automation task
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: हर हफ्ते बच्चों से बात करने के लिए एक 'खुला दरवाज़ा' समय रखें
छात्र टीमों को छोटा रोबोटिक्स या ऑटोमेशन कार्य दें
scene: Ahmedabad polytechnic innovation lab with a woman lecturer guiding a robotics project

name: Prof. Keshav Kashinath Sangle
school: Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute, Mumbai, Maharashtra
citation: Prof. Keshav Kashinath Sangle is a highly effective and popular teacher, a competent administrator, and an excellent researcher. With over two decades of experience, he has developed an innovative teaching methodology by integrating learnings from live industry, government, and research projects into his pedagogy, with strong emphasis on problem-solving. He has innovatively revised curricula in alignment with NEP and implemented government programs like Prerna, Margdarshan, and TEQIP-II Mentor-Mentee schemes to support students and engineering colleges nationwide. He also founded a Skill Development Centre for the Maharashtra State Government, enhancing employability for rural students in Ratnagiri District. Prof. Sangle holds membership in multiple national and international professional bodies.
core: Innovative pedagogy, curriculum development, mentoring, and skill development for rural students.
t_en: Live industry projects in pedagogy and rural skill centre
t_hi: शिक्षण में लाइव उद्योग प्रोजेक्ट और ग्रामीण कौशल केंद्र
s_hi: उद्योग, सरकार व शोध प्रोजेक्ट से सीख को शिक्षण में जोड़ा; NEP अनुरूप पाठ्यक्रम; प्रेरणा, मार्गदर्शन, TEQIP मेंटर-मेंटी योजनाएँ; रत्नागिरी में ग्रामीण छात्रों हेतु कौशल विकास केंद्र।
steps_en: School use: bring a real problem from a local workplace into a maths/science lesson
Connect students to a skill centre for summer courses
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: किसी स्थानीय कार्यस्थल की वास्तविक समस्या को गणित/विज्ञान पाठ में लाएँ
ग्रीष्मकालीन पाठ्यक्रमों हेतु बच्चों को कौशल केंद्र से जोड़ें
scene: Civil engineering students on a live construction site with a professor

name: Dr. S.R. Mahadeva Prasanna
school: Indian Institute of Technology, Dharwad, Karnataka
citation: Dr. S.R. Mahadeva Prasanna is a Professor of Electronics & Communication Engineering at IIT Dharwad, Karnataka. Coming from a family of educators, his passion for teaching is reflected in his methodology and excellent student feedback. He played a pivotal role in the development of IIT Guwahati and the establishment of IIT Dharwad. He introduced specialized courses such as speech processing, neural networks, and deep learning, tailoring them for students from diverse departments, enabling them to secure admissions in esteemed institutions nationally and internationally. Dr. Prasanna actively mentors faculty from other engineering colleges in teaching, research, and project proposal writing. His initiatives include multiple faculty development programs, workshops, conferences, invited talks, and cultural events. He also fosters industry-academia collaborations and guides research groups, enriching both campus and external institutions.
core: Innovative teaching, mentorship, faculty development, and research-industry collaboration.
t_en: Courses tailored for diverse departments and mentoring other faculty
t_hi: विविध विभागों हेतु अनुकूलित पाठ्यक्रम और अन्य संकाय की मेंटरिंग
s_hi: IIT गुवाहाटी व IIT धारवाड़ के विकास में भूमिका; स्पीच प्रोसेसिंग, न्यूरल नेटवर्क, डीप लर्निंग पाठ्यक्रम विविध विभागों के लिए अनुकूलित; अन्य कॉलेजों के संकाय की मेंटरिंग।
steps_en: School use: adapt one lesson for students with different interests (art vs science)
Mentor a new teacher in your school
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: अलग रुचियों (कला बनाम विज्ञान) वाले बच्चों के लिए एक पाठ अनुकूलित करें
अपने विद्यालय के किसी नए शिक्षक के मेंटर बनें
scene: Professor mentoring young faculty from other colleges in a workshop

name: Dr. Dinesh Babu J
school: International Institute of Information Technology, Bangalore, Karnataka
citation: Dr. Dinesh Babu is an Associate Professor at IIIT Bangalore, Karnataka. Renowned for highly engaging lectures, he has developed a unique problem-theory-practice methodology for teaching complex theories in a simple and effective way. He has implemented best practices for teaching large classes (300+ students), including weekly student feedback. His online course on Predictive Analytics has benefited thousands of students. Beyond his institution, Dr. Babu actively supports rural and secondary school students. He participated in the Excite program at IIITB and developed a Virtual Reality interview platform, employing AI and VR with five virtual interviewers, now adopted by Karnataka government's minority affairs department to train rural students for competitive exams.
core: Innovative teaching, large-class pedagogy, VR-based student training, and mentorship.
t_en: Problem–theory–practice method and AI-VR interview platform
t_hi: समस्या-सिद्धांत-अभ्यास पद्धति और AI-VR साक्षात्कार मंच
s_hi: जटिल सिद्धांत सरल बनाने की "समस्या-सिद्धांत-अभ्यास" पद्धति; 300+ छात्रों की बड़ी कक्षा हेतु साप्ताहिक फ़ीडबैक; ग्रामीण छात्रों हेतु AI-VR साक्षात्कार मंच जिसे कर्नाटक सरकार ने अपनाया।
steps_en: School use: start a lesson with a problem, then teach the theory, then practise
Collect a 2-question feedback slip every week
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: पाठ की शुरुआत समस्या से, फिर सिद्धांत, फिर अभ्यास
हर हफ्ते 2 प्रश्नों वाली फ़ीडबैक पर्ची लें
scene: Large lecture hall with a professor posing a problem on screen before theory

name: Dr. Farheen Bano
school: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh
citation: Dr. Farheen Bano is a highly inspiring assistant professor at AKTU, Lucknow. She teaches Architectural Design, Drawing, History, Services, Energy Conservation, and Simulation. Beyond deep subject knowledge, she guides students in creative thinking, critical analysis, and overall personality development, significantly impacting their personal and professional growth. Dr. Bano actively encourages students to pursue research in Architecture and is a go-to mentor for brainstorming, doubt clearance, field research, and career guidance. Her empathetic, non-judgmental approach has created long-lasting bonds with students. Awards and recognition include: - International Best Researcher in Architecture Award, Rula Awards: Research Peace Awards (2019) - Best Teacher Award, AKTU Lucknow (2021) - Outstanding Teacher Award (उ कृ ट fश क पुर कार), International Institute of Organized Research (I2OR), Government of India (2022)
core: Architectural teaching, research mentorship, creative pedagogy, and student guidance.
t_en: Empathetic mentoring in architecture
t_hi: वास्तुकला में सहानुभूतिपूर्ण मेंटरिंग
s_hi: वास्तुकला डिज़ाइन, ड्रॉइंग, इतिहास व ऊर्जा संरक्षण पढ़ाती हैं; रचनात्मक व आलोचनात्मक सोच; शोध प्रोत्साहन; सहानुभूतिपूर्ण, बिना-जजमेंट मेंटरिंग से छात्रों से दीर्घ संबंध।
steps_en: School use: hold non-judgemental doubt-clearing time after class
Help students plan careers using their drawing/design interests
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: कक्षा के बाद बिना-जजमेंट डाउट समाधान समय रखें
ड्रॉइंग/डिज़ाइन रुचि वाले बच्चों को करियर योजना में मदद करें
scene: Architecture studio with a woman professor discussing a student's sketch kindly

name: Shri Suman Chakraborty
citation: Prof. Suman Chakraborty is a distinguished professor in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at IIT Kharagpur. He established India’s first-ever global-standard Microfluidics Lab and developed innovative frugal bench-top experiments for effective teaching and learning, which evolved into high-quality products. He mentors a broad spectrum of students, including Post-Docs, Ph.D. scholars (50+), masters, graduates, and even school students. His primary focus is on interdisciplinary areas and emerging technologies. Prof. Chakraborty also guides student-driven start-ups and trains socially-challenged rural entrepreneurs, especially girls, in creating sustainable rural healthcare enterprises. His excellence has been recognized with multiple national and international accolades, including: - Fellowship of the American Physical Society - Fellowship of the Royal Society of Chemistry - Fellowship of the American Society of Mechanical Engineering - Infosys Prize - Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize (Government of India) Prof. Chakraborty is celebrated as both a passionate teacher and an outstanding researcher, widely regarded among the best at IIT Kharagpur.
core: Microfluidics, interdisciplinary research, innovative pedagogy, and student mentorship.
t_en: Frugal bench-top experiments and rural healthcare entrepreneurs
t_hi: किफ़ायती बेंच-टॉप प्रयोग और ग्रामीण स्वास्थ्य उद्यमी
s_hi: भारत की पहली वैश्विक-स्तरीय माइक्रोफ़्लूइडिक्स लैब; शिक्षण हेतु किफ़ायती बेंच-टॉप प्रयोग जो उत्पाद बने; विद्यालय छात्रों तक मेंटरिंग; ग्रामीण बालिकाओं को स्वास्थ्य उद्यम हेतु प्रशिक्षण।
steps_en: School use: design 'frugal' experiments with syringes, straws and food colour
Show how a classroom experiment can become a useful product
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: सिरिंज, स्ट्रॉ और खाद्य रंग से 'किफ़ायती' प्रयोग बनाएँ
दिखाएँ कि कक्षा का प्रयोग कैसे उपयोगी उत्पाद बन सकता है
scene: IIT lab with a professor showing a paper-based microfluidic device to rural girls

name: Shri Sayam Sen Gupta
citation: Shri Sayam Sen Gupta is a Professor in the Department of Chemical Sciences at IISER Kolkata. He is an excellent teacher and researcher, actively involved in science outreach, particularly among municipal school students. He ran a corporate-funded “Exciting Science” group for a decade, which aimed to convey the excitement of science and technology to school students. His group adopted three Pune Municipal Corporation Schools, where weekly science club sessions helped students learn the scientific method—making observations, framing hypotheses, reaching conclusions, and formulating research questions. In addition to his teaching outreach, Prof. Sen Gupta has undertaken several sponsored research projects funded by SERB and DST.
core: Science education outreach, chemical sciences research, mentoring school students.
t_en: Adopting municipal schools for weekly science clubs
t_hi: साप्ताहिक विज्ञान क्लब हेतु नगर निगम विद्यालयों को गोद लेना
s_hi: उत्कृष्ट शिक्षक व शोधकर्ता; नगर निगम विद्यालयों में विज्ञान आउटरीच; दस वर्षों तक "एक्साइटिंग साइंस" समूह; पुणे के तीन नगर निगम विद्यालय गोद लेकर साप्ताहिक विज्ञान क्लब—अवलोकन, परिकल्पना, निष्कर्ष।
steps_en: School use: invite a nearby college to run a weekly science club
Teach the scientific method cycle: observe → hypothesise → test → conclude
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: पास के कॉलेज को साप्ताहिक विज्ञान क्लब चलाने बुलाएँ
वैज्ञानिक पद्धति चक्र सिखाएँ: देखो → परिकल्पना → परीक्षण → निष्कर्ष
scene: University scientists running a science club with municipal-school children doing experiments

name: Dr. Chandragouda Raosaheb Patil
school: R.C. Patel Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Shirpur, Dist. Dhule, Maharashtra
citation: Dr. Chandragouda Raosaheb Patil is a Professor in the Department of Pharmacology at R.C. Patel Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Shirpur, with over 20 years of teaching experience. He strives to make himself accessible to students using modern pedagogical tools. A pharmacologist by profession, he has developed software and hardware tools in his field, used for more than two decades by teachers and students in Pharmacy, Medical, and paramedical institutions across India and abroad. His artificial mice device gained prominence after the ban on animal-based experiments and dissections. Dr. Patil’s contributions have been recognized with awards such as “The Best Presentation Award” and “Young Scientist Award” from World Congresses on Alternatives to Animals in Life Sciences (Rome, Italy and Tokyo, Japan), as well as the “Innovator Teacher Award” from the Education Ministry and “Young Scientist Award” from the AYUSH Ministry.
core: Pharmacology education, development of educational tools, innovative alternatives to animal experimentation.
t_en: Artificial mouse device replacing animal dissection
t_hi: पशु विच्छेदन का स्थान लेने वाला कृत्रिम चूहा उपकरण
s_hi: आधुनिक शिक्षण उपकरणों से सुलभता; फ़ार्माकोलॉजी में सॉफ़्टवेयर-हार्डवेयर उपकरण; पशु प्रयोग प्रतिबंध के बाद "कृत्रिम चूहा" उपकरण प्रसिद्ध; "इनोवेटर टीचर अवार्ड"।
steps_en: School use: use models, apps or simulations instead of dissection
Discuss ethics of animal use in science
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: विच्छेदन के बजाय मॉडल, ऐप या सिमुलेशन का प्रयोग करें
विज्ञान में पशु उपयोग की नैतिकता पर चर्चा करें
scene: Pharmacy students practising on an artificial mouse model instead of a live animal

name: Dr. Raghavan B. Sunoj
citation: Dr. Raghavan B. Sunoj is an outstanding Chemistry Professor at IIT Bombay, renowned for inspiring and motivating young students to pursue science as a career. He has played a key role in outreach programs such as the national-level "Teach Ten Thousand College Teachers" initiative, and has actively promoted problem-solving approaches to organic chemistry for rural colleges. He has contributed to summer school programs in theoretical and organic chemistry and guided students through innovative learning methods. Dr. Sunoj’s excellence in teaching has been recognized with multiple awards, including the Prof. S. P. Sukhatme Excellence in Teaching Award (IIT Bombay, 2017) and the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Chemical Sciences (2019). His students consider him among the best teachers at IIT Bombay.
t_en: "Teach Ten Thousand College Teachers" and problem-solving chemistry
t_hi: "टीच टेन थाउज़ेंड कॉलेज टीचर्स" और समस्या-समाधान रसायन
s_hi: युवा छात्रों को विज्ञान करियर हेतु प्रेरित किया; राष्ट्रीय "टीच टेन थाउज़ेंड कॉलेज टीचर्स" कार्यक्रम; ग्रामीण कॉलेजों हेतु समस्या-समाधान आधारित कार्बनिक रसायन; शांति स्वरूप भटनागर पुरस्कार।
steps_en: School use: teach reactions through puzzle-like 'what happens next?' problems
Join online teacher-training from IITs to update your subject
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: अभिक्रियाओं को पहेली जैसे 'आगे क्या होगा?' प्रश्नों से पढ़ाएँ
अपने विषय को अद्यतन करने हेतु IIT के ऑनलाइन शिक्षक प्रशिक्षण से जुड़ें
scene: IIT Bombay chemistry professor leading a workshop for college teachers with reaction puzzles

name: Prof. Indranath Sengupta
citation: Prof. Indranath Sengupta is one of the most popular teachers at IIT Gandhinagar. Known for his approachable personality and excellent listening skills, his lucid teaching methods make complex mathematical theories engaging and accessible. Many of his students have gone on to become faculty members at premier Indian institutions, reflecting his profound impact. He dedicates hours to mentoring students, addressing their queries, and helping them overcome academic inhibitions. He also coordinates the Student Support Service cell at IIT Gandhinagar, promoting student welfare. Beyond classroom teaching, Prof. Sengupta actively participates in outreach activities and workshops to promote mathematics education nationwide. He strongly believes a teacher’s role is to teach “how to ask good questions” and has developed an online course module in Mathematics for e-PG Pathshala to reach students through digital resources.
t_en: Teaching students "how to ask good questions" in mathematics
t_hi: गणित में "अच्छे प्रश्न पूछना" सिखाना
s_hi: सबसे लोकप्रिय शिक्षक; सरल शिक्षण से जटिल गणित सुलभ; घंटों मेंटरिंग; छात्र सहायता प्रकोष्ठ; मानना है कि शिक्षक का काम "अच्छे प्रश्न पूछना" सिखाना है; e-PG पाठशाला मॉड्यूल।
steps_en: School use: end each class by asking students to write one good question
Display the 'question of the week' on a board
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: हर कक्षा के अंत में बच्चों से एक अच्छा प्रश्न लिखवाएँ
'सप्ताह का प्रश्न' बोर्ड पर प्रदर्शित करें
scene: IIT Gandhinagar maths professor listening to a student's question in a small group

name: Dr. Ashish Baldi
school: Maharaja Ranjit Singh Punjab Technical University, Bathinda, Punjab
citation: Dr. Ashish Baldi is currently Professor and Dean, Faculty of Pharmacy at Maharaja Ranjit Singh Punjab Technical University, Bathinda. With over 20 years of academic experience, he excels in innovative pedagogical approaches, creating an interactive and critical thinking-driven learning environment. Beyond exceptional teaching, his mentorship has shaped the professional paths of numerous students. As Chief Mentor of IDEA Lab, he has fostered an ecosystem for innovative and out-of-the-box thinking, resulting in the development of many student-driven products. Dr. Baldi combines student-centric academic excellence, impactful research, strong administrative skills, and societal contributions, establishing himself as a distinguished teacher in the field of Pharmacy.
t_en: IDEA Lab for student-driven pharmacy products
t_hi: छात्र-संचालित फ़ार्मेसी उत्पादों हेतु IDEA लैब
s_hi: नवाचारी शिक्षण से इंटरैक्टिव व आलोचनात्मक सोच वाला वातावरण; IDEA लैब के मुख्य मेंटर—अनेक छात्र-निर्मित उत्पाद; छात्र-केंद्रित उत्कृष्टता।
steps_en: School use: keep an 'idea lab' corner where students prototype health/hygiene products (hand-wash, herbal balm)
Hold an idea fair
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: 'आइडिया लैब' कोना रखें जहाँ बच्चे स्वास्थ्य/स्वच्छता उत्पाद (हैंडवॉश, हर्बल बाम) बनाएँ
आइडिया मेला लगाएँ
scene: Pharmacy students in an IDEA lab formulating a herbal product

name: Dr. Satya Ranjan Acharya
school: Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India, Bhat, Gandhinagar, Gujarat
citation: Dr. Satya Ranjan Acharya is Professor and Director of the Department of Entrepreneurship Education at the Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India. He specializes in training both budding and established entrepreneurs. His mentoring extends beyond classrooms, exemplified by the "Hastakala Setu" project, through which he supports over 20,000 traditional artisans across 33 districts of Gujarat in training, market exposure, and financial management. He is recognized for his teaching in courses such as New Enterprise Creation and Entrepreneurial Finance. Additionally, Dr. Acharya organizes and conducts management development programs and faculty development programs on entrepreneurship teaching and startup incubation, collaborating with the Government of Gujarat and the Ministry of Education.
t_en: "Hastakala Setu" supporting 20,000 artisans
t_hi: "हस्तकला सेतु" से 20,000 कारीगरों को सहयोग
s_hi: उभरते व स्थापित उद्यमियों का प्रशिक्षण; "हस्तकला सेतु" प्रोजेक्ट से गुजरात के 33 ज़िलों के 20,000+ पारंपरिक कारीगरों को प्रशिक्षण, बाज़ार व वित्त प्रबंधन; उद्यमिता शिक्षण पर संकाय विकास।
steps_en: School use: invite a local artisan to teach a craft and discuss how they sell it
Let students design a label/price for a craft product
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: किसी स्थानीय कारीगर को शिल्प सिखाने और बिक्री के तरीके पर बात करने बुलाएँ
बच्चे शिल्प उत्पाद का लेबल/मूल्य तय करें
scene: Gujarati artisans displaying embroidery at a training camp with a professor explaining pricing

name: Ms. Yaku Tame
school: Government Secondary School, G-Sector Naharlagun, Papum Pare

name: Shri Rajesh Bordoloi
school: Adarsha Tribal Higher Secondary School, Jorhat

name: Ms. Sangeeta Yadav
school: St. Joseph's Convent Sr. Sec. School, Idgah Hills, Bhopal
citation: Transformed mathematics learning by moving away from rote memorisation towards exploration and problem-solving. Through initiatives such as GANITOTSAV, MathEMind and Mathletics she encourages critical thinking, creativity and collaboration among students.
t_en: GANITOTSAV and Mathletics: exploration over rote maths
t_hi: गणितोत्सव और मैथलेटिक्स: रटने के बजाय खोज से गणित
s_hi: गणित को रटने से हटाकर खोज व समस्या समाधान पर केंद्रित किया; गणितोत्सव, MathEMind और मैथलेटिक्स से आलोचनात्मक सोच, रचनात्मकता व सहयोग।
steps_en: Hold a yearly 'Ganitotsav' with maths games, puzzles and model stalls
Replace one drill worksheet a week with an open problem groups explore
Run a 'Mathletics' relay where teams solve problems at stations
steps_hi: हर साल गणित खेलों, पहेलियों और मॉडल स्टॉल के साथ 'गणितोत्सव' मनाएँ
हर हफ्ते एक अभ्यास वर्कशीट की जगह खुली समस्या दें जिसे समूह खोजें
'मैथलेटिक्स' रिले करें जिसमें टीमें स्टेशनों पर प्रश्न हल करें
scene: Bhopal schoolgirls at a maths festival running between puzzle stations, a banner reading Ganitotsav

name: Shri Ravi Jaiswal
school: Govt. Model High School, Maloya Colony

name: Ms. Sunita Yadav
citation: Built a smart classroom with community support and expanded community initiatives such as Nyota Bhojan and home-reading campaigns, showing how school–community collaboration can strengthen learning.
t_en: Community-supported smart class, Nyota Bhojan and home reading
t_hi: समुदाय सहयोग से स्मार्ट क्लास, न्योता भोजन और घर पर पठन
s_hi: समुदाय सहयोग से स्मार्ट क्लासरूम; न्योता भोजन (समुदाय द्वारा बच्चों को भोजन) और घर पर पठन अभियान का विस्तार; विद्यालय-समुदाय सहयोग से शिक्षा मज़बूत।
steps_en: Invite families to sponsor a special meal (Nyota Bhojan) on birthdays or festivals
Send a book home weekly with a parent reading card
Show the smart class to donors who helped build it
steps_hi: परिवारों को जन्मदिन या त्योहार पर विशेष भोजन (न्योता भोजन) प्रायोजित करने बुलाएँ
हर हफ्ते अभिभावक पठन कार्ड के साथ एक किताब घर भेजें
जिन दानदाताओं ने स्मार्ट क्लास बनवाई उन्हें कक्षा दिखाएँ
scene: Chhattisgarh village school where families serve a festive meal to children, a smart TV classroom in the background

name: Ms. Patel Purnima Mohanlal
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

name: Md. Zafar Alam
citation: Over two decades at EMRS Karanjia, he combined technology, sports and tribal heritage to support students beyond academics. Under his leadership the school reached 100% Class X results and won 16 national sports medals; he also improved enrolment, ran anti-addiction drives and guided students to higher education.
t_en: Technology, sports and tribal heritage in an EMRS
t_hi: EMRS में तकनीक, खेल और जनजातीय विरासत
s_hi: दो दशकों से तकनीक, खेल और जनजातीय विरासत को जोड़कर पढ़ाई से आगे सहयोग; कक्षा 10 में 100% परिणाम, 16 राष्ट्रीय खेल पदक; नामांकन वृद्धि, नशा-विरोधी पहल, उच्च शिक्षा मार्गदर्शन।
steps_en: Celebrate a tribal heritage day with local art, music and food
Run daily sports training with a target competition
Hold anti-addiction sessions with peer leaders
steps_hi: स्थानीय कला, संगीत और भोजन के साथ जनजातीय विरासत दिवस मनाएँ
लक्ष्य प्रतियोगिता के साथ रोज़ खेल प्रशिक्षण चलाएँ
साथी नेताओं के साथ नशा-विरोधी सत्र करें
scene: Odisha EMRS tribal students in traditional dress after archery practice, medals displayed, a computer lab nearby

name: Shri Mahadev Hanamant Shinde
citation: Focused on inclusive education by developing digital and activity-based learning resources for children with disabilities, and supports other educators in making classrooms more inclusive.
t_en: Digital and activity resources for children with disabilities
t_hi: दिव्यांग बच्चों के लिए डिजिटल व गतिविधि संसाधन
s_hi: दिव्यांग बच्चों के लिए डिजिटल व गतिविधि आधारित संसाधन बनाकर समावेशी शिक्षा; अन्य शिक्षकों को कक्षाएँ समावेशी बनाने में सहायता।
steps_en: Make picture-based activity cards for each daily routine and lesson
Use free apps with large buttons and audio for children with special needs
Share your resources with mainstream teachers
steps_hi: हर दैनिक दिनचर्या व पाठ के लिए चित्र आधारित गतिविधि कार्ड बनाएँ
विशेष आवश्यकता वाले बच्चों के लिए बड़े बटन और ऑडियो वाले मुफ्त ऐप अपनाएँ
अपने संसाधन सामान्य कक्षा के शिक्षकों से साझा करें
scene: Goa special school where a teacher helps a child with a tablet learning app, activity picture cards on the table

name: Ms. Munmun Bhattacherjee
citation: Empowers a vulnerable coal-mining community through education. Aligned with NEP 2020 and NIPUN Bharat, she uses low-cost FLN tools, art-integrated learning and vocational exposure to close poverty-linked learning gaps; her students have become young artists, NEET aspirants and self-reliant vocational entrepreneurs.
t_en: Low-cost FLN tools and art for a coal-mining community
t_hi: कोयला खनन समुदाय के लिए कम लागत FLN उपकरण और कला
s_hi: वंचित कोयला-खनन समुदाय को शिक्षा से सशक्त किया; NEP व निपुण भारत के अनुरूप कम लागत FLN उपकरण, कला समेकित शिक्षा और व्यावसायिक अनुभव; बच्चे युवा कलाकार, NEET अभ्यर्थी व आत्मनिर्भर उद्यमी बने।
steps_en: Make FLN kits from coal-area waste (bottle caps, cartons) for letters and numbers
Use drawing and painting to retell every story read
Introduce one simple vocational skill (stitching, craft) for older students
steps_hi: कोयला क्षेत्र के कबाड़ (ढक्कन, डिब्बे) से अक्षर व संख्या के FLN किट बनाएँ
पढ़ी गई हर कहानी को चित्रकला से दोबारा कहलवाएँ
बड़े बच्चों के लिए एक सरल व्यावसायिक कौशल (सिलाई, शिल्प) शुरू करें
scene: Dhanbad coal-belt middle school children painting colourful pictures beside FLN number cards made from waste

name: Ms. Rathnakumari S
school: Government Higher Primary School Samatagaru, Honnebailu

name: Ms. Amutha J
school: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 2, Madurai

name: Dr. Archana Shukla
school: Govt. Mahatma Gandhi Sandipani Hr. Sec. School, BHEL Bhopal

name: Shri Shailendra Pratap Singh
school: Government Middle School Kanjwar, Majhauli, Sidhi

name: Shri Vaibhav Vasantrao Kulkarni
citation: Made mathematics more accessible by creating 700+ open-access mathematics videos that help students and teachers understand concepts beyond the classroom.
t_en: 700+ open-access mathematics videos
t_hi: 700+ ओपन-एक्सेस गणित वीडियो
s_hi: डिजिटल संसाधनों से गणित को सुलभ बनाया; 700 से अधिक मुफ्त गणित वीडियो जो छात्रों और शिक्षकों को कक्षा से आगे अवधारणाएँ समझने में मदद करते हैं।
steps_en: Record one short concept video per topic and organise them chapter-wise
Share a playlist link so students revise anytime
Ask students to suggest the next video topic
steps_hi: हर टॉपिक का एक छोटा अवधारणा वीडियो रिकॉर्ड करें और अध्यायवार व्यवस्थित करें
प्लेलिस्ट लिंक साझा करें ताकि बच्चे कभी भी रिवीज़न करें
अगले वीडियो का विषय बच्चों से सुझवाएँ
scene: Navodaya maths teacher recording a video at a whiteboard with a phone, a playlist on a laptop screen

name: Shri Ganesan S
school: Viduthalai Veerar R Seenuvasan Govt. High School, Mettupalayam

name: Shri Dinesh Kumar
school: Govt. Victoria Girls Senior Secondary School, Patiala

name: Dr. Divyendu Sen
school: Mahatma Gandhi Government School, Pachpahar, Jhalawar
citation: Biology lecturer who brought students into a NASA-supported citizen-science asteroid search campaign; since the COVID-19 period his students have identified 12 asteroid candidates, four with provisional recognition. Also known for work on scientific research and educational equity.
t_en: NASA-supported asteroid search with students
t_hi: छात्रों के साथ नासा-समर्थित क्षुद्रग्रह खोज
s_hi: नासा-समर्थित सिटीज़न साइंस अभियान से जोड़ा; कोविड काल से छात्रों ने 12 संभावित क्षुद्रग्रह खोजे, 4 को अस्थायी मान्यता; विज्ञान को पाठ्यपुस्तक से आगे ले जाकर वैश्विक वैज्ञानिक प्रयासों में भागीदारी।
steps_en: Register your class in a free citizen-science campaign (e.g., IASC asteroid search) for school students
Teach students to compare telescope images and spot moving objects
Celebrate every confirmed finding with a certificate
steps_hi: अपनी कक्षा को विद्यालय छात्रों के लिए मुफ्त सिटीज़न साइंस अभियान (जैसे IASC क्षुद्रग्रह खोज) में पंजीकृत करें
बच्चों को दूरबीन चित्रों की तुलना कर चलती वस्तुएँ पहचानना सिखाएँ
हर पुष्ट खोज का प्रमाणपत्र के साथ उत्सव मनाएँ
scene: Rajasthan government school students analysing star-field images on laptops at night, a poster of an asteroid

name: Dr. Vartika Gulati
school: GGUPS Tumli Ka Bas, Chaksu, Jaipur

name: Shri Shivprasad Arvind Tingare
citation: Recognised for hands-on science education, low-cost instructional design and interactive digital learning; over twelve years his mentorship helped 100+ cadets get selected as officers.
t_en: Low-cost science instruments and officer-cadet mentoring
t_hi: कम लागत विज्ञान उपकरण और कैडेट मेंटरिंग
s_hi: हाथ से करने वाली विज्ञान शिक्षा, कम लागत अनुदेशात्मक डिज़ाइन व इंटरैक्टिव डिजिटल शिक्षण; बारह वर्षों की मेंटरिंग से 100+ कैडेट अधिकारी बने।
steps_en: Design one low-cost instrument per term (periscope, spectroscope from a CD)
Pair each experiment with a short interactive digital quiz
Mentor students for defence careers with alumni talks
steps_hi: हर टर्म एक कम लागत उपकरण बनाएँ (पेरिस्कोप, CD से स्पेक्ट्रोस्कोप)
हर प्रयोग के साथ छोटा इंटरैक्टिव डिजिटल क्विज़ जोड़ें
पूर्व छात्र वार्ता से रक्षा करियर हेतु मेंटरिंग करें
scene: Sainik School Satara cadets building a CD spectroscope and periscope in a lab

name: Ms. Sushma Tamang
school: PM SHRI Govt. Senior Secondary School, Dikling, Pakyong
citation: PGT Chemistry working with remote learners through peer-led education; guides students to national and global competitions and promotes climate education.
t_en: Peer-led learning and climate education in a remote school
t_hi: दूरस्थ विद्यालय में साथी-नेतृत्व शिक्षा और जलवायु शिक्षा
s_hi: दूरस्थ बच्चों के साथ साथी-नेतृत्व शिक्षा; राष्ट्रीय व वैश्विक प्रतियोगिताओं हेतु मार्गदर्शन; जलवायु शिक्षा का प्रसार; PGT रसायन।
steps_en: Train senior students as peer tutors for juniors in Science
Run a climate project: measure rainfall/temperature and compare with past data
Shortlist students for national/global science competitions each year
steps_hi: विज्ञान में वरिष्ठ छात्रों को जूनियर के साथी शिक्षक के रूप में तैयार करें
जलवायु प्रोजेक्ट करें: वर्षा/तापमान मापें और पुराने आँकड़ों से तुलना करें
हर साल राष्ट्रीय/वैश्विक विज्ञान प्रतियोगिताओं हेतु छात्र चुनें
scene: Sikkim mountain school students measuring rainfall with a rain gauge, a senior student tutoring juniors

name: Ms. Bhavani Bompelly
citation: Scaled school enrolment from 40 to 130 children, pioneered pre-primary education and created play-based, digital learning environments that make mathematics and languages easier for young children.
t_en: Pre-primary start and play-based digital learning (40 to 130 children)
t_hi: पूर्व-प्राथमिक शुरुआत और खेल आधारित डिजिटल शिक्षा (40 से 130 बच्चे)
s_hi: नामांकन 40 से 130 तक; पूर्व-प्राथमिक शिक्षा की शुरुआत; खेल आधारित व डिजिटल अधिगम वातावरण से छोटे बच्चों के लिए गणित व भाषा आसान।
steps_en: Open a pre-primary corner with toys, songs and picture books
Use 10-minute play-based digital games for numbers and letters
Invite parents of 3–5 year olds for an open day
steps_hi: खिलौनों, गीतों और चित्र-पुस्तकों के साथ पूर्व-प्राथमिक कोना खोलें
संख्याओं व अक्षरों के लिए 10 मिनट के खेल आधारित डिजिटल खेल रखें
3–5 वर्ष के बच्चों के अभिभावकों को खुले दिवस पर बुलाएँ
scene: Telangana girls' primary school with small children playing number games on a tablet and with blocks

name: Shri Ranjan Debnath
school: PM SHRI Sabroom Girls HS School

name: Dr. Renu Tripathi
school: Govt. Balika Inter College, Vijay Nagar, Ghaziabad
citation: Brought drop-out and out-of-school children from about 60 villages back into education; emphasises STEM, Atal Tinkering Labs and low-cost teaching material to build innovation and problem-solving.
t_en: Bringing out-of-school children of 60 villages back and STEM labs
t_hi: 60 गाँवों के विद्यालय से बाहर बच्चों की वापसी और STEM लैब
s_hi: लगभग 60 गाँवों के ड्रॉपआउट व विद्यालय से बाहर बच्चों को फिर से शिक्षा की मुख्यधारा में जोड़ा; STEM, अटल टिंकरिंग लैब और कम लागत शिक्षण सामग्री से नवाचार व समस्या समाधान।
steps_en: Run a village-wise survey with volunteers to list out-of-school girls
Offer a 'bridge course' to bring them back to grade level
Use tinkering and low-cost models to keep them engaged
steps_hi: स्वयंसेवकों के साथ गाँववार सर्वे कर विद्यालय से बाहर बालिकाओं की सूची बनाएँ
उन्हें कक्षा स्तर तक लाने के लिए 'ब्रिज कोर्स' दें
उन्हें जोड़े रखने के लिए टिंकरिंग और कम लागत मॉडल अपनाएँ
scene: Ghaziabad girls' inter-college tinkering lab with returning students building a model, a map of villages on the wall

name: Dr. Iftkhar Khan
citation: Takes learning beyond the classroom through free Sunday art classes that build students' creativity, plus initiatives on road safety, environment protection and social awareness.
t_en: Free Sunday art classes and social-awareness campaigns
t_hi: निःशुल्क रविवार कला कक्षाएँ और सामाजिक जागरूकता अभियान
s_hi: निःशुल्क रविवार कला कक्षाओं से रचनात्मकता; सड़क सुरक्षा, पर्यावरण संरक्षण व सामाजिक जागरूकता की पहल; शिक्षा को कक्षा की सीमा से आगे ले जाना।
steps_en: Offer a free weekend art class open to any child in the area
Turn art into awareness posters on road safety and environment
Exhibit student art in the market or panchayat hall
steps_hi: क्षेत्र के किसी भी बच्चे के लिए मुफ्त सप्ताहांत कला कक्षा रखें
कला को सड़क सुरक्षा और पर्यावरण पर जागरूकता पोस्टर में बदलें
बच्चों की कला बाज़ार या पंचायत भवन में प्रदर्शित करें
scene: Ballia school courtyard on a Sunday, children painting road-safety posters with a teacher

name: Ms. Shalini Kushwaha
citation: Links technology and creative activities with lessons, using digital resources and AI-based tools to make learning easy and joyful; her school earned 'NIPUN Vidyalaya' recognition.
t_en: AI tools and creative activities for a NIPUN school
t_hi: निपुण विद्यालय हेतु AI टूल और रचनात्मक गतिविधियाँ
s_hi: तकनीक व रचनात्मक गतिविधियों को पढ़ाई से जोड़ा; डिजिटल संसाधन और AI आधारित टूल से सीखना आसान व रोचक; विद्यालय को "निपुण विद्यालय" की पहचान।
steps_en: Use a free AI tool to make level-wise reading passages and picture prompts (teacher checks every output)
Pair each digital activity with a hands-on craft
Track NIPUN benchmarks for every child monthly
steps_hi: मुफ्त AI टूल से स्तरवार पठन अनुच्छेद और चित्र संकेत बनाएँ (हर आउटपुट शिक्षक जाँचें)
हर डिजिटल गतिविधि के साथ एक हस्तशिल्प जोड़ें
हर बच्चे के निपुण लक्ष्य हर महीने ट्रैक करें
scene: Kaushambi composite school children reading AI-generated picture stories on a tablet, crafts on the desk

name: Shri Palash Chowdhury
school: Sri Ramkrishna Sarada Vidyapith Primary School, Purba Bardhaman
citation: Improves student nutrition (he and a colleague contribute about Rs 60,000 a month for breakfast for 300 students), advances digital education and runs inclusive, community-driven school development including CPR and AI sessions for mothers.
t_en: Breakfast for 300 students and digital learning for mothers
t_hi: 300 बच्चों के लिए नाश्ता और माताओं के लिए डिजिटल शिक्षा
s_hi: पोषण सुधार (वे और एक सहकर्मी हर महीने लगभग ₹60,000 देकर 300 बच्चों को नाश्ता कराते हैं), डिजिटल शिक्षा, माताओं के लिए CPR व AI सत्र; समावेशी, समुदाय-संचालित विकास।
steps_en: Start a breakfast or fruit programme with community/donor support
Run monthly sessions for mothers (first aid, using phones for learning)
Track attendance before and after the nutrition programme
steps_hi: समुदाय/दानदाता सहयोग से नाश्ता या फल कार्यक्रम शुरू करें
माताओं के लिए मासिक सत्र (प्राथमिक उपचार, पढ़ाई के लिए फ़ोन का उपयोग) चलाएँ
पोषण कार्यक्रम से पहले और बाद की उपस्थिति ट्रैक करें
scene: Bengal primary school children eating breakfast together, mothers practising CPR on a dummy in the next room

name: Prof. Sankar Prasad Rath
citation: Recognised for research in chemistry and an effective teaching approach that builds students' talent.
t_en: Research-driven chemistry teaching
t_hi: शोध आधारित रसायन शिक्षण
s_hi: रसायन शोध और प्रभावी शिक्षण पद्धति से छात्रों की प्रतिभा निखारने हेतु सम्मानित (समाचार स्रोत; आधिकारिक प्रशस्ति प्रतीक्षित)।
steps_en: School use: share one recent Indian chemistry discovery with Class 11–12 each term
Encourage students to ask research-style 'what if' questions
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: हर टर्म कक्षा 11–12 से एक हालिया भारतीय रसायन खोज साझा करें
बच्चों को शोध जैसे 'अगर ऐसा हो तो?' प्रश्न पूछने को प्रोत्साहित करें
scene: IIT Kanpur chemistry lab with a professor and students around a fume hood

name: Dr. Pukhrambam Lilabati Devi
school: Dept. of Dance and Music, Manipur University, Imphal

name: Prof. Ashutosh Mohan
school: Institute of Management Studies, BHU, Varanasi
citation: About 25 years of teaching with research at the core; 50+ research papers in management education.
t_en: Research-centred management education
t_hi: शोध-केंद्रित प्रबंधन शिक्षा
s_hi: लगभग 25 वर्षों की शिक्षण यात्रा में शोध केंद्र में; 50+ शोध पत्र; विद्यार्थियों हेतु प्रेरक अकादमिक योगदान (समाचार स्रोत; आधिकारिक प्रशस्ति प्रतीक्षित)।
steps_en: School use: run a small class survey project and present findings as a mini research report
Introduce basic data collection skills
steps_hi: विद्यालय में: छोटा कक्षा सर्वे प्रोजेक्ट करें और निष्कर्ष लघु शोध रिपोर्ट के रूप में प्रस्तुत करें
बुनियादी डेटा संग्रह कौशल सिखाएँ
scene: BHU management classroom with students analysing survey charts
